  objectValue,
  type ApplicationIntent,
  type ObjectValue,
} from "./application-draft";
export {
  isApplicationIntent,
  type ApplicationIntent,
} from "./application-draft";

export function ApplicationsPage({
  managed,
  snapshot,
  intents,
  busy,
  onAppend,
  onAmend,
  onReview,
  onInstallation,
  onDirtyChange,
  loadSecrets,
  loadPendingSecrets,
  saveSecrets,
  loadSecretAvailability,
  loadSecretStatuses,
  executionContextKey = "",
  choosePackage,
  onImport,
  draftActive,
  backendError,
  importCompleted = false,
}: {
  choosePackage?: () => Promise<string>;
  onImport: (
    source: string,
    kind: string,
    name: string,
    version: string,
    digest: string,
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
  draftActive: boolean;
  backendError?: string;
  importCompleted?: boolean;
  onProviderSecrets?: (deploymentId: string) => void;
  loadSecrets?: () => Promise<RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation>;
  loadPendingSecrets?: (context: {
    applicationLibrary: string;
    applicationSlot?: string;
  }) => Promise<RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation>;
  saveSecrets?: (input: RuntimeSecretValuesInput) => Promise<void>;
  loadSecretAvailability?: () => Promise<RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation>;
  loadSecretStatuses?: ProjectBackend["getRuntimeSecretStatuses"];
  executionContextKey?: string;
  managed: OpenResult["managed"];
  snapshot: OpenResult["snapshot"];
  intents: ApplicationIntent[];
  busy: boolean;
  onAppend: (intent: ApplicationIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
  onAmend: (
    previous: ApplicationIntent,
    replacement: ApplicationIntent | null,
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
  onReview: () => void;
  onInstallation: () => void;
  onDirtyChange: (dirty: boolean) => void;
}) {
  const { libraries, placements, libraryEndpointGroups } = applicationDraft(
    managed,
    intents,
  );
  const packages = objectValue(managed?.applicationPackages);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState("");
  const [slot, setSlot] = useState("");
  const [tab, setTab] = useState("Общее");
  const [search, setSearch] = useState("");
  const [formEpoch, setFormEpoch] = useState(0);
  const [addingEnvironment, setAddingEnvironment] = useState(false);
  const [create, setCreate] = useState(false);
  const [id, setId] = useState("");
  const [ref, setRef] = useState("");
  const [runtime, setRuntime] = useState("");
  const runtimeOptions = Object.entries(managed?.deployments ?? {})
    .filter(([, row]) => row.serviceType === "docker")
    .map(([key]) => key);
  const selectedRuntime =
    runtime || (runtimeOptions.length === 1 ? runtimeOptions[0] : "");
  const [local, setLocal] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState<Set<string>>(new Set());
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [secretStatusVersion, setSecretStatusVersion] = useState(0);
  const listSecretStatuses = useRuntimeSecretStatuses(
    loadSecretStatuses,
    "applications",
    managed,
    secretStatusVersion,
    executionContextKey,
  )?.applications;
  // One public descriptor query per saved revision and execution context.
  // A fresh query intentionally invalidates attached service inputs on the backend.
  const secretDescriptors = useRef<
    { context: string; operation: RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation } | undefined
  >(undefined);
  const descriptorContext = JSON.stringify([
    managed?.projectRevision,
    executionContextKey,
  ]);
  const secretScope = JSON.stringify([
    selected,
    slot,
    managed?.projectRevision,
    executionContextKey,
  ]);
  const [secretAvailability, setSecretAvailability] = useState<{
    value: RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation;
    snapshot: OpenResult["snapshot"];
    scope: string;
  }>();
  const availabilityGeneration = useRef(0);
  const availabilityQueue = useRef<Promise<void>>(Promise.resolve());
  const secretDescriptorLoad = useRef<
    | {
        context: string;
        promise: Promise<RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation>;
      }
    | undefined
  >(undefined);
  const loadApplicationSecrets = useCallback(async () => {
    if (
      secretDescriptors.current &&
      secretDescriptors.current.context === descriptorContext
    )
      return secretDescriptors.current.operation;
    const revision = managed?.projectRevision ?? "";
    if (secretDescriptorLoad.current?.context === descriptorContext)
      return secretDescriptorLoad.current.promise;
    const promise = loadSecrets!()
      .then((result) => {
        if (secretDescriptorLoad.current?.promise === promise) {
          secretDescriptors.current =
            result.status === "READY" && result.projectRevision === revision
              ? { context: descriptorContext, operation: result }
              : undefined;
        }
        return result;
      })
      .finally(() => {
        if (secretDescriptorLoad.current?.promise === promise)
          secretDescriptorLoad.current = undefined;
      });
    secretDescriptorLoad.current = { context: descriptorContext, promise };
    return promise;
  }, [loadSecrets, managed?.projectRevision, descriptorContext]);
  const refreshSecretAvailability = useCallback(() => {
    const generation = ++availabilityGeneration.current;
    const request = availabilityQueue.current
      .catch(() => {})
      .then(async () => {
        if (generation !== availabilityGeneration.current) return;
        try {
          const cached = secretDescriptors.current;
          const descriptors =
            cached?.context === descriptorContext
              ? cached.operation
              : undefined;
          const result = await loadSecretAvailability!();
          if (generation !== availabilityGeneration.current) return;
          setSecretAvailability(
            result.status === "READY" &&
              result.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision &&
              descriptors?.status === "READY" &&
              result.descriptorSetFingerprint ===
                descriptors.descriptorSetFingerprint
              ? {
                  value: {
                    ...descriptors,
                    applicationSecretAvailability:
                      result.applicationSecretAvailability,
                  },
                  snapshot,
                  scope: secretScope,
                }
              : undefined,
          );
        } catch {
          if (generation === availabilityGeneration.current)
            setSecretAvailability(undefined);
        }
      });
    availabilityQueue.current = request;
    return request;
  }, [
    loadSecretAvailability,
    managed?.projectRevision,
    snapshot,
    secretScope,
    descriptorContext,
  ]);
  const saveApplicationSecrets = async (input: RuntimeSecretValuesInput) => {
    ++availabilityGeneration.current;
    setSecretAvailability(undefined);
    try {
      await saveSecrets!(input);
      setSecretStatusVersion((version) => version + 1);
      if (loadSecretAvailability) await refreshSecretAvailability();
    } catch (error) {
      secretDescriptors.current = undefined;
      ++availabilityGeneration.current;
      setSecretAvailability(undefined);
      throw error;
    }
  };
  const childDirtyKeys = useRef(new Set<string>());
  const [childDirty, setChildDirty] = useState(false);
  const dirty = Object.keys(local).length > 0 || childDirty;
  const markChildDirty = (value: boolean, key = "active") => {
    if (value) childDirtyKeys.current.add(key);
    else childDirtyKeys.current.delete(key);
    setChildDirty(childDirtyKeys.current.size > 0);
    onDirtyChange(
      childDirtyKeys.current.size > 0 || Object.keys(local).length > 0,
    );
  };
  const library = libraries[selected] ?? {};
  const placementHosts = new Set(
    managed?.deployments[String(library.runtimeRef)]?.serviceType === "docker"
      ? [...(managed.hostPlacements ?? []), ...(managed.memberPlacements ?? [])]
          .filter((row) => row.deploymentId === library.runtimeRef)
          .map((row) => row.hostId)
      : [],
  );
  const availablePlacementHosts = Object.keys(managed?.servers ?? {}).filter(
    (host) => placementHosts.has(host),
  );
  const packageDefinition = (kind: string, reference: unknown) =>
    objectValue(
      objectValue(packages[kind + ":" + String(reference)]).definition,
    );
  const definition = packageDefinition("library", library.libraryRef);
  const scenarioMetadata = objectValue(
    packages["library:" + String(library.libraryRef)],
  ).userScenarios;
  const scenarios = Array.isArray(scenarioMetadata)
    ? scenarioMetadata
        .map(objectValue)
        .filter((item) => typeof item.setting === "string")
    : [];
  const libraryParameters = objectValue(
    objectValue(library.overrides).parameters,
  );
  const resourceDefaults = (provider: string, section: string): ObjectValue => {
    const defaults = (value: unknown) =>
      objectValue(objectValue(objectValue(value)[provider])[section]);
    const packaged = defaults(definition.resource_defaults);
    const instance = defaults(library.resource_defaults);
    return Object.fromEntries(
      [...new Set([...Object.keys(packaged), ...Object.keys(instance)])].map(
        (id) => [
          id,
          { ...objectValue(packaged[id]), ...objectValue(instance[id]) },
        ],
      ),
    );
  };
  const declaredConnections = (value: unknown): ObjectValue =>
    Array.isArray(value)
      ? Object.fromEntries(
          value.map((key) => [
            String(key),
            objectValue(objectValue(definition.connections)[String(key)]),
          ]),
        )
      : objectValue(value);
  const recipe = objectValue(definition.slots);
  const bindingHints: Record<string, string> = {};
  const bindingConnectionNames: Record<string, string[]> = {};
  const declareConnection = (connectionName: string, connection: unknown) => {
    const name = objectValue(connection).library_binding;
    if (typeof name === "string") {
      bindingHints[name] = "deployment";
      (bindingConnectionNames[name] ??= []).push(connectionName);
    }
  };
  for (const [name, connection] of Object.entries(
    objectValue(definition.connections),
  )) {
    declareConnection(name, connection);
  }
  for (const raw of Object.values(recipe)) {
    const def = packageDefinition(
      "application",
      objectValue(raw).applicationRef,
    );
    for (const [name, connection] of Object.entries(
      declaredConnections(def.connections),
    )) {
      declareConnection(name, connection);
    }
  }
  for (const raw of Object.values(objectValue(definition.shared_secrets))) {
    const source = objectValue(objectValue(raw).source);
    if (source.kind === "pki_credential" && typeof source.binding === "string")
      bindingHints[source.binding] = "pki";
  }
  const slotDefinition = objectValue(recipe[slot]);
  const appDefinition = packageDefinition(
    "application",
    slotDefinition.applicationRef,
  );
  const appConnections = declaredConnections(appDefinition.connections);
  const defaults = objectValue(appDefinition.defaults);
  const authored = objectValue(objectValue(library.applications)[slot]);
  const overrides = objectValue(authored.overrides);
  const change = (key: string, value: string) => {
    setLocal((v) => ({ ...v, [key]: value }));
    onDirtyChange(true);
  };
  const clearLocal = () => {
    setAddingEnvironment(false);
    setLocal({});
    setEditing(new Set());
    setChildDirty(false);
    childDirtyKeys.current.clear();
    setFormEpoch((v) => v + 1);
    onDirtyChange(false);
  };
  const navigate = (next: () => void) => {
    if (
      dirty &&
      !window.confirm(
        "Отбросить несохранённый ввод формы? Изменения, уже добавленные в черновик проекта, сохранятся.",
      )
    )
      return;
    clearLocal();
    setError("");
    next();
  };
  const send = async (c: ApplicationIntent) => {
    const pendingCreate =
      c.operation === "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment"
        ? intents.find(
            (p) =>
              p.deploymentId === c.deploymentId &&
              p.operation === "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment",
          )
        : undefined;
    const previous =
      pendingCreate ??
      [...intents]
        .reverse()
        .find(
          (p) =>
            p.deploymentId === c.deploymentId &&
            p.entityId === c.entityId &&
            p.hostId === c.hostId &&
            p.setting === c.setting &&
            p.property === c.property &&
            p.operation.replace(/^(Set|Remove|Clear)/, "") ===
              c.operation.replace(/^(Set|Remove|Clear)/, ""),
        );
    try {
      if (
        previous &&
        c.entity &&
        (c.operation === "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment" ||
          c.operation === "SetApplicationLibrarySlot")
      )
        c = { ...c, entity: { ...previous.entity, ...c.entity } };
      if (pendingCreate)
        c = { ...c, operation: "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment" };
      const ok = previous ? await onAmend(previous, c) : await onAppend(c);
      if (ok) {
        setError("");
      }
      return ok;
    } catch {
      setError(
        "Не удалось добавить изменение. Проверьте состояние черновика и повторите.",
      );
      return false;
    }
  };
  const override = (
    setting: string,
    value: unknown,
    property?: string,
  ): ApplicationIntent => ({
    operation: "SetApplicationLibraryOverride",
    deploymentId: selected,
    entityId: slot,
    setting,
    ...(property ? { property } : {}),
    value,
  });
  const remove = (setting: string, property?: string): ApplicationIntent => ({
    operation: "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride",
    deploymentId: selected,
    entityId: slot,
    setting,
    ...(property ? { property } : {}),
  });
  const clearField = (key: string, ok: boolean) => {
    if (!ok) return;
    const next = { ...local };
    delete next[key];
    setLocal(next);
    onDirtyChange(childDirty || Object.keys(next).length > 0);
  };
  const scalar = (
    key: string,
    label: string,
    defaultValue: unknown,
    authoredValue: unknown,
    save: (v: string) => Promise<boolean>,
    reset?: () => Promise<boolean>,
    type = "text",
  ) => (
    <div
      className={
        "application-field" +
        (key === "image" ? " application-image-field" : "")
      }
      key={key}
    >
      <div className="application-field-origin">
        <span>
          {authoredValue === undefined
            ? defaultValue === undefined
              ? "Не задано в пакете"
              : "Из пакета"
            : "Переопределено"}
        </span>
        <button
          className="application-link"
          type="button"
          disabled={busy}
          aria-label={`Переопределить: ${label}`}
          onClick={() => setEditing((current) => new Set(current).add(key))}
        >
          Переопределить
        </button>
      </div>
      <label>
        {label}
        {type === "multiline" ? (
          <textarea
            value={local[key] ?? String(authoredValue ?? defaultValue ?? "")}
            disabled={
              busy || (authoredValue === undefined && !editing.has(key))
            }
            onChange={(e) => change(key, e.target.value)}
          />
        ) : (
          <input
            type={type}
            placeholder={
              key.startsWith("port:") && defaultValue === undefined
                ? "См. источники портов"
                : undefined
            }
            min={type === "number" ? 1 : undefined}
            max={type === "number" ? 65535 : undefined}
            value={local[key] ?? String(authoredValue ?? defaultValue ?? "")}
            onChange={(e) => change(key, e.target.value)}
            disabled={
              busy || (authoredValue === undefined && !editing.has(key))
            }
          />
        )}
      </label>
      <small>
        {authoredValue !== undefined
          ? "Переопределено в экземпляре"
          : "Значение пакета · без вычисления Ansible"}
      </small>
      <div className="row">
        <button
          hidden={key === "image" && local[key] === undefined}
          disabled={
            busy ||
            local[key] === undefined ||
            (type === "number" &&
              (!Number.isInteger(Number(local[key])) ||
                Number(local[key]) < 1 ||
                Number(local[key]) > 65535))
          }
          onClick={() =>
            void save(local[key]).then((ok) => clearField(key, ok))
          }
        >
          В черновик
        </button>
        {reset && (
          <button
            className="outline"
            hidden={key === "image" && authoredValue === undefined}
            disabled={busy || authoredValue === undefined}
            onClick={() =>
              void reset().then((ok) => {
                clearField(key, ok);
                if (ok)
                  setEditing((current) => {
                    const next = new Set(current);
                    next.delete(key);
                    return next;
                  });
              })
            }
          >
            Сбросить к default
          </button>
        )}
      </div>
    </div>
  );
  const tabs = slot
    ? ["Основное", "Секреты", "Файлы", "Запуск", "Состояние"]
    : ["Общее", "Общие параметры", "Подключения", "Ресурсы и секреты"];
  const selectedTab = tabs.includes(tab) ? tab : tabs[0];
  const resolved = snapshot?.applicationLibraries?.libraries?.[selected];
  const freshSecrets =
    !busy &&
    !draftActive &&
    !dirty &&
    intents.length === 0 &&
    snapshot?.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision;
  const editableSecretSession =
    !busy && !draftActive && !dirty && intents.length === 0;
  const pendingSecretContext = JSON.stringify([
    selected,
    slot,
    managed?.projectRevision,
  ]);
  const [pendingAvailability, setPendingAvailability] = useState<{
    context: string;
    value: RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation;
  }>();
  const pendingGeneration = useRef(0);
  const loadPendingApplicationSecrets = useCallback(async () => {
    const generation = ++pendingGeneration.current;
    const value = await loadPendingSecrets!({
      applicationLibrary: selected,
      applicationSlot: slot,
    });
    if (pendingGeneration.current === generation)
      setPendingAvailability({ context: pendingSecretContext, value });
    return value;
  }, [loadPendingSecrets, selected, slot, pendingSecretContext]);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      !loadPendingSecrets ||
      !editableSecretSession ||
      !["Секреты", "Подключения", "Ресурсы и секреты"].includes(selectedTab)
    )
      return;
    const refresh = () => {
      void loadPendingApplicationSecrets().catch(() =>
        setPendingAvailability(undefined),
      );
    };
    refresh();
    const interval = window.setInterval(refresh, 10000);
    return () => {
      ++pendingGeneration.current;
      window.clearInterval(interval);
    };
  }, [
    loadPendingSecrets,
    editableSecretSession,
    selectedTab,
    loadPendingApplicationSecrets,
  ]);
  // Selecting an authored reference must not depend on successful Core resolution.
  const providedConnectionChoices = Object.entries(libraries).flatMap(
    ([id, lib]) =>
      Object.keys(
        objectValue(
          packageDefinition("library", lib.libraryRef).provided_connections,
        ),
      ).map((name) => id + "/" + name),
  );
  const secretContext = JSON.stringify([
    selected,
    slot,
    managed?.projectRevision,
    freshSecrets,
  ]);
  useEffect(() => {
    ++availabilityGeneration.current;
    if (
      !["Секреты", "Подключения", "Ресурсы и секреты"].includes(selectedTab) ||
      !!loadPendingSecrets ||
      !freshSecrets ||
      !loadSecrets ||
      !loadSecretAvailability
    )
      return;
    let active = true;
    let pending = false;
    const refresh = async () => {
      if (!active || pending) return;
      pending = true;
      try {
        await refreshSecretAvailability();
      } finally {
        pending = false;
      }
    };
    // Descriptor discovery is an explicit context-entry operation, never a poll.
    void loadApplicationSecrets()
      .then(() => {
        if (active) void refresh();
      })
      .catch(() => {
        if (active) setSecretAvailability(undefined);
      });
    const interval = window.setInterval(() => void refresh(), 10000);
    window.addEventListener("focus", refresh);
    return () => {
      active = false;
      ++availabilityGeneration.current;
      window.clearInterval(interval);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", refresh);
    };
  }, [
    secretContext,
    slot,
    selectedTab,
    freshSecrets,
    loadSecrets,
    loadPendingSecrets,
    loadSecretAvailability,
    loadApplicationSecrets,
    refreshSecretAvailability,
  ]);
  const resolvedSecretAccounts = freshSecrets
    ? objectValue(
        Object.values(resolved?.instances ?? {}).find(
          (instance) => instance.slotId === slot,
        )?.credentialRequirements,
      )
    : {};
  const librarySecretSession: ApplicationSecretSession | undefined =
    (loadSecrets || loadPendingSecrets) && saveSecrets
      ? {
          projectRevision: managed?.projectRevision ?? "",
          contextKey: executionContextKey,
          libraryId: selected,
          pending: !!loadPendingSecrets,
          applicationSlot: slot,
          disabled: loadPendingSecrets
            ? !editableSecretSession
            : busy || !freshSecrets,
          availability: loadPendingSecrets
            ? pendingAvailability?.context === pendingSecretContext
              ? pendingAvailability.value
              : undefined
            : freshSecrets &&
                secretAvailability &&
                secretAvailability?.snapshot === snapshot &&
                secretAvailability.scope === secretScope
              ? secretAvailability.value
              : undefined,
          load: loadPendingSecrets
            ? loadPendingApplicationSecrets
            : loadApplicationSecrets,
          save: loadPendingSecrets
            ? async (input) => {
                await saveSecrets(input);
                setSecretStatusVersion((version) => version + 1);
                await loadPendingApplicationSecrets();
              }
            : saveApplicationSecrets,
        }
      : undefined;
  const secretRefCounts: Record<string, number> = {};
  for (const resolvedLibrary of Object.values(
    snapshot?.applicationLibraries?.libraries ?? {},
  )) {
    for (const secret of Object.values(
      objectValue(resolvedLibrary.sharedSecretRequirements),
    )) {
      const source = objectValue(objectValue(secret).source);
      if (
        source.kind === "runtime_secret_ref" &&
        typeof source.ref === "string"
      )
        secretRefCounts[source.ref] = (secretRefCounts[source.ref] ?? 0) + 1;
    }
    for (const instance of Object.values(resolvedLibrary.instances ?? {})) {
      for (const account of Object.values(
        objectValue(instance.credentialRequirements),
      )) {
        for (const credential of Object.values(
          objectValue(objectValue(account).credentials),
        )) {
          const source = objectValue(objectValue(credential).source);
          if (
            source.kind === "runtime_secret_ref" &&
            typeof source.ref === "string"
          )
            secretRefCounts[source.ref] =
              (secretRefCounts[source.ref] ?? 0) + 1;
        }
      }
    }
  }
  const resolvedTopics =
    !draftActive && snapshot?.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision
      ? objectValue(resolved?.topics)
      : {};
  const resolvedResources =
    !draftActive && snapshot?.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision
      ? objectValue(resolved?.resources)
      : {};
  const [baselineHost, setBaselineHost] = useState("");
  const resolvedInstance = Object.values(resolved?.instances ?? {}).find(
    (instance) => instance.slotId === slot,
  );
  const instancePlacements = resolvedInstance?.placements ?? {};
  const hosts = Object.keys(instancePlacements);
  const selectedBaselineHost = hosts.includes(baselineHost)
    ? baselineHost
    : hosts[0];
  const inherited = objectValue(
    objectValue(instancePlacements[selectedBaselineHost]).inherited,
  );
  const commonActive =
    slotDefinition.inherit_defaults !== false &&
    (Object.keys(objectValue(definition.defaults)).length > 0 ||
      Object.keys(objectValue(library.overrides)).length > 0);
  const freshBaseline =
    snapshot?.projectRevision === managed?.projectRevision &&
    !draftActive &&
    intents.length === 0 &&
    Object.keys(inherited).length > 0;
  const startupDefaults = freshBaseline
    ? inherited
    : commonActive
      ? {}
      : defaults;
  const portSources: PortSource[] = [
    { label: "Пакет приложения", ports: objectValue(defaults.ports) },
    {
      label: "Пакет библиотеки · " + slot,
      ports: objectValue(objectValue(slotDefinition.overrides).ports),
    },
    { label: "Экземпляр", ports: objectValue(overrides.ports) },
    ...Object.entries(placements)
      .filter(([, members]) => Object.hasOwn(members, selected))
      .map(([host, members]) => ({
        label: "Размещение · " + host,
        ports: objectValue(
          objectValue(objectValue(members[selected]).overrides).ports,
        ),
      })),
    ...Object.entries(resolved?.instances ?? {})
      .filter(([, instance]) => instance.slotId === slot)
      .flatMap(([, instance]) =>
        Object.entries(instance.placements ?? {}).map(([host, placement]) => ({
          label:
            "Core · " +
            host +
            " · " +
            (snapshot?.projectRevision ?? "последняя проверка"),
          ports: objectValue(placement.ports),
        })),
      ),
  ];
  return (
    <section className="applications-page">
      <header className="page-heading">
        <div>
          <h1>Приложения</h1>
          <p>Пакеты, настройки экземпляров и подключения к сервисам</p>
        </div>
        <button className="outline" onClick={() => navigate(onInstallation)}>
          К плану установки
        </button>
      </header>
      {(error || backendError) && <p role="alert">{error || backendError}</p>}
      {importCompleted && (
        <p role="status">
          Пакет успешно импортирован и доступен для выбора при добавлении
          библиотеки или приложения. Чтобы добавить библиотеку, нажмите
          «Добавить библиотеку».
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="applications-layout">
        <aside className="application-list">
          <label>
            Поиск
            <input value={search} onChange={(e) => setSearch(e.target.value)} />
          </label>
          <button
            disabled={busy}

                          defaults={objectValue(defaults.endpoint)}
                          disabled={busy}
                          onDirtyChange={(v) => markChildDirty(v, "endpoint")}
                          onSave={(value) =>
                            send(
                              Object.keys(value).length
                                ? override("endpoint", value)
                                : remove("endpoint"),
                            )
                          }
                          />
                        </fieldset>
                        {(["https", "tcp"] as const).map((route) => {
                          const authoredRoute = objectValue(objectValue(overrides.endpoints)[route]);
                          const inheritedRoute = objectValue(objectValue(defaults.endpoints)[route]);
                          const existingRoute = route === "https" && !Object.keys(inheritedRoute).length
                            ? { ...objectValue(defaults.endpoint), ...objectValue(overrides.endpoint) }
                            : inheritedRoute;
                          const routeDefaults = route === "https"
                            ? { enabled: false, listener: "", protocol: "http", ...existingRoute }
                            : { enabled: false, listener: "", public_port: "", ...existingRoute };
                          delete (routeDefaults as ObjectValue).endpoint_group;
                          const label = `Маршрут ${route.toUpperCase()}`;
                          return (
                            <fieldset key={selected + slot + route}>
                              <legend>{label}</legend>
                              <ApplicationValueFields
                                label={label}
                                compact
                                value={authoredRoute}
                                defaults={routeDefaults}
                                disabled={busy}
                                onDirtyChange={(dirty) => markChildDirty(dirty, route)}
                                onSave={(value) => {
                                  if (!Object.keys(value).length) return send(remove(route, "endpoints"));
                                  const setting: ObjectValue = { ...existingRoute, enabled: routeDefaults.enabled, ...value };
                                  delete setting.endpoint_group;
                                  return send(override(route, setting, "endpoints"));
                                }}
                              />
                            </fieldset>
                          );
                        })}
                      </details>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                )}

                {slot && selectedTab === "Запуск" && (
                  <>
                    <ApplicationTopicBindings
                      resolvedTopics={resolvedTopics}
                      connections={appConnections}
                      resources={objectValue(library.resources)}
                      bindings={objectValue(library.bindings)}
                      deployments={managed?.deployments ?? {}}
                      defaults={objectValue(defaults.topicBindings)}
                      authored={objectValue(overrides.topicBindings)}
                      disabled={busy}
                      onSave={(value) => send(override("topicBindings", value))}
                      onReset={() => send(remove("topicBindings"))}
                    />
                    {hosts.length > 1 && (
                      <label>
                        Наследуемые значения для сервера
                        <select

                          onChange={(e) =>
                            navigate(() => setBaselineHost(e.target.value))

                          {hosts.map((host) => (

                      </p>

                      <div className="application-startup-policy-fields">

                            : undefined,

                            ? overrides.command.join("\n")
                            : undefined,
                          (v) => send(override("command", v.split("\n"))),
                          () => send(remove("command")),
                          "multiline",

                          scalar(
                            field,
                            field,
                            defaults[field],
                            overrides[field],
                            (v) => send(override(field, v)),
                            () => send(remove(field)),
                          ),

                    <section className="application-section">
                      <ApplicationValueFields
                        key={selected + slot + "environment"}
                        label="Переменные окружения (ENV)"
                        compact
                        addControl={{
                          adding: addingEnvironment,
                          setAdding: setAddingEnvironment,
                        }}
                        value={objectValue(overrides.environment)}
                        defaults={objectValue(
                          freshBaseline
                            ? inherited.environment
                            : defaults.environment,

                        resolvedValues={
                          freshBaseline && !dirty && !busy
                            ? objectValue(

                                  instancePlacements[selectedBaselineHost],

                        defaultLabel={
                          freshBaseline
                            ? "Унаследовано · последний расчёт Core"
                            : undefined
                        }
                        disabled={busy}
                        onDirtyChange={(v) => markChildDirty(v, "environment")}
                        onSave={(value) =>

                            Object.keys(value).length
                              ? override("environment", value)
                              : remove("environment"),

                        }

                      <p className="muted">
                        ENV передаются процессу контейнера.
                      </p>
                    </section>
                    {(Object.keys(objectValue(startupDefaults.parameters))
                      .length > 0 ||
                      commonActive ||
                      Object.keys(objectValue(overrides.parameters)).length >
                        0) && (
                      <section className="application-section">
                        <ApplicationValueFields
                          key={selected + slot + "parameters"}
                          label="Настройки конфигурации"
                          value={objectValue(overrides.parameters)}
                          defaults={objectValue(startupDefaults.parameters)}
                          defaultLabel={
                            freshBaseline
                              ? "Унаследовано · последний расчёт Core"
                              : undefined
                          }
                          disabled={busy}
                          onDirtyChange={(v) => markChildDirty(v, "parameters")}
                          onSave={(value) =>
                            send(
                              Object.keys(value).length
                                ? override("parameters", value)

                        ),
                      )}
                      bindings={objectValue(library.bindings)}
                      onDirtyChange={markChildDirty}
                      defaults={defaults}
                      authored={authored}
                      connections={appConnections}
                      disabled={busy}
                      onSave={(accounts) =>
                        send({
                          operation: "SetApplicationLibrarySlot",
                          deploymentId: selected,
                          entityId: slot,
                          entity: { accounts },
                        })
                      }
                    />
                    {draftActive && (
                      <p>
                        Для сессионного ввода сначала сохраните изменения
                        проекта.
                      </p>
                    )}
                  </>
                )}
                {slot && selectedTab === "Файлы" && (
                  <>
                    <ApplicationFileSettings
                      key={
                        selected + slot + JSON.stringify(overrides.config_files)
                      }
                      authored={overrides.config_files}
                      defaults={defaults.config_files}
                      disabled={busy}
                      onDirtyChange={(v) => markChildDirty(v, "files")}
                      onSave={(value) => send(override("config_files", value))}
                      onReset={() => send(remove("config_files"))}

                      </summary>
                      <pre>
                        {JSON.stringify(
                          Object.fromEntries(
                            Object.entries(resolved?.instances ?? {}).filter(
                              ([, instance]) => instance.slotId === slot,
                            ),
                          ),
                          null,
                          2,
                        )}
                      </pre>
                    </details>
                    <p>
                      Работа контейнера, подключения и endpoint Verify: нет

                      странице установки.
                    </p>
                  </>
                )}
              </div>
            </>
          )}
          <footer>
            <div className="application-draft-status">
              <strong>
                {intents.length
                  ? `В черновике: ${intents.length}`
                  : "Нет изменений"}
              </strong>
              <small>Сохранение не запускает установку</small>
            </div>
            <button
              className="outline"
              disabled={busy || intents.length === 0 || dirty}
              onClick={onReview}
            >
              Показать изменения проекта
            </button>
            {dirty && (
              <span role="status">
                Есть ввод, ещё не добавленный в черновик
              </span>
            )}
          </footer>
        </article>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

import { useMemo, useState } from "react";
import type {
  OpenResult,
  SessionCredentialStatus,
  VerificationStatus,
  VerifiedPKIView,
} from "./backend";

export type CertificateIntent =
  | {
      operation:
        | "CreateCertificateAuthority"
        | "UpdateCertificateAuthority"
        | "CreateCertificateProfile"
        | "UpdateCertificateProfile"
        | "CreateTLSProfile"
        | "UpdateTLSProfile"
        | "CreateCertificateScope"
        | "UpdateCertificateScope";
      entityId: string;
      entity: Record<string, unknown>;
    }
  | {
      operation:
        | "DeleteCertificateAuthority"
        | "DeleteCertificateProfile"
        | "DeleteTLSProfile"
        | "DeleteCertificateScope";
      entityId: string;
    };

type PKIKind = "authority" | "profile" | "tls" | "scope";
type PKIEntity = Record<string, unknown>;
type Rows = Record<string, PKIEntity>;
export type CertificateSourceOptions = {
  hosts: string[];
  deployments: string[];
  members: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
};

const labels: Record<PKIKind, string> = {
  authority: "Управляемые центры сертификации",
  profile: "Профили сертификатов",
  tls: "Профили TLS",
  scope: "Области применения сертификатов",
};
const kindOrder: PKIKind[] = ["authority", "profile", "tls", "scope"];
const dependencyHints: Record<PKIKind, string> = {
  authority: "Используется в профилях сертификатов.",
  profile: "Ссылается на центр сертификации.",
  tls: "Использует профиль сертификата.",
  scope: "Тоже использует профиль сертификата.",
};
const operations: Record<
  PKIKind,
  {
    create: CertificateIntent["operation"];
    update: CertificateIntent["operation"];
    remove: CertificateIntent["operation"];
  }
> = {
  authority: {
    create: "CreateCertificateAuthority",
    update: "UpdateCertificateAuthority",
    remove: "DeleteCertificateAuthority",
  },
  profile: {
    create: "CreateCertificateProfile",
    update: "UpdateCertificateProfile",
    remove: "DeleteCertificateProfile",
  },
  tls: {
    create: "CreateTLSProfile",
    update: "UpdateTLSProfile",
    remove: "DeleteTLSProfile",
  },
  scope: {
    create: "CreateCertificateScope",
    update: "UpdateCertificateScope",
    remove: "DeleteCertificateScope",
  },
};

function rowsFor(
  kind: PKIKind,
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: CertificateIntent[],
): Rows {
  const pki = managed?.pki;
  const source =
    kind === "authority"
      ? pki?.authorities
      : kind === "profile"
        ? pki?.profiles
        : kind === "tls"
          ? pki?.tlsProfiles
          : pki?.scopes;
  const rows: Rows = { ...(source || {}) };
  for (const intent of intents) {
    const operation = operations[kind];
    if (
      (intent.operation === operation.create ||
        intent.operation === operation.update) &&
      "entity" in intent
    )
      rows[intent.entityId] = intent.entity;
    if (intent.operation === operation.remove) delete rows[intent.entityId];
  }
  return rows;
}

const stringList = (value: unknown) =>
  Array.isArray(value)
    ? value.filter((item): item is string => typeof item === "string")
    : [];
const listText = (value: unknown) => stringList(value).join(", ");
const parseList = (value: string) =>
  value
    .split(",")
    .map((item) => item.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);
const asRecord = (value: unknown): PKIEntity =>
  value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? (value as PKIEntity)
    : {};

function secretRefLabel(value: unknown) {
  return typeof value === "string" && value.startsWith("runtime:")
    ? "runtime:••••"
    : "не задана";
}

export function CertificatesPage({
  managed,
  intents,
  busy,
  structuralDisabled,
  commandCount,
  sourceOptions,
  verification,
  verifiedPKI,
  credentialStatus,
  onAppend,
  onSetPKIStorePassword,
  onReview,
  onDiscard,
  onReturnToServices,
}: {
  managed: OpenResult["managed"];
  intents: CertificateIntent[];
  busy: boolean;
  structuralDisabled: boolean;
  commandCount: number;
  sourceOptions: CertificateSourceOptions;
  verification?: VerificationStatus;
  verifiedPKI?: VerifiedPKIView;
  credentialStatus?: SessionCredentialStatus | null;
  onAppend: (intent: CertificateIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
  onSetPKIStorePassword?: (value: string) => Promise<SessionCredentialStatus>;
  onReview: () => void;
  onDiscard: () => void;
  onReturnToServices?: () => void;
}) {
  const [editor, setEditor] = useState<{ kind: PKIKind; id?: string } | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [selectedKind, setSelectedKind] = useState<PKIKind>("authority");
  const blocked = busy || structuralDisabled || commandCount >= 16;
  const pkiPasswordPresent =
    credentialStatus?.pkiStorePasswordStatus === "PRESENT";
  const allRows = useMemo(
    () => ({
      authority: rowsFor("authority", managed, intents),
      profile: rowsFor("profile", managed, intents),
      tls: rowsFor("tls", managed, intents),
      scope: rowsFor("scope", managed, intents),
    }),
    [managed, intents],
  );
  const remove = async (kind: PKIKind, entityId: string) => {
    if (
      await onAppend({
        operation: operations[kind].remove as CertificateIntent["operation"],
        entityId,
      } as CertificateIntent)
    )
      setEditor(null);
  };

  return (
    <section className="certificates-page">
      <div className="title">
        <div>
          {onReturnToServices && (
            <button className="outline" onClick={onReturnToServices}>
              Вернуться к настройке сервиса
            </button>
          )}
          <h1>Сертификаты</h1>
          <p>
            Желаемые параметры сертификатов проекта. Выпуск и применение
            сертификатов выполняются отдельно.
          </p>
        </div>
        <DraftActions
          commandCount={commandCount}
          blocked={blocked}
          onReview={onReview}
          onDiscard={onDiscard}
        />
      </div>
      <section
        className="certificate-dependency-guide"
        aria-labelledby="certificate-dependency-heading"
      >
        <div>
          <h2 id="certificate-dependency-heading">
            Порядок настройки и зависимости
          </h2>
          <p>
            Сначала центр и профиль сертификата; TLS-профиль и область
            применения — независимые ветви.
          </p>
        </div>
        <div
          className="certificate-dependency-flow"
          role="img"
          aria-label="Центр сертификации ведёт к профилю сертификата; от него независимо зависят профиль TLS и область применения"
        >
          <div className="certificate-dependency-chain">
            <span>1 · Центр сертификации</span>
            <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
            <span>2 · Профиль сертификата</span>
          </div>
          <div className="certificate-dependency-branches">
            <div>
              <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
              <span>3 · Профиль TLS</span>
            </div>
            <div>
              <span aria-hidden="true">↘</span>
              <span>4 · Область применения</span>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </section>
      <div className="certificate-workspace">
        <nav className="certificate-type-nav" aria-label="Разделы сертификатов">
          {kindOrder.map((kind, index) => (
            <button
              key={kind}
              type="button"
              className={`certificate-type-option${
                selectedKind === kind ? " selected" : ""
              }`}
              aria-label={labels[kind]}
              aria-current={selectedKind === kind ? "page" : undefined}
              onClick={() => setSelectedKind(kind)}
            >
              <span className="certificate-type-title">
                <span className="certificate-type-step">{index + 1}</span>
                <span>{labels[kind]}</span>
                <span className="certificate-type-count">
                  {Object.keys(allRows[kind]).length}
                </span>
              </span>
              <small>{dependencyHints[kind]}</small>
            </button>
          ))}
        </nav>
        <article
          className="card certificate-section"
          aria-labelledby="selected-certificate-section"
        >
          <div className="section-head">
            <div>
              <h2 id="selected-certificate-section">{labels[selectedKind]}</h2>
              <small>{sectionHint(selectedKind)}</small>
            </div>
            <button
              className="outline"
              disabled={blocked}
              onClick={() => setEditor({ kind: selectedKind })}
            >
              Добавить
            </button>
          </div>
          <CertificateRows
            kind={selectedKind}
            rows={allRows[selectedKind]}
            disabled={blocked}
            onEdit={(id) => setEditor({ kind: selectedKind, id })}
            onDelete={remove}
          />
          {selectedKind === "tls" && pkiPasswordPresent && (
            <p className="muted" role="status">
              Пароль PKCS#12 сохранён в текущем сеансе. В проект он не записывается.
            </p>
          )}
        </article>
      </div>
      <CertificateIdentities
        verification={verification || { status: "UNVERIFIED" }}
        view={verifiedPKI}
      />
      {editor && (
        <CertificateDialog
          key={`${editor.kind}:${editor.id || "new"}`}
          kind={editor.kind}
          entityId={editor.id}
          entity={editor.id ? allRows[editor.kind][editor.id] : undefined}
          authorityIds={Object.keys(allRows.authority).sort()}
          profileIds={Object.keys(allRows.profile).sort()}
          sourceOptions={sourceOptions}
          disabled={blocked}
          pkiPasswordPresent={pkiPasswordPresent}
          onSetPKIStorePassword={onSetPKIStorePassword}
          onClose={() => setEditor(null)}
          onSubmit={async (entityId, entity) => {
            const operation = editor.id
              ? operations[editor.kind].update
              : operations[editor.kind].create;
            if (
              await onAppend({
                operation: operation as CertificateIntent["operation"],
                entityId,
                entity,
              } as CertificateIntent)
            )
              setEditor(null);
          }}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function CertificateIdentities({
  verification,
  view,
}: {
  verification: VerificationStatus;
  view?: VerifiedPKIView;
}) {
  if (verification.status !== "VERIFIED" || view?.status !== "CURRENT") return null;
  return (
    <article className="card certificate-verification">
      <div className="section-head">
        <div>
          <h2>Имена сертификатов и SAN</h2>
          <small>
            Имена и SAN отображаются только по актуальным данным проверки Core.
          </small>
        </div>
      </div>
      <p className="muted">
        Влияние виртуального IP поставщика определяет Core после сохранения и
        проверки. Этот экран не выпускает и не перевыпускает сертификаты.
      </p>
      {view.identities?.length ? (
        <div className="verified-identities">
          {view.identities.map((identity) => (
            <section key={identity.id} className="verified-identity">
              <b>{identity.id}</b>
              <small>
                {identity.scope === "PROJECT" ? "Весь проект" : identity.scope} · Профиль TLS: {identity.tlsProfileId}
              </small>
              <div>
                <span>DNS: </span>
                {identity.dnsNames.join(", ") || "—"}
              </div>
              <div>
                <span>IP: </span>
                {identity.ipAddresses.join(", ") || "—"}
              </div>
              <div>
                <span>Потребители: </span>
                {identity.consumers
                  .map(
                    (consumer) =>
                      `${consumer.deploymentId}/${consumer.memberId} @ ${consumer.hostId}`,
                  )
                  .join(", ") || "—"}
              </div>
            </section>
          ))}
        </div>
      ) : (
        <p className="muted">
          Core подтвердил проект; потребителей сертификатов нет.
        </p>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

function sectionHint(kind: PKIKind) {
  if (kind === "authority") return "Только управляемый центр сертификации.";
  if (kind === "profile")
    return "Центр сертификации, назначения ключа, правила SAN и параметры владельца.";
  if (kind === "tls") return "Только ссылка на секрет, без самого пароля.";
  return "Источники: серверы, сервисы, их экземпляры и явные DNS/IP.";
}

function DraftActions({
  commandCount,
  blocked,
  onReview,
  onDiscard,
}: {
  commandCount: number;
  blocked: boolean;
  onReview: () => void;
  onDiscard: () => void;
}) {
  return (
    <div className="actions">
      <span className="muted">{commandCount} / 16 изменений</span>
      {commandCount > 0 && (
        <>
          <button className="outline" disabled={blocked} onClick={onDiscard}>
            Отменить изменения
          </button>
          <button disabled={blocked} onClick={onReview}>
            Просмотреть изменения
          </button>
        </>
      )}
    </div>
  );
}

function CertificateRows({
  kind,
  rows,
  disabled,
  onEdit,
  onDelete,
}: {
  kind: PKIKind;
  rows: Rows;
  disabled: boolean;
  onEdit: (id: string) => void;
  onDelete: (kind: PKIKind, id: string) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const values = Object.entries(rows).sort(([left], [right]) =>
    left.localeCompare(right),
  );
  if (!values.length)
    return <p className="muted">Нет сохранённых или черновых записей.</p>;
  return (
    <div className="certificate-rows">
      {values.map(([id, entity]) => (
        <div className="certificate-row" key={id}>
          <div>
            <b>{id}</b>
            <small>{rowSummary(kind, entity)}</small>
          </div>
          <div className="actions">
            <button
              className="link"
              disabled={disabled}
              onClick={() => onEdit(id)}
            >
              Изменить
            </button>
            <button
              className="link danger"
              disabled={disabled}
              onClick={() => void onDelete(kind, id)}
            >
              Удалить
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      ))}
    </div>
  );
}

function rowSummary(kind: PKIKind, entity: PKIEntity) {
  if (kind === "authority") return String(entity.commonName || "MANAGED");
  if (kind === "profile") return `CA: ${String(entity.authorityRef || "—")}`;
  if (kind === "tls")
    return `Profile: ${String(entity.certificateProfileRef || "—")} · ${secretRefLabel(entity.storePasswordSecretRef)}`;
  return `Profile: ${String(entity.profile || "—")} · ${Object.keys(asRecord(entity.sources)).length} sources`;
}

function CertificateDialog({
  kind,
  entityId,
  entity,
  authorityIds,
  profileIds,
  sourceOptions,
  disabled,
  pkiPasswordPresent,
  onSetPKIStorePassword,
  onClose,
  onSubmit,
}: {
  kind: PKIKind;
  entityId?: string;
  entity?: PKIEntity;
  authorityIds: string[];
  profileIds: string[];
  sourceOptions: CertificateSourceOptions;
  disabled: boolean;
  pkiPasswordPresent: boolean;
  onSetPKIStorePassword?: (value: string) => Promise<SessionCredentialStatus>;
  onClose: () => void;
  onSubmit: (id: string, entity: PKIEntity) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const existing = asRecord(entity);
  const [id, setID] = useState(entityId || "");
  const [displayName, setDisplayName] = useState(
    String(existing.displayName || ""),
  );
  const [commonName, setCommonName] = useState(
    String(existing.commonName || ""),
  );
  const [authorityRef, setAuthorityRef] = useState(
    String(existing.authorityRef || authorityIds[0] || ""),
  );
  const [profileRef, setProfileRef] = useState(
    String(
      existing.certificateProfileRef || existing.profile || profileIds[0] || "",
    ),
  );
  const [scope, setScope] = useState(String(existing.scope || ""));
  const [secretInput, setSecretInput] = useState("");
  const [keyAlgorithm, setKeyAlgorithm] = useState(
    String(existing.keyAlgorithm || ""),
  );
  const [keySize, setKeySize] = useState(
    existing.keySize === undefined ? "" : String(existing.keySize),
  );
  const [validityDays, setValidityDays] = useState(
    existing.validityDays === undefined ? "" : String(existing.validityDays),
  );
  const [usages, setUsages] = useState(stringList(existing.usages));
  const [usagesPresent, setUsagesPresent] = useState(
    Object.hasOwn(existing, "usages"),
  );
  const [sanPolicy, setSanPolicy] = useState(asRecord(existing.sanPolicy));
  const [subject, setSubject] = useState(asRecord(existing.subject));
  const sources = asRecord(existing.sources);
  const [hosts, setHosts] = useState(stringList(sources.hosts));
  const [deployments, setDeployments] = useState(
    stringList(sources.serviceDeployments),
  );
  const [members, setMembers] = useState(
    (Array.isArray(sources.members) ? sources.members : []).flatMap((item) => {
      const value = asRecord(item);
      const deploymentId = value.deploymentId;
      const memberId = value.memberId;
      return typeof deploymentId === "string" && typeof memberId === "string"
        ? [{ deploymentId, memberId }]
        : [];
    }),
  );
  const [dnsNames, setDnsNames] = useState(listText(sources.explicitDnsNames));
  const [ipAddresses, setIPAddresses] = useState(
    listText(sources.explicitIpAddresses),
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const tlsSettingsUnchanged =
    kind === "tls" &&
    !!entityId &&
    Object.keys(existing).every((key) =>
      ["certificateProfileRef", "storePasswordSecretRef", "scope"].includes(key),
    ) &&
    String(existing.certificateProfileRef || "") === profileRef &&
    String(existing.storePasswordSecretRef || "") ===
      "runtime:pki-store-password" &&
    String(existing.scope || "") === scope;
  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!id.trim()) return setError("Укажите ID записи.");
    if (kind === "tls" && secretInput.length > 0) {
      if (!onSetPKIStorePassword) {
        setError("Не удалось сохранить пароль в текущем сеансе.");
        return;
      }
      try {
        await onSetPKIStorePassword(secretInput);
        setSecretInput("");
      } catch (reason) {
        const code = reason instanceof Error ? reason.message : String(reason);
        setError(
          code === "PKI_STORE_PASSWORD_INPUT_INVALID"
            ? "Пароль не соответствует допустимым ограничениям."
            : code === "PKI_STORE_PASSWORD_UNAVAILABLE"
              ? "Сначала сохраните учётные данные для выбранного узла выполнения."
              : "Не удалось сохранить пароль в текущем сеансе.",
        );
        return;
      }
    }
    const result = entityFor(kind, {
      displayName,
      commonName,
      authorityRef,
      profileRef,
      scope,
      keyAlgorithm,
      keySize,
      validityDays,
      usages,
      usagesPresent,
      sanPolicy,
      subject,
      hosts,
      deployments,
      members,
      dnsNames,
      ipAddresses,
    });
    if (!result)
      return setError("Проверьте поля области применения сертификатов.");
    setError("");
    if (tlsSettingsUnchanged) {
      onClose();
      return;
    }
    await onSubmit(id.trim(), result);
  };
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <form className="card dialog certificate-dialog" onSubmit={submit}>
        <h1>
          {entityId ? "Изменить" : "Добавить"}: {labels[kind]}
        </h1>
        <label>
          ID
          <input
            value={id}
            disabled={!!entityId || disabled}
            onChange={(event) => setID(event.target.value)}
            autoFocus
          />
        </label>
        {kind !== "tls" && (
          <OptionalText
            label="Отображаемое имя"
            value={displayName}
            onChange={setDisplayName}
          />
        )}
        {kind === "authority" && (
          <>
            <label>
              Общее имя (CN)
              <input
                value={commonName}
                onChange={(event) => setCommonName(event.target.value)}
                required
              />
            </label>
            <OptionalNumber
              label="Срок действия (дней)"
              value={validityDays}
              onChange={setValidityDays}
            />
          </>
        )}
        {kind === "profile" && (
          <ProfileFields
            authorityRef={authorityRef}
            authorityIds={authorityIds}
            onAuthorityRef={setAuthorityRef}
            keyAlgorithm={keyAlgorithm}
            onKeyAlgorithm={setKeyAlgorithm}
            keySize={keySize}
            onKeySize={setKeySize}
            validityDays={validityDays}
            onValidityDays={setValidityDays}
            usages={usages}
            onUsages={(value) => {
              setUsagesPresent(true);
              setUsages(value);
            }}
            sanPolicy={sanPolicy}
            onSanPolicy={setSanPolicy}
            subject={subject}
            onSubject={setSubject}
          />
        )}
        {kind === "tls" && (
          <>
            <ReferenceSelect
              label="Профиль сертификата"
              value={profileRef}
              values={profileIds}
              onChange={setProfileRef}
            />
            <label>
              Область применения
              <select
                value={scope}
                onChange={(event) => setScope(event.target.value)}
              >
                <option value="">Наследуется</option>
                <option value="HOST">Сервер</option>
                <option value="MEMBER">Экземпляр</option>
                <option value="DEPLOYMENT">Развёртывание</option>
                <option value="PROJECT">Весь проект</option>
              </select>
            </label>
            <label>
              Пароль хранилищ PKCS#12
              <input
                type="password"
                autoComplete="new-password"
                value={secretInput}
                onChange={(event) => setSecretInput(event.target.value)}
                placeholder={
                  pkiPasswordPresent
                    ? "Сохранён в текущем сеансе; введите новый для замены"
                    : "Введите пароль для хранилищ PKCS#12"
                }
                disabled={disabled}
              />
            </label>
            <p className="muted" role="status">
              {pkiPasswordPresent
                ? "Пароль хранится только в текущем сеансе. Для замены введите новый; проект содержит только фиксированную ссылку на секрет."
                : "Пароль сохранится только в текущем сеансе. Проект содержит только фиксированную ссылку на секрет."}
            </p>
          </>
        )}
        {kind === "scope" && (
          <ScopeFields
            profileRef={profileRef}
            profileIds={profileIds}
            onProfileRef={setProfileRef}
            scope={scope}
            onScope={setScope}
            hosts={hosts}
            onHosts={setHosts}
            deployments={deployments}
            onDeployments={setDeployments}
            members={members}
            onMembers={setMembers}
            sourceOptions={sourceOptions}
            dnsNames={dnsNames}
            onDNSNames={setDnsNames}
            ipAddresses={ipAddresses}
            onIPAddresses={setIPAddresses}
          />
        )}
        {error && <p className="field-error">{error}</p>}
        <div className="actions">
          <button type="button" className="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            Отмена
          </button>
          <button disabled={disabled || (tlsSettingsUnchanged && !secretInput)} type="submit">
            {tlsSettingsUnchanged && secretInput
              ? "Сохранить пароль в сеансе"
              : "Добавить в черновик"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

function OptionalText({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <label>
      {label}
      <input
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        placeholder="Наследуется"
      />
    </label>
  );
}
function OptionalNumber({
  label,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <label>
      {label}
      <input
        type="number"
        min="1"
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        placeholder="Наследуется"
      />
    </label>
  );
}
function ReferenceSelect({
  label,
  value,
  values,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  value: string;
  values: string[];
  onChange: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <label>
      {label}
      <select
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) => onChange(event.target.value)}
        required
      >
        <option value="">Выберите</option>
        {values.map((item) => (
          <option key={item}>{item}</option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </label>
  );
}

function ProfileFields(props: {
  authorityRef: string;
  authorityIds: string[];
  onAuthorityRef: (value: string) => void;
  keyAlgorithm: string;
  onKeyAlgorithm: (value: string) => void;
  keySize: string;
  onKeySize: (value: string) => void;
  validityDays: string;
  onValidityDays: (value: string) => void;
  usages: string[];
  onUsages: (value: string[]) => void;
  sanPolicy: PKIEntity;
  onSanPolicy: (value: PKIEntity) => void;
  subject: PKIEntity;
  onSubject: (value: PKIEntity) => void;
}) {
  const policyLabels: Record<string, string> = {
    includeHostDns: "DNS-имена серверов",
    includeHostIp: "IP-адреса серверов",
    includeEndpointFqdns: "FQDN точек входа",
    includeEndpointWildcard: "Wildcard-имена точек входа",
    includeEndpointVip: "Виртуальные IP точек входа",
  };
  return (
    <>
      <ReferenceSelect
        label="Центр сертификации"
        value={props.authorityRef}
        values={props.authorityIds}
        onChange={props.onAuthorityRef}
      />
      <label>
        Алгоритм ключа
        <select
          value={props.keyAlgorithm}
          onChange={(event) => props.onKeyAlgorithm(event.target.value)}
        >
          <option value="">Наследуется</option>
          <option>RSA</option>
          <option>EC</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <OptionalNumber
        label="Размер ключа"
        value={props.keySize}
        onChange={props.onKeySize}
      />
      <OptionalNumber
        label="Срок действия (дней)"
        value={props.validityDays}
        onChange={props.onValidityDays}
      />
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Назначение сертификата</legend>
        {["serverAuth", "clientAuth"].map((usage) => (
          <label key={usage}>
            <input
              type="checkbox"
              checked={props.usages.includes(usage)}
              onChange={(event) =>
                props.onUsages(
                  event.target.checked
                    ? [...props.usages, usage]
                    : props.usages.filter((item) => item !== usage),
                )
              }
            />
            {usage === "serverAuth"
              ? "Серверная аутентификация"
              : "Клиентская аутентификация"}
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Переопределение правил SAN</legend>
        {Object.keys(policyLabels).map((key) => (
          <label key={key}>
            {policyLabels[key]}
            <select
              aria-label={policyLabels[key]}
              value={
                typeof props.sanPolicy[key] === "boolean"
                  ? String(props.sanPolicy[key])
                  : ""
              }
              onChange={(event) => {
                const next = { ...props.sanPolicy };
                if (event.target.value === "") delete next[key];
                else next[key] = event.target.value === "true";
                props.onSanPolicy(next);
              }}
            >
              <option value="">Наследуется</option>
              <option value="true">Включено</option>
              <option value="false">Выключено</option>
            </select>
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
      <fieldset>
        <legend>Переопределение полей субъекта</legend>
        {["C", "ST", "L", "O", "OU"].map((key) => (
          <label key={key}>
            {key}
            <input
              value={String(props.subject[key] || "")}
              onChange={(event) =>
                props.onSubject({ ...props.subject, [key]: event.target.value })
              }
            />
          </label>
        ))}
      </fieldset>
    </>
  );
}

function ScopeFields(props: {
  profileRef: string;
  profileIds: string[];
  onProfileRef: (value: string) => void;
  scope: string;
  onScope: (value: string) => void;
  hosts: string[];
  onHosts: (value: string[]) => void;
  deployments: string[];
  onDeployments: (value: string[]) => void;
  members: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
  onMembers: (value: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>) => void;
  sourceOptions: CertificateSourceOptions;
  dnsNames: string;
  onDNSNames: (value: string) => void;
  ipAddresses: string;
  onIPAddresses: (value: string) => void;
}) {
  return (
    <>
      <ReferenceSelect
        label="Профиль сертификата"
        value={props.profileRef}
        values={props.profileIds}
        onChange={props.onProfileRef}
      />
      <label>
        Область применения
        <select
          value={props.scope}
          onChange={(event) => props.onScope(event.target.value)}
        >
          <option value="">Наследуется</option>
          <option value="HOST">Сервер</option>
          <option value="MEMBER">Экземпляр</option>
          <option value="DEPLOYMENT">Развёртывание</option>
        </select>
      </label>
      <ReferenceChoices
        label="Серверы"
        values={props.sourceOptions.hosts}
        selected={props.hosts}
        onChange={props.onHosts}
      />
      <ReferenceChoices
        label="Развёртывания"
        values={props.sourceOptions.deployments}
        selected={props.deployments}
        onChange={props.onDeployments}
      />
      <MemberChoices
        values={props.sourceOptions.members}
        selected={props.members}
        onChange={props.onMembers}
      />
      <OptionalText
        label="Явные DNS-имена"
        value={props.dnsNames}
        onChange={props.onDNSNames}
      />
      <OptionalText
        label="Явные IP-адреса"
        value={props.ipAddresses}
        onChange={props.onIPAddresses}
      />
    </>
  );
}

function ReferenceChoices({
  label,
  values,
  selected,
  onChange,
}: {
  label: string;
  values: string[];
  selected: string[];
  onChange: (value: string[]) => void;
}) {
  const options = [...new Set([...values, ...selected])].sort();
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>{label}</legend>
      {!options.length && (
        <small>Нет доступных записей в текущем черновике.</small>
      )}
      {options.map((value) => (
        <label key={value}>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={selected.includes(value)}
            onChange={(event) =>
              onChange(
                event.target.checked
                  ? [...selected, value]
                  : selected.filter((item) => item !== value),
              )
            }
          />
          {value}
        </label>
      ))}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function MemberChoices({
  values,
  selected,
  onChange,
}: {
  values: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
  selected: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
  onChange: (value: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>) => void;
}) {
  const key = (value: { deploymentId: string; memberId: string }) =>
    `${value.deploymentId}\u0000${value.memberId}`;
  const options = [
    ...new Map(
      [...values, ...selected].map((value) => [key(value), value]),
    ).values(),
  ];
  return (
    <fieldset>
      <legend>Экземпляры</legend>
      {!options.length && (
        <small>В текущем черновике нет размещённых экземпляров.</small>
      )}
      {options.map((value) => (
        <label key={key(value)}>
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={selected.some((item) => key(item) === key(value))}
            onChange={(event) =>
              onChange(
                event.target.checked
                  ? [...selected, value]
                  : selected.filter((item) => key(item) !== key(value)),
              )
            }
          />
          {value.deploymentId}/{value.memberId}
        </label>
      ))}
    </fieldset>
  );
}

function entityFor(
  kind: PKIKind,
  input: {
    displayName: string;
    commonName: string;
    authorityRef: string;
    profileRef: string;
    scope: string;
    keyAlgorithm: string;
    keySize: string;
    validityDays: string;
    usages: string[];
    usagesPresent: boolean;
    sanPolicy: PKIEntity;
    subject: PKIEntity;
    hosts: string[];
    deployments: string[];
    members: Array<{ deploymentId: string; memberId: string }>;
    dnsNames: string;
    ipAddresses: string;
  },
): PKIEntity | null {
  const optional = (value: string) => value.trim() || undefined;
  const number = (value: string) => (value.trim() ? Number(value) : undefined);
  if (kind === "authority")
    return {
      mode: "MANAGED",
      commonName: input.commonName.trim(),
      ...(optional(input.displayName) && {
        displayName: optional(input.displayName),
      }),
      ...(number(input.validityDays) !== undefined && {
        validityDays: number(input.validityDays),
      }),
    };
  if (kind === "profile") {
    const subject = Object.fromEntries(
      Object.entries(input.subject).filter(([, value]) => String(value).trim()),
    );
    return {
      authorityRef: input.authorityRef,
      sanPolicy: input.sanPolicy,
      ...(optional(input.displayName) && {
        displayName: optional(input.displayName),
      }),
      ...(optional(input.keyAlgorithm) && {
        keyAlgorithm: optional(input.keyAlgorithm),
      }),
      ...(number(input.keySize) !== undefined && {
        keySize: number(input.keySize),
      }),
      ...(number(input.validityDays) !== undefined && {
        validityDays: number(input.validityDays),
      }),
      ...(input.usagesPresent && { usages: input.usages }),
      ...(Object.keys(subject).length && { subject }),
    };
  }
  if (kind === "tls")
    return {
      certificateProfileRef: input.profileRef,
      storePasswordSecretRef: "runtime:pki-store-password",
      ...(optional(input.scope) && { scope: optional(input.scope) }),
    };
  const sources: PKIEntity = {};
  const add = (key: string, values: string[]) => {
    if (values.length) sources[key] = values;
  };
  add("hosts", input.hosts);
  add("serviceDeployments", input.deployments);
  if (input.members.length) sources.members = input.members;
  add("explicitDnsNames", parseList(input.dnsNames));
  add("explicitIpAddresses", parseList(input.ipAddresses));
  return {
    profile: input.profileRef,
    sources,
    ...(optional(input.displayName) && {
      displayName: optional(input.displayName),
    }),
    ...(optional(input.scope) && { scope: optional(input.scope) }),
  };
}
