  domain: string;
  wildcard: boolean;
  state?: "new" | "deleting";
};
type Deployment = {
  id: string;
  serviceType: string;
  mode: string;
  endpointGroup?: string;
  endpointGroupRef?: string;
  virtualRouterId?: number;
  virtualAddresses?: Array<{ address: string; interface: string }>;
  providerEditState?: "NONE" | "EDITABLE" | "INCOMPLETE" | "UNSUPPORTED";
  state?: "new" | "deleting";
};
const idPattern = /^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$/;

function finalGroups(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: EndpointIntent[],
) {
  const values = new Map<string, Group>();
  for (const [id, group] of Object.entries(managed?.endpointGroups || {}))
    values.set(id, { id, domain: group.domain, wildcard: group.wildcard });
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "CreateEndpointGroup")
      values.set(intent.endpointGroupId, {
        id: intent.endpointGroupId,
        ...intent.endpointGroup.address,
        state: "new",
      });
    if (intent.operation === "UpdateEndpointGroup") {
      const current = values.get(intent.endpointGroupId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.endpointGroupId, {
          ...current,
          ...intent.endpointGroup.address,
        });
    }
    if (intent.operation === "DeleteEndpointGroup") {
      const current = values.get(intent.endpointGroupId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.endpointGroupId, { ...current, state: "deleting" });
    }
  }
  return [...values.values()].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
}

function finalDeployments(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  deploymentIntents: DeploymentIntent[],
  intents: EndpointIntent[],
  providerIntents: ProviderIntent[],
) {
  const values = new Map<string, Deployment>();
  for (const [id, item] of Object.entries(managed?.deployments || {}))
    values.set(id, {
      id,
      serviceType: item.serviceType,
      mode: item.mode,
      endpointGroup: item.endpointGroup,
      endpointGroupRef: item.endpointGroupRef,
      virtualRouterId: item.virtualRouterId,
      virtualAddresses: item.virtualAddresses,
      providerEditState: item.providerEditState,
    });
  for (const intent of deploymentIntents) {
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServiceDeployment")
      values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        id: intent.deploymentId,
        serviceType: intent.serviceType,
        mode: intent.mode,
        state: "new",
      });
    if (intent.operation === "DeleteServiceDeployment") {
      const current = values.get(intent.deploymentId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.deploymentId, { ...current, state: "deleting" });
    }
  }
  for (const intent of intents) {
    if (intent.operation === "SetServiceEndpointGroup") {
      const current = values.get(intent.deploymentId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
          ...current,
          endpointGroup: intent.endpointGroupId,
        });
    }
    if (intent.operation === "ClearServiceEndpointGroup") {
      const current = values.get(intent.deploymentId);
      if (current)
        values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
          ...current,
          endpointGroup: undefined,
        });
    }
  }
  for (const intent of providerIntents) {
    const current = values.get(intent.deploymentId);
    if (!current) continue;
    if (intent.operation === "ReconcileEndpointProvider")
      values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        ...current,
        endpointGroupRef: intent.endpointGroupId,
        virtualRouterId: intent.virtualRouterId,
        virtualAddresses: intent.virtualAddresses,
        providerEditState: "EDITABLE",
      });
    if (intent.operation === "ClearEndpointProvider")
      values.set(intent.deploymentId, {
        ...current,
        endpointGroupRef: undefined,
        virtualRouterId: undefined,
        virtualAddresses: undefined,
        providerEditState: "NONE",
      });
  }
  return [...values.values()].sort((a, b) => a.id.localeCompare(b.id));
}

export function EntryPointsView({
  managed,
  catalog,
  intents,
  providerIntents,
  deploymentIntents,
  busy,
  disabled,
  commandCount,
  onAppend,
}: {
  managed: OpenResult["managed"];
  catalog: OpenResult["catalog"];
  intents: EndpointIntent[];
  providerIntents: ProviderIntent[];
  deploymentIntents: DeploymentIntent[];
  preview?: EndpointPreview;
  verificationStatus: VerificationStatus["status"];
  busy: boolean;
  disabled: boolean;
  commandCount: number;
  onAppend: (intent: EntryPointsIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [dialog, setDialog] = useState<{
    mode: "add" | "edit";
    group?: Group;
  } | null>(null);
  const [providerDialog, setProviderDialog] = useState<Deployment | null>(null);
  const groups = useMemo(
    () => finalGroups(managed, intents),
    [managed, intents],
  );
  const deployments = useMemo(
    () =>
      finalDeployments(managed, deploymentIntents, intents, providerIntents),
    [managed, deploymentIntents, intents, providerIntents],
  );
  const catalogReady = catalog?.status === "READY";
  const limit = commandCount >= 16;
  const groupLocked = (id: string) =>
    intents.some(
      (item) => "endpointGroupId" in item && item.endpointGroupId === id,
    );
  const deploymentLocked = (id: string) =>
    intents.some((item) =>
      item.operation === "SetServiceEndpointGroup" ||
      item.operation === "ClearServiceEndpointGroup"
        ? item.deploymentId === id
        : false,
    );
  const eligible = (serviceType: string) =>
    catalog?.services?.find((item) => item.id === serviceType)
      ?.endpointConsumer === true;
  const providerEligible = (serviceType: string) =>
    catalog?.services?.find((item) => item.id === serviceType)
      ?.endpointProvider === true;
  const providerLocked = (id: string) =>
    providerIntents.some((item) => item.deploymentId === id);
  const providerDeployments = deployments.filter((item) =>
    item.state === "deleting"
      ? false
      : catalogReady
        ? providerEligible(item.serviceType)
        : !!item.endpointGroupRef ||
          item.providerEditState === "INCOMPLETE" ||
          item.providerEditState === "UNSUPPORTED",
  );
  return (
    <>
      {providerIntents.length > 0 && (
        <p className="entry-draft-notice" role="status">
          Конфигурация provider изменена в черновике; влияние на PKI/SAN определяет только Core.
        </p>
      )}
      <section className="title topology-title">
        <div>
          <h1>Точки входа</h1>
          <p>
            Группы адресов, назначения потребителей и параметры provider/VIP.
          </p>
          {commandCount > 0 && (
            <p className="muted">
              Черновик: {commandCount} из 16 · осталось {Math.max(0, 16 - commandCount)}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
        <button
          onClick={() => setDialog({ mode: "add" })}
          disabled={busy || disabled || limit}
        >
          Добавить группу
        </button>
      </section>
      <div className="entry-grid">
        <section className="card entry-panel">
          <h2 className="entry-panel-title">
            <EntryPointIcon kind="groups" />
            <span>Группы endpoint</span>
          </h2>
          {groups.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="muted">Групп пока нет.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="entry-list">
              {groups.map((group) => (
                <div key={group.id} className="entry-row">
                  <div>
                    <b>{group.id}</b>
                    <span>
                      {group.domain}
                      {group.wildcard ? " · wildcard" : ""}
                    </span>
                    {group.state && (
                      <small
                        className={`entry-state-chip ${group.state === "new" ? "entry-state-chip--info" : "entry-state-chip--warning"}`}
                      >
                        <span aria-hidden="true">
                          {group.state === "new" ? "+" : "!"}
                        </span>
                        {group.state === "new" ? "Новая" : "Будет удалена"}
                      </small>
                    )}
                  </div>
                  <div className="actions">
                    <button
                      className="outline"
                      onClick={() => setDialog({ mode: "edit", group })}
                      disabled={
                        busy ||
                        disabled ||
                        limit ||
                        !!group.state ||
                        groupLocked(group.id)
                      }
                    >
                      Изменить
                    </button>
                    <button
                      className="outline danger"
                      onClick={() =>
                        onAppend({
                          operation: "DeleteEndpointGroup",
                          endpointGroupId: group.id,
                        })
                      }
                      disabled={
                        busy ||
                        disabled ||
                        limit ||
                        !!group.state ||
                        groupLocked(group.id)
                      }
                    >
                      Удалить
                    </button>
                  </div>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
        <section className="card entry-panel entry-consumers">
          <h2 className="entry-panel-title">
            <EntryPointIcon kind="consumers" />
            <span>Назначения consumers</span>
          </h2>
          {deployments.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="muted">Нет deployments.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="entry-list">
              {deployments
                .filter((item) => item.state !== "deleting")
                .map((deployment) => {
                  const canSet =
                    catalogReady && eligible(deployment.serviceType);
                  const choices = groups.filter(
                    (group) => !group.state || group.id === deployment.endpointGroup,
                  );
                  const assignmentStatus = !canSet
                    ? {
                        tone: "neutral",
                        symbol: "·",
                        label: catalogReady
                          ? "Не поддерживает consumer"
                          : "Каталог недоступен",
                      }
                    : deployment.endpointGroup
                      ? {
                          tone: "success",
                          symbol: "✓",
                          label: `Назначена: ${deployment.endpointGroup}`,
                        }
                      : {
                          tone: "warning",
                          symbol: "!",
                          label: "Не назначена",
                        };
                  return (
                    <div key={deployment.id} className="entry-row">
                      <div>
                        <b>{deployment.id}</b>
                        <span>{deployment.serviceType}</span>
                        <small
                          className={`entry-state-chip entry-state-chip--${assignmentStatus.tone}`}
                        >
                          <span aria-hidden="true">{assignmentStatus.symbol}</span>
                          {assignmentStatus.label}
                        </small>
                      </div>
                      <div className="actions">
                        <select
                          aria-label={`Endpoint group for ${deployment.id}`}
                          value={deployment.endpointGroup || ""}
                          disabled={
                            busy ||
                            disabled ||
                            limit ||
                            deploymentLocked(deployment.id) ||
                            !canSet
                          }
                          onChange={(event) => {
                            if (event.target.value)
                              void onAppend({
                                operation: "SetServiceEndpointGroup",
                                deploymentId: deployment.id,
                                endpointGroupId: event.target.value,
                              });
                          }}
                        >
                          <option value="">Выберите группу</option>
                          {choices.map((group) => (
                            <option value={group.id} key={group.id}>
                              {group.id}{group.state === "deleting" ? " · будет удалена" : ""}
                            </option>
                          ))}
                        </select>
                        {deployment.endpointGroup && (
                          <button
                            className="outline"
                            onClick={() =>
                              void onAppend({
                                operation: "ClearServiceEndpointGroup",
                                deploymentId: deployment.id,
                              })
                            }
                            disabled={
                              busy ||
                              disabled ||
                              limit ||
                              deploymentLocked(deployment.id)
                            }
                          >
                            Очистить
                          </button>
                        )}
                      </div>
                    </div>
                  );
                })}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
        <section className="card entry-panel">
          <h2 className="entry-panel-title">
            <EntryPointIcon kind="provider" />
            <span>Provider / VIP</span>
          </h2>
          {providerDeployments.length === 0 ? (
            <p className="muted">Нет доступных provider deployments.</p>
          ) : (
            <div className="entry-list">
              {providerDeployments.map((deployment) => {
                const supported = providerEligible(deployment.serviceType);
                const readOnly = !catalogReady || !supported;
                const canClear =
                  !!deployment.endpointGroupRef &&
                  !providerLocked(deployment.id);
                const providerStatus =
                  deployment.providerEditState === "INCOMPLETE"
                    ? {
                        tone: "danger",
                        symbol: "!",
                        label: "Неполная конфигурация",
                      }
                    : deployment.providerEditState === "UNSUPPORTED"
                      ? {
                          tone: "neutral",
                          symbol: "·",
                          label: "Только просмотр",
                        }
                      : deployment.endpointGroupRef
                        ? {
                            tone: "success",
                            symbol: "✓",
                            label: "Настроен",
                          }
                        : {
                            tone: "warning",
                            symbol: "!",
                            label: "Не настроен",
                          };
                return (
                  <div key={deployment.id} className="entry-row">
                    <div>
                      <b>{deployment.id}</b>
                      <span>
                        {deployment.endpointGroupRef
                          ? `${deployment.endpointGroupRef} · VRID ${deployment.virtualRouterId || "—"}`
                          : "Provider не настроен"}
                      </span>
                      <small
                        className={`entry-state-chip entry-state-chip--${providerStatus.tone}`}
                      >
                        <span aria-hidden="true">{providerStatus.symbol}</span>
                        {providerStatus.label}
                      </small>
                      {deployment.virtualAddresses?.map((address) => (
                        <small key={`${address.address}-${address.interface}`}>
                          {address.address} · {address.interface}
                        </small>
                      ))}
                      {deployment.providerEditState === "INCOMPLETE" && (
                        <small>
                          Неполная конфигурация: завершите или очистите.
                        </small>
                      )}
                      {deployment.providerEditState === "UNSUPPORTED" && (
                        <small>
                          Legacy-конфигурация вне безопасных границ редактора.
                        </small>
                      )}
                      {!catalogReady && (
                        <small>
                          Каталог недоступен: редактирование выключено.
                        </small>
                      )}
                      {catalogReady && !supported && (
                        <small>Сервис не поддерживает endpoint provider.</small>
                      )}
                    </div>
                    <div className="actions">
                      <button
                        className="outline"
                        onClick={() => setProviderDialog(deployment)}
                        disabled={
                          busy ||
                          disabled ||
                          limit ||
                          readOnly ||
                          providerLocked(deployment.id)
                        }
                      >
                        {deployment.providerEditState === "UNSUPPORTED"
                          ? "Заменить"
                          : "Настроить"}
                      </button>
                      <button
                        className="outline danger"
                        onClick={() =>
                          void onAppend({
                            operation: "ClearEndpointProvider",
                            deploymentId: deployment.id,
                          })
                        }
                        disabled={busy || disabled || limit || !canClear}
                        title="Удаляет provider tuple из черновика. После сохранения Core потребует complete tuple или удаления deployment."
                      >
                        Очистить
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </div>
                );
              })}
            </div>
          )}
        </section>
      </div>
      {dialog && (
        <EndpointGroupDialog
          group={dialog.group}
          busy={busy}
          existing={new Set(groups.map((item) => item.id))}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) setDialog(null);
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}
      {providerDialog && (
        <ProviderDialog
          deployment={providerDialog}
          groups={groups.filter((group) => !group.state)}
          busy={busy}
          onClose={() => setProviderDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) setProviderDialog(null);
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function EntryPointIcon({
  kind,
}: {
  kind: "groups" | "consumers" | "provider";
}) {
  return (
    <svg
      className="entry-panel-icon"
      viewBox="0 0 20 20"
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth="1.5"
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
    >
      {kind === "groups" ? (
        <>
          <circle cx="4" cy="10" r="2" />
          <circle cx="15.5" cy="4.5" r="2" />
          <circle cx="15.5" cy="15.5" r="2" />
          <path d="m6 9 7.5-3.5M6 11l7.5 3.5" />
        </>
      ) : kind === "consumers" ? (
        <>
          <path d="M10 3v5m0 0-5 5m5-5 5 5" />
          <path d="M10 8v8m-2-2 2 2 2-2" />
          <path d="m3 11 2 2 2-2m6 0 2 2 2-2" />
        </>
      ) : (
        <>
          <rect x="5" y="2.5" width="10" height="5" rx="1" />
          <rect x="1.5" y="13" width="6" height="4.5" rx="1" />
          <rect x="12.5" y="13" width="6" height="4.5" rx="1" />
          <path d="M10 7.5v3M4.5 10.5h11m-11 0v2.5m11-2.5v2.5" />
        </>
      )}
    </svg>
  );
}

function EndpointGroupDialog({
  group,
  existing,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onAppend,
}: {
  group?: Group;
  existing: Set<string>;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAppend: (intent: EndpointIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [id, setID] = useState(group?.id || "");
  const [domain, setDomain] = useState(group?.domain || "");
  const [wildcard, setWildcard] = useState(group?.wildcard || false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const submit = async () => {
    const normalizedID = id.trim();
    const normalizedDomain = domain.trim().toLowerCase();
    if (!group && (!idPattern.test(normalizedID) || existing.has(normalizedID)))
      return setError("Введите уникальный ID группы.");
    if (
      !normalizedDomain ||
      normalizedDomain.length > 253 ||
      !normalizedDomain.includes(".")
    )
      return setError("Введите корректный домен.");
    const intent: EndpointIntent = group
      ? {
          operation: "UpdateEndpointGroup",
          endpointGroupId: group.id,
          endpointGroup: { address: { domain: normalizedDomain, wildcard } },
        }
      : {
          operation: "CreateEndpointGroup",
          endpointGroupId: normalizedID,
          endpointGroup: { address: { domain: normalizedDomain, wildcard } },
        };
    await onAppend(intent);
  };
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="dialog" aria-modal="true">
      <section className="card dialog">
        <h2>{group ? "Изменить группу" : "Добавить группу"}</h2>
        {!group && (
          <label>
            ID
            <input
              value={id}
              onChange={(event) => setID(event.target.value)}
              maxLength={128}
            />
          </label>
        )}
        <label>
          Домен
          <input
            value={domain}
            onChange={(event) => setDomain(event.target.value)}
            maxLength={253}
          />
        </label>
        <label className="checkbox">
          <input
            type="checkbox"
            checked={wildcard}
            onChange={(event) => setWildcard(event.target.checked)}
          />
          Wildcard
        </label>
        {error && <p className="field-error">{error}</p>}
        <div className="actions">
          <button className="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Отмена
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => void submit()} disabled={busy}>
            {group ? "Сохранить" : "Добавить"}
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function ProviderDialog({
  deployment,
  groups,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onAppend,
}: {
  deployment: Deployment;
  groups: Group[];
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAppend: (intent: ProviderIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [endpointGroupId, setEndpointGroupID] = useState(
    deployment.endpointGroupRef || "",
  );
  const [vrid, setVRID] = useState(
    deployment.virtualRouterId ? String(deployment.virtualRouterId) : "",
  );
  const [addresses, setAddresses] = useState(
    deployment.providerEditState === "UNSUPPORTED"
      ? [{ address: "", interface: "" }]
      : deployment.virtualAddresses?.length
        ? deployment.virtualAddresses
        : [{ address: "", interface: "" }],
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const submit = async () => {
    const normalized = addresses.map((item) => ({
      address: item.address.trim(),
      interface: item.interface.trim(),
    }));
    const parsedVRID = Number(vrid);
    const ipv4 =
      /^(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)(?:\.(?:25[0-5]|2[0-4]\d|1?\d?\d)){3}$/;
    if (
      !endpointGroupId ||
      !Number.isInteger(parsedVRID) ||
      parsedVRID < 1 ||
      parsedVRID > 255
    )
      return setError("Выберите группу и укажите VRID от 1 до 255.");
    if (
      normalized.length === 0 ||
      normalized.length > 64 ||
      normalized.some(
        (item) =>
          !ipv4.test(item.address) ||
          !item.interface ||
          item.interface.length > 128,
      ) ||
      new Set(
        normalized.map((item) => `${item.address}\\u0000${item.interface}`),
      ).size !== normalized.length
    )
      return setError(
        "Добавьте до 64 уникальных IPv4-адресов с interface длиной не более 128 символов.",
      );
    await onAppend({
      operation: "ReconcileEndpointProvider",
      deploymentId: deployment.id,
      endpointGroupId,
      virtualRouterId: parsedVRID,
      virtualAddresses: normalized,
    });
  };
  return (
    <div
      className="modal"
      role="dialog"
      aria-modal="true"
      aria-label="Настроить provider"
    >
      <section className="card dialog provider-dialog">
        <h2>Provider: {deployment.id}</h2>
        <p className="muted">
          Настройка сохраняется в общий черновик и будет проверена Core только
          после сохранения.
        </p>
        <label>
          Endpoint group
          <select
            value={endpointGroupId}
            onChange={(event) => setEndpointGroupID(event.target.value)}
          >
            <option value="">Выберите группу</option>
            {groups.map((group) => (
              <option key={group.id} value={group.id}>
                {group.id}
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          VRID
          <input
            value={vrid}
            inputMode="numeric"
            onChange={(event) => setVRID(event.target.value)}
          />
        </label>
        <h3>Virtual IP addresses</h3>
        <div className="provider-addresses">
          {addresses.map((item, index) => (
            <div className="provider-address" key={index}>
              <input
                aria-label={`IPv4 ${index + 1}`}
                value={item.address}
                placeholder="192.0.2.42"
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setAddresses((current) =>
                    current.map((row, rowIndex) =>
                      rowIndex === index
                        ? { ...row, address: event.target.value }
                        : row,
                    ),
                  )
                }
              />
              <input
                aria-label={`Interface ${index + 1}`}
                value={item.interface}
                placeholder="eth0"
                maxLength={128}
                onChange={(event) =>
                  setAddresses((current) =>
                    current.map((row, rowIndex) =>
                      rowIndex === index
                        ? { ...row, interface: event.target.value }
                        : row,
                    ),
                  )
                }
              />
              <button
                className="outline danger"
                aria-label={`Удалить адрес ${index + 1}`}
                onClick={() =>
                  setAddresses((current) =>
                    current.filter((_, rowIndex) => rowIndex !== index),
                  )
                }
                disabled={addresses.length === 1}
              >
                Удалить
              </button>
            </div>
          ))}
        </div>
        <button
          className="outline"
          onClick={() =>
            setAddresses((current) =>
              current.length < 64
                ? [...current, { address: "", interface: "" }]
                : current,
            )
          }
          disabled={addresses.length >= 64}
        >
          Добавить адрес
        </button>
        {error && <p className="field-error">{error}</p>}
        <div className="actions">
          <button className="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy}>
            Отмена
          </button>
          <button onClick={() => void submit()} disabled={busy}>
            Применить к черновику
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

  const date = new Date(timestamp);
  if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return "Время неизвестно";
  return `${new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", {
    timeZone: "Europe/Moscow",

    hour: "2-digit",
    minute: "2-digit",

    hourCycle: "h23",
  }).format(date)} МСК`;
}

export type ServicePriorityInput = {
  serviceType: string;
  priority: number | null;
};

export type ServiceDeploymentInput = {
  deploymentId: string;
  serviceType: string;
};

export type LibraryPriorityInput = {
  libraryName: string;
  priority: number | null;
};
export type LibraryDeploymentInput = {
  deploymentId: string;
  libraryRef: string;
};

export function libraryOrderFromPriorities(
  deployments: LibraryDeploymentInput[],
  priorities: LibraryPriorityInput[],
): { order: string[]; missingNames: string[] } {
  const byName = new Map(
    priorities.map((item, index) => [item.libraryName, { ...item, index }]),
  );
  const nameOf = (item: LibraryDeploymentInput) =>
    item.libraryRef.split("@", 1)[0];
  const missingNames = [
    ...new Set(
      deployments
        .filter((item) => byName.get(nameOf(item))?.priority == null)
        .map(nameOf),
    ),
  ].sort();
  if (missingNames.length) return { order: [], missingNames };
  return {
    order: [...deployments]
      .sort((left, right) => {
        const a = byName.get(nameOf(left))!;
        const b = byName.get(nameOf(right))!;
        return (
          a.priority! - b.priority! ||
          a.index - b.index ||
          (left.deploymentId < right.deploymentId
            ? -1
            : left.deploymentId > right.deploymentId
              ? 1
              : 0)
        );
      })
      .map((item) => item.deploymentId),
    missingNames: [],
  };
}

export function deploymentOrderFromPriorities(
  deployments: ServiceDeploymentInput[],
  priorities: ServicePriorityInput[],
): { order: string[]; missingTypes: string[] } {
  const byType = new Map(
    priorities.map((item, index) => [item.serviceType, { ...item, index }]),
  );
  const missingTypes = [
    ...new Set(
      deployments
        .filter(
          (item) =>
            !byType.has(item.serviceType) ||
            byType.get(item.serviceType)?.priority == null,
        )
        .map((item) => item.serviceType),
    ),
  ].sort();
  if (missingTypes.length) return { order: [], missingTypes };
  return {
    order: [...deployments]
      .sort((left, right) => {
        const leftPriority = byType.get(left.serviceType)!;
        const rightPriority = byType.get(right.serviceType)!;
        return (
          leftPriority.priority! - rightPriority.priority! ||
          leftPriority.index - rightPriority.index ||
          (left.deploymentId < right.deploymentId
            ? -1
            : left.deploymentId > right.deploymentId
              ? 1
              : 0)
        );
      })
      .map((item) => item.deploymentId),
    missingTypes: [],
  };
}

                  value={
                    applicationVaultSources[service.deploymentId] ||
                    "RUNTIME_INPUT"
                  }
                  onChange={(event) => {
                    const sources = { ...applicationVaultSources };
                    if (event.target.value === "CURRENT_RUN_BOOTSTRAP")
                      sources[service.deploymentId] = "CURRENT_RUN_BOOTSTRAP";
                    else delete sources[service.deploymentId];
                    onApplicationVaultSourcesChange(sources);
                  }}
                >
                  <option value="RUNTIME_INPUT">
                    Из секретов инфраструктурного Vault
                  </option>
                  <option
                    value="CURRENT_RUN_BOOTSTRAP"
                    disabled={
                      executionMode !== "FULL_PROJECT" ||
                      skippedServices.includes(service.deploymentId)
                    }
                  >
                    Из текущей установки Vault
                  </option>
                </select>
              </label>
            ))}
        {libraryDeployments.length > 0 && (
          <div aria-label="Выбор библиотек">
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>Библиотека</th>
                  <th>Установить</th>
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {libraryDeployments.map((library) => (
                  <tr key={library.deploymentId}>
                    <td>{library.deploymentId}</td>
                    <td>
                      <input
                        type="checkbox"
                        aria-label={
                          "Установить библиотеку " + library.deploymentId
                        }
                        checked={
                          !skippedLibraries.includes(library.deploymentId)
                        }
                        disabled={
                          busy ||
                          runActive ||
                          executionMode === "INFRASTRUCTURE_VERIFY_ONLY"
                        }
                        onChange={(event) =>
                          setSkippedLibraries((current) =>
                            !event.target.checked
                              ? [...current, library.deploymentId]
                              : current.filter(
                                  (id) => id !== library.deploymentId,
                                ),
                          )
                        }
                      />
                    </td>
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            <p className="muted">
              Установка и проверка библиотек со снятым флажком пропускаются. Их
              подключения остаются доступны интеграциям устанавливаемых
              приложений.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
      </div>
    ) : null;
  return (
    <section className="installation-page">
      {!!displayedPlan?.plan?.skipApplicationLibraries?.length && (
        <p role="status">
          Установка библиотек пропущена:{" "}
          {displayedPlan.plan.skipApplicationLibraries.join(", ")}. Необходимые
          интеграции сохраняются.
        </p>
      )}
      <div className="title">
        <div>
          <h1>Установка</h1>
          <p>Готовность, свежий план и выполнение сохранённой конфигурации.</p>
        </div>
        <span
          className={`readonly installation-status-pill ${presentation.tone}`}
          role="status"
        >
          <span>Текущий этап: </span>
          <strong>
            {presentation.stage === "plan"
              ? "План"
              : presentation.stage === "execution"
                ? "Выполнение"
                : "Результат"}
          </strong>
          {` · ${presentation.label}`}
          {presentation.percent !== undefined
            ? ` · ${presentation.percent}%`
            : ""}
        </span>
      </div>

      <nav
        className="installation-tabs"
        role="tablist"
        aria-label="Разделы установки"
        onKeyDown={(event) => {
          const index = tabLabels.findIndex((item) => item.id === tab);
          const next =
            event.key === "ArrowRight"
              ? (index + 1) % tabLabels.length
              : event.key === "ArrowLeft"
                ? (index - 1 + tabLabels.length) % tabLabels.length
                : event.key === "Home"
                  ? 0
                  : event.key === "End"
                    ? tabLabels.length - 1
                    : -1;
          if (next < 0) return;
          event.preventDefault();
          onTabChange(tabLabels[next].id);
          (
            event.currentTarget.querySelectorAll('[role="tab"]')[
              next
            ] as HTMLButtonElement
          )?.focus();
        }}
      >
        {tabLabels.map((item) => (
          <button
            key={item.id}
            type="button"
            className={tab === item.id ? "active" : "outline"}
            role="tab"
            id={`installation-tab-${item.id}`}
            aria-controls={`installation-panel-${item.id}`}
            aria-selected={tab === item.id}
            tabIndex={tab === item.id ? 0 : -1}
            onClick={() => onTabChange(item.id)}
          >
            {item.label}
          </button>
        ))}
      </nav>
      <div
        className="installation-body"
        role="tabpanel"
        id={`installation-panel-${tab}`}
        aria-labelledby={`installation-tab-${tab}`}
        tabIndex={0}
      >
        {tab === "summary" && (
          <section className="installation-summary">
            <article className="card">
              <h2>Узел выполнения · необходимое условие</h2>
              <dl>
                <dt>Состояние</dt>
                <dd>
                  {executionNodeStatusLabel(node?.status || "NOT_CONFIGURED")}
                </dd>
                <dt>Узел</dt>
                <dd>{node?.safeLabel || "Не выбран"}</dd>
                <dt>Подготовка</dt>
                <dd>Доступна только на странице «Серверы».</dd>
              </dl>
              <p>
                <button className="outline" onClick={onOpenServers}>
                  Открыть Серверы
                </button>
              </p>
            </article>
            <article className="card">
              <h2>Сохранённый проект</h2>
              {state?.project ? (
                <dl>
                  <dt>Ревизия</dt>
                  <dd>{state.project.revision}</dd>
                  <dt>Проверка</dt>
                  <dd>{verificationLabel(state.project.verificationStatus)}</dd>
                  <dt>Изменения</dt>
                  <dd>
                    {state.project.hasUnsavedChanges
                      ? "Есть несохранённые"
                      : "Сохранено"}
                  </dd>
                </dl>
              ) : (
                <p>Сохранённый проект пока недоступен.</p>
              )}
            </article>
            <article className="card installation-summary-plan">
              <h2>Состав запуска</h2>
              {servicesControl}
              {librariesControl}
              <div className="installation-summary-plan-heading">
                <div>
                  <h2>План установки</h2>
                  <div className="installation-summary-plan-meta">
                    <span>
                      <b>
                        {displayedPlan?.plan
                          ? displayedPlan.plan.phases.reduce(
                              (count, phase) => count + phase.actions.length,
                              0,
                            )
                          : 0}
                      </b>{" "}
                      действий
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      Ревизия: {displayedPlan?.plan?.projectRevision || "—"}
                    </span>
                    <span>
                      Статус:{" "}
                      {displayedPlan
                        ? runActive
                          ? "Выполняется"
                          : planOperationStatusLabel(displayedPlan.status)
                        : "План не сформирован"}
                    </span>
                  </div>
                </div>
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="primary"
                  onClick={() => onTabChange("plan")}
                >
                  Открыть план
                </button>
              </div>
              {displayedPlan?.plan ? (
                <div className="installation-summary-plan-actions">
                  <table>
                    <thead>
                      <tr>
                        <th scope="col">#</th>
                        <th scope="col">Действие</th>
                        <th scope="col">Целевые узлы</th>
                      </tr>
                    </thead>
                    <tbody>
                      {displayedPlan.plan.phases
                        .flatMap((phase) => phase.actions)
                        .map((action, index) => (
                          <tr key={action.id}>
                            <td>{index + 1}</td>
                            <td>{planActionLabel(action)}</td>
                            <td>
                              {action.targets.join(", ") || "без целевых узлов"}
                            </td>
                          </tr>
                        ))}
                    </tbody>
                  </table>
                  {displayedPlan.plan.phases.every(
                    (phase) => phase.actions.length === 0,
                  ) && <p>В плане пока нет действий.</p>}
                </div>
              ) : (
                <p className="muted">
                  Предварительный список действий появится после формирования
                  свежего плана.
                </p>
              )}
            </article>
          </section>
        )}
        {tab === "plan" && (
          <>
            <PlanStage
              starting={starting}
              key={plan?.plan?.id || "no-plan"}
              servicesControl={servicesControl}
              serviceCheckbox={serviceCheckbox}
              librariesControl={librariesControl}
              scopeChanged={!runActive && scopeChanged}
              skipChanged={!runActive && skipChanged}
              infrastructureExcluded={
                executionMode === "APPLICATION_LIBRARIES_ONLY"
              }
              state={state}
              draftActive={draftActive}
              operation={
                ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
                  run?.run?.state || "",
                ) && runPlan
                  ? { status: "PLAN_APPROVED", plan: runPlan }
                  : plan
              }
              busy={
                busy ||
                ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
                  run?.run?.state || "",
                )
              }
              onCreatePlan={createPlan}
              orderError={orderError}
              onApprovePlan={onApprovePlan}
              approvalErrorAttempt={approvalErrorAttempt}
              onStart={onStart}
              run={run}
              credentialStatus={credentialStatus}
              onSetOutputEncryptionPassword={onSetOutputEncryptionPassword}
            />
          </>
        )}
        {tab === "execution" && (
          <ExecutionStage
            run={run}
            plan={runPlan}
            progress={runProgress}
            events={events}
            busy={busy}
            onCancel={onCancel}
            onOpenPendingOutputs={() => {
              onTabChange("result");
              onRefreshSecretOutputs();
            }}
          />
        )}
        {tab === "result" && (
          <ResultStage
            run={run}
            plan={runPlan}
            progress={runProgress}
            events={events}
            secretOutputPackages={secretOutputPackages}
            outputDelivery={outputDelivery}
            onOpenPendingOutputs={onRefreshSecretOutputs}
            onCollectSecretOutputs={onCollectSecretOutputs}
          />
        )}
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function PlanStage({
  servicesControl,
  serviceCheckbox,
  librariesControl,
  scopeChanged,
  skipChanged,
  infrastructureExcluded,
  state,
  draftActive,
  operation,
  busy,
  starting = false,
  onCreatePlan,
  orderError,
  onApprovePlan,
  approvalErrorAttempt,
  onStart,
  run,
  credentialStatus,
  onSetOutputEncryptionPassword,
}: {
  servicesControl: ReactNode;
  serviceCheckbox: (id: string) => ReactNode;
  librariesControl: ReactNode;
  scopeChanged: boolean;
  skipChanged: boolean;
  infrastructureExcluded: boolean;
  state?: InstallationState;
  draftActive: boolean;
  operation?: InstallationPlanOperation;
  busy: boolean;
  starting?: boolean;
  onCreatePlan: () => void;
  orderError: string;
  onApprovePlan: (planId: string, acknowledgements: string[]) => void;
  approvalErrorAttempt: number;
  onStart: (planId: string) => void;
  run?: InstallationRunOperation;
  credentialStatus: SessionCredentialStatus | null;
  onSetOutputEncryptionPassword: (
    password: string,
    confirm: string,
  ) => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [acknowledged, setAcknowledged] = useState<string[]>([]);
  const [expandedActions, setExpandedActions] = useState<
    Record<string, boolean>
  >({});
  const [outputPasswordAcknowledgement, setOutputPasswordAcknowledgement] =
    useState<InstallationPlanOperation>();
  const outputPasswordPresent =
    !!operation?.plan?.secretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresent ||
    (!!operation && outputPasswordAcknowledgement === operation);
  const [outputPassword, setOutputPassword] = useState("");
  const [outputConfirm, setOutputConfirm] = useState("");
  const [outputError, setOutputError] = useState("");
  const errorsRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const handledApprovalErrorAttempt = useRef(approvalErrorAttempt);
  useEffect(() => {
    if (
      approvalErrorAttempt > handledApprovalErrorAttempt.current &&
      operation?.error
    ) {
      handledApprovalErrorAttempt.current = approvalErrorAttempt;
      errorsRef.current?.focus();
    }
  }, [approvalErrorAttempt, operation?.error]);
  const plan = operation?.plan;
  if (!plan) {
    return (
      <article className="card installation-empty">
        <h2>План</h2>
        {servicesControl}
        {librariesControl}
        <p>
          {operation?.error && (
            <>
              <code>{operation.error.code}</code> —{" "}
            </>
          )}
          {operation?.error?.message || "Свежий план ещё не создан."}
          {!!operation?.error?.diagnosticCodes?.length && (
            <> Диагностика Core: {operation.error.diagnosticCodes.join(", ")}</>
          )}
        </p>
        {orderError && (
          <p className="error" role="alert">
            {orderError}
          </p>
        )}
        <button onClick={onCreatePlan} disabled={busy}>
          {busy ? "Формирование плана…" : "Сформировать свежий план"}
        </button>
      </article>
    );
  }
  const requiredCodes = plan.acknowledgements.map((item) => item.code);
  const required = !!plan.pkiStorePasswordRequired;
  const present = credentialStatus?.pkiStorePasswordStatus === "PRESENT";
  const outputRequired = !!plan.secretOutputEncryptionRequired;
  const outputReady = !outputRequired || outputPasswordPresent;
  const displayedPhases =
    infrastructureExcluded && scopeChanged
      ? plan.phases.map((phase) =>
          phase.id === "services"
            ? {
                ...phase,
                actions: phase.actions.filter(
                  (action) => action.type !== "SERVICE_APPLY",
                ),
              }
            : phase,
        )
      : plan.phases;
  const runActive = ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
    run?.run?.state || "",
  );
  const currentPlan =
    !skipChanged &&
    !runActive &&
    !draftActive &&
    !state?.project?.hasUnsavedChanges &&
    state?.executionNode.status === "READY" &&
    state?.project?.revision === plan.projectRevision &&
    state?.plan.planId === plan.id;
  const canApprove =
    currentPlan &&
    (scopeChanged || state?.status === "PLAN_REVIEW") &&
    (scopeChanged || state?.plan.status === "PLAN_REVIEW") &&
    plan.status === "EXECUTABLE" &&
    (scopeChanged || !plan.approved) &&
    requiredCodes.every((code) => acknowledged.includes(code)) &&
    outputReady;
  const canStart =
    !scopeChanged &&
    currentPlan &&
    !["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(run?.run?.state || "") &&
    state?.status === "PLAN_APPROVED" &&
    state.plan.status === "PLAN_APPROVED" &&
    plan.status === "EXECUTABLE" &&
    plan.approved;
  const startBlockers: Array<{ code: string; message: string }> = [];
  const addStartBlocker = (code: string, message: string) => {
    if (
      !startBlockers.some(
        (item) => item.code === code && item.message === message,
      )
    )
      startBlockers.push({ code, message });
  };
  for (const prerequisite of state?.prerequisites || []) {
    const message =
      prerequisite.code === "EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED"
        ? "Узел выполнения не готов. Откройте «Серверы» и проверьте его состояние."
        : planFindingMessage(prerequisite.safeMessage);
    addStartBlocker(prerequisite.code, message);
  }
  for (const finding of plan.findings || []) {
    addStartBlocker(finding.code, planFindingMessage(finding.safeMessage));
  }
  if (draftActive || state?.project?.hasUnsavedChanges) {
    addStartBlocker(
      "PROJECT_HAS_UNSAVED_CHANGES",
      "Есть несохранённые изменения проекта. Сохраните или отмените их и сформируйте новый план.",
    );
  }
  if (state?.executionNode.status !== "READY") {
    addStartBlocker(
      "EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED",
      "Узел выполнения не готов. Откройте «Серверы» и проверьте его состояние.",
    );
  }
  if (state?.project?.revision !== plan.projectRevision) {
    addStartBlocker(
      "PLAN_PROJECT_REVISION_MISMATCH",
      "План создан для другой ревизии проекта. Сформируйте свежий план.",
    );
  }
  if (state?.plan.planId !== plan.id) {
    addStartBlocker(
      "PLAN_NOT_CURRENT",
      "Этот план больше не является текущим. Сформируйте свежий план.",
    );
  }
  if (
    state?.status !== "PLAN_APPROVED" ||
    state?.plan.status !== "PLAN_APPROVED"
  ) {
    addStartBlocker(
      "PLAN_APPROVAL_REQUIRED",
      "Текущий план не находится в состоянии «Одобрен». Одобрите свежий план.",
    );
  }
  if (plan.status !== "EXECUTABLE") {
    addStartBlocker(
      "PLAN_NOT_EXECUTABLE",
      "План заблокирован. Исправьте перечисленные замечания и сформируйте его заново.",
    );
  }
  if (required && !present) {
    addStartBlocker(
      "PKI_STORE_PASSWORD_REQUIRED",
      "В сеансе не задан пароль хранилищ PKCS#12, необходимый плану.",
    );
  }
  if (!outputReady) {
    addStartBlocker(
      "SECRET_OUTPUT_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD_REQUIRED",
      "Для защищённых выходных файлов задайте пароль шифрования в настройках плана.",
    );
  }
  if (!canStart && startBlockers.length === 0) {
    addStartBlocker(
      "START_PREREQUISITES_UNAVAILABLE",
      "Проверьте актуальность плана и готовность узла выполнения.",
    );
  }
  const hasActions = displayedPhases.some((phase) => phase.actions.length > 0);
  const saveOutputPassword = async () => {
    setOutputError("");
    try {
      await onSetOutputEncryptionPassword(outputPassword, outputConfirm);
      setOutputPassword("");
      setOutputConfirm("");
      setOutputPasswordAcknowledgement(operation);
    } catch (reason) {
      const code =
        typeof reason === "string" ? reason : "SECRET_OUTPUT_PASSWORD_INVALID";
      setOutputError(
        code === "SECRET_OUTPUT_PASSWORD_INVALID"
          ? "Пароли шифрования не совпадают или не подходят. Проверьте оба поля."
          : code,
      );
    }
  };
  return (
    <section className="installation-plan-content">
      <div className="installation-plan-scroll">
        <article className="card">
          <h2>Новый план установки</h2>
          {plan.skipInfrastructureVerify && (
            <p role="alert">
              Проверка инфраструктуры явно пропущена. Риски приняты
              пользователем; успешный Verify не подтверждён этим запуском.
            </p>
          )}
          {plan.executionMode === "APPLICATION_LIBRARIES_ONLY" &&
            !plan.skipInfrastructureVerify &&
            plan.infrastructureVerification && (
              <section aria-label="Проверка инфраструктуры">
                <h3>
                  {plan.infrastructureVerification.status === "PASS"
                    ? "Инфраструктура проверена"
                    : "Проверка инфраструктуры не подтверждена"}
                </h3>
                <p>
                  {plan.infrastructureVerification.status}
                  {plan.infrastructureVerification.code
                    ? ` · ${plan.infrastructureVerification.code}`
                    : ""}
                </p>
                {plan.infrastructureObservedAt && (
                  <p>Получено: {plan.infrastructureObservedAt}</p>
                )}
                <ul>
                  {plan.infrastructureVerification.deployments.map((item) => (
                    <li key={item.deploymentId}>
                      {item.deploymentId} · Verify {item.verifiedAt}
                    </li>
                  ))}
                </ul>
                {plan.infrastructureCacheWarning && (
                  <p role="status">
                    Локальное наблюдение не сохранено. Решение текущего плана
                    получено от Core.
                  </p>
                )}
              </section>
            )}

          <dl>
            <dt>Статус</dt>
            <dd>{planOperationStatusLabel(operation.status)}</dd>
            <dt>Ревизия проекта</dt>
            <dd>{plan.projectRevision}</dd>
            <dt>Узел выполнения</dt>
            <dd>{plan.executionNodeId}</dd>
            <dt>Истекает</dt>
            <dd>
              <time dateTime={plan.expiresAt}>
                {planExpiryLabel(plan.expiresAt)}
              </time>
            </dd>
          </dl>
        </article>
        {(operation.error || run?.error) && (
          <article
            className="card installation-plan-errors"
            role="alert"
            tabIndex={-1}
            ref={errorsRef}
          >
            <h2>Ошибки плана</h2>
            <ul>
              {operation.error && (
                <li>
                  <code>{operation.error.code}</code> —{" "}
                  {operation.error.message}
                  {!!operation.error.diagnosticCodes?.length && (
                    <span>
                      {" "}
                      Диагностика Core и плана:{" "}
                      {operation.error.diagnosticCodes.join(", ")}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </li>
              )}
              {run?.error && (
                <li>
                  <code>{run.error.code}</code> — {run.error.message}
                  {!!run.error.diagnosticCodes?.length && (
                    <span>
                      {" "}
                      Диагностика Core: {run.error.diagnosticCodes.join(", ")}
                    </span>
                  )}
                </li>
              )}
            </ul>
          </article>
        )}
        {!currentPlan && !runActive && (
          <article className="card">
            <p role="status">
              Этот план нельзя использовать для текущего состояния проекта.
              Сохраните или отмените черновик и сформируйте свежий план.
            </p>
            {(state?.status === "READY_TO_PLAN" || scopeChanged) && (
              <>
                {orderError && (
                  <p className="error" role="alert">
                    {orderError}
                  </p>
                )}
                <button onClick={onCreatePlan} disabled={busy}>
                  Сформировать свежий план
                </button>
              </>
            )}
          </article>
        )}
        {plan.findings && plan.findings.length > 0 && (
          <article className="card">
            <h2>Замечания</h2>
            <ul className="safe-findings">
              {plan.findings.map((item, index) => (
                <li key={`${item.code}:${index}`}>
                  <code>{item.code}</code>{" "}
                  {planFindingMessage(item.safeMes
@@END

                </li>
              ))}
            </ul>
          </article>
        )}
        {outputRequired && (
          <details
            className="card secret-output-setup"
            open={!outputPasswordPresent}
          >
            <summary>
              Защищённые выходные файлы
              {outputPasswordPresent

                Пароль не отправляется на узел выполнения и хранится только в
                памяти сеанса.
              </p>
              {!outputPasswordPresent && (
                <>
                  <label>
                    Пароль шифрования
                    <input
                      type="password"
                      value={outputPassword}
                      onChange={(event) =>
                        setOutputPassword(event.target.value)
                      }
