                    Повторите пароль
                    <input
                      type="password"
                      value={outputConfirm}
                      onChange={(event) => setOutputConfirm(event.target.value)}
                      disabled={busy}
                      autoComplete="new-password"
                    />
                  </label>
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    onClick={saveOutputPassword}
                    disabled={busy || !outputPassword || !outputConfirm}
                  >
                    Сохранить пароль в сеансе
                  </button>
                </>
              )}
              <p>
                Файлы сохраняются в каталоге secrets/&lt;ID развёртывания&gt;/
                текущего проекта.
              </p>
              {outputError && (
                <p className="field-error" role="alert">
                  {outputError}
                </p>
              )}
            </div>
          </details>
        )}
        <article className="card installation-plan-phases">
          <h2>Этапы плана</h2>
          {!displayedPhases.some((phase) => phase.id === "services") && (
            <section className="plan-phase-card">
              <h3>services · Инфраструктура</h3>
              {servicesControl}
            </section>
          )}
          {librariesControl &&
            !displayedPhases.some((phase) => phase.id === "applications") && (
              <section className="plan-phase-card">
                <h3>Библиотеки</h3>
                {librariesControl}
              </section>
            )}
          {!hasActions && (
            <p role="status">
              В плане нет действий по развёртыванию сервисов. Проверьте состав и
              размещение сервисов в проекте.
            </p>
          )}
          {displayedPhases.map((phase) => (
            <details
              className={`plan-phase-card${phase.id === "services" && infrastructureExcluded ? " installation-phase-excluded" : ""}`}
              key={phase.id}
              open={phase.order < 2}
            >
              <summary>
                <span className="plan-phase-number">{phase.order + 1}</span>
                <span className="plan-phase-title">
                  <b>
                    {phase.id === "pki"
                      ? "Сертификаты"
                      : phase.id === "apply"
                        ? "Применение"
                        : phase.id === "verify"
                          ? "Проверка и завершение"
                          : phase.id === "services"
                            ? "services · Инфраструктура"
                            : phase.id === "applications"
                              ? "Библиотеки"
                              : phase.id}
                  </b>
                  <small>
                    {phase.actions.length}{" "}
                    {phase.actions.length === 1 ? "действие" : "действий"}
                    {phase.actions.length > 0 &&
                      ` · ${[...new Set(phase.actions.flatMap((action) => action.targets))].join(", ") || "без целевых узлов"}`}
                  </small>
                </span>
                <span className="plan-phase-state">
                  {phase.id === "services" && infrastructureExcluded
                    ? "Исключено из выбранного запуска"
                    : scopeChanged
                      ? "Требуется свежий план"
                      : plan.status !== "EXECUTABLE"
                        ? "Есть замечания"
                        : plan.approved
                          ? "Готово к выполнению"
                          : "Ожидает одобрения"}
                </span>
              </summary>
              {phase.id === "services" && servicesControl}
              {phase.id === "applications" && librariesControl}
              <div className="plan-phase-actions">
                {phase.actions
                  .slice(
                    0,
                    expandedActions[phase.id]
                      ? phase.actions.length
                      : Math.min(3, phase.actions.length),
                  )
                  .map((action, index) => (
                    <div className="plan-action-row" key={action.id}>
                      <span className="plan-action-number">
                        {action.type === "SERVICE_APPLY" &&
                        action.serviceDeployment
                          ? serviceCheckbox(action.serviceDeployment)
                          : index + 1}
                      </span>
                      <span className="plan-action-description">
                        <b>{planActionLabel(action)}</b>
                        {!!action.progressSteps?.length && (
                          <ul className="plan-progress-steps">
                            {action.progressSteps.map((step) => (
                              <li key={step.id}>{step.summary}</li>
                            ))}
                          </ul>
                        )}
                        {action.serviceDeployment && (
                          <small>
                            Развёртывание: {action.serviceDeployment}
                          </small>
                        )}
                      </span>
                      <span className="plan-action-targets">
                        {action.targets.join(", ") || "без целевых серверов"}
                      </span>
                      <span className="plan-action-impact">
                        {action.mutating ? "Инфраструктура" : "Проверка"}
                      </span>
                    </div>
                  ))}
                {phase.actions.length > 3 && (
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="link plan-show-more"
                    aria-expanded={!!expandedActions[phase.id]}
                    onClick={() =>
                      setExpandedActions((current) => ({
                        ...current,
                        [phase.id]: !current[phase.id],
                      }))
                    }
                  >
                    {expandedActions[phase.id]
                      ? "Скрыть дополнительные действия"
                      : `Показать ещё ${phase.actions.length - 3} действий`}
                  </button>
                )}
              </div>
            </details>
          ))}
        </article>
        {plan.status === "EXECUTABLE" && (scopeChanged || !plan.approved) && (
          <article className="card">
            <h2>Подтверждение</h2>
            {plan.acknowledgements.map((item) => (
              <label className="acknowledgement" key={item.code}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={acknowledged.includes(item.code)}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setAcknowledged((current) =>
                      event.target.checked
                        ? [...current, item.code]
                        : current.filter((code) => code !== item.code),
                    )
                  }
                />{" "}
                <span>
                  <b>{item.code}</b>
                  <br />
                  {item.summary}
                </span>
              </label>
            ))}
          </article>
        )}
      </div>
      {plan.status === "EXECUTABLE" && (scopeChanged || !plan.approved) && (
        <footer
          className="installation-plan-actions"
          aria-label="Подтверждение плана"
        >
          <span className="muted" role="status">
            {canApprove
              ? "План проверен и готов к одобрению и запуску."
              : "Отметьте обязательные подтверждения, чтобы одобрить и запустить план."}
          </span>
          <button
            type="button"
            onClick={() => onApprovePlan(plan.id, requiredCodes)}
            disabled={busy || !canApprove}
          >
            {starting
              ? "Запускается выполнение…"
              : "Одобрить и начать установку"}
          </button>
        </footer>
      )}
      {plan.approved && !scopeChanged && (
        <StartApproval
          starting={starting}
          plan={plan}
          busy={busy}
          canStart={canStart}
          onStart={onStart}
          credentialStatus={credentialStatus}
          outputReady={outputReady}
          startBlockers={startBlockers}
          runActive={["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
            run?.run?.state || "",
          )}
        />
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

function StartApproval({
  plan,
  busy,
  starting = false,
  canStart,
  onStart,
  credentialStatus,
  outputReady,
  startBlockers,
  runActive,
}: {
  plan: NonNullable<InstallationPlanOperation["plan"]>;
  busy: boolean;
  starting?: boolean;
  canStart: boolean;
  onStart: (planId: string) => void;
  credentialStatus: SessionCredentialStatus | null;
  outputReady: boolean;
  startBlockers: Array<{ code: string; message: string }>;
  runActive: boolean;
}) {
  const required = plan.pkiStorePasswordRequired;
  const present = credentialStatus?.pkiStorePasswordStatus === "PRESENT";
  return (
    <footer
      className="installation-plan-actions"
      aria-label="Действия с планом"
    >
      <div className="installation-start-gate">
        <span className="muted" role="status">
          {starting
            ? "Запускается выполнение…"
            : runActive
              ? "Выполнение этого плана уже запущено."
              : canStart && (!required || present) && outputReady
                ? "Одобренный план готов к запуску."
                : "Запуск пока недоступен. Устраните причины ниже:"}
        </span>
        {!runActive && startBlockers.length > 0 && (
          <ul
            className="safe-findings"
            aria-label="Причины недоступности запуска"
          >
            {startBlockers.map((item, index) => (
              <li key={`${item.code}:${index}`}>
                <code>{item.code}</code> {item.message}
              </li>
            ))}
          </ul>
        )}
      </div>
      <button
        type="button"
        className="primary"
        onClick={() => onStart(plan.id)}
        disabled={
          busy ||
          !canStart ||
          (required && !present) ||
          !outputReady ||
          runActive
        }
      >
        {starting ? "Запускается выполнение…" : "Начать выполнение"}
      </button>
    </footer>
  );
}

function ExecutionStage({
  run,
  plan,
  progress,
  events,
  busy,
  onCancel,
  onOpenPendingOutputs,
}: {
  run?: InstallationRunOperation;
  plan?: InstallationPlanView;
  progress?: RunProgress;
  events: InstallationEventView[];
  busy: boolean;
  onCancel: (runId: string) => void;
  onOpenPendingOutputs: () => void;
}) {
  const eventScrollRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const visibleEvents = events.slice(-executionEventWindowSize);
  const outputBusy =
    run?.error?.code === "OUTPUT_BUSY" ||
    events.some(
      (event) => executionDiagnosticCode(event.safeMessage) === "OUTPUT_BUSY",
    );
  useEffect(() => {
    const scrollContainer = eventScrollRef.current;
    if (scrollContainer)
      scrollContainer.scrollTop = scrollContainer.scrollHeight;
  }, [events.length]);
  if (!run?.run)
    return (
      <article className="card installation-empty">
        <h2>Выполнение</h2>
        {run?.error ? (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            Запуск не начался: <code>{run.error.code}</code> {run.error.message}
            {!!run.error.diagnosticCodes?.length && (
              <> Диагностика Core: {run.error.diagnosticCodes.join(", ")}</>
            )}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <p>В этом сеансе запуск ещё не начат.</p>
        )}
        {outputBusy && (
          <OutputBusyNotice onOpenPendingOutputs={onOpenPendingOutputs} />
        )}
      </article>
    );
  const display = installationDisplay(undefined, run, progress);
  const currentAction = installationActionRows(plan).find(
    (action) =>
      action.id === progress?.activeActionId &&
      ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(run.run!.state),
  );
  const lastTask = [...events]
    .reverse()
    .find((event) => event.eventType === "TASK_COMPLETED" && event.task?.name);
  const runEvents = events.filter((event) => event.runId === run.run!.runId);
  const started = runEvents
    .filter((event) => event.eventType === "RUN_STARTED")
    .reduce<InstallationEventView | undefined>(
      (first, event) =>
        !first || event.sequence < first.sequence ? event : first,
      undefined,
    );
  const terminalStatus: Record<string, string> = {
    SUCCEEDED: "SUCCESS",
    FAILED: "FAILED",
    CANCELLED: "CANCELLED",
    INTERRUPTED: "INTERRUPTED",
  };
  const completed = terminalStatus[run.run.state]
    ? runEvents.find(
        (event) =>
          event.sequence === run.run!.sequence &&
          event.eventType === "DIAGNOSTIC" &&
          event.status === terminalStatus[run.run!.state] &&
          !event.actionId &&
          !event.task,
      )
    : undefined;
  const runTime = (timestamp?: string) => {
    const date = new Date(timestamp || "");
    return Number.isFinite(date.getTime())
      ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", {
          dateStyle: "short",
          timeStyle: "medium",
          timeZone: "Europe/Moscow",
        }).format(date)
      : undefined;
  };
  const startedTime = runTime(started?.timestamp);
  const completedTime = runTime(completed?.timestamp);
  return (
    <section className="execution-stage-content">
      <article className="card execution-overview">
        {outputBusy && (
          <OutputBusyNotice onOpenPendingOutputs={onOpenPendingOutputs} />
        )}
        <div className="installation-stage-heading">
          <div>
            <h2>{display.label}</h2>
            <p>
              Запуск: {run.run.runId} · {runStatusLabel(run.run.state)}
            </p>
            {run.reconnected && (
              <p>
                Переподключено к прежнему запуску. Ревизия:{" "}
                {run.projectRevision}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          {(["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(run.run.state) ||
            run.cancelUnconfirmed) && (
            <button
              className="outline"
              disabled={busy}
              onClick={() => onCancel(run.run!.runId)}
            >
              Отменить выполнение
            </button>
          )}
        </div>
        {display.percent !== undefined && progress && (
          <div className="installation-progress">
            <div>
              <span>
                {progress.completedActionIds.length} из{" "}
                {progress.actionIds.length} действий плана подтверждены
              </span>
              <strong>{display.percent}%</strong>
            </div>
            <progress
              max={100}
              value={display.percent}
              aria-label="Прогресс подтверждённых действий плана"
            />
          </div>
        )}
        {display.percent === undefined && (
          <p className="installation-progress-unavailable">
            Точный процент недоступен: нет полного подтверждённого потока
            действий плана.
          </p>
        )}
        <p className="installation-current-action">
          {currentAction ? (
            <>
              Текущее действие: <b>{planActionLabel(currentAction)}</b> ·{" "}
              {currentAction.targets.join(", ") || "без целевых серверов"}
            </>
          ) : (
            "Активное действие пока не подтверждено."
          )}
        </p>
        {lastTask && (
          <p className="installation-current-task">
            Последняя завершённая задача: {taskNameWithoutRole(lastTask)}{" "}
            {lastTask.host ? `· ${lastTask.host}` : ""} ·{" "}
            {eventStatusLabel(lastTask.status)}
          </p>
        )}
      </article>
      <div className="execution-event-workspace">
        <article className="card execution-event-table-card">
          <div className="execution-event-title">
            <h2>События выполнения</h2>
            <span>
              {events.length > executionEventWindowSize
                ? `Показаны последние ${executionEventWindowSize}; всего ${events.length}`
                : `Всего событий: ${events.length}`}
            </span>
          </div>
          {events.length === 0 ? (
            <p>События ещё не получены.</p>
          ) : (
            <>
              <div
                className="execution-event-table-scroll"
                ref={eventScrollRef}
              >
                <table className="execution-event-table">
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th scope="col">Время</th>
                      <th scope="col">Событие / задача</th>
                      <th scope="col">Развёртывание</th>
                      <th scope="col">Узел</th>
                      <th scope="col">Результат</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {visibleEvents.map((event) => (
                      <tr key={`${event.runId}-${event.sequence}`}>
                        <td>
                          <time dateTime={event.timestamp || undefined}>
                            {eventTimestampLabel(event.timestamp)}
                          </time>
                        </td>
                        <td>
                          <span className="execution-event-select">
                            {taskNameWithoutRole(event) ||
                              eventMessageLabel(event.safeMessage) ||
                              event.eventType}
                          </span>
                          <small>{eventMessageLabel(event.safeMessage)}</small>
                          {event.errorCode && (
                            <small className="field-error">
                              <code>{event.errorCode}</code>{" "}
                              {event.errorSummary}
                            </small>
                          )}
                        </td>
                        <td>{event.serviceDeployment || "—"}</td>
                        <td>{event.host || "—"}</td>
                        <td>{eventStatusLabel(event.status)}</td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            </>
          )}
        </article>
        <article className="card execution-plan-card">
          <div className="execution-event-title">
            <h2>Действия плана</h2>
            {progress && (
              <span>
                {progress.completedActionIds.length} из{" "}
                {progress.actionIds.length} завершено
              </span>
            )}
          </div>
          <p className="execution-plan-timestamp">
            Начало установки:{" "}
            {startedTime ? (
              <time dateTime={started!.timestamp}>{startedTime} МСК</time>
            ) : (
              "время ещё не получено"
            )}
          </p>
          <div className="execution-plan-scroll">
            {!plan?.phases.some((phase) => phase.actions.length) ? (
              <p>Действия плана для этого запуска недоступны.</p>
            ) : (
              <ol className="execution-plan-actions">
                {installationActionRows(plan).map((action) => {
                  const outcome = progress?.actionOutcomes[action.id];
                  const completion = events.find(
                    (event) =>
                      event.runId === run.run!.runId &&
                      event.actionId === action.id &&
                      event.eventType === "ACTION_COMPLETED" &&
                      event.sequence ===
                        progress?.actionOutcomeSequences[action.id],
                  );
                  const completedDate = new Date(completion?.timestamp || "");
                  const completedTime = Number.isFinite(completedDate.getTime())
                    ? new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", {
                        timeZone: "Europe/Moscow",
                        hour: "2-digit",
                        minute: "2-digit",
                        second: "2-digit",
                      }).format(completedDate)
                    : "Время неизвестно";
                  const active =
                    (progress?.activeActionId === action.id ||
                      (!!action.progressSteps?.length &&
                        progress?.stepParents[progress.activeActionId || ""] ===
                          action.id)) &&
                    ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
                      run.run!.state,
                    );
                  const waiting =
                    !outcome &&
                    !active &&
                    progress?.complete &&
                    ["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"].includes(
                      run.run!.state,
                    );
                  const label = active
                    ? "Выполняется"
                    : waiting
                      ? "Ожидает"
                      : actionResultLabel(action.id, run.run!.state, progress);
                  const tone = active
                    ? "running"
                    : ["SUCCESS", "CHANGED"].includes(outcome || "")
                      ? "success"
                      : outcome === "FAILED"
                        ? "error"
                        : "neutral";
                  const symbol = active
                    ? "◌"
                    : tone === "success"
                      ? "✓"
                      : tone === "error"
                        ? "!"
                        : outcome === "SKIPPED"
                          ? "↷"
                          : "◷";
                  return (
                    <li
                      key={action.id}
                      className={`execution-plan-action is-${tone}${action.parentId ? " is-progress-step" : ""}${action.progressSteps?.length ? " is-progress-group" : ""}`}
                      aria-current={
                        active && !action.progressSteps?.length
                          ? "step"
                          : undefined
                      }
                    >
                      {action.number !== undefined && (
                        <span
                          className="execution-plan-number"
                          aria-hidden="true"
                        >
                          {action.number}
                        </span>
                      )}
                      <span
                        className="execution-plan-symbol"
                        aria-hidden="true"
                      >
                        {symbol}
                      </span>
                      <div className="execution-plan-description">
                        <strong>{planActionLabel(action)}</strong>
                        <small>
                          {action.targets.join(", ") || "Без целевых серверов"}
                          {action.serviceDeployment
                            ? ` · ${action.serviceDeployment}`
                            : ""}
                        </small>
                      </div>
                      <span
                        className="execution-plan-status"
                        title={
                          tone === "success" ? `${label} · МСК` : undefined
                        }
                      >
                        {tone === "success" ? completedTime : label}
                      </span>
                    </li>
                  );
                })}
              </ol>
            )}
          </div>
          {completedTime && (
            <p className="execution-plan-timestamp">
              Завершение установки:{" "}
              <time dateTime={completed!.timestamp}>{completedTime} МСК</time>
            </p>
          )}
        </article>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}

function ResultStage({
  run,
  plan,
  progress,
  events,
  secretOutputPackages,
  outputDelivery,
  onOpenPendingOutputs,
  onCollectSecretOutputs,
}: {
  run?: InstallationRunOperation;
  plan?: InstallationPlanView;
  progress?: RunProgress;
  events: InstallationEventView[];
  secretOutputPackages?: SecretOutputPackagesOperation;
  outputDelivery?: SecretOutputDeliveryOperation;
  onOpenPendingOutputs: () => void;
  onCollectSecretOutputs: () => Promise<void>;
}) {
  const [collectingOutputs, setCollectingOutputs] = useState(false);
  const terminal =
    !!run?.run &&
    ["SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED", "INTERRUPTED"].includes(run.run.state);
  const outputBusy =
    run?.error?.code === "OUTPUT_BUSY" ||
    events.some(
      (event) => executionDiagnosticCode(event.safeMessage) === "OUTPUT_BUSY",
    );
  const actions = installationActionRows(plan);
  return (
    <section className="installation-stage-content">
      <article className="card">
        <h2>Результат</h2>
        {!terminal ? (
          <p role="status">
            {run?.run
              ? "Выполнение продолжается. Итог ещё не определён; потеря связи с наблюдателем не означает ошибку."
              : "Нет завершённого запуска в текущем сеансе."}
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <p
              role="status"
              className={
                run?.run?.state === "SUCCEEDED" ? "success" : "field-error"
              }
            >
              {runStatusLabel(run!.run!.state)} · запуск {run!.run!.runId}
            </p>
            {actions.length > 0 && (
              <div
                className="action-result-table"
                role="region"
                aria-label="Итог по действиям плана"
                tabIndex={0}
              >
                <table>
                  <thead>
                    <tr>
                      <th>Действие плана</th>
                      <th>Развёртывание</th>
                      <th>Серверы</th>
                      <th>Подтверждённый исход</th>
                    </tr>
                  </thead>
                  <tbody>
                    {actions.map((action) => (
                      <tr key={action.id}>
                        <td>{planActionLabel(action)}</td>
                        <td>{action.serviceDeployment || "—"}</td>
                        <td>{action.targets.join(", ") || "—"}</td>
                        <td>
                          {actionResultLabel(
                            action.id,
                            run!.run!.state,
                            progress,
                          )}
                        </td>
                      </tr>
                    ))}
                  </tbody>
                </table>
              </div>
            )}
            {!actions.length && (
              <p>
                Подробный план действий для этого запуска недоступен. Общий итог
                получен от узла выполнения.
              </p>
            )}
          </>
        )}
        {outputBusy && (
          <OutputBusyNotice onOpenPendingOutputs={onOpenPendingOutputs} />
        )}
        <h3>Защищённые выходные файлы</h3>
        <p>
          Здесь отображается только состояние доставки. Содержимое секретов в
          интерфейс не передаётся.
        </p>
        {(!secretOutputPackages ||
          secretOutputPackages.status !== "READY" ||
          secretOutputPackages.nextCursor ||
          secretOutputPackages.packages?.some(
            (item) => item.state !== "LOCAL_DELIVERED",
          )) && (
          <button

function executionDiagnosticCode(message: string): string | undefined {
  return message.match(/\bdiagnostic:\s*([A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{2,79})\b/)?.[1];
}

function eventStatusLabel(status: string): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "PENDING":
      return "ожидает";
    case "SUCCESS":
      return "успешно";
    case "CHANGED":
      return "изменено";
    case "SKIPPED":
      return "пропущено";
    case "FAILED":
      return "ошибка";
    case "RUNNING":
      return "выполняется";
    case "CANCELLED":
      return "отменено";
    case "INTERRUPTED":
      return "прервано";
    default:
      return "ожидает";
  }
}

function eventTypeLabel(eventType: string): string {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    RUN_STARTED: "Запуск начат",
    PHASE_STARTED: "Этап начат",
    ACTION_STARTED: "Действие начато",
    TASK_STARTED: "Задача начата",
    TASK_COMPLETED: "Задача завершена",
    ACTION_COMPLETED: "Действие завершено",
    PHASE_COMPLETED: "Этап завершён",
    RUN_COMPLETED: "Запуск завершён",
    DIAGNOSTIC: "Диагностика",
  };
  return labels[eventType] || eventType;
}

function eventMessageLabel(message: string): string {
  if (executionDiagnosticCode(message) === "OUTPUT_BUSY") {
    return "Пакет защищённых выходных файлов занят; план остановлен до задач Ansible";
  }
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    "Detached controller accepted": "Контроллер принят",
    "Fixed Core controller started": "Контроллер Core запущен",
    "Execution controller is running": "Контроллер выполнения работает",
    "Trusted operation started": "Доверенная операция начата",
    "Ansible task started": "Задача Ansible начата",
    "Ansible task completed": "Задача Ansible завершена",
    "Ansible operation failed": "Операция Ansible завершилась ошибкой",
    "Detailed task observability was truncated":
      "Подробная запись событий задач ограничена",
    "Detailed task observability was degraded":
      "Подробная запись событий задач неполна",
  };
  return labels[message] || message;
}

                  {event.serviceDeployment
                    ? ` · ${event.serviceDeployment}`
                    : ""}
                  {` · ${eventStatusLabel(event.status)}`}
                </small>
              </span>
            </li>

        </ol>
      )}
    </article>
  );
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"frontend/src/RuntimeSecretStatus.tsx","mode":420,"size":2190,"sha256":"a546120c17a6312a7377037916ce23c107789cc6ef32352e8bb265e8615a53f2","index":0,"count":1,"newline":"lf","encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":2190}
import { useEffect, useState } from "react";
import type {
  OpenResult,
  ProjectBackend,
  RuntimeSecretStatuses,
} from "./backend";

export function useRuntimeSecretStatuses(
  load: ProjectBackend["getRuntimeSecretStatuses"],
  section: "services" | "applications",
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  refreshVersion: number,
  contextKey = "",
) {
  const [result, setResult] = useState<{
    managed: OpenResult["managed"];
    contextKey: string;
    statuses: RuntimeSecretStatuses;
  }>();
  useEffect(() => {
    if (!load || !managed) return;
    let active = true;
    let pending = false;
    const refresh = async () => {
      if (!active || pending) return;
      pending = true;
      try {
        const statuses = await load(section);
        if (active)
          setResult(
            statuses.projectRevision === managed.projectRevision
              ? { managed, contextKey, statuses }
              : undefined,
          );
      } catch {
        if (active) setResult(undefined);
      } finally {
        pending = false;
      }
    };
    void refresh();
    const timer = window.setInterval(refresh, 30_000);
    window.addEventListener("focus", refresh);
    return () => {
      active = false;
      window.clearInterval(timer);
      window.removeEventListener("focus", refresh);
    };
  }, [load, section, managed, refreshVersion, contextKey]);
  return load &&
    result?.managed === managed &&
    result?.contextKey === contextKey
    ? result.statuses
    : undefined;
}

export function RuntimeSecretStatus({
  present,
  compact = false,
}: {
  present?: boolean;
  compact?: boolean;
}) {
  if (typeof present !== "boolean") return null;
  const label = present ? "Секреты заданы" : "Секреты не заданы";
  return (
    <small
      className={`status-chip status-chip--${present ? "success" : "warning"}${compact ? " list-secret-status" : ""}`}
      title={compact ? label : undefined}
    >
      {compact ? (
        <>
          <span aria-hidden="true">{present ? "✓" : "!"}</span>
          <span className="visually-hidden">{label}</span>
        </>
      ) : (
        label
      )}
    </small>
  );
}

export function ServerInformationText({ value }: { value: ServerInformationResult }) {
  const info = value.information;
  if (!info) return <small className="field-error">{value.error?.message}</small>;
  const date = (value: string) => new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", {
    timeZone: "Europe/Moscow", day: "2-digit", month: "2-digit", year: "numeric",
    hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit", hourCycle: "h23",
  }).format(new Date(value)) + " МСК";
  return <div className="server-information">
    <span>{info.hostname} · {info.os} {info.osVersion} · {info.architecture}</span>
    <span>CPU: {info.cpuCount} · RAM: {(info.memoryBytes / 1024 ** 3).toLocaleString("ru-RU", { maximumFractionDigits: 1 })} ГБ</span>

export function ServerInformationDialog({ hostId, onProbe, onCheck, onResult, onClose }: {
  hostId: string;
  onProbe: (hostId: string) => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  onCheck: (probeId: string) => Promise<ServerInformationResult>;
  onResult: (result: ServerInformationResult) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [probe, setProbe] = useState<HostKeyProbeResult | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(true);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const request = useRef<{ hostId: string; probe: typeof onProbe; promise: Promise<HostKeyProbeResult> } | null>(null);
  useEffect(() => {
    let live = true;
    if (!request.current || request.current.hostId !== hostId || request.current.probe !== onProbe) {
      request.current = { hostId, probe: onProbe, promise: onProbe(hostId) };
    }
    void request.current.promise.then((value) => {
      if (!live) return;
      setProbe(value);
      if (value.status !== "APPROVAL_REQUIRED") setError(value.error?.message || "Не удалось получить SSH-отпечаток. Проверьте действующий SSH-сеанс.");
    }).catch(() => live && setError("Не удалось получить SSH-отпечаток.")).finally(() => live && setBusy(false));
    return () => { live = false; };
  }, [hostId, onProbe]);
  const confirm = async () => {
    if (!probe?.probeId) return;
    setBusy(true);
    try {
      const result = await onCheck(probe.probeId);
      onResult(result);
      if (result.status === "CHECKED") onClose();
      else setError(result.error?.message || "Не удалось проверить сервер.");
    } catch { setError("Не удалось проверить сервер."); }
    finally { setBusy(false); }
  };
  return <div className="modal" role="presentation"><section className="card dialog server-dialog" role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="server-information-title">
    <h1 id="server-information-title">Проверка сервера</h1>
    <p>{probe?.safeLabel || hostId}</p>
    {probe?.status === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" && <>
      <p>Тип ключа: {probe.keyType}</p><p>Отпечаток: <code>{probe.fingerprint}</code></p>
      <p className="muted">Сверьте отпечаток с независимым доверенным источником. Подтверждённый ключ будет использоваться для проверки сервера и установки.</p>
    </>}
    {error && <p className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
    {busy && <p role="status">Проверка…</p>}
    <div className="actions"><button className="outline" onClick={onClose} disabled={busy && !!probe}>Отмена</button>
      <button onClick={() => void confirm()} disabled={busy || probe?.status !== "APPROVAL_REQUIRED"}>Подтверждаю совпадение</button>
    </div>
  </section></div>;
}

function sessionCredentialErrorText(reason: unknown): string {
  const raw =
    typeof reason === "string"
      ? reason
      : reason &&
          typeof reason === "object" &&
          "message" in reason &&
          typeof reason.message === "string"
        ? reason.message
        : "";
  const code =
    raw.match(
      /\b(?:SESSION_CREDENTIAL|SESSION_PRIVATE_KEY)_[A-Z_]+\b|\bINSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE\b/,
    )?.[0] ||
    "";
  return (
    sessionCredentialErrors[code] ||
    sessionCredentialErrors.SESSION_CREDENTIAL_UNAVAILABLE
  );
}

export type ServerIntent = Record<string, unknown> & {
  operation: "CreateServer" | "UpdateServer" | "DeleteServer";
  hostId: string;
};
type Row = {
  hostId: string;
  type: string;
  desiredHostname: string;
  address: string;
  port: number;
  state?: "new" | "changed" | "deleting";
};
type Dialog =
  | { mode: "add" }
  | { mode: "edit"; row: Row }
  | { mode: "delete"; row: Row }
  | { mode: "target-key"; row: Row }
  | null;
type ServerType = { id: string; displayName: string };

function rows(
  snapshot: OpenResult["snapshot"],
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: ServerIntent[],
): Row[] {
  const result = new Map<string, Row>();
  for (const [hostId, host] of Object.entries(managed?.servers || {})) {
    result.set(hostId, {
      hostId,
      type: String(host.type || ""),
      desiredHostname: String(host.desiredHostname || ""),
      address: String(host.address || ""),
      port: Number(host.sshPort || 22),
    });
  }
  for (const [hostId, raw] of Object.entries(snapshot?.hosts || {})) {
    if (result.has(hostId)) continue;
    const host = raw as Record<string, unknown>;
    result.set(hostId, {
      hostId,
      type: String(host.type || ""),
      desiredHostname: String(host.desiredHostname || ""),
      address: String(host.ansibleHost || ""),
      port: Number(host.ansiblePort || 22),
    });
  }
  for (const intent of intents) {
    const existing = result.get(intent.hostId);
    if (intent.operation === "CreateServer")
      result.set(intent.hostId, {
        hostId: intent.hostId,
        type: String(intent.type || ""),
        desiredHostname: String(intent.desiredHostname || ""),
        address: String(intent.address || ""),
        port: typeof intent.sshPort === "number" ? intent.sshPort : 22,
        state: "new",
      });
    else if (intent.operation === "UpdateServer" && existing)
      result.set(intent.hostId, {
        ...existing,
        type: intent.type === undefined ? existing.type : String(intent.type),
        desiredHostname:
          intent.desiredHostname === undefined
            ? existing.desiredHostname
            : String(intent.desiredHostname),
        address:
          intent.address === undefined
            ? existing.address
            : String(intent.address),
        port:
          typeof intent.sshPort === "number" ? intent.sshPort : existing.port,
        state: "changed",
      });
    else if (intent.operation === "DeleteServer" && existing)
      result.set(intent.hostId, { ...existing, state: "deleting" });
  }
  return [...result.values()].sort((a, b) => a.hostId.localeCompare(b.hostId));
}

        {visible.length === 0 ? (
          <section className="card empty server-list-scroll">
            <h2>Серверов пока нет</h2>
            <p>
              Добавление сервера создаёт typed intent. Файлы появятся только
              после проверки и общего сохранения.
            </p>
            <button
              onClick={() => setDialog({ mode: "add" })}
              disabled={crudDisabled || !!configError}
            >
              Добавить первый сервер
            </button>
          </section>
        ) : (
          <section className="card server-table server-list-scroll">
            <table>
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  <th>ID</th>
                  <th>Тип</th>
                  <th>Желаемое имя</th>
                  <th>Адрес</th>
                  <th>SSH</th>
                  <th>Состояние</th>
                  <th />
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {visible.map((row) => {
                  const created = row.state === "new";
                  const disableCrud =
                    crudDisabled ||
                    row.state === "deleting" ||
                    (firstSave && created);
                  return (
                    <tr
                      key={row.hostId}
                      className={[row.state ? `draft-${row.state}` : "", serverInformation[row.hostId] ? "server-information-attached" : ""].join(" ")}
                    >
                      <td>
                        <span className="server-name-cell">
                          <ServerLineIcon kind="server" />
                          <b>{row.hostId}</b>
                        </span>
                        {serverInformation[row.hostId] && <ServerInformationText value={serverInformation[row.hostId]} />}
                      </td>
                      <td>{labelType(row.type, serverTypes)}</td>
                      <td>{row.desiredHostname || <em>Не задано</em>}</td>
                      <td>{row.address}</td>
                      <td>{row.port}</td>
                      <td>
                        {row.state === "new" ? (
                          <StatusChip tone="info">Новый</StatusChip>
                        ) : row.state === "changed" ? (
                          <StatusChip tone="warning">Изменён</StatusChip>
                        ) : row.state === "deleting" ? (
                          <StatusChip tone="danger">Будет удалён</StatusChip>
                        ) : (
                          <StatusChip tone="success">{serverInformation[row.hostId]?.status === "CHECKED" ? "Проверен" : "Сохранён"}</StatusChip>
                        )}
                      </td>
                      <td>
                        {firstSave && created ? (
                          <small>Доступно после первого сохранения</small>
                        ) : (
                          <>
                            <button
                              className="link"
                              onClick={() => setDialog({ mode: "edit", row })}
                              disabled={disableCrud}
                            >
                              Изменить
                            </button>
                            {" · "}
                            <button
                              className="link"
                              onClick={() =>
                                onProbeServerInformation ? setInformationHost(row.hostId) : setDialog({ mode: "target-key", row })
                              }
                              disabled={
                                disableCrud ||
                                commandCount > 0 ||
                                !managed?.servers?.[row.hostId] ||
                                (!onProbeServerInformation && !onProbeTargetHostKey)
                              }
                            >
                              {onProbeServerInformation ? "Проверить сервер" : approvedTargets.includes(row.hostId)
                                ? "SSH-ключ подтверждён"
                                : "Проверить SSH-ключ"}
                            </button>
                            {" · "}
                            <button
                              className="link danger"
                              onClick={() => setDialog({ mode: "delete", row })}
                              disabled={disableCrud}
                            >
                              Удалить
                            </button>
                          </>
                        )}
                      </td>
                    </tr>
                  );
                })}
              </tbody>
            </table>
          </section>
        )}
        <ExecutionNodePanel
          context={executionNode}
          coreProjectionNotice={coreProjectionNotice}
          nodeDisplayStatus={nodeDisplayStatus}
          rows={visible.filter((row) => row.state !== "deleting")}
          disabled={busy}
          onSelect={onSelectExecutionNode}
          onCheck={onCheckExecutionNode}
          credentialStatus={credentialStatus}
          onProbe={onProbeExecutionNodeHostKey}
          onApprove={onApproveExecutionNodeHostKey}
          onDecline={onDeclineExecutionNodeHostKey}
          onPlan={onPlanExecutionNodePreparation}
          onPrepare={onPrepareExecutionNode}
          recoveryAction={runRecoveryPanel}
          cachedReadiness={cachedNodeReadiness}
          onInformationCheck={onProbeServerInformation ? () => setInformationHost(executionNode?.selectedHostId || "") : undefined}
          information={serverInformation[executionNode?.selectedHostId || ""]}
        />
      </div>
      {commandCount > 0 && (
        <section className="card draft-actions">
          <p>
            Черновик: {commandCount}. Перед сохранением будет показан локальный
            предварительный просмотр структуры затрагиваемых документов.
          </p>
          <button className="outline" onClick={onDiscard} disabled={busy}>
            Отменить все изменения
          </button>
          <button onClick={onReview} disabled={busy}>
            Просмотреть изменения
          </button>
        </section>
      )}
      {dialog?.mode === "add" && (
        <ServerDialog
          mode="add"
          serverTypes={serverTypes}
          configError={configError}
          busy={crudDisabled}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const ok = await onAppend(intent);
            if (ok) setDialog(null);
            return ok;
          }}
        />
      )}
      {dialog?.mode === "edit" && (
        <ServerDialog
          mode="edit"
          row={dialog.row}
          serverTypes={serverTypes}
          configError={configError}
          busy={crudDisabled}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const ok = await onAppend(intent);
            if (ok) setDialog(null);
            return ok;
          }}
        />
      )}
      {dialog?.mode === "delete" && (
        <DeleteDialog
          row={dialog.row}
          busy={crudDisabled}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const ok = await onAppend(intent);
            if (ok) setDialog(null);
            return ok;
          }}
        />
      )}
      {dialog?.mode === "target-key" &&
        onProbeTargetHostKey &&
        onApproveTargetHostKey &&
        onDeclineTargetHostKey && (
          <TargetHostKeyDialog
            row={dialog.row}
            onProbe={onProbeTargetHostKey}
            onApprove={onApproveTargetHostKey}
            onDecline={onDeclineTargetHostKey}
            onApproved={() =>
              setApprovedTargets((items) => [
                ...new Set([...items, dialog.row.hostId]),
              ])
            }
            onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          />
        )}
      {informationHost && onProbeServerInformation && onCheckServerInformation && <ServerInformationDialog
        hostId={informationHost} onProbe={onProbeServerInformation} onCheck={onCheckServerInformation}
        onResult={() => {}} onClose={() => setInformationHost(null)} />}
    </>
  );
}

function TargetHostKeyDialog({
  row,
  onProbe,
  onApprove,
  onDecline,
  onApproved,
  onClose,
}: {
  row: Row;
  onProbe: (hostId: string) => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  onApprove: (probeId: string) => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  onDecline: () => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  onApproved: () => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [probe, setProbe] = useState<HostKeyProbeResult | null>(null);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const close = async () => {
    if (probe?.status === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED")
      await onDecline().catch(() => undefined);
    onClose();
  };
  const runProbe = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    setProbe(null);
    try {
      const next = await onProbe(row.hostId);
      setProbe(next);
      if (next.error)
        setError(next.error.message || "Не удалось получить ключ сервера.");
    } catch {
      setError("Не удалось получить ключ сервера.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const approve = async () => {
    if (!probe?.probeId) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const next = await onApprove(probe.probeId);
      setProbe(next);
      if (next.status === "APPROVED") onApproved();
      else setError(next.error?.message || "Подтверждение ключа отклонено.");
    } catch {
      setError("Не удалось подтвердить ключ сервера.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <section
        className="card dialog server-dialog"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="target-key-title"
      >
        <h1 id="target-key-title">SSH-ключ сервера {row.hostId}</h1>
        <p>
          Адрес: {row.address}:{row.port}
        </p>
        <p className="muted">
          Сверьте отпечаток с независимым доверенным источником. Получение ключа
          по сети само по себе не подтверждает его подлинность.
        </p>
        <button type="button" onClick={runProbe} disabled={busy}>
          Получить отпечаток
        </button>
        {probe?.status === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" && (
          <div role="group" aria-label="Подтверждение ключа целевого сервера">
            <p>Тип: {probe.keyType}</p>
            <p>
              Отпечаток: <code>{probe.fingerprint}</code>
            </p>
            <button type="button" onClick={approve} disabled={busy}>
              Подтверждаю совпадение
            </button>
          </div>
        )}
        {probe?.status === "APPROVED" && (
          <p role="status">
            Ключ подтверждён для текущего проекта и сохранённой ревизии.
          </p>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p role="alert" className="field-error">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <button
          type="button"
          className="outline"
          onClick={close}
          disabled={busy}
        >
          Закрыть
        </button>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function ExecutionNodePanel({
  context,
  coreProjectionNotice,
  nodeDisplayStatus,
  rows,
  disabled,
  onSelect,
  onCheck,
  credentialStatus,
  onProbe,
  onApprove,
  onDecline,
  onPlan,
  onPrepare,
  recoveryAction,
  cachedReadiness,
  onInformationCheck,
  information,
}: {
  context: ExecutionNodeContext | null;
  coreProjectionNotice?: string;
  nodeDisplayStatus?: ExecutionNodeCombinedStatus;
  rows: Row[];
  disabled: boolean;
  onSelect: (hostId: string) => Promise<ExecutionNodeContext>;
  onCheck: () => Promise<ExecutionNodeReadiness>;
  credentialStatus: SessionCredentialStatus | null;
  onProbe?: () => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  onApprove?: (probeId: string) => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  onDecline?: () => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  onPlan: () => Promise<ExecutionNodePreparation>;
  onPrepare: (planId: string) => Promise<ExecutionNodePreparation>;
  recoveryAction?: ReactNode;
  cachedReadiness?: ExecutionNodeReadiness | null;
  onInformationCheck?: () => void;
  information?: ServerInformationResult;
}) {
  const [changing, setChanging] = useState(false);
  const [selected, setSelected] = useState("");
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const [readiness, setReadiness] = useState<ExecutionNodeReadiness | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [preparation, setPreparation] =
    useState<ExecutionNodePreparation | null>(null);
  const [hostKeyProbe, setHostKeyProbe] = useState<HostKeyProbeResult | null>(
    null,
  );
  const [hostKeyDialogOpen, setHostKeyDialogOpen] = useState(false);
  useEffect(() => {
    setHostKeyProbe(null);
    setHostKeyDialogOpen(false);
    setReadiness(null);
    setPreparation(null);
  }, [
    context?.selectedHostId,
    context?.runtimeDigest,
    credentialStatus?.expiresAt,
    credentialStatus?.sshMode,
    credentialStatus?.status,
  ]);
  const effective: Partial<ExecutionNodeContext> & {
    status: string;
    selectionSource: string;
  } = context || {
    status: "NOT_CONFIGURED",
    selectionSource: "NONE",
  };
  const combinedStatus = nodeDisplayStatus || executionNodeCombinedStatus(
    readiness || cachedReadiness || { status: effective.status }, preparation,
  );
  const headingStatus = { ...combinedStatus, label: combinedStatus.label.replace(/^Проверен: /, "") };
  const checkedNode = readiness || cachedReadiness;
  const useServerInformation =
    !!onInformationCheck && context?.selectionKind === "PROJECT_SERVER";
  const canSuggestAction =
    !disabled && !busy && !changing;
  const checkIsNext =
    canSuggestAction &&
    !!context?.safeLabel &&
    context.status !== "READY" &&
    !(useServerInformation ? information?.status === "CHECKED" : checkedNode) &&
    !preparation &&
    (context.selectionKind !== "PROJECT_SERVER" ||
      credentialStatus?.status === "PRESENT");
  const preparationIsNeeded = [
    "PREPARATION_REQUIRED",
    "UPDATE_REQUIRED",
    "UNPREPARED",
    "NOT_PREPARED",
  ].includes(checkedNode?.status || "");
  const planPreparationIsNext =
    canSuggestAction && preparationIsNeeded && !preparation;
  const confirmPreparationIsNext =
    canSuggestAction &&
    preparation?.status === "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED" &&
    !!preparation.steps?.some((step) => step.mutates);
  const choose = async () => {
    if (!selected) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      await onSelect(selected);
      setChanging(false);
    } catch (reason) {
      setError(
        typeof reason === "string"
          ? reason
          : "EXECUTION_NODE_SELECTION_UNAVAILABLE",
      );
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  return (
    <>
    <section
      className="card execution-node-panel"
      aria-labelledby="execution-node-heading"
    >
      <div className="execution-node-heading">
        <h2 id="execution-node-heading">
          <ServerLineIcon kind="execution" />
          Узел выполнения
        </h2>
        <StatusChip tone={headingStatus.tone}>
          {headingStatus.label}
        </StatusChip>
      </div>
      <div className="execution-node-detail">
        <span>Выбранный узел</span>
        <b>{effective.safeLabel || "Не выбран"}</b>
        <span>Источник выбора</span>
        <b>{executionNodeSelectionLabel(effective.selectionSource)}</b>
      </div>
      <p className="muted">
        Выбор узла хранится только в приложении и не меняет проект. Подготовка —
        только после подтверждения.
      </p>
      {preparation?.steps?.some((step) => step.id === "ensure-runtime-packages") && (
        <p className="muted">
          Уже установленные runtime-пакеты используются без повторной установки.
          Недостающие пакеты берутся из набора установки; если их в нём нет — из
          настроенных DNF-репозиториев узла.
        </p>
      )}
      {!onInformationCheck && onProbe && context?.selectionKind === "PROJECT_SERVER" && (
        <div className="execution-node-host-key">
          <p className="muted">
            Нужен действующий SSH-сеанс; перед подключением сверьте SSH-отпечаток вне
            приложения.
          </p>
          <button
            className="outline"
            disabled={
              disabled ||
              busy ||
              credentialStatus?.status !== "PRESENT"
            }
            onClick={() => {
              setHostKeyProbe(null);
              setHostKeyDialogOpen(true);
            }}
          >
            Получить отпечаток SSH
          </button>
          {hostKeyProbe?.status === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" && hostKeyDialogOpen && (
            <div role="group" aria-label="Подтверждение ключа SSH">
              <p>
                Ключ: <b>{hostKeyProbe.keyType}</b> · Отпечаток:{" "}
                <code>{hostKeyProbe.fingerprint}</code>
              </p>
              <p className="muted">
                Не подтверждайте ключ, пока не сверите отпечаток вне этого
                приложения.
              </p>
              <button
                disabled={
                  disabled || busy || !onApprove || !hostKeyProbe.probeId
                }
                onClick={async () => {
                  if (!hostKeyProbe.probeId || !onApprove) return;
                  setBusy(true);
                  setError("");
                  try {
                    setHostKeyProbe(await onApprove(hostKeyProbe.probeId));
                  } catch {
                    setError("Не удалось подтвердить ключ SSH.");
                  } finally {
                    setBusy(false);
                  }
                }}
              >
                Подтверждаю совпадение
              </button>
              <button
                className="outline"
                disabled={busy || !onDecline}
                onClick={async () => {
                  if (!onDecline) return;
                  setBusy(true);
                  try {
                    setHostKeyProbe(await onDecline());
                  } catch {
                    setError("Не удалось отклонить ключ SSH.");
                  } finally {
                    setBusy(false);
                  }
                }}
              >
                Отклонить
              </button>
            </div>
          )}
          {hostKeyProbe?.status === "APPROVED" && (
            <span className="execution-node-trust-status" role="status">
              <StatusChip tone="success">
                SSH-отпечаток подтверждён
              </StatusChip>
            </span>
          )}
          {hostKeyProbe?.error && (
            <p className="field-error" role="alert">
              {hostKeyProbe.error.message}
            </p>
          )}
        </div>
      )}
      <p
        className={combinedStatus.tone === "danger" ? "field-error" : "muted"}
        role={combinedStatus.tone === "danger" ? "alert" : "status"}
      >
        Статус:{" "}
        <StatusChip tone={combinedStatus.tone}>{combinedStatus.label}</StatusChip>
        {combinedStatus.detail ? ` · ${combinedStatus.detail}` : coreProjectionNotice ? ` · ${coreProjectionNotice}` : ""}
        {preparation?.verification
          ? ` · Проверка проекта: ${verificationLabel(preparation.verification.status)}`
          : ""}
      </p>
      {[
        ...(preparation?.status === "PREPARED" ? [] : readiness?.findings || []),
        ...(preparation?.findings || []),
      ].map(
        (finding, index) => (
          <p
            className="field-error"
            key={`${index}-${finding.code}`}
            role="status"
          >
            {finding.safeMessage}
          </p>
        ),
      )}
      <div className="actions">
        {recoveryAction}
        {useServerInformation && (
          <button
            className={checkIsNext ? "outline next-step-hint" : "outline"}
            onClick={onInformationCheck}
            disabled={disabled || busy || credentialStatus?.status !== "PRESENT"}
          >
            Проверить сервер
          </button>
        )}
        {!useServerInformation &&
        <button
          className={checkIsNext ? "outline next-step-hint" : "outline"}
          onClick={async () => {
            setBusy(true);
            setError("");
            setPreparation(null);
            try {
              setReadiness(await onCheck());
            } catch {
              setError("EXECUTION_NODE_CHECK_UNAVAILABLE");
            } finally {
              setBusy(false);
            }
          }}
          disabled={disabled || busy}
        >
          Проверить узел
        </button>
        }
        <button
          className={planPreparationIsNext ? "outline next-step-hint" : "outline"}
          onClick={async () => {
            setBusy(true);
            setError("");
            try {
              setPreparation(await onPlan());
            } catch {
              setError("EXECUTION_NODE_PREPARATION_UNAVAILABLE");
            } finally {
              setBusy(false);
            }
          }}
          disabled={disabled || busy}
        >
          Спланировать подготовку
        </button>
        {preparation?.status === "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED" &&
          preparation.planId && (
            <button
              className={confirmPreparationIsNext ? "next-step-hint" : undefined}
              onClick={async () => {
                const planId = preparation.planId;
                if (!planId) return;
                if (
                  !window.confirm(
                    "Подготовить выбранный узел выполнения? Это может установить недостающие runtime-пакеты из набора установки или настроенных DNF-репозиториев и активировать проверенное окружение.",
                  )
                )
                  return;
                setBusy(true);
                setError("");
                const currentPreparation = preparation;
                setPreparation({ ...preparation, status: "PREPARING" });
                try {
                  const result = await onPrepare(planId);
                  setPreparation(result);
                } catch {
                  setPreparation(currentPreparation);
                  setError("EXECUTION_NODE_PREPARATION_UNAVAILABLE");
                } finally {
                  setBusy(false);
                }
              }}
              disabled={disabled || busy}
            >
              Подтвердить подготовку
            </button>
          )}
      </div>
      {!changing ? (
        <button
          className="outline"
          aria-label="Выбрать узел выполнения"
          onClick={() => {
            setSelected(context?.selectedHostId || rows[0]?.hostId || "");
            setChanging(true);
          }}
          disabled={disabled || rows.length === 0}
        >
          Выбрать узел выполнения
        </button>
      ) : (
        <div className="execution-node-change">
          <label>
            Сервер проекта
            <select
              aria-label="Сервер проекта для узла выполнения"
              value={selected}
              onChange={(event) => setSelected(event.target.value)}
              disabled={busy || disabled}
            >
              {rows.map((row) => (
                <option key={row.hostId} value={row.hostId}>
                  {row.hostId} · {row.address}
                </option>
              ))}
            </select>
          </label>
          {error && (
            <p className="field-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <div className="actions">
            <button
              className="outline"
              onClick={() => setChanging(false)}
              disabled={busy}
            >
              Отмена
            </button>
            <button onClick={choose} disabled={busy || disabled || !selected}>
              Выбрать
            </button>
          </div>
        </div>
      )}
      {information && <div className="execution-node-information"><ServerInformationText value={information} /></div>}
    </section>
    {hostKeyDialogOpen && onProbe && (
      <ExecutionNodeHostKeyDialog
        label={effective.safeLabel || effective.selectedHostId || "узел выполнения"}
        onProbe={onProbe}
        onApprove={onApprove}
        onDecline={onDecline}
        disabled={disabled}
        onApproved={(result) => setHostKeyProbe(result)}
        onClose={() => setHostKeyDialogOpen(false)}
      />
    )}
    </>
  );
}

function ExecutionNodeHostKeyDialog({
  label,
  onProbe,
  onApprove,
  onDecline,
  disabled,
  onApproved,
  onClose,
}: {
  label: string;
  onProbe: () => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  onApprove?: (probeId: string) => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  onDecline?: () => Promise<HostKeyProbeResult>;
  disabled: boolean;
  onApproved: (result: HostKeyProbeResult) => void;
  onClose: () => void;
}) {
  const [probe, setProbe] = useState<HostKeyProbeResult | null>(null);
  const [busy, setBusy] = useState(false);
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const runProbe = async () => {
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    setProbe(null);
    try {
      const result = await onProbe();
      setProbe(result);
      if (result.status === "APPROVED") onApproved(result);
      if (result.error) setError(result.error.message || "Не удалось получить SSH-ключ.");
    } catch {
      setError("Не удалось получить отпечаток ключа SSH.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const approve = async () => {
    if (!probe?.probeId || !onApprove) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      const result = await onApprove(probe.probeId);
      setProbe(result);
      if (result.status === "APPROVED") onApproved(result);
      else setError(result.error?.message || "Подтверждение ключа не выполнено.");
    } catch {
      setError("Не удалось подтвердить ключ SSH.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const decline = async () => {
    if (!onDecline) return;
    setBusy(true);
    setError("");
    try {
      setProbe(await onDecline());
    } catch {
      setError("Не удалось отклонить ключ SSH.");
    } finally {
      setBusy(false);
    }
  };
  const close = async () => {
    if (probe?.status === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED") await decline();
    onClose();
  };
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <section
        className="card dialog server-dialog execution-node-key-dialog"
        role="dialog"
        aria-modal="true"
        aria-labelledby="execution-node-key-title"
      >
        <h1 id="execution-node-key-title">SSH-ключ узла выполнения</h1>
        <p>Узел: {label}</p>
        <p className="muted">
          Сверьте отпечаток с независимым доверенным источником. Получение ключа
          по сети само по себе не подтверждает его подлинность.
        </p>
        {probe?.status === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" && (
          <div role="group" aria-label="Подтверждение ключа SSH">
            <p>Тип: <b>{probe.keyType}</b></p>
            <p>Отпечаток: <code>{probe.fingerprint}</code></p>
            <p className="muted">
              Не подтверждайте ключ, пока не сверите отпечаток вне этого приложения.
            </p>
          </div>
        )}
        {probe?.status === "APPROVED" && (
          <p role="status">Ключ SSH подтверждён для текущего сеанса.</p>
        )}
        {error && <p className="field-error" role="alert">{error}</p>}
        <div className="actions execution-node-key-actions">
          {probe?.status !== "APPROVED" && (
            <button type="button" onClick={runProbe} disabled={busy || disabled}>
              {probe?.status === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" ? "Получить заново" : "Получить отпечаток"}
            </button>
          )}
          {probe?.status === "APPROVAL_REQUIRED" && (
            <>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={approve}
                disabled={busy || disabled || !onApprove || !probe.probeId}
              >
                Подтверждаю совпадение
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="outline"
                onClick={decline}
                disabled={busy || !onDecline}
              >
                Отклонить
              </button>
            </>
          )}
          <button type="button" className="outline" onClick={close} disabled={busy}>
            Закрыть
          </button>
        </div>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

      onClose();

type CatalogService = NonNullable<OpenResult["catalog"]>["services"] extends
  Array<infer Service> | undefined
  ? Service
  : never;
type CatalogSetting = CatalogService["configurationSettings"][number];
type Row = {
  deploymentId: string;
  serviceType: string;
  mode: string;
  state?: "new" | "deleting";

type MemberRow = {
