                    disabled={selected.state === "deleting"}
                    title={
                      selected.state === "deleting"
                        ? "Настройка недоступна для экземпляра, который будет удалён."
                        : "Открыть настройку сервиса."
                    }
                  >
                    Настроить экземпляр
                  </button>
                  <button
                    className="outline danger"
                    onClick={() => setDialog("delete")}
                    disabled={
                      crudDisabled || !!selected.state || commandLimitReached
                    }
                  >
                    Удалить экземпляр
                  </button>
                </div>
              </>
            )}
          </section>

          <section className="card topology-summary">
            <h2>Состояние топологии</h2>
            <dl>
              <dt>Экземпляры</dt>
              <dd>{rows.filter((row) => row.state !== "deleting").length}</dd>
              <dt>Черновик</dt>
              <dd>{commandCount} / 16 изменений</dd>
              <dt>Размещение</dt>
              <dd>Настраивается здесь</dd>
            </dl>
            <p className="muted">
              Размещение и роли задаются в проекте; итоговую проверку выполняет Core после сохранения.
            </p>
          </section>
        </div>
      ) : (
        <ByServersView
          servers={servers}
          rows={rows}
          placements={placements}
          selectedHostId={selectedHostId}
          onSelectedHostChange={onSelectedHostChange}
          onSelectedDeploymentChange={onSelectedDeploymentChange}
          onConfigureDeployment={onConfigureDeployment}
          onConfigureMember={onConfigureMember}
          onEdit={(deploymentId, hostId) => {
            onSelectedDeploymentChange(deploymentId);
            setPlacementHostContext(hostId);
            setPlacementDeploymentId(deploymentId);
            setDialog("placement");
          }}
          disabled={crudDisabled || commandLimitReached}
          placementLocked={(deploymentId) =>
            intents.some(
              (intent) =>
                (intent.operation === "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement" ||
                  intent.operation ===
                    "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement") &&
                intent.deploymentId === deploymentId,
            )
          }
        />
      )}

      {commandCount > 0 && (
        <section className="card draft-actions">
          <p>
            Общий черновик: {commandCount} / 16. Файлы изменятся только после
            локального Review и общего сохранения.
          </p>
          <button className="outline" onClick={onDiscard} disabled={busy}>
            Отменить все изменения
          </button>
          <button onClick={onReview} disabled={busy}>
            Просмотреть изменения
          </button>
        </section>
      )}

      {dialog === "add" && (
        <AddDeploymentDialog
          services={catalog?.services || []}
          existingIDs={new Set(rows.map((row) => row.deploymentId))}
          busy={busy}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) {
              onSelectedDeploymentChange(intent.deploymentId);
              setDialog(null);
            }
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}

      {dialog === "delete" && selected && (
        <DeleteDeploymentDialog
          row={selected}
          busy={busy}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) setDialog(null);
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}
      {dialog === "placement" && placementTarget && (
        <PlacementDialog
          row={placementTarget}
          mode={catalogMode(
            catalogService(catalog, placementTarget.serviceType),
            placementTarget.mode,
          )}
          placement={placements.get(placementTarget.deploymentId)}
          servers={servers}
          preferredHostId={placementHostContext}
          busy={busy}
          onClose={() => setDialog(null)}
          onAppend={async (intent) => {
            const accepted = await onAppend(intent);
            if (accepted) setDialog(null);
            return accepted;
          }}
        />
      )}
    </>
  );
}

function ByServersView({
  servers,
  rows,
  placements,
  selectedHostId,
  onSelectedHostChange,
  onSelectedDeploymentChange,
  onConfigureDeployment,
  onConfigureMember,
  onEdit,
  disabled,
  placementLocked,
}: {
  servers: ServerRow[];
  rows: DeploymentRow[];
  placements: Map<string, Placement>;
  selectedHostId: string;
  onSelectedHostChange: (id: string) => void;
  onSelectedDeploymentChange: (id: string) => void;
  onConfigureDeployment: (deploymentId: string) => void;
  onConfigureMember: (deploymentId: string, memberId: string) => void;
  onEdit: (deploymentId: string, hostId: string) => void;
  disabled: boolean;
  placementLocked: (deploymentId: string) => boolean;
}) {
  const selected = servers.find((server) => server.hostId === selectedHostId);
  const assignments = rows.flatMap((deployment) => {
    const placement = placements.get(deployment.deploymentId);
    if (placement?.kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED")
      return placement.members
        .filter((member) => member.hostId === selectedHostId)
        .map((member) => ({
          deployment,
          key: `member:${member.memberId}`,
          memberId: member.memberId,
          text: `${member.memberId}${member.roles.length ? ` · ${member.roles.join(", ")}` : ""}`,
        }));
    if (placement?.kind === "HOST_SCOPED")
      return placement.hosts
        .filter((host) => host.hostId === selectedHostId)
        .map((host) => ({
          deployment,
          key: `host:${host.hostId}`,
          memberId: "",
          text: host.roles.join(", ") || "без ролей",
        }));
    return [];
  });
  return (
    <div className="topology-grid topology-servers-grid">
      <section className="card topology-list">
        <h2>Серверы</h2>
        <div className="topology-list-scroll">
          {servers.map((server) => (
            <button
              key={server.hostId}
              className={`topology-row ${server.hostId === selectedHostId ? "selected" : ""} ${server.state ? `draft-${server.state}` : ""}`}
              onClick={() => onSelectedHostChange(server.hostId)}
            >
              <TopologyServerIcon />
              <span className="topology-instance-copy">
                <span className="topology-instance-heading">
                  <b>{server.hostId}</b>
                  {server.state && (
                    <TopologyStateChip state={server.state} compact />
                  )}
                </span>
                <span>{server.label}</span>
              </span>
            </button>
          ))}
        </div>
      </section>
      <section className="card topology-detail">
        <h2>Размещение на сервере</h2>
        {!selected ? (
          <p className="muted">Добавьте сервер или выберите его в списке.</p>
        ) : selected.state === "deleting" ? (
          <p className="muted">
            Сервер будет удалён и не предлагается для нового размещения.
          </p>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="topology-list-scroll">
              {assignments.length === 0 ? (
                <p className="muted">На этом сервере пока нет размещений.</p>
              ) : (
                assignments.map(({ deployment, key, memberId, text }) => (
                  <article
                    className="topology-assignment"
                    key={`${deployment.deploymentId}:${key}`}
                  >
                    <div className="topology-assignment-info">
                      <b>{deployment.deploymentId}</b>
                      <span>{text}</span>
                    </div>
                    <div className="topology-assignment-actions">
                      <button
                        aria-label={`Изменить размещение ${deployment.deploymentId} на сервере ${selected.hostId}`}
                        onClick={() => {
                          onSelectedDeploymentChange(deployment.deploymentId);
                          onEdit(deployment.deploymentId, selected.hostId);
                        }}
                        disabled={
                          disabled ||
                          !!deployment.state ||
                          placementLocked(deployment.deploymentId)
                        }
                      >
                        Изменить
                      </button>
                      <button
                        className="outline"
                        aria-label={memberId
                          ? `Настроить участника ${memberId} на сервере ${selected.hostId}`
                          : `Настроить сервис ${deployment.deploymentId}`}
                        onClick={() => memberId
                          ? onConfigureMember(deployment.deploymentId, memberId)
                          : onConfigureDeployment(deployment.deploymentId)}
                        disabled={deployment.state === "deleting"}
                      >
                        {memberId ? "Настроить участника" : "Настроить сервис"}
                      </button>
                    </div>
                  </article>
                ))
              )}
            </div>
            <label className="topology-add-placement">
              Добавить размещение
              <select
                aria-label="Deployment для размещения"
                defaultValue=""
                onChange={(event) => {
                  const deploymentId = event.target.value;
                  if (deploymentId) {
                    onSelectedDeploymentChange(deploymentId);
                    onEdit(deploymentId, selected.hostId);
                    event.currentTarget.value = "";
                  }
                }}
                disabled={disabled}
              >
                <option value="">Выберите экземпляр сервиса</option>
                {rows
                  .filter(
                    (row) => !row.state && !placements.has(row.deploymentId),
                  )
                  .map((deployment) => (
                    <option
                      key={deployment.deploymentId}
                      value={deployment.deploymentId}
                    >
                      {deployment.deploymentId}
                    </option>
                  ))}
              </select>
            </label>
          </>
        )}
      </section>
      <section className="card topology-summary">
        <h2>Сводка</h2>
        <dl>
          <dt>Сервер</dt>
          <dd>{selected?.hostId || "—"}</dd>
          <dt>Адрес</dt>
          <dd>{selected?.label.split(" · ").slice(1).join(" · ") || "—"}</dd>
          <dt>Размещений</dt>
          <dd>{assignments.length}</dd>
        </dl>
        <p className="muted">
          Настраивайте размещение и параметры сервиса или участника в центральном
          списке.
        </p>
      </section>
    </div>
  );
}

function normalizedMemberBase(serviceType: string, suffixLength: number) {
  const normalized = serviceType
    .toLowerCase()
    .replace(/[_.]/g, "-")
    .replace(/-+/g, "-")
    .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, "");
  return normalized.slice(0, Math.max(0, 63 - suffixLength));
}

function candidateMemberId(serviceType: string, members: MemberRow[]) {
  const used = new Set(members.map((member) => member.memberId));
  for (let n = 1; n < 10000; n += 1) {
    const suffix = `-${n}`;
    const base = normalizedMemberBase(serviceType, suffix.length);
    if (!base) return "";
    const candidate = `${base}${suffix}`;
    if (!used.has(candidate)) return candidate;
  }
  return "";
}

function PlacementDialog({
  row,
  mode,
  placement,
  servers,
  preferredHostId,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onAppend,
}: {
  row: DeploymentRow;
  mode: CatalogMode | undefined;
  placement: Placement | undefined;
  servers: ServerRow[];
  preferredHostId: string;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAppend: (intent: PlacementIntent) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const kind = mode?.placementKind as
    "MEMBER_SCOPED" | "HOST_SCOPED" | undefined;
  const [members, setMembers] = useState<MemberRow[]>(
    placement?.kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? placement.members : [],
  );
  const [hosts, setHosts] = useState<HostRow[]>(
    placement?.kind === "HOST_SCOPED" ? placement.hosts : [],
  );
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const selectable = servers.filter((server) => server.state !== "deleting");
  const roleOptions = mode?.roles || [];
  const addMember = () => {
    const hostId =
      preferredHostId &&
      selectable.some((server) => server.hostId === preferredHostId)
        ? preferredHostId
        : selectable[0]?.hostId || "";
    setMembers((current) => [
      ...current,
      {
        memberId: candidateMemberId(row.serviceType, current),
        hostId,
        roles: [],
      },
    ]);
  };
  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    if (!kind) {
      setError("Для непустого размещения требуется READY catalog.");
      return;
    }
    if (kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED") {
      const ids = new Set<string>();
      if (
        members.some(
          (member) =>
            !/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$/.test(member.memberId) ||
            !member.hostId ||
            ids.has(member.memberId) ||
            (ids.add(member.memberId), false),
        )
      ) {
        setError("Укажите уникальный ID экземпляра и сервер для каждой строки.");
        return;
      }
      if (
        !(await onAppend({
          operation: "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement",
          deploymentId: row.deploymentId,
          members,
        }))
      )
        setError("Размещение не добавлено в общий черновик.");
      return;
    }
    const seen = new Set<string>();
    if (
      hosts.some(
        (host) =>
          !host.hostId ||
          !Number.isInteger(host.priority) ||
          host.priority < 1 ||
          host.priority > 254 ||
          seen.has(host.hostId) ||
          (seen.add(host.hostId), false),
      )
    ) {
      setError(
        "Укажите уникальные серверы и приоритет каждого от 1 до 254.",
      );
      return;
    }
    if (
      !(await onAppend({
        operation: "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement",
        deploymentId: row.deploymentId,
        hosts,
      }))
    )
      setError("Размещение не добавлено в общий черновик.");
  };
  if (!kind)
    return (
      <div className="modal">
        <section className="card dialog">
          <h1>Размещение недоступно</h1>
          <p>Для нового размещения требуется READY catalog.</p>
          {placement && (
            <button
              onClick={async () => {
                const accepted = await onAppend(
                  placement.kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED"
                    ? {
                        operation: "ReconcileDeploymentPlacement",
                        deploymentId: row.deploymentId,
                        members: [],
                      }
                    : {
                        operation: "ReconcileHostScopedDeploymentPlacement",
                        deploymentId: row.deploymentId,
                        hosts: [],
                      },
                );
                if (!accepted)
                  setError("Очистка размещения не добавлена в общий черновик.");
              }}
              disabled={busy}
            >
              Очистить существующее размещение
            </button>
          )}
          {error && (
            <p className="field-error" role="alert">
              {error}
            </p>
          )}
          <button className="outline" onClick={onClose}>
            Закрыть
          </button>
        </section>
      </div>
    );
  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <form className="card dialog topology-dialog" onSubmit={submit}>
        <h1>Размещение: {row.deploymentId}</h1>
        <p className="muted">
          {kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? "Экземпляры и роли" : "Серверы и роли"}.
          Применение заменяет всё размещение выбранного сервиса.
        </p>
        {kind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? (
          <>
            <div className="placement-rows">
              {members.map((member, index) => (
                <div
                  className="placement-row"
                  key={`${member.memberId}-${index}`}
                >
                  <input
                    aria-label={`Member ID ${index + 1}`}
                    value={member.memberId}
                    placeholder={`${row.serviceType}-1`}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setMembers((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index
                            ? { ...value, memberId: event.target.value }
                            : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  <select
                    aria-label={`Сервер ${index + 1}`}
                    value={member.hostId}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setMembers((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index
                            ? { ...value, hostId: event.target.value }
                            : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    {selectable.map((server) => (
                      <option key={server.hostId} value={server.hostId}>
                        {server.hostId}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <RoleSelector
                    roles={roleOptions}
                    value={member.roles}
                    onChange={(roles) =>
                      setMembers((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index ? { ...value, roles } : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="outline"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setMembers((current) =>
                        current.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    Удалить
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="outline"
              onClick={addMember}
              disabled={!selectable.length}
            >
              Добавить узел сервиса
            </button>
          </>
        ) : (
          <>
            <div className="placement-rows">
              {hosts.map((host, index) => (
                <div className="placement-row" key={`${host.hostId}-${index}`}>
                  <select
                    aria-label={`Сервер ${index + 1}`}
                    value={host.hostId}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setHosts((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index
                            ? { ...value, hostId: event.target.value }
                            : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    {selectable.map((server) => (
                      <option key={server.hostId} value={server.hostId}>
                        {server.hostId}
                      </option>
                    ))}
                  </select>
                  <RoleSelector
                    roles={roleOptions}
                    value={host.roles}
                    onChange={(roles) =>
                      setHosts((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index ? { ...value, roles } : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  <input
                    aria-label={`Приоритет ${index + 1}`}
                    type="number"
                    min={1}
                    max={254}
                    required
                    value={host.priority}
                    onChange={(event) =>
                      setHosts((current) =>
                        current.map((value, i) =>
                          i === index
                            ? { ...value, priority: Number(event.target.value) }
                            : value,
                        ),
                      )
                    }
                  />
                  <button
                    type="button"
                    className="outline"
                    onClick={() =>
                      setHosts((current) =>
                        current.filter((_, i) => i !== index),
                      )
                    }
                  >
                    Удалить
                  </button>
                </div>
              ))}
            </div>
            <button
              type="button"
              className="outline"
              onClick={() =>
                setHosts((current) => [
                  ...current,
                  {
                    hostId: preferredHostId || selectable[0]?.hostId || "",
                    roles: [],
                    priority: 0,
                  },
                ])
              }
              disabled={!selectable.length}
            >
              Добавить сервер
            </button>
          </>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <div className="actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="outline"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={busy}
          >
            Отмена
          </button>
          <button type="submit" disabled={busy}>
            Применить
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
    </div>
  );
}

function RoleSelector({
  roles,
  value,
  onChange,
}: {
  roles: string[];
  value: string[];
  onChange: (roles: string[]) => void;
}) {
  if (!roles.length) return <span className="muted">Без ролей</span>;
  return (
    <label className="role-selector">
      Роли
      <select
        multiple
        value={value}
        onChange={(event) =>
          onChange(
            [...event.currentTarget.selectedOptions].map(
              (option) => option.value,
            ),
          )
        }
      >
        {roles.map((role) => (
          <option key={role} value={role}>
            {role}
          </option>
        ))}
      </select>
    </label>
  );
}

function AddDeploymentDialog({
  services,
  existingIDs,
  busy,
  onClose,
  onAppend,
}: {
  services: CatalogService[];
  existingIDs: Set<string>;
  busy: boolean;
  onClose: () => void;
  onAppend: (
    intent: DeploymentIntent & { operation: "CreateServiceDeployment" },
  ) => Promise<boolean>;
}) {
  const [deploymentID, setDeploymentID] = useState("");
  const [serviceType, setServiceType] = useState(services[0]?.id || "");
  const selectedService = services.find(
    (service) => service.id === serviceType,
  );
  const [mode, setMode] = useState(selectedService?.modes[0]?.id || "");
  const [error, setError] = useState("");
  const selectedMode = selectedService?.modes.find((item) => item.id === mode);

  const selectService = (id: string) => {
    setServiceType(id);
    const next = services.find((service) => service.id === id);
    setMode(next?.modes[0]?.id || "");
    setError("");
  };

  const submit = async (event: React.FormEvent) => {
    event.preventDefault();
    const id = deploymentID.trim();
    if (!/^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$/.test(id)) {
      setError("ID: 1–63 символа, строчные латинские буквы, цифры и дефис.");
      return;
    }
    if (existingIDs.has(id)) {
      setError(
        "Deployment с таким ID уже есть в сохранённом состоянии или черновике.",
      );
      return;
    }
    if (!serviceType || !mode) {
      setError("Выберите сервис и режим.");
      return;
    }
    const accepted = await onAppend({
      operation: "CreateServiceDeployment",
      deploymentId: id,
      serviceType,
      mode,
    });
    if (!accepted) setError("Изменение не добавлено в общий черновик.");
  };

  return (
    <div className="modal" role="presentation">
      <form className="card dialog topology-dialog" onSubmit={submit}>
        <h1>Добавить экземпляр сервиса</h1>
        <label>
          Технический ID экземпляра сервиса
          <input
            value={deploymentID}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setDeploymentID(event.target.value);
              setError("");
            }}
            required
            autoFocus
          />
        </label>
        <small className="muted">ID стабилен и не переименовывается.</small>
        <label>
          Сервис
          <select
            value={serviceType}
            onChange={(event) => selectService(event.target.value)}
          >
            {services.map((service) => (
              <option key={service.id} value={service.id}>
                {service.displayName} ({service.id})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        <label>
          Режим
          <select
            value={mode}
            onChange={(event) => setMode(event.target.value)}
          >
            {selectedService?.modes.map((item) => (
              <option key={item.id} value={item.id}>
                {item.displayName} ({item.id})
              </option>
            ))}
          </select>
        </label>
        {selectedMode && (
          <p className="topology-guidance">
            Размещение: <b>{selectedMode.placementKind === "MEMBER_SCOPED" ? "По экземплярам" : selectedMode.placementKind === "HOST_SCOPED" ? "По серверам" : "Неизвестный тип"}</b>
          </p>
        )}
        {error && (
          <p className="field-error" role="alert">
            {error}
          </p>
        )}
        <p className="muted">
          Размещение, группы точек входа и настройки сервиса здесь не создаются.
        </p>
        <div className="actions">
          <button
            type="button"
            className="outline"
            onClick={onClose}
            disabled={busy}
          >
          
@@END

  Отмена
          </button>
          <button type="submit" disabled={busy || services.length === 0}>
            Добавить в черновик

    </div>
  );
}

const LOGS_PAGE_SIZE = 512;
const LOGS_VISIBLE_COLUMNS_KEY = "platform-installer.logs.visible-columns";

type EventColumn = {
  key: string;
  label: string;
  value: (event: InstallationEventView) => string;
};

const eventColumns: EventColumn[] = [
  { key: "sequence", label: "№", value: (event) => String(event.sequence) },
  {
    key: "timestamp",
    label: "Время",
    value: (event) => eventTimestampLabel(event.timestamp),
  },
  {
    key: "eventType",
    label: "Тип события",
    value: (event) => eventTypeLabel(event.eventType),
  },
  {
    key: "status",
    label: "Статус",
    value: (event) => eventStatusLabel(event.status),
  },
  {
    key: "safeMessage",
    label: "Сообщение",
    value: (event) => event.safeMessage,
  },
  {
    key: "ansibleOutput",
    label: "Вывод Ansible",
    value: (event) => event.ansibleOutput || "—",
  },
  { key: "phaseId", label: "Этап", value: (event) => event.phaseId || "—" },
  {
    key: "actionId",
    label: "Действие",
    value: (event) => event.actionId || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "serviceDeployment",
    label: "Развёртывание сервиса",
    value: (event) => event.serviceDeployment || "—",
  },
  { key: "host", label: "Узел", value: (event) => event.host || "—" },
  {
    key: "taskRole",
    label: "Роль задачи",
    value: (event) => event.task?.role || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "taskName",
    label: "Задача",
    value: (event) =>
      taskNameWithoutRole(event) || (event.task ? "Скрыто" : "—"),
  },
  {
    key: "taskUUID",
    label: "ID задачи",
    value: (event) => event.task?.uuid || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "elapsed",
    label: "Длительность",
    value: (event) =>
      event.elapsedMilliseconds === undefined
        ? "—"
        : `${event.elapsedMilliseconds} мс`,
  },
  {
    key: "errorCode",
    label: "Код ошибки",
    value: (event) => event.errorCode || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "errorSummary",
    label: "Описание ошибки",
    value: (event) => event.errorSummary || "—",
  },
  {
    key: "redacted",
    label: "Редакция данных",
    value: (event) => (event.redacted ? "Применена" : "Нет"),
  },
  { key: "runId", label: "ID запуска", value: (event) => event.runId },
];

const defaultVisibleColumns = [
  "timestamp",
  "status",
  "ansibleOutput",
  "serviceDeployment",
  "host",
  "taskName",
];

function initialVisibleColumns(): string[] {
  try {
    const saved = window.sessionStorage.getItem(LOGS_VISIBLE_COLUMNS_KEY);
    if (saved !== null) {
      const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(saved);
      if (Array.isArray(parsed)) {
        const selected = new Set(
          parsed.filter((key): key is string => typeof key === "string"),
        );
        return eventColumns
          .filter((column) => selected.has(column.key))
          .map((column) => column.key);
      }
    }
  } catch {
    // Storage may be unavailable in restricted WebView contexts.
  }
  return defaultVisibleColumns;
}

function eventTypeLabel(value: string): string {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    RUN_STARTED: "Запуск начат",
    PHASE_STARTED: "Этап начат",
    ACTION_STARTED: "Действие начато",
    TASK_STARTED: "Задача начата",
    TASK_COMPLETED: "Задача завершена",
    ACTION_COMPLETED: "Действие завершено",
    PHASE_COMPLETED: "Этап завершён",
    RUN_COMPLETED: "Запуск завершён",
    DIAGNOSTIC: "Диагностика",
  };
  return labels[value] || value;
}

function eventStatusLabel(value: string): string {
  const labels: Record<string, string> = {
    PENDING: "Ожидает",
    RUNNING: "Выполняется",
    SUCCESS: "Успешно",
    CHANGED: "Изменено",
    SKIPPED: "Пропущено",
    FAILED: "Ошибка",
    CANCELLED: "Отменено",
    INTERRUPTED: "Прервано",
  };
  return labels[value] || value;
}

function EventLog({
  events,
  runId,
}: {
  events: InstallationEventView[];
  runId?: string;
}) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [page, setPage] = useState(0);
  const [selectedSequence, setSelectedSequence] = useState<number>();
  const [visibleColumns, setVisibleColumns] = useState<string[]>(
    initialVisibleColumns,
  );
  useEffect(() => {
    try {
      window.sessionStorage.setItem(
        LOGS_VISIBLE_COLUMNS_KEY,
        JSON.stringify(visibleColumns),
      );
    } catch {
      // Keep the selection in component state if storage is unavailable.
    }
  }, [visibleColumns]);
  useEffect(() => {
    setPage(0);
    setSelectedSequence(undefined);
  }, [runId]);
  const orderedEvents = useMemo(
    () => [...events].sort((a, b) => b.sequence - a.sequence),
    [events],
  );
  const filteredEvents = useMemo(() => {
    const needle = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru");
    if (!needle) return orderedEvents;
    return orderedEvents.filter((event) =>
      eventColumns.some((column) =>
        column.value(event).toLocaleLowerCase("ru").includes(needle),
      ),
    );
  }, [orderedEvents, query]);
  const pageCount = Math.max(
    1,
    Math.ceil(filteredEvents.length / LOGS_PAGE_SIZE),
  );
  const currentPage = Math.min(page, pageCount - 1);
  const pageEvents = filteredEvents.slice(
    currentPage * LOGS_PAGE_SIZE,
    (currentPage + 1) * LOGS_PAGE_SIZE,
  );
  const selectedEvent =
    filteredEvents.find((event) => event.sequence === selectedSequence) ||
    filteredEvents[0];
  const visible = eventColumns.filter((column) =>
    visibleColumns.includes(column.key),
  );

  return (
    <>
      <div className="event-log-toolbar">
        <label className="event-log-search">
          Поиск по событиям
          <input
            value={query}
            onChange={(event) => {
              setQuery(event.target.value);
              setPage(0);
            }}
            placeholder="Сообщение, задача, узел…"
          />
        </label>
        <details className="event-log-columns">
          <summary>
            Колонки ({visible.length} из {eventColumns.length})
          </summary>
          <fieldset>
            <legend>Показывать колонки</legend>
            {eventColumns.map((column) => (
              <label key={column.key}>
                <input
                  type="checkbox"
                  checked={visibleColumns.includes(column.key)}
                  onChange={(event) =>
                    setVisibleColumns((current) =>
                      event.target.checked
                        ? [...current, column.key]
                        : current.filter((key) => key !== column.key),
                    )
                  }
                />
                {column.label}
              </label>
            ))}
          </fieldset>
        </details>
      </div>
      <div className="event-log-layout">
        <section
          className="event-log-table-panel"
          aria-label="События текущего запуска"
        >
          <div className="event-log-table-scroll">
            <table className="event-log-table">
              <thead>
                <tr>
                  {visible.map((column) => (
                    <th key={column.key} scope="col">
                      {column.label}
                    </th>
                  ))}
                </tr>
              </thead>
              <tbody>
                {pageEvents.map((event) => (
                  <tr
                    key={`${event.runId}-${event.sequence}`}
                    className={
                      selectedEvent?.sequence === event.sequence
                        ? "is-selected"
                        : ""
                    }
                    onClick={() => setSelectedSequence(event.sequence)}
                  >
                    {visible.map((column) => (
                      <td
                        key={column.key}
                        title={column.value(event)}
                        className={
                          column.key === "ansibleOutput"
                            ? "ansible-output"
                            : undefined
                        }
                      >
                        {column.value(event)}
                      </td>
                    ))}
                  </tr>
                ))}
              </tbody>
            </table>
            {pageEvents.length === 0 && (
              <p className="event-log-empty">
                {events.length
                  ? "По заданным условиям события не найдены."
                  : "События появятся здесь после запуска плана."}
              </p>
            )}
          </div>
          <footer className="event-log-pagination">
            <span>
              {filteredEvents.length
                ? `Показаны ${currentPage * LOGS_PAGE_SIZE + 1}–${Math.min((currentPage + 1) * LOGS_PAGE_SIZE, filteredEvents.length)} из ${filteredEvents.length}`
                : "Нет событий"}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() => setPage((value) => Math.max(0, value - 1))}
              disabled={currentPage === 0}
            >
              Назад
            </button>
            <span>
              Страница {currentPage + 1} из {pageCount}
            </span>
            <button
              type="button"
              onClick={() =>
                setPage((value) => Math.min(pageCount - 1, value + 1))
              }
              disabled={currentPage >= pageCount - 1}
            >
              Далее
            </button>
          </footer>
        </section>
        <aside className="event-log-details" aria-label="Подробности события">
          <h2>Детали события</h2>
          {selectedEvent ? (
            <>
              <strong>
                {eventTypeLabel(selectedEvent.eventType)} ·{" "}
                {eventStatusLabel(selectedEvent.status)}
              </strong>
              <p>{selectedEvent.safeMessage}</p>
              <dl>
                <dt>Время</dt>
                <dd>{eventTimestampLabel(selectedEvent.timestamp)}</dd>
                <dt>Этап / действие</dt>
                <dd>
                  {[selectedEvent.phaseId, selectedEvent.actionId]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(" · ") || "—"}
                </dd>
                <dt>Развёртывание сервиса</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.serviceDeployment || "—"}</dd>
                <dt>Узел</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.host || "—"}</dd>
                <dt>Роль задачи</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.task?.role || "—"}</dd>
                <dt>Задача</dt>
                <dd>
                  {taskNameWithoutRole(selectedEvent) ||
                    (selectedEvent.task ? "Скрыто" : "—")}
                </dd>
                <dt>ID задачи</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.task?.uuid || "—"}</dd>
                <dt>Длительность</dt>
                <dd>
                  {selectedEvent.elapsedMilliseconds === undefined
                    ? "—"
                    : `${selectedEvent.elapsedMilliseconds} мс`}
                </dd>
                <dt>Ошибка</dt>
                <dd>
                  {[selectedEvent.errorCode, selectedEvent.errorSummary]
                    .filter(Boolean)
                    .join(" · ") || "—"}
                </dd>
                <dt>Редакция данных</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.redacted ? "Применена" : "Нет"}</dd>
                <dt className="event-log-output-label">Вывод Ansible</dt>
                <dd className="event-log-output">
                  {selectedEvent.ansibleOutput || "—"}
                </dd>
                <dt>ID запуска</dt>
                <dd>{selectedEvent.runId || runId || "—"}</dd>
              </dl>
            </>
          ) : (
            <p>Выберите событие, чтобы увидеть подробности.</p>
          )}
        </aside>
      </div>
    </>
  );
}

type Props = {
  page: string;
  managed?: ManagedProjectView;
  projectSettingDraftValues?: Partial<
    Record<"platform_data_root_directory" | "platform_name_prefix", string>
  >;
  onAppendProjectSetting?: (intent: {
    operation: "SetProjectSetting";
    setting: "platform_data_root_directory" | "platform_name_prefix";
    value: string;
  }) => Promise<boolean>;
  editError?: EditResult["error"] | null;
  events: InstallationEventView[];
  runId?: string;
  configVersion?: number;
  serverTypes: Array<{ id: string; displayName: string }>;
  configError: string | null;
  onNavigate?: (page: HelpPageId) => void;
};

function HelpPage({ onNavigate }: { onNavigate?: (page: HelpPageId) => void }) {
  const [query, setQuery] = useState("");
  const [categoryId, setCategoryId] = useState<string>();
  const [articleId, setArticleId] = useState<string>();
  const normalizedQuery = query.trim().toLocaleLowerCase("ru");
  const matches = useMemo(() => {
    const candidates = helpArticles.filter(
      (article) =>
        !categoryId || normalizedQuery || article.category === categoryId,
    );
    if (!normalizedQuery) return candidates;
    return candidates.filter((article) => {
      const category = helpCategories.find(
        (item) => item.id === article.category,
      );
      const searchable = [
        category?.title,
        article.title,
        article.summary,
        article.intro,
        article.warning,
        ...article.sections.flatMap((section) => [
          section.title,
          section.text,
          ...(section.steps || []),
        ]),
      ]
        .filter(Boolean)
        .join(" ")
        .toLocaleLowerCase("ru");
      return searchable.includes(normalizedQuery);
    });
  }, [categoryId, normalizedQuery]);
  const selectedArticle = matches.find((article) => article.id === articleId);
  const selectedCategory = helpCategories.find(
    (item) => item.id === categoryId,
  );

  const openCategory = (id: string) => {
    const firstArticle = helpArticles.find(
      (article) => article.category === id,
    );
    setQuery("");
    setCategoryId(id);
    setArticleId(firstArticle?.id);
  };
  const openArticle = (article: (typeof helpArticles)[number]) => {
    setCategoryId(article.category);
    setArticleId(article.id);
  };

  return (
    <section className="utility-page help-page" aria-labelledby="help-title">
      <header className="utility-page-title">
        <div>
          <h1 id="help-title">Справка</h1>
          <p>Инструкции по проекту, настройке и устранению ошибок.</p>
        </div>
      </header>
      <label className="help-search">
        <span className="visually-hidden">Поиск по справке</span>
        <input
          type="search"
          value={query}
          onChange={(event) => {
            setQuery(event.target.value);
            setArticleId(undefined);
          }}
          placeholder="Например: каталог недоступен"
        />
      </label>

      {selectedArticle ? (
        <div className="help-reading-layout">
          <aside className="help-article-list" aria-label="Статьи раздела">
            <div className="help-list-heading">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-back-link"
                onClick={() => {
                  setArticleId(undefined);
                  setCategoryId(undefined);
                }}
              >
                Все разделы
              </button>
              <h2>
                {normalizedQuery
                  ? "Результаты поиска"
                  : selectedCategory?.title}
              </h2>
            </div>
            {matches.map((article) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                key={article.id}
                className={`help-article-link${article.id === selectedArticle.id ? " is-selected" : ""}`}
                onClick={() => openArticle(article)}
              >
                {article.title}
              </button>
            ))}
          </aside>
          <article
            className="utility-card help-article"
            aria-labelledby="help-article-title"
          >
            <div className="help-breadcrumb">
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-back-link"
                onClick={() => {
                  setArticleId(undefined);
                  setCategoryId(undefined);
                }}
              >
                Справка
              </button>
              <span aria-hidden="true">›</span>
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-back-link"
                onClick={() => setArticleId(undefined)}
              >
                {selectedCategory?.title}
              </button>
            </div>
            <h2 id="help-article-title">{selectedArticle.title}</h2>
            <p className="help-article-intro">{selectedArticle.intro}</p>
            {selectedArticle.sections.map((section) => (
              <section className="help-article-section" key={section.title}>
                <h3>{section.title}</h3>
                {section.text && <p>{section.text}</p>}
                {section.steps && (
                  <ol>
                    {section.steps.map((step) => (
                      <li key={step}>{step}</li>
                    ))}
                  </ol>
                )}
              </section>
            ))}
            {selectedArticle.warning && (
              <p className="help-warning" role="note">
                {selectedArticle.warning}
              </p>
            )}
            {selectedArticle.targetPage && onNavigate && (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-open-page"
                onClick={() => onNavigate(selectedArticle.targetPage!)}
              >
                Открыть страницу «{helpPageLabels[selectedArticle.targetPage]}»
              </button>
            )}
          </article>
        </div>
      ) : normalizedQuery ? (
        <section
          className="help-search-results"
          aria-live="polite"
          aria-label="Результаты поиска"
        >
          <h2>Результаты поиска</h2>
          {matches.length ? (
            matches.map((article) => {
              const category = helpCategories.find(
                (item) => item.id === article.category,
              );
              return (
                <button
                  type="button"
                  className="help-search-result"
                  key={article.id}
                  onClick={() => openArticle(article)}
                >
                  <span>{category?.title}</span>
                  <strong>{article.title}</strong>
                  <small>{article.summary}</small>
                </button>
              );
            })
          ) : (
            <p role="status">По этому запросу статьи не найдены.</p>
          )}
        </section>
      ) : categoryId && selectedCategory ? (
        <section
          className="help-search-results"
          aria-labelledby="help-category-title"
        >
          <button
            type="button"
            className="help-back-link"
            onClick={() => setCategoryId(undefined)}
          >
            Все разделы
          </button>
          <h2 id="help-category-title">{selectedCategory.title}</h2>
          {matches.map((article) => (
            <button
              type="button"
              className="help-search-result"
              key={article.id}
              onClick={() => openArticle(article)}
            >
              <strong>{article.title}</strong>
              <small>{article.summary}</small>
            </button>
          ))}
        </section>
      ) : (
        <section
          className="help-category-grid"
          aria-labelledby="help-categories-title"
        >
          <h2 id="help-categories-title">Темы</h2>
          <div className="help-category-cards">
            {helpCategories.map((category) => (
              <button
                type="button"
                className="help-category-card"
                key={category.id}
                onClick={() => openCategory(category.id)}
              >
                <span className="help-category-card-heading">
                  <strong>{category.title}</strong>
                  <span aria-hidden="true">›</span>
                </span>
                <span className="help-category-description">
                  {category.description}
                </span>
                <small>
                  Статей:{" "}
                  {
                    helpArticles.filter(
                      (article) => article.category === category.id,
                    ).length
                  }
                </small>
              </button>
            ))}
          </div>
        </section>
      )}
    </section>
  );
}

import type { OpenResult } from "./backend";
export type ObjectValue = Record<string, unknown>;
export type ApplicationIntent = {
  operation:
    | "SetApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup"
    | "ClearApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup"
    | "DeleteApplicationLibraryWithPlacements"
    | "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment"
    | "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment"
    | "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment"
    | "SetApplicationLibrarySlot"
    | "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot"
    | "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement"
    | "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement"
    | "SetApplicationLibraryOverride"
    | "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride";
  deploymentId: string;
  entityId?: string;
  hostId?: string;
  entity?: ObjectValue;
  placement?: ObjectValue;
  property?: string;
  setting?: string;
  value?: unknown;
};
export const isApplicationIntent = (value: {
  operation: string;
}): value is ApplicationIntent =>
  value.operation.includes("ApplicationLibrary");
export const objectValue = (value: unknown): ObjectValue =>
  value && typeof value === "object" && !Array.isArray(value)
    ? (value as ObjectValue)
    : {};
// This projects authored edit intents only. No inheritance/resolution is performed.
export function applicationDraft(
  managed: OpenResult["managed"],
  intents: ApplicationIntent[],
) {
  const libraries = Object.assign(
    Object.create(null),
    structuredClone(managed?.applicationLibraries ?? {}),
  ) as Record<string, ObjectValue>;
  const placements = Object.assign(
    Object.create(null),
    structuredClone(managed?.applicationPlacements ?? {}),
  ) as Record<string, ObjectValue>;
  const libraryEndpointGroups = { ...managed?.libraryEndpointGroups };
  for (const c of intents) {
    const id = c.deploymentId;
    if (c.operation === "SetApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup") {
      libraryEndpointGroups[id] = String(c.value);
      libraries[id].bindings = {
        ...objectValue(libraries[id].bindings),
        endpoint: { endpointGroupRef: String(c.value) },
      };
    } else if (c.operation === "ClearApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup") {
      delete libraryEndpointGroups[id];
      const bindings = { ...objectValue(libraries[id].bindings) };
      delete bindings.endpoint;
      libraries[id].bindings = bindings;
    } else if (c.operation === "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment")
      libraries[id] = { ...c.entity };
    else if (
      c.operation === "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment" ||
      c.operation === "DeleteApplicationLibraryWithPlacements"
    ) {
      delete libraries[id];
      delete libraryEndpointGroups[id];
      if (c.operation === "DeleteApplicationLibraryWithPlacements")
        for (const host of Object.keys(placements)) delete placements[host][id];
    } else if (c.operation === "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment")
      libraries[id] = { ...libraries[id], ...c.entity };
    else if (c.hostId && c.operation.endsWith("Placement")) {
      placements[c.hostId] ??= {};
      if (c.operation.startsWith("Remove")) delete placements[c.hostId][id];
      else placements[c.hostId][id] = { ...c.placement };
    } else if (c.operation.endsWith("Slot")) {
      const apps = objectValue(libraries[id]?.applications);
      if (c.operation.startsWith("Remove")) delete apps[c.entityId!];
      else
        apps[c.entityId!] = { ...objectValue(apps[c.entityId!]), ...c.entity };
      libraries[id] = { ...libraries[id], applications: apps };
    } else if (c.setting) {
      let target: ObjectValue;
      if (c.hostId) {
        placements[c.hostId] ??= {};
        const member = objectValue(placements[c.hostId][id]);
        target = objectValue(member.overrides);
        member.overrides = target;
        placements[c.hostId][id] = member;
      } else if (c.entityId) {
        libraries[id] ??= {};
        const apps = objectValue(libraries[id].applications);
        const slot = objectValue(apps[c.entityId!]);
        target = objectValue(slot.overrides);
        slot.overrides = target;
        apps[c.entityId!] = slot;
        libraries[id].applications = apps;
      } else {
        libraries[id] ??= {};
        target = objectValue(libraries[id].overrides);
        libraries[id].overrides = target;
      }
      const fields = c.property ? objectValue(target[c.property]) : target;
      if (c.operation.startsWith("Remove")) delete fields[c.setting];
      else
        Object.defineProperty(fields, c.setting, {
          value: c.value,
          enumerable: true,
          writable: true,
          configurable: true,
        });
      if (c.property) target[c.property] = fields;
    }
  }
  return { libraries, placements, libraryEndpointGroups };
}

import type { InstallationEventView, ProjectBackend } from "./backend";

declare global {
  interface Window {
    __PI_BROWSER_READY__?: Promise<void>;
    __PI_BROWSER_LEASE__?: string;
  }
}

async function browserReady(): Promise<string> {
  if (!window.__PI_BROWSER_READY__) throw new Error("BROWSER_HOST_UNAVAILABLE");
  await window.__PI_BROWSER_READY__;
  const lease = window.__PI_BROWSER_LEASE__;
  if (!lease) throw new Error("BROWSER_TAB_LEASE_UNAVAILABLE");
  return lease;
}

async function invoke<T>(operation: string, args: unknown[] = []): Promise<T> {
  const lease = await browserReady();
  const response = await fetch(`/api/call/${encodeURIComponent(operation)}`, {
    method: "POST",
    credentials: "same-origin",
    headers: {
      "Content-Type": "application/json",
      "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease,
    },
    body: JSON.stringify(args),
  });
  const payload = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
    result?: T;
    error?: { code?: string };
  };
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new Error(payload.error?.code || "BROWSER_API_REQUEST_FAILED");
  return payload.result as T;
}

function promptExecutionNodePath(purpose: string): string {
  return (
    window.prompt(
      `${purpose}\nУкажите абсолютный путь на Linux Execution Node.`,
    ) || ""
  ).trim();
}

function chooseBrowserFile(): Promise<File | null> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => {
    const input = document.createElement("input");
    input.type = "file";
    input.accept = ".json,.age,application/json";
    input.onchange = () => resolve(input.files?.[0] || null);
    input.addEventListener("cancel", () => resolve(null), { once: true });
    input.click();
  });
}

function toBase64(bytes: Uint8Array): string {
  let binary = "";
  const chunkSize = 0x8000;
  for (let offset = 0; offset < bytes.length; offset += chunkSize) {
    binary += String.fromCharCode(
      ...bytes.subarray(offset, offset + chunkSize),
    );
  }
  return btoa(binary);
}

async function choosePendingRuntimeSecretFile(
  input: Parameters<
    NonNullable<ProjectBackend["choosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile"]>
  >[0],
): Promise<string> {
  const file = await chooseBrowserFile();
  if (!file) return "CANCELLED";
  if (file.size === 0 || file.size > 131_072)
    throw new Error("SECRET_FILE_INVALID");
  const bytes = new Uint8Array(await file.arrayBuffer());
  try {
    return await invoke("choosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile", [
      input,
      toBase64(bytes),
    ]);
  } finally {
    bytes.fill(0);
  }
}

function sleep(milliseconds: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolve) => window.setTimeout(resolve, milliseconds));
}

function subscribeEvents(
  handler: (value: {
    subscriptionId?: string;
    event?: InstallationEventView;
    errorCode?: string;
  }) => void,
): () => void {
  let stopped = false;
  let lastEventID = "";
  let controller: AbortController | undefined;
  const readStream = async (response: Response) => {
    if (!response.body) throw new Error("BROWSER_EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE");
    const reader = response.body.getReader();
    const decoder = new TextDecoder();
    let buffer = "";
    let frame: { id?: string; data: string[] } = { data: [] };
    const dispatch = () => {
      if (frame.id) lastEventID = frame.id;
      if (frame.data.length) {
        try {
          const message = JSON.parse(frame.data.join("\n")) as {
            name?: string;
            payload?: {
              subscriptionId?: string;
              event?: InstallationEventView;
              errorCode?: string;
            };
          };
          if (message.name === "installation-run-event" && message.payload)
            handler(message.payload);
        } catch {
          // Ignore malformed event frames; the next frame remains usable.
        }
      }
      frame = { data: [] };
    };
    while (!stopped) {
      const { value, done } = await reader.read();
      if (done) break;
      buffer += decoder.decode(value, { stream: true });
      let boundary = buffer.indexOf("\n");
      while (boundary >= 0) {
        const line = buffer.slice(0, boundary).replace(/\r$/, "");
        buffer = buffer.slice(boundary + 1);
        if (line === "") dispatch();
        else if (!line.startsWith(":")) {
          const separator = line.indexOf(":");
          const field = separator < 0 ? line : line.slice(0, separator);
          const valueText =
            separator < 0 ? "" : line.slice(separator + 1).replace(/^ /, "");
          if (field === "id") frame.id = valueText;
          else if (field === "data") frame.data.push(valueText);
        }
        boundary = buffer.indexOf("\n");
      }
    }
    try {
      await reader.cancel();
    } catch {
      // Stream already closed.
    }
  };
  const connect = async () => {
    const lease = await browserReady();
    controller = new AbortController();
    const headers = new Headers({ "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease });
    if (lastEventID) headers.set("Last-Event-ID", lastEventID);
    const response = await fetch("/api/events", {
      method: "GET",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers,
      signal: controller.signal,
    });
    if (!response.ok) throw new Error("BROWSER_EVENT_STREAM_UNAVAILABLE");
    await readStream(response);
  };
  void (async () => {
    let delay = 250;
    while (!stopped) {
      try {
        await connect();
        delay = 250;
      } catch {
        if (stopped) return;
      }
      if (!stopped) {
        await sleep(delay);
        delay = Math.min(delay * 2, 5000);
      }
    }
  })();
  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    controller?.abort();
  };
}

async function requestExit(): Promise<{
  status: "EXITING" | "EXIT_AFTER_RUN";
}> {
  const lease = await browserReady();
  const response = await fetch("/api/exit", {
    method: "POST",
    credentials: "same-origin",
    headers: { "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease },
  });
  const result = (await response.json().catch(() => ({}))) as {
    status?: "EXITING" | "EXIT_AFTER_RUN";
    error?: { code?: string };
  };
  if (!response.ok)
    throw new Error(result.error?.code || "BROWSER_EXIT_FAILED");
  return { status: result.status || "EXITING" };
}

export function startBrowserActivityKeepAlive(): () => void {
  const touchInterval = 10_000;
  let lastTouch = 0;
  let timer = 0;
  let stopped = false;
  const touch = async () => {
    timer = 0;
    if (stopped || document.visibilityState !== "visible") return;
    lastTouch = Date.now();
    const lease = await browserReady().catch(() => "");
    if (!lease || stopped) return;
    void fetch("/api/heartbeat", {
      method: "POST",
      credentials: "same-origin",
      headers: { "X-Platform-UI-Lease": lease },
    }).catch(() => undefined);
  };
  const schedule = () => {
    if (stopped || timer) return;
    const delay = Math.max(0, touchInterval - (Date.now() - lastTouch));
    timer = window.setTimeout(() => void touch(), delay);
  };
  const activity = () => schedule();
  const visibility = () => {
    if (document.visibilityState === "visible") {
      lastTouch = 0;
      schedule();
    }
  };
  for (const eventName of [
    "pointerdown",
    "keydown",
    "input",
    "change",
    "focusin",
  ])
    document.addEventListener(eventName, activity, true);
  document.addEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
  return () => {
    stopped = true;
    if (timer) window.clearTimeout(timer);
    for (const eventName of [
      "pointerdown",
      "keydown",
      "input",
      "change",
      "focusin",
    ])
      document.removeEventListener(eventName, activity, true);
    document.removeEventListener("visibilitychange", visibility);
  };
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"frontend/src/event-format.ts","mode":420,"size":754,"sha256":"fd64f4c499baef2986196d77180b668aeca5d49292d437e08bfe937979c508c3","index":0,"count":1,"newline":"lf","encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":754}
import type { InstallationEventView } from "./backend";

export function eventTimestampLabel(timestamp: string): string {
  const date = new Date(timestamp);
  if (!Number.isFinite(date.getTime())) return "время неизвестно";
  return new Intl.DateTimeFormat("ru-RU", {
    dateStyle: "short",
    timeStyle: "medium",
  }).format(date);
}

export function taskNameWithoutRole(
  event: InstallationEventView,
): string | undefined {
  const name = event.task?.name;
  const role = event.task?.role?.trim();
  if (!name || !role || !name.startsWith(role)) return name;

  const remainder = name.slice(role.length);
  const separator = remainder.match(/^\s*:\s*/);
  return separator ? remainder.slice(separator[0].length) || name : name;
}

// Presentation only: runtime identity and capability decisions remain in Go.
export function executionNodeStatusLabel(status?: string): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "NOT_CONFIGURED": return "Не настроен";
    // Selection/reset state is not evidence that runtime preparation is needed.
    case "NOT_PREPARED": return "Требуется проверка";
    case "UNPREPARED": return "Не подготовлен";
    case "UNREACHABLE": return "Недоступен";
    case "PREPARATION_REQUIRED": return "Требуется подготовка";
    case "UPDATE_REQUIRED": return "Требуется обновление";
    case "INCOMPATIBLE": return "Несовместим";
    case "BROKEN": return "Ошибка узла";
    case "READY": return "Готов";
    default: return "Состояние неизвестно";
  }
}

export function executionNodeSelectionLabel(source?: string): string {
  switch (source) {
    case "NONE": return "Не выбран";
    case "EXPLICIT": return "Выбран вручную";
    case "AUTO_LOCAL_LINUX": return "Автоматически: этот компьютер";
    case "AUTO_FIRST_ELIGIBLE": return "Автоматически: первый подходящий сервер";
    default: return "Источник выбора неизвестен";
  }
}

export function executionNodePreparationLabel(status?: string): string {
  switch (status) {
    case "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED": return "Ожидает подтверждения";
    case "BLOCKED": return "Подготовка недоступна";
    case "PREPARED": return "Подготовлен";
    default: return executionNodeStatusLabel(status);
  }
}

type ExecutionNodeStatusInput = {
  status?: string;
  error?: { message?: string };
  findings?: Array<{ safeMessage: string }>;
  steps?: Array<{ mutates?: boolean }>;
};

export type ExecutionNodeCombinedStatus = {
  label: string;
  tone: "success" | "warning" | "danger" | "neutral";
  detail?: string;
};

export function executionNodeCombinedStatus(
  readiness?: ExecutionNodeStatusInput | null,
  preparation?: ExecutionNodeStatusInput | null,
): ExecutionNodeCombinedStatus {
  if (preparation?.status === "PREPARING") {
    return { label: "Выполняется подготовка", tone: "warning" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "PREPARED") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Подготовлен", tone: "success" };
  }
  if (preparation?.error) {
    return {
      label: "Ошибка подготовки",
      tone: "danger",
      detail: preparation.error.message,
    };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED") {
    if (preparation.steps?.some((step) => step.mutates)) {
      return {
        label: "Проверен: Требуется подготовка",
        tone: "warning",
        detail: "Ожидает подтверждения",
      };
    }
    if (!preparation.steps?.length) {
      return {
        label: "Проверен: Ожидает подтверждения",
        tone: "warning",
      };
    }
    return {
      label: "Проверен: Подготовлен",
      tone: "success",
      detail: "Ожидает подтверждения проверки",
    };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "BLOCKED") {
    return {
      label: "Подготовка недоступна",
      tone: "danger",
      detail: preparation.findings?.map((finding) => finding.safeMessage).join(" · "),
    };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "UNREACHABLE") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Недоступен", tone: "danger" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "INCOMPATIBLE") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Несовместим", tone: "danger" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "BROKEN") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Ошибка узла", tone: "danger" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "UPDATE_REQUIRED") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Требуется обновление", tone: "warning" };
  }
  if (
    preparation?.status === "PREPARATION_REQUIRED" ||
    preparation?.status === "UNPREPARED" ||
    preparation?.status === "NOT_PREPARED"
  ) {
    return { label: "Проверен: Требуется подготовка", tone: "warning" };
  }
  if (preparation?.status === "READY") {
    return { label: "Проверен: Подготовлен", tone: "success" };
  }
  if (readiness?.error) {
    return {
      label: "Проверка недоступна",
      tone: "danger",
      detail: readiness.error.message,
    };
  }
  if (!readiness) return { label: "Не проверен", tone: "neutral" };
  switch (readiness.status) {
    case "READY":
      return { label: "Проверен: Подготовлен", tone: "success" };
    case "UPDATE_REQUIRED":
      return { label: "Проверен: Требуется обновление", tone: "warning" };
    case "PREPARATION_REQUIRED":
    case "UNPREPARED":
      return { label: "Проверен: Требуется подготовка", tone: "warning" };
    case "NOT_PREPARED":
      return { label: "Требуется проверка", tone: "warning" };
    case "UNREACHABLE":
      return { label: "Проверен: Недоступен", tone: "danger" };
    case "INCOMPATIBLE":
      return { label: "Проверен: Несовместим", tone: "danger" };
    case "BROKEN":
      return { label: "Проверен: Ошибка узла", tone: "danger" };
    case "NOT_CONFIGURED":
      return { label: "Не проверен: Узел не настроен", tone: "neutral" };
    default:
      return { label: "Состояние неизвестно", tone: "neutral" };
  }
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"frontend/src/installationPresentation.ts","mode":420,"size":8163,"sha256":"b0c2f899b69dc30c8c4f2340958cecb6ba760d1be08bffcd21b65394252d549a","index":0,"count":1,"newline":"lf","encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":8163}
import type {
  InstallationEventView,
  InstallationPlanView,
  InstallationRunOperation,
  InstallationState,
} from "./backend";

export type RunProgress = {
  runId: string;
  // Highest sequence observed, which can advance ahead of delivery order.
  lastSequence: number;
  lastActionSequence: number;
  // Highest sequence for which every preceding event has been observed.
  lastContiguousSequence: number;
  pendingSequences: number[];
  complete: boolean;
  actionIds: string[];
  stepParents: Record<string, string>;
  completedActionIds: string[];
  actionOutcomes: Record<string, string>;
  actionOutcomeSequences: Record<string, number>;
  activeActionId?: string;
};

export function beginRunProgress(
  runId: string,
  plan?: InstallationPlanView,
): RunProgress {
  return {
    runId,
    lastSequence: 0,
    lastActionSequence: 0,
    lastContiguousSequence: 0,
    pendingSequences: [],
    complete: true,
    actionIds: [
      ...new Set(
        plan?.phases.flatMap((phase) =>
          phase.actions.flatMap((action) =>
            action.progressSteps?.length
              ? action.progressSteps.map((step) => step.id)
              : [action.id],
          ),
        ) || [],
      ),
    ],
    stepParents: Object.fromEntries(
      plan?.phases.flatMap((phase) =>
        phase.actions.flatMap(
          (action) =>
            action.progressSteps?.map((step) => [step.id, action.id]) || [],
        ),
      ) || [],
    ),
    completedActionIds: [],
    actionOutcomes: {},
    actionOutcomeSequences: {},
  };
}

export function observeRunEvent(
  current: RunProgress,
  event: InstallationEventView,
): RunProgress {
  if (event.runId !== current.runId || event.sequence < 1) return current;
  const pending = new Set(current.pendingSequences);
  let contiguous = current.lastContiguousSequence;
  if (event.sequence > contiguous) pending.add(event.sequence);
  while (pending.delete(contiguous + 1)) contiguous += 1;
  const complete = pending.size === 0;
  const knownAction =
    !!event.actionId &&
    (current.actionIds.includes(event.actionId) ||
      Object.values(current.stepParents).includes(event.actionId));
  const outcomeRecorded =
    knownAction &&
    event.eventType === "ACTION_COMPLETED" &&
    [
      "SUCCESS",
      "CHANGED",
      "SKIPPED",
      "FAILED",
      "CANCELLED",
      "INTERRUPTED",
    ].includes(event.status);
  const isNewestAction =
    knownAction &&
    ["ACTION_STARTED", "ACTION_COMPLETED"].includes(event.eventType) &&
    event.sequence > (current.lastActionSequence || 0);
  const shouldRecordOutcome =
    outcomeRecorded &&
    event.sequence > (current.actionOutcomeSequences[event.actionId!] || 0);
  const actionOutcomes = shouldRecordOutcome
    ? { ...current.actionOutcomes, [event.actionId!]: event.status }
    : current.actionOutcomes;
  const actionOutcomeSequences = shouldRecordOutcome
    ? { ...current.actionOutcomeSequences, [event.actionId!]: event.sequence }
    : current.actionOutcomeSequences;
  const completedActionIds = current.actionIds.filter((actionId) =>
    ["SUCCESS", "CHANGED", "SKIPPED"].includes(actionOutcomes[actionId]),
  );
  return {
    ...current,
    lastSequence: Math.max(current.lastSequence, event.sequence),
    lastActionSequence: isNewestAction
      ? event.sequence
      : current.lastActionSequence,
    lastContiguousSequence: contiguous,
    pendingSequences: [...pending],
    complete,
    completedActionIds,
    actionOutcomes,
    actionOutcomeSequences,
    activeActionId: !isNewestAction
      ? current.activeActionId
      : knownAction && event.eventType === "ACTION_STARTED"
        ? event.actionId
        : event.eventType === "ACTION_COMPLETED" &&
            (event.actionId === current.activeActionId ||
              event.actionId ===
                current.stepParents[current.activeActionId || ""])
          ? undefined
          : current.activeActionId,
  };
}

export function actionResultLabel(
  actionId: string,
  runState: string,
  progress?: RunProgress,
): string {
  const outcome = progress?.actionOutcomes[actionId];
  if (outcome === "SUCCESS" || outcome === "CHANGED") return "Успешно";
  if (outcome === "SKIPPED") return "Пропущено";
  if (outcome === "FAILED") return "Ошибка";
  if (outcome === "CANCELLED" || outcome === "INTERRUPTED") return "Прервано";
  if (terminalStates.has(runState) && progress?.activeActionId === actionId)
    return "Не завершено";
  if (!progress?.complete) return "Сведения неполные";
  return runState === "SUCCEEDED" ? "Событие не получено" : "Не подтверждено";
}

// Keep the executable parent visible; child rows are display-only work units.
export function installationActionRows(plan?: InstallationPlanView) {
  let number = 0;
  return (
    plan?.phases.flatMap((phase) =>
      phase.actions.flatMap((action) => [
        {
          ...action,
          number: action.progressSteps?.length ? undefined : ++number,
          parentId: undefined as string | undefined,
        },
        ...(action.progressSteps?.map((step) => ({
          ...action,
          id: step.id,
          summary: step.summary,
          type: "APPLICATION_PROGRESS",
          progressSteps: undefined,
          parentId: action.id,
          number: ++number,
        })) || []),
      ]),
    ) || []
  );
}

const terminalStates = new Set([
  "SUCCEEDED",
  "FAILED",
  "CANCELLED",
  "INTERRUPTED",
]);
const activeStates = new Set(["STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING"]);

export function installationDisplay(
  state?: InstallationState,
  run?: InstallationRunOperation,
  progress?: RunProgress,
  starting = false,
): {
  label: string;
  detail: string;
  tone: "neutral" | "running" | "failed" | "succeeded";
  percent?: number;
  stage: "plan" | "execution" | "result";
} {
  if (starting) {
    return { label: "Запускается выполнение…", detail: "Ожидается подтверждение запуска Core", tone: "running", stage: "plan" };
  }
  const runState = run?.run?.state;
  if (runState === "SUCCEEDED") {
    return {
      label: "Установка выполнена",
      detail: "Все действия завершены",
      tone: "succeeded",
      percent: 100,
      stage: "result",
    };
  }
  if (runState && terminalStates.has(runState)) {
    const label =
      runState === "FAILED"
        ? "Ошибка установки"
        : runState === "CANCELLED"
          ? "Установка отменена"
          : "Установка прервана";
    return {
      label,
      detail: "Откройте результат запуска",
      tone: "failed",
      percent: confirmedPercent(progress),
      stage: "result",
    };
  }
  if (runState && activeStates.has(runState)) {
    return {
      label: runState === "CANCELLING" ? "Отмена установки" : "Идёт установка",
      detail: "Откройте ход выполнения",
      tone: "running",
      percent: confirmedPercent(progress),
      stage: "execution",
    };
  }
  if (run?.error) {
    return {
      label: "Запуск не начался",
      detail: "Требуется исправить ошибку",
      tone: "failed",
      stage: "plan",
    };
  }
  if (state?.status === "PLAN_APPROVED" || state?.status === "PLAN_REVIEW") {
    return {
      label: "Установка не начата",
      detail:
        state.status === "PLAN_APPROVED"
          ? "План одобрен"
          : "План ожидает одобрения",
      tone: "neutral",
      stage: "plan",
    };
  }
  return {
    label: "План не готов",
    detail: "Сформируйте свежий план",
    tone: "neutral",
    stage: "plan",
  };
}

function confirmedPercent(progress?: RunProgress): number | undefined {
  if (!progress || progress.actionIds.length === 0) return undefined;
  return Math.min(
    99,
    Math.floor(
      (progress.completedActionIds.length * 100) / progress.actionIds.length,
    ),
  );
}
