	ID          string `json:"id" yaml:"id"`
	DisplayName string `json:"displayName" yaml:"displayName"`
}

type ServiceExecutionPriority struct {
	ServiceType string `json:"serviceType" yaml:"serviceType"`
	Priority    *int   `json:"priority" yaml:"priority"`
}

type LibraryExecutionPriority struct {
	LibraryName string `json:"libraryName" yaml:"libraryName"`
	Priority    *int   `json:"priority" yaml:"priority"`
}

type Config struct {
	SchemaVersion              int                        `json:"schemaVersion" yaml:"schemaVersion"`
	ServerTypes                []ServerType               `json:"serverTypes" yaml:"serverTypes"`
	ServiceExecutionPriorities []ServiceExecutionPriority `json:"serviceExecutionPriorities" yaml:"serviceExecutionPriorities"`
	LibraryExecutionPriorities []LibraryExecutionPriority `json:"libraryExecutionPriorities" yaml:"libraryExecutionPriorities"`
}

type Error struct {
	Code string
}

func (e *Error) Error() string { return e.Code }

func Load(path string) (Config, error) {
	file, err := openRegularFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	defer file.Close()
	if info, err := file.Stat(); err != nil {
		return Config{}, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
	} else if info.Size() > maxConfigBytes {
		return Config{}, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_TOO_LARGE"}
	}

	decoder := yaml.NewDecoder(io.LimitReader(file, maxConfigBytes+1))
	decoder.KnownFields(true)
	var config Config
	if err := decoder.Decode(&config); err != nil {
		return Config{}, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_INVALID"}
	}
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); err != io.EOF {
		return Config{}, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_INVALID"}
	}
	if err := Validate(config); err != nil {
		return Config{}, err
	}
	return config, nil
}

func openRegularFile(path string) (*os.File, error) {
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
	}
	for component := absolute; ; component = filepath.Dir(component) {
		info, err := os.Lstat(component)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
				return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND"}
			}
			return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
		}
		if info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
			return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNSAFE_PATH"}
		}
		parent := filepath.Dir(component)
		if parent == component {
			break
		}
	}
	before, err := os.Lstat(absolute)
	if err != nil {
		if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
			return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND"}
		}
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
	}
	if before.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 || !before.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNSAFE_PATH"}
	}
	file, err := os.Open(absolute)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNREADABLE"}
	}
	after, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !after.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(before, after) {
		file.Close()
		return nil, &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UNSAFE_PATH"}
	}
	return file, nil
}

func Validate(config Config) error {
	if config.SchemaVersion == 1 || config.SchemaVersion == 2 {
		return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_UPGRADE_REQUIRED"}
	}
	if config.SchemaVersion != SchemaVersion {
		return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_VERSION_UNSUPPORTED"}
	}
	if len(config.ServerTypes) == 0 || len(config.ServerTypes) > maxServerTypes {
		return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVER_TYPES_INVALID"}
	}
	if len(config.ServiceExecutionPriorities) == 0 || len(config.ServiceExecutionPriorities) > maxServicePriorities {
		return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVICE_PRIORITIES_INVALID"}
	}
	prioritySeen := make(map[string]bool, len(config.ServiceExecutionPriorities))
	for _, entry := range config.ServiceExecutionPriorities {
		if !ServerTypeIDPattern.MatchString(entry.ServiceType) || entry.Priority == nil || *entry.Priority < 0 {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVICE_PRIORITY_INVALID"}
		}
		if prioritySeen[entry.ServiceType] {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVICE_PRIORITY_DUPLICATE"}
		}
		prioritySeen[entry.ServiceType] = true
	}
	if len(config.LibraryExecutionPriorities) > maxLibraryPriorities {
		return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_LIBRARY_PRIORITIES_INVALID"}
	}
	librarySeen := make(map[string]bool, len(config.LibraryExecutionPriorities))
	for _, entry := range config.LibraryExecutionPriorities {
		if !libraryNamePattern.MatchString(entry.LibraryName) || len(entry.LibraryName) > 128 || entry.Priority == nil || *entry.Priority < 0 {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_LIBRARY_PRIORITY_INVALID"}
		}
		if librarySeen[entry.LibraryName] {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_LIBRARY_PRIORITY_DUPLICATE"}
		}
		librarySeen[entry.LibraryName] = true
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(config.ServerTypes))
	for _, serverType := range config.ServerTypes {
		if !ServerTypeIDPattern.MatchString(serverType.ID) {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVER_TYPE_ID_INVALID"}
		}
		name := strings.TrimSpace(serverType.DisplayName)
		if name == "" || !utf8.ValidString(name) || utf8.RuneCountInString(name) > maxDisplayNameLength {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVER_TYPE_NAME_INVALID"}
		}
		key := strings.ToLower(serverType.ID)
		if seen[key] {
			return &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_SERVER_TYPE_DUPLICATE"}
		}
		seen[key] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func (c Config) HasServerType(id string) bool {
	for _, serverType := range c.ServerTypes {
		if serverType.ID == id {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

func ResolveDevelopmentPath(workingDirectory, executable string) (string, error) {
	candidates := []string{}
	if executable != "" {
		candidates = append(candidates, filepath.Clean(filepath.Join(filepath.Dir(executable), "..", "..", "config", "application.yml")))
	}
	if isRepositoryDevelopmentRoot(workingDirectory) {
		candidates = append(candidates, filepath.Join(workingDirectory, "config", "application.yml"))
	}
	for _, candidate := range candidates {
		file, err := openRegularFile(candidate)
		if err == nil {
			file.Close()
			return candidate, nil
		}
		var typed *Error
		if errors.As(err, &typed) && typed.Code != "APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND" {
			return "", err
		}
	}
	return "", &Error{Code: "APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND"}
}

func isRepositoryDevelopmentRoot(root string) bool {
	file, err := openRegularFile(filepath.Join(root, "go.mod"))
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	defer file.Close()
	content, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, 4097))
	if err != nil || len(content) > 4096 {
		return false
	}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(string(content), "\n") {
		if strings.TrimSpace(line) == "module platform-installer" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// Package artifactsource selects where one compatible install requirement is
// satisfied. Repository checks are supplied by the actual install node.
package artifactsource

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
)

type Source string

const (
	Repository    Source = "REPOSITORY"
	OfflineBundle Source = "OFFLINE_BUNDLE"
	Blocked       Source = "BLOCKED"
)

type Requirement struct {
	ID           string `json:"id"`
	Name         string `json:"name"`
	Version      string `json:"version"`
	OS           string `json:"os"`
	Architecture string `json:"architecture"`
}

type Candidate struct {
	ID           string     `json:"id"`
	Name         string     `json:"name"`
	Version      string     `json:"version"`
	OS           string     `json:"os"`
	Architecture string     `json:"architecture"`
	Artifacts    []Artifact `json:"artifacts,omitempty"`
}

type Artifact struct {
	Ref    string `json:"ref"`
	SHA256 string `json:"sha256"`
	Size   int64  `json:"size"`
	Type   string `json:"type"`
}

type Result struct {
	APIVersion  string      `json:"apiVersion"`
	Kind        string      `json:"kind"`
	Requirement Requirement `json:"requirement"`
	TargetNode  string      `json:"targetNode"`
	Source      Source      `json:"source"`
	Version     string      `json:"version,omitempty"`
	ArtifactRef string      `json:"artifactRef,omitempty"`
	Artifacts   []Artifact  `json:"artifacts,omitempty"`
	Reason      string      `json:"reason"`
}

type Provider interface {
	FindCompatible(Requirement) (Candidate, bool, error)
}

// CandidatesProvider is a data-only bundle provider. It contains candidates
// already verified by the bundle importer; it does not select a source or
// inspect the target node.
type CandidatesProvider []Candidate

func (p CandidatesProvider) FindCompatible(requirement Requirement) (Candidate, bool, error) {
	for _, candidate := range p {
		if compatible(requirement, candidate) {
			return candidate, true, nil
		}
	}
	return Candidate{}, false, nil
}

type ProbeStatus string

const (
	AvailableCompatible   ProbeStatus = "AVAILABLE_COMPATIBLE"
	AvailableIncompatible ProbeStatus = "AVAILABLE_INCOMPATIBLE"
	NotFound              ProbeStatus = "NOT_FOUND"
	RepositoryUnavailable ProbeStatus = "REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE"
	ProbeFailed           ProbeStatus = "PROBE_FAILED"
)

type RepositoryProbeResult struct {
	TargetNode  string      `json:"targetNode"`
	Requirement Requirement `json:"requirement"`
	Status      ProbeStatus `json:"status"`
	Candidates  []Candidate `json:"candidates,omitempty"`
	Reason      string      `json:"reason"`
}

type RepositoryProbe interface {
	ProbeRepository(context.Context, Requirement) (RepositoryProbeResult, error)
}

// RuntimeProjection converts resolved decisions into the derived Ansible
// variable consumed by the shared service gate. It never writes project state.
func RuntimeProjection(targetNode string, results []Result) map[string]Result {
	projection := make(map[string]Result, len(results))
	for _, result := range results {
		if result.TargetNode != targetNode {
			continue
		}
		projection[result.Requirement.ID] = result
	}
	return projection
}

// Resolve applies the same policy to execution-node and target-node
// requirements. Each provider must query only the node it represents.
func Resolve(requirement Requirement, repository, bundle Provider) (Result, error) {
	return ResolveForNode("", requirement, repository, bundle)
}

// ResolveForNode returns the versioned contract consumed by Core service
// roles. Providers remain scoped to the target node supplied by the caller.
func ResolveForNode(targetNode string, requirement Requirement, repository, bundle Provider) (Result, error) {
	base := func(source Source, candidate Candidate, reason string) Result {
		return Result{APIVersion: "platform.installer/artifact-source/v1alpha1", Kind: "ResolvedArtifactSource", Requirement: requirement, TargetNode: targetNode, Source: source, Version: candidate.Version, ArtifactRef: candidate.ID, Artifacts: candidate.Artifacts, Reason: reason}
	}
	if candidate, ok, err := repository.FindCompatible(requirement); err != nil {
		if candidate, bundleOK, bundleErr := bundle.FindCompatible(requirement); bundleErr != nil {
			return Result{}, bundleErr
		} else if bundleOK {
			return base(OfflineBundle, candidate, "REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE"), nil
		}
		return base(Blocked, Candidate{}, "REPOSITORY_UNAVAILABLE"), err
	} else if ok && compatible(requirement, candidate) {
		return base(Repository, candidate, "REPOSITORY_COMPATIBLE"), nil
	}
	if candidate, ok, err := bundle.FindCompatible(requirement); err != nil {
		return Result{}, err
	} else if ok && compatible(requirement, candidate) {
		return base(OfflineBundle, candidate, "BUNDLE_COMPATIBLE"), nil
	}
	return base(Blocked, Candidate{}, "BUNDLE_MISSING_OR_INCOMPATIBLE"), nil
}

func compatible(requirement Requirement, candidate Candidate) bool {
	if candidate.Name != requirement.Name || candidate.OS != requirement.OS || candidate.Architecture != requirement.Architecture {
		return false
	}
	return versionMatches(requirement.Version, candidate.Version)
}

func versionMatches(required, actual string) bool {
	if required == "" {
		return true
	}
	requiredParts, actualParts := strings.Split(required, "."), strings.Split(actual, ".")
	if len(requiredParts) != len(actualParts) {
		return false
	}
	for i, part := range requiredParts {
		if part != "x" && part != "X" && part != actualParts[i] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

// MaxSnapshotResponseBytes keeps large application projections within the
// existing bounded execution protocol budget.
const MaxSnapshotResponseBytes = 16 * 1024 * 1024

func DecodeSnapshot(data []byte) (*Snapshot, error) {
	if len(data) > MaxSnapshotResponseBytes {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	var snapshot Snapshot
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &snapshot); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := snapshot.validateApplications(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	snapshot.Raw = append(snapshot.Raw[:0], data...)
	return &snapshot, nil
}

var applicationID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)

func (s *Snapshot) validateApplications() error {
	if s.ApplicationLibraries == nil {
		return nil
	}
	a := s.ApplicationLibraries
	invalid := errors.New("APPLICATION_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	if s.APIVersion != "platform.installer/project-snapshot/v2alpha1" || a.APIVersion != "platform.installer/application-libraries/v1alpha1" || (a.Status != "PASS" && a.Status != "BLOCKED") || a.Libraries == nil || len(a.Libraries) > 256 || len(a.Findings) > 1024 {
		return invalid
	}
	for id, library := range a.Libraries {
		if !validApplicationID(id) || library.LibraryRef == "" || len(library.LibraryRef) > 256 || library.Instances == nil || len(library.Instances) > 256 {
			return invalid
		}
		for id, instance := range library.Instances {
			if !validApplicationID(id) || !validApplicationID(instance.ApplicationName) || !validApplicationID(instance.SlotID) || instance.Placements == nil || len(instance.Placements) > 256 || len(instance.RuntimeSecretRequirements) > 256 {
				return invalid
			}
			for host, placement := range instance.Placements {
				if !validApplicationID(host) || placement.ServerID != host || !validApplicationID(placement.RuntimeRef) || placement.Origin.Host != host || placement.Origin.Resolution != "ANSIBLE" || placement.Origin.Precision != "RESOLUTION_SCOPE" {
					return invalid
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validApplicationID(id string) bool { return len(id) <= 128 && applicationID.MatchString(id) }

import (

type boundedBuffer struct {
	buffer    bytes.Buffer
	remaining int
}

func (b *boundedBuffer) Write(content []byte) (int, error) {
	written := len(content)
	if b.remaining > 0 {
		limit := len(content)
		if limit > b.remaining {
			limit = b.remaining
		}
		_, _ = b.buffer.Write(content[:limit])
		b.remaining -= limit
	}
	return written, nil
}

// CommandAdapter invokes the existing target-free UI-BE-02 Ansible entrypoint.
type CommandAdapter struct {
	Executable string
	WorkingDir string
	Playbook   string
	Catalog    string
	Env        []string
	Timeout    time.Duration
}

func (a *CommandAdapter) BuildSnapshot(ctx context.Context, projectRoot string, owned []string) (*Snapshot, error) {
	if a.Executable == "" || a.Playbook == "" || a.Catalog == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("core adapter is not configured")
	}
	timeout := a.Timeout
	if timeout <= 0 {
		timeout = 30 * time.Second
	}
	boundedContext, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, timeout)
	defer cancel()
	temporary, err := os.MkdirTemp("", "platform-installer-core-")
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer os.RemoveAll(temporary)
	response := filepath.Join(temporary, "snapshot.json")
	variables := filepath.Join(temporary, "request.json")
	request := map[string]any{
		"platform_project_root":          projectRoot,
		"platform_service_catalog_path":  a.Catalog,
		"platform_installer_owned_paths": owned,
	}
	encoded, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := os.WriteFile(variables, encoded, 0o600); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	inventory := filepath.Join(projectRoot, "inventory", "hosts.yml")
	command := exec.CommandContext(boundedContext, a.Executable, "-i", inventory, a.Playbook, "-e", "@"+variables)
	command.Dir = a.WorkingDir
	command.Env = append(os.Environ(), a.Env...)
	command.Env = append(command.Env,
		"ANSIBLE_CALLBACKS_ENABLED=platform.core.project_snapshot_json",
		"PLATFORM_PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_OUTPUT="+response,
	)
	var diagnostics boundedBuffer
	diagnostics.remaining = 16384
	command.Stdout = io.Discard
	command.Stderr = &diagnostics
	err = command.Run()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("core snapshot command failed: %w", err)
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(response)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("core snapshot response missing: %w", err)
	}
	var envelope map[string]json.RawMessage
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &envelope); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("core snapshot response invalid: %w", err)
	}
	if _, blocked := envelope["adapterError"]; blocked {
		return nil, errors.New("core snapshot was blocked")
	}
	snapshot, err := DecodeSnapshot(data)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if snapshot.ProjectRevision == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("core snapshot response has no project revision")
	}
	return snapshot, nil
}

// projectSnapshotReader is intentionally narrower than the future editor
// backend: UI-01B can only obtain an authoritative read-only Core projection.
type projectSnapshotReader interface {
	BuildProjectSnapshot(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, map[string]any) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error)
}

type projectReader struct {
	transport      projectSnapshotReader
	node           executionnode.Node
	runtimeRelease map[string]any
}

type verificationSnapshot struct {
	Snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot
	Runtime  executionnode.RuntimeEvidence
	NodeID   string
}

func (r projectReader) BuildVerificationSnapshot(ctx context.Context, root string) (verificationSnapshot, error) {
	transport, ok := r.transport.(interface {
		BuildProjectVerificationSnapshot(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string, map[string]any) (executionnode.ProjectVerificationSnapshot, error)
	})
	if !ok || r.node.ID == "" || len(r.runtimeRelease) == 0 {
		return verificationSnapshot{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED")
	}
	result, err := transport.BuildProjectVerificationSnapshot(ctx, r.node, root, r.runtimeRelease)
	if err != nil {
		return verificationSnapshot{}, err
	}
	if !runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(result.Runtime, r.runtimeRelease) {
		return verificationSnapshot{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_MISMATCH")
	}
	return verificationSnapshot{Snapshot: result.Snapshot, Runtime: result.Runtime, NodeID: r.node.ID}, nil
}

func runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(actual executionnode.RuntimeEvidence, expected map[string]any) bool {
	for key, actualValue := range map[string]string{"bundleDigest": actual.BundleDigest, "coreVersion": actual.CoreVersion, "catalogDigest": actual.CatalogDigest} {
		requested, present := expected[key]
		if !present || requested != actualValue {
			return false
		}
	}
	planningProtocol, ok := expected["planningProtocol"].(string)
	return ok && planningProtocol != "" && actual.Protocol != "" && planningProtocol == actual.Protocol
}

func (r projectReader) BuildSnapshot(ctx context.Context, root string) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error) {
	if r.transport == nil || r.node.ID == "" || len(r.runtimeRelease) == 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_CONFIGURED")
	}
	return r.transport.BuildProjectSnapshot(ctx, r.node, root, r.runtimeRelease)
}

type unavailableProjectReader struct{}

func (unavailableProjectReader) BuildSnapshot(context.Context, string) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error) {
	return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_CONFIGURED")
}

func notVerified() ProjectVerification {
	return ProjectVerification{APIVersion: "platform.installer/project-verification/v1alpha1", Kind: "ProjectVerification", Status: "UNVERIFIED"}
}

func verificationAfterSave(previous ProjectVerification) ProjectVerification {
	if previous.Status != "VERIFIED" && previous.Status != "INVALID" && previous.Status != "STALE" {
		return notVerified()
	}
	return ProjectVerification{
		APIVersion:      "platform.installer/project-verification/v1alpha1",
		Kind:            "ProjectVerification",
		Status:          "STALE",
		ProjectIdentity: previous.ProjectIdentity,
		ProjectRevision: previous.ProjectRevision,
		ExecutionNodeID: previous.ExecutionNodeID,
		Runtime:         previous.Runtime,
		CheckedAt:       previous.CheckedAt,
	}
}

type AppOption func(*App)

func WithApplicationConfig(config appconfig.Config, err error) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) {
		app.config, app.configErr = config, err
		if err == nil {
			app.configErr = appconfig.Validate(config)
		}
	}
}

// WithExplicitExecutionNode supplies only a safe display identity for the
// existing startup-configured Execution Node. It never changes its transport.
func WithExplicitExecutionNode(id, address string) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) {
		if id == "" || address == "" {
			return
		}
		app.execution.external = &executionNodeCandidate{hostID: id, label: id + " · " + address}
	}
}

// WithTrustedExecutionNodeBinding supplies the private, startup-validated
// binding used by the existing read-only project reader. It is deliberately
// not derived from an E4 candidate or Wails input.
func WithTrustedExecutionNodeBinding(binding executionNodeBinding) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) {
		app.binding = &binding
	}
}

func WithAvailableExecutionBundle(root string) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) { app.availableBundleRoot = root }
}

func WithBundleCacheRoot(root string) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) { app.bundleCacheRoot = root }
}

func WithLocalRunRecordRoot(root string) AppOption {
	return func(app *App) { app.localRunRecordRoot = root }
}

type projectLifecycle interface {
	CreateProject(context.Context, projectlifecycle.CreateProjectRequest) (projectlifecycle.Result, error)
	OpenProject(context.Context, string) (projectlifecycle.Result, error)
	ResolveProjectCatalog(context.Context, string) (*projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView, error)
}

func NewApp(reader interface {
	BuildSnapshot(context.Context, string) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error)
}, lifecycle projectLifecycle, options ...AppOption) *App {
	app := &App{reader: reader, lifecycle: lifecycle, projectRevision: installer.ProjectRevision, sessions: installer.NewEditSessionStore(), current: ProjectOpenResult{Status: "NO_PROJECT"}, configErr: errors.New("APPLICATION_CONFIG_NOT_FOUND"), secrets: runtimesecret.NewBroker(), execution: newExecutionNodeContextStore(nil, probeLocalExecutionNodeCandidate()), installationRuns: newInstallationRunRegistry(), approvedTargetHostKeys: map[string]approvedTargetHostKey{}, localRunRecordRoot: defaultLocalRunRecordRoot(), infrastructureVerificationRoot: defaultInfrastructureVerificationRoot(), events: noopEventPublisher{}}
	for _, option := range options {
		option(app)
	}
	app.configureTargetCredentialLease()
	app.configureTargetHostTrust()
	return app
}

func (a *App) GetApplicationConfig() ApplicationConfigResult {
	if a.configErr != nil {
		code := projectErrorCode(a.configErr)
		return ApplicationConfigResult{Status: "ERROR", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
	}
	config := a.config
	return ApplicationConfigResult{Status: "READY", Config: &config}
}

func (a *App) serverTypeDiagnostics(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot) []ApplicationDiagnostic {
	if snapshot == nil || a.configErr != nil {
		return nil
	}
	var diagnostics []ApplicationDiagnostic
	hostIDs := make([]string, 0, len(snapshot.Hosts))
	for hostID := range snapshot.Hosts {
		hostIDs = append(hostIDs, hostID)
	}
	sort.Strings(hostIDs)
	for _, hostID := range hostIDs {
		host := snapshot.Hosts[hostID]
		typeID, _ := host["type"].(string)
		if typeID == "" {
			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, ApplicationDiagnostic{Code: "LEGACY_SERVER_TYPE_MISSING", Severity: "WARNING", HostID: hostID, SafeMessage: "Server type is missing and must be selected before editing this server"})
		} else if !a.config.HasServerType(typeID) {
			diagnostics = append(diagnostics, ApplicationDiagnostic{Code: "UNKNOWN_CONFIGURED_SERVER_TYPE", Severity: "WARNING", HostID: hostID, SafeMessage: "Server type is not present in the current application configuration"})
		}
	}
	return diagnostics
}

func (a *App) managedServerTypeDiagnostics(view *installer.ManagedProjectView) []ApplicationDiagnostic {
	if view == nil || a.configErr != nil {
		return nil
	}
	hosts := managedSnapshotHosts(view)
	return a.serverTypeDiagnostics(&coreadapter.Snapshot{Hosts: hosts})
}

func (a *App) startup(ctx context.Context) { a.ctx = ctx }

func (a *App) shutdown(context.Context) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.secrets.Close()
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	a.clearInstallationRunsLocked()
	a.execution.clear()
	a.continuation = nil
	a.clearProjectExportLocked()
}

func (a *App) ChooseProject() ProjectOpenResult {
	if a.ctx == nil {
		return a.failure("UI_NOT_READY")
	}
	root, err := a.openDirectory(a.ctx, DialogOptions{Title: "Открыть существующий проект"})
	if err != nil {
		return a.failure("PROJECT_SELECTION_FAILED")
	}
	if root == "" {
		return a.CurrentProject()
	}
	return a.OpenProject(root)
}

func (a *App) ChooseProjectParent() string {
	if a.ctx == nil {
		return ""
	}
	root, err := a.openDirectory(a.ctx, DialogOptions{Title: "Выбрать папку для нового проекта"})
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return root
}

// validates or publishes an export destination.

	if a.ctx == nil {
		return ""
	}
	root, err := a.openDirectory(a.ctx, DialogOptions{Title: "Выбрать папку для экспорта проекта"})
	if err != nil {
		return ""
	}
	return root
}

func (a *App) CreateProject(request projectlifecycle.CreateProjectRequest) ProjectOpenResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return a.failure("EDIT_SESSION_ACTIVE")
	}
	a.clearProjectExportLocked()
	if a.lifecycle == nil {
		return a.failure("PROJECT_COMPATIBILITY_SOURCE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	result, err := a.lifecycle.CreateProject(context.Background(), request)
	if err != nil {
		return a.failure(projectErrorCode(err))
	}
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	a.secrets.Clear()
	a.clearInstallationRunsLocked()
	a.current = ProjectOpenResult{Status: "OPEN", Root: result.Root, Classification: result.Classification, Project: result.Project, Counts: result.Counts, Catalog: result.Catalog, Verification: notVerified()}
	a.bindExecutionLocked(result.Root, result.Project, nil)
	return a.current
}

func (a *App) OpenProject(root string) ProjectOpenResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.bundlePreview = nil
	a.orphanRecovery = nil
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return a.failure("EDIT_SESSION_ACTIVE")
	}
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	a.pendingTargetHostKey = nil
	clear(a.approvedTargetHostKeys)
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	a.clearProjectExportLocked()
	if a.lifecycle == nil {
		return a.failure("PROJECT_OPEN_BLOCKED")
	}
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 2; attempt++ {
		r0, revisionErr := a.projectRevision(root)
		if revisionErr != nil {
			return a.failure(projectErrorCode(revisionErr))
		}
		local, err := a.lifecycle.OpenProject(context.Background(), root)
		if err != nil {
			return a.failure(projectErrorCode(err))
		}
		if local.Classification == projectlifecycle.ClassificationEmpty {
			r1, afterErr := a.projectRevision(local.Root)
			if afterErr != nil {
				return a.failure(projectErrorCode(afterErr))
			}
			if r0 != r1 {
				continue
			}
			a.clearCredentialForReplacementLocked(local.Root, local.Project)
			a.current = ProjectOpenResult{Status: "OPEN", Root: local.Root, Classification: local.Classification, Project: local.Project, Counts: local.Counts, Catalog: local.Catalog, Verification: notVerified()}
			a.bindExecutionLocked(local.Root, local.Project, nil)
			return a.current
		}
		if local.Classification == projectlifecycle.ClassificationManaged && local.Project != nil {
			managed, managedErr := installer.ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog(local.Root, local.Catalog)
			if managedErr != nil {
				result := a.failure(projectErrorCode(managedErr))
				if finding := installer.ManagedDocumentFinding(managedErr); finding != nil {
					result.Error.Message += " " + finding.SafeMessage + " Документ / поле: «" + finding.Field + "»."
				}
				return result
			}
			r1, afterErr := a.projectRevision(local.Root)
			if afterErr != nil {
				return a.failure(projectErrorCode(afterErr))
			}
			if r0 != r1 || managed.ProjectRevision != r0 {
				continue
			}
			local.Counts.Servers = len(managed.Servers)
			local.Counts.Deployments = len(managed.Deployments)
			a.clearCredentialForReplacementLocked(local.Root, local.Project)
			a.current = ProjectOpenResult{Status: "OPEN", Root: local.Root, Classification: local.Classification, Project: local.Project,
				Counts: local.Counts, Catalog: local.Catalog, Managed: managed, Verification: notVerified(), Diagnostics: a.managedServerTypeDiagnostics(managed)}
			a.bindExecutionLocked(local.Root, local.Project, managedSnapshotHosts(managed))
			return a.current
		}
		// Existing external-project behavior remains Core-backed and is outside
		// F1's Installer-owned local observation contract.
		return a.openExternalProjectLocked(local)
	}
	return a.failure("PROJECT_CHANGED")
}

func (a *App) openExternalProjectLocked(local projectlifecycle.Result) ProjectOpenResult {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 90*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	snapshot, err := a.reader.BuildSnapshot(ctx, local.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return a.failure(projectErrorCode(err))
	}
	a.clearCredentialForReplacementLocked(local.Root, local.Project)
	a.current = ProjectOpenResult{Status: "OPEN", Root: local.Root, Classification: local.Classification, Project: local.Project, Counts: local.Counts, Snapshot: snapshot, Verification: notVerified(), Diagnostics: a.serverTypeDiagnostics(snapshot)}
	a.bindExecutionLocked(local.Root, local.Project, snapshot.Hosts)
	return a.current
}

func (a *App) CloseProject() ProjectOpenResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.bundlePreview = nil
	a.orphanRecovery = nil
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return a.failure("EDIT_SESSION_ACTIVE")
	}
	a.clearProjectExportLocked()
	a.secrets.Clear()
	a.pendingHostKey = nil
	a.pendingTargetHostKey = nil
	clear(a.approvedTargetHostKeys)
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	a.execution.clear()
	a.continuation = nil
	a.installationGeneration++
	a.installationPlanID = ""
	a.clearInstallationRunsLocked()
	a.current = ProjectOpenResult{Status: "NO_PROJECT"}
	return a.current
}

// VerifyProject validates exactly the current saved revision through the
// existing target-free Core snapshot operation. It never writes project files.
// When E5 has a trusted binding it first performs the permitted read-only
// readiness check; preparation remains a separately confirmed operation.
func (a *App) VerifyProject() ProjectVerification {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root == "" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return ProjectVerification{APIVersion: "platform.installer/project-verification/v1alpha1", Kind: "ProjectVerification", Status: "UNVERIFIED",
			Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: "PROJECT_NOT_OPEN", Message: projectErrorMessage("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")}}
	}
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(err, "")
	}
	if a.binding != nil {
		binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
		if err != nil {
			return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(err, revision)
		}
		// Readiness belongs to Check/PrepareExecutionNode. Keep identity and
		// runtime binding checks, but do not repeat inspection for a ready node.
		return a.verifyProjectWithBindingLocked(binding, revision, a.execution.context.Status != "READY")
	}
	return a.verifyProjectWithReaderLocked(a.reader, revision, nil)
}

func (a *App) verifyProjectWithBindingLocked(binding *executionNodeBinding, revision string, inspect bool) ProjectVerification {
	if inspect {
		ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(90 * time.Second)
		defer cancel()
		inspection, err := binding.service.InspectExecutionNode(ctx, binding.node)
		if err != nil {
			a.execution.setStatus(string(executionnode.Unreachable))
			return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(err, revision)
		}
		if err := a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding); err != nil {
			return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(err, revision)
		}
		a.execution.setStatus(string(inspection.State))
		if inspection.State != executionnode.Ready {
			return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED"), revision)
		}
	}
	return a.verifyProjectWithReaderLocked(binding.reader, revision, binding)
}

const projectCoreResolutionTimeout = 5 * time.Minute

func (a *App) verifyProjectWithReaderLocked(reader interface {
	BuildSnapshot(context.Context, string) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error)
}, revision string, binding *executionNodeBinding) ProjectVerification {
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(projectCoreResolutionTimeout)
	defer cancel()
	verificationReader, ok := reader.(interface {
		BuildVerificationSnapshot(context.Context, string) (verificationSnapshot, error)
	})
	if !ok {
		return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED"), revision)
	}
	verifiedSnapshot, err := verificationReader.BuildVerificationSnapshot(ctx, a.current.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(err, revision)
	}
	after, err := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(err, revision)
	}
	evidence := ProjectVerification{APIVersion: "platform.installer/project-verification/v1alpha1", Kind: "ProjectVerification",
		ProjectIdentity: a.current.Project.ID, ProjectRevision: revision, ExecutionNodeID: verifiedSnapshot.NodeID,
		Runtime: &verifiedSnapshot.Runtime, CheckedAt: time.Now().UTC()}
	evidence.Findings, evidence.FindingsTruncated = safeVerificationFindings(verifiedSnapshot.Snapshot.Findings)
	if after != revision || verifiedSnapshot.Snapshot.ProjectRevision != revision {
		return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(errors.New("PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED"), revision)
	}
	if binding != nil {
		if err := a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding); err != nil {
			return a.setVerificationUnavailableLocked(err, revision)
		}
	}
	if verifiedSnapshot.Snapshot.Status == "PASS" && !verifiedSnapshot.Snapshot.Partial {
		evidence.Status = "VERIFIED"
		a.current.Snapshot = verifiedSnapshot.Snapshot
	} else {
		evidence.Status = "INVALID"
		a.current.Snapshot = verifiedSnapshot.Snapshot
	}
	a.current.Verification = evidence
	// Return the proof and its exact projection in one response. The cached
	// verification metadata does not retain a second copy of the snapshot.
	response := evidence
	current := a.current
	response.Current = &current
	return response
}

func (a *App) setVerificationUnavailableLocked(err error, revision string) ProjectVerification {
	code := safeVerificationErrorCode(err)
	if code == "EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_CONFIGURED" || code == "EXECUTION_NODE_UNAVAILABLE" {
		code = "EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED"
	}
	evidence := ProjectVerification{APIVersion: "platform.installer/project-verification/v1alpha1", Kind: "ProjectVerification", Status: "UNVERIFIED",
		ProjectRevision: revision, CheckedAt: time.Now().UTC(), Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
	var executionError *executionnode.ExecutionError
	if code == "PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_INPUT_INVALID" && errors.As(err, &executionError) {
		var findings []map[string]any
		for _, finding := range executionError.Findings {
			if finding.Code == code {
				findings = append(findings, map[string]any{"code": finding.Code, "safeMessage": finding.SafeMessage, "status": "BLOCKED"})
			}
		}
		evidence.Findings, evidence.FindingsTruncated = safeVerificationFindings(findings)
	}
	a.current.Verification = evidence
	return evidence
}

var verificationErrorCodePattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Z][A-Z0-9_]{0,95}$`)

// Verify may receive transport/process errors containing paths or command
// output. Only bounded diagnostic identifiers may cross into the UI.
func safeVerificationErrorCode(err error) string {
	if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		return "PROJECT_VERIFY_TIMEOUT"
	}
	if errors.Is(err, context.Canceled) {
		return "PROJECT_VERIFY_CANCELLED"
	}
	var executionError *executionnode.ExecutionError
	if errors.As(err, &executionError) && verificationErrorCodePattern.MatchString(executionError.Code) {
		return executionError.Code
	}
	switch projectErrorCode(err) {
	case "EXECUTION_NODE_NOT_CONFIGURED", "EXECUTION_NODE_UNAVAILABLE", "EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED",
		"EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED", "EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_MISMATCH",
		"EXECUTION_PROTOCOL_RESPONSE_INVALID", "PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED",
		"PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_INPUT_INVALID", "PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID",
		"PROJECT_REVISION_UNAVAILABLE", "EXECUTION_BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE":
		return projectErrorCode(err)
	default:
		return "PROJECT_VERIFY_FAILED"
	}
}

func safeVerificationFindings(findings []map[string]any) ([]VerificationFinding, bool) {
	const maxFindings = 64
	truncated := len(findings) > maxFindings
	if truncated {
		findings = findings[:maxFindings]
	}
	result := make([]VerificationFinding, 0, len(findings))
	for _, raw := range findings {
		code, message := boundedFindingString(raw["code"], 128), boundedFindingString(raw["safeMessage"], 512)
		if code == "" || message == "" {
			continue
		}
		finding := VerificationFinding{Code: code, Summary: projectFindingMessageRU(code, message), Severity: boundedFindingString(raw["status"], 32)}
		if field := boundedFindingString(raw["field"], 256); code != "RUNTIME_SECRET_REFERENCE_REQUIRED" && verificationFindingField.MatchString(field) {
			detail := " Параметр: «" + field + "»."
			if len(finding.Summary)+len(detail) <= 512 {
				finding.Summary += detail
			}
		}
		if code == "RUNTIME_SECRET_REFERENCE_REQUIRED" {
			// Core already identifies the missing setting. Render only its closed
			// public field path; never include configuration values in diagnostics.
			field := boundedFindingString(raw["field"], 256)
			parts := strings.Split(field, ".")
			if len(parts) == 4 && parts[0] == "serviceDeployments" && parts[2] == "configuration" && runtimeSecretDescriptorRequirement.MatchString(parts[1]) && verificationSettingName.MatchString(parts[3]) {
				finding.Summary = "У экземпляра сервиса «" + parts[1] + "» не задан пароль для параметра «" + parts[3] + "». Укажите пароль в разделе «Секреты» и сохраните проект."
				if finding.Severity == "WARNING" {
					finding.Summary = "У экземпляра сервиса «" + parts[1] + "» не задан пароль для параметра «" + parts[3] + "». Укажите пароль в разделе «Секреты» и сохраните проект перед одобрением плана."
				}
			}
		}
		if code == "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PROPERTY_UNKNOWN" {
			if details, ok := raw["safeDetails"].(map[string]any); ok {
				property := boundedFindingString(details["property"], 128)
				deployment := boundedFindingString(details["deploymentId"], 64)
				if verificationSettingName.MatchString(property) && runtimeSecretDescriptorRequirement.MatchString(deployment) {
					finding.Summary = "Неизвестный параметр конфигурации «" + property + "» у сервиса «" + deployment + "»."
				}
			}
		}
		if finding.Severity == "" {
			finding.Severity = "UNKNOWN"
		}
		if subject, ok := raw["subject"].(map[string]any); ok {
			finding.SubjectKind = boundedFindingString(subject["kind"], 64)
			finding.SubjectID = boundedFindingString(subject["id"], 128)
		}
		if remediation, ok := raw["remediation"].(map[string]any); ok {
			finding.HelpRef = boundedFindingString(remediation["helpUri"], 256)
		}
		result = append(result, finding)
	}
	return result, truncated
}

func boundedFindingString(raw any, limit int) string {
	value, ok := raw.(string)
	if !ok || len(value) == 0 || len(value) > limit {
		return ""
	}
	return value
}

// SetSessionCredential captures one target credential for the current project
// in memory only. It does not contact an Execution Node or target host.
func (a *App) SetSessionCredential(input runtimesecret.Input) (runtimesecret.Status, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.startInFlight || (a.installationRuns.hasActiveRun() && a.recoveredRun == nil) || a.secrets.HasAnyRunExecutionIdentityHold() {
		return runtimesecret.Status{}, errors.New("INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	if a.recoveredRunActiveLocked() && input.Username != a.recoveredRun.NodeUser {
		return runtimesecret.Status{}, errors.New("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return runtimesecret.Status{}, err
	}
	status, err := a.secrets.Set(binding, input)
	if err == nil {
		a.pauseRecoveredObservationLocked()
		a.pendingHostKey = nil
		a.invalidateDynamicBindingRuntimeInputsLocked(true)
	}
	return status, err
}

func (a *App) GetSessionCredentialStatus() (runtimesecret.Status, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return runtimesecret.Status{}, err
	}
	return a.secrets.Status(binding), nil
}

// SetPKIStorePassword stores the runtime-only PKI password with project secret
// inputs independently of SSH credentials. The return value is status-only.
func (a *App) SetPKIStorePassword(value string) (runtimesecret.Status, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return runtimesecret.Status{}, err
	}
	return a.secrets.SetPKIStorePassword(binding, value)
}

// GetApplicationRuntimeSecretAvailability reads only presence in the current
// Broker binding. Unlike descriptor discovery it never clears or promotes values.
func (a *App) GetApplicationRuntimeSecretAvailability() RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	unavailable := RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE"}
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	evidence := a.runtimeSecretEvidence
	if err != nil || evidence == nil || a.binding == nil || evidence.projectID != binding.ID || evidence.nodeID != a.execution.context.SelectedHostID || !runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(evidence.runtime, a.binding.reader.runtimeRelease) {
		return unavailable
	}
	revision, err := a.projectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil || revision != evidence.projectRevision {
		return unavailable
	}
	references := make([]string, 0, len(evidence.applicationInputs))
	for _, descriptor := range evidence.applicationInputs {
		references = append(references, descriptor.RequirementRef)
	}
	missing := a.secrets.MissingRequiredSecrets(binding, references, false, true)
	availability := make(map[string]bool, len(references))
	for _, reference := range references {
		availability[reference] = !slices.Contains(missing, reference)
	}
	return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "READY", ProjectRevision: revision, DescriptorSetFingerprint: evidence.fingerprint, ApplicationSecretAvailability: availability}
}

// SetDeploymentRuntimeSecretValues accepts Core-bound values or locally saved
// application sources pending Core attestation. It never persists/returns values.
func (a *App) SetDeploymentRuntimeSecretValues(input RuntimeSecretValuesInput) error {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if input.PendingApplicationInput {
		return a.setPendingApplicationSecretLocked(binding, input)
	}
	if input.ApplicationSourceValues != nil {
		if input.ApplicationLibrary == "" || input.ServiceDeployment != "" || input.ApplicationRequirementRef != "" || input.DescriptorSetFingerprint != "" || len(input.Values) != 0 || a.current.Managed == nil || a.activeSession != "" {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
		}
		revision, err := a.projectRevision(a.current.Root)
		if err != nil || revision != input.ProjectRevision || revision != a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
		}
		library := a.current.Managed.ApplicationLibraries[input.ApplicationLibrary]
		registries, _ := library["registry_credentials"].(map[string]any)
		allowed := map[string]bool{}
		for _, raw := range registries {
			pair, _ := raw.(map[string]any)
			for _, field := range []string{"username", "password"} {
				credential, _ := pair[field].(map[string]any)
				source, _ := credential["source"].(map[string]any)
				if source["kind"] == "runtime_secret_ref" {
					if ref, ok := source["ref"].(string); ok {
						allowed[ref] = true
					}
				}
			}
		}
		for source := range input.ApplicationSourceValues {
			if !allowed[source] || !applicationSecretID.MatchString(source) {
				return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTOR_NOT_FOUND")
			}
		}
		if err := a.secrets.SetPendingApplicationSecretValues(binding, input.ApplicationSourceValues); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if evidence := a.runtimeSecretEvidence; evidence != nil && a.runtimeSecretEvidenceDescriptorsLocked(revision) != nil {
			requirements := []string{}
			for _, item := range evidence.descriptors {
				if item.Purpose == "SERVICE_PASSWORD" {
					requirements = append(requirements, item.RequirementRef)
				}
			}
			for _, item := range evidence.applicationInputs {
				requirements = append(requirements, item.RequirementRef)
			}
			return a.secrets.PromotePendingRuntimeSecretValues(binding, requirements, applicationSecretSourceRequirements(evidence.applicationInputs))
		}
		return nil
	}
	evidence := a.runtimeSecretEvidence
	if evidence == nil || a.binding == nil || a.current.Project == nil || input.ProjectRevision == "" || input.ProjectRevision != evidence.projectRevision || input.DescriptorSetFingerprint == "" || input.DescriptorSetFingerprint != evidence.fingerprint || evidence.projectID != a.current.Project.ID || evidence.nodeID != a.execution.context.SelectedHostID || !runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(evidence.runtime, a.binding.reader.runtimeRelease) {
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
	}
	requirements := make([]string, 0)
	if input.ApplicationLibrary != "" && input.ServiceDeployment != "" {
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	if input.ApplicationRequirementRef != "" {
		if input.ApplicationLibrary == "" || input.ServiceDeployment != "" || len(input.Values) != 1 || input.Values[input.ApplicationRequirementRef] == "" {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
		}
		revision, revisionErr := a.projectRevision(a.current.Root)
		if revisionErr != nil || revision != evidence.projectRevision {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE")
		}
		for _, descriptor := range evidence.applicationInputs {
			if descriptor.RequirementRef == input.ApplicationRequirementRef && descriptor.Purpose == "APPLICATION_SECRET" && slices.Contains(descriptor.ApplicationLibraries, input.ApplicationLibrary) {
				return a.secrets.SetPendingRuntimeSecretValuesForRequirements(binding, []string{descriptor.RequirementRef}, input.Values)
			}
		}
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTOR_NOT_FOUND")
	}
	for _, descriptor := range evidence.descriptors {
		if descriptor.Purpose == "SERVICE_PASSWORD" && descriptor.ServiceDeployment == input.ServiceDeployment {
			requirements = append(requirements, descriptor.RequirementRef)
		}
	}
	if input.ServiceDeployment == "" {
		for _, descriptor := range evidence.applicationInputs {
			if input.ApplicationLibrary != "" && !slices.Contains(descriptor.ApplicationLibraries, input.ApplicationLibrary) {
				continue
			}
			requirements = append(requirements, descriptor.RequirementRef)
		}
		if len(requirements) == 0 {
			return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTOR_NOT_FOUND")
		}
		return a.secrets.SetPendingRuntimeSecretValuesForRequirements(binding, requirements, input.Values)
	}
	if len(requirements) == 0 {
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTOR_NOT_FOUND")
	}
	return a.secrets.SetRuntimeSecretValuesForRequirements(binding, requirements, input.Values)
}

// GetPendingRuntimeSecretDescriptors uses only the exact immutable catalog
// already locked by project.yml plus the saved managed deployment. It neither
// contacts Core nor requires an Execution Node to be READY.
func (a *App) GetPendingRuntimeSecretDescriptors(serviceDeployment string) RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	descriptors, err := a.pendingRuntimeSecretDescriptorsLocked(serviceDeployment)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: projectErrorCode(err), Message: projectErrorMessage(projectErrorCode(err))}}
	}
	installed := false
	if binding, bindingErr := a.credentialBindingLocked(); bindingErr == nil {
		installed = a.serviceSecretsPresent(binding, descriptors)
	}
	return RuntimeSecretDescriptorOperation{Status: "READY", Descriptors: descriptors, SecretsInstalled: installed}
}

func (a *App) serviceSecretsPresent(binding runtimesecret.Binding, descriptors []RuntimeSecretDescriptorView) bool {
	requirements := make([]runtimesecret.RuntimeSecretInput, 0, len(descriptors))
	for _, descriptor := range descriptors {
		requirements = append(requirements, runtimesecret.RuntimeSecretInput{RequirementRef: descriptor.RequirementRef, Purpose: descriptor.Purpose, ServiceDeployment: descriptor.ServiceDeployment})
	}
	return a.secrets.ServiceSecretsPresent(binding, requirements)
}

// SetPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretValues keeps locally catalog-authorized
// service passwords in short-lived process memory. They are never written to
// desired state. A later Core descriptor query must attest the same
// requirements before the Broker can attach them to a target credential.
func (a *App) SetPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretValues(input PendingRuntimeSecretValuesInput) error {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	descriptors, err := a.pendingRuntimeSecretDescriptorsLocked(input.ServiceDeployment)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	requirements := make([]string, 0, len(descriptors))
	for _, descriptor := range descriptors {
		if descriptor.DeploymentBound {
			if len(descriptors) != 1 || descriptor.Purpose != "SERVICE_PASSWORD" || len(input.Values) != 1 || input.Values[descriptor.RequirementRef] == "" {
				return errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_INPUT_INVALID")
			}
			return a.secrets.SetPendingServiceSecretInput(binding, input.ServiceDeployment, descriptor.Purpose, []byte(input.Values[descriptor.RequirementRef]), nil)
		}
		requirements = append(requirements, descriptor.RequirementRef)
	}
	return a.secrets.SetPendingRuntimeSecretValuesForRequirements(binding, requirements, input.Values)
}

// SetSecretOutputEncryptionPassword keeps a confirmed workstation age
// password only in the project-bound in-memory Broker. It is never sent to
// Core or to the Execution Node.
func (a *App) SetSecretOutputEncryptionPassword(input OutputEncryptionPasswordInput) error {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	password, confirm := []byte(input.Password), []byte(input.Confirm)
	defer clear(password)
	defer clear(confirm)
	if len(password) == 0 || len(password) > secretfiles.MaxPasswordBytes || !utf8.Valid(password) || !bytes.Equal(password, confirm) {
		return errors.New("SECRET_OUTPUT_PASSWORD_INVALID")
	}
	return a.secrets.SetOutputEncryptionPassword(binding, password)
}

// ChoosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile imports one trusted typed-secret
// file without returning its path or contents to the Wails/React boundary.
func (a *App) ChoosePendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile(input PendingRuntimeSecretFileInput) (string, error) {
	binding, ctx, err := a.pendingRuntimeSecretFileBinding(input)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	path, err := a.openFile(ctx, DialogOptions{Title: "Выбрать файл секрета", Filters: []DialogFilter{{DisplayName: "Файлы секрета (*.json, *.age)", Pattern: "*.json;*.age"}}})
	if err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_FAILED")
	}
	if path == "" {
		return "CANCELLED", nil
	}
	fileBytes, err := secretfiles.ReadSelectedFile(path, secretfiles.MaxEncryptedBytes)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("SECRET_FILE_INVALID")
	}
	defer clear(fileBytes)
	return a.importPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFileBound(input, fileBytes, binding)
}

func (a *App) importPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFile(input PendingRuntimeSecretFileInput, fileBytes []byte) (string, error) {
	binding, _, err := a.pendingRuntimeSecretFileBinding(input)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return a.importPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFileBound(input, fileBytes, binding)
}

func (a *App) pendingRuntimeSecretFileBinding(input PendingRuntimeSecretFileInput) (runtimesecret.Binding, context.Context, error) {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.ctx == nil {
		return runtimesecret.Binding{}, nil, errors.New("UI_NOT_READY")
	}
	descriptors, err := a.pendingRuntimeSecretDescriptorsLocked(input.ServiceDeployment)
	if err != nil {
		return runtimesecret.Binding{}, nil, err
	}
	allowed := false
	for _, descriptor := range descriptors {
		if descriptor.Purpose == input.Purpose && descriptor.ServiceDeployment == input.ServiceDeployment && (input.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeAdminToken || input.Purpose == secretfiles.PurposeUnsealShares) {
			allowed = true
			break
		}
	}
	binding, bindErr := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if !allowed || bindErr != nil {
		return runtimesecret.Binding{}, nil, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTOR_NOT_FOUND")
	}
	return binding, a.ctx, nil
}

func (a *App) importPendingDeploymentRuntimeSecretFileBound(input PendingRuntimeSecretFileInput, fileBytes []byte, binding runtimesecret.Binding) (string, error) {
	if len(fileBytes) == 0 || len(fileBytes) > secretfiles.MaxEncryptedBytes {
		return "", errors.New("SECRET_FILE_INVALID")
	}
	password := []byte(input.EncryptionPassword)
	defer clear(password)
	parsed, err := secretfiles.ReadVaultInput(input.Purpose, fileBytes, password)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("SECRET_FILE_INVALID")
	}
	defer clear(parsed.Token)
	defer func() {
		for _, share := range parsed.Shares {
			clear(share)
		}
	}()
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	currentBinding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || currentBinding != binding {
		return "", errors.New("PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	currentDescriptors, err := a.pendingRuntimeSecretDescriptorsLocked(input.ServiceDeployment)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	for _, descriptor := range currentDescriptors {
		if descriptor.Purpose == input.Purpose && descriptor.ServiceDeployment == input.ServiceDeployment {
			if err := a.secrets.SetPendingServiceSecretInput(binding, input.ServiceDeployment, input.Purpose, parsed.Token, parsed.Shares); err != nil {
				return "", err
			}
			return "STORED", nil
		}
	}
	return "", errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTOR_STALE")
}
