func RunBrowserLinux(static fs.FS) {
	if sshpassword.Dispatch() {
		return
	}
	address := flag.String("execution-node-address", "", "READY Execution Node address")
	user := flag.String("execution-node-user", "", "Execution Node SSH user")
	identity := flag.String("execution-node-identity", "", "runtime-only SSH identity path")
	knownHosts := flag.String("execution-node-known-hosts", "", "trusted known_hosts path")
	fingerprint := flag.String("execution-node-fingerprint", "", "operator-approved host fingerprint")
	port := flag.Uint("execution-node-port", 22, "Execution Node SSH port")
	bundle := flag.String("execution-bundle", "", "verified local runtime bundle root")
	listenAddress := flag.String("browser-listen", "127.0.0.1:8765", "browser HTTP listener address; dev only, restrict access to the browser workstation and localhost")
	publicHost := flag.String("browser-host", "127.0.0.1:8765", "Host:port used by the browser; must match the browser URL exactly")
	allowInsecureDevHTTP := flag.Bool("browser-allow-insecure-dev-http", false, "explicitly allow remote HTTP for development only; credentials and secret uploads are not protected in transit")
	flag.Parse()
	if !*allowInsecureDevHTTP {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_REMOTE_HTTP_REQUIRES_DEV_OPT_IN\n")
		return
	}
	if !validBrowserAuthority(*publicHost) || !browserListenerMatchesHost(*listenAddress, *publicHost) {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_HOST_CONFIGURATION_INVALID\n")
		return
	}

	events := newBrowserEventHub()
	app, err := newConfiguredApp(LaunchSettings{Address: *address, User: *user, Identity: *identity, KnownHosts: *knownHosts, Fingerprint: *fingerprint, Port: *port, Bundle: *bundle}, newBrowserDialogProvider(), events)
	if err != nil {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_APPLICATION_START_FAILED\n")
		return
	}
	webRoot, err := fs.Sub(static, "frontend/dist")
	if err != nil {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_ASSETS_UNAVAILABLE\n")
		return
	}
	ctx, stop := signal.NotifyContext(context.Background(), os.Interrupt, syscall.SIGTERM)
	defer stop()
	if err := runRemoteBrowserHost(ctx, app, webRoot, events, *listenAddress, *publicHost); err != nil {
		_, _ = os.Stderr.WriteString("BROWSER_HOST_FAILED\n")
	}
}

func browserListenerMatchesHost(listenAddress, publicHost string) bool {
	_, listenPort, listenErr := net.SplitHostPort(listenAddress)
	_, publicPort, publicErr := net.SplitHostPort(publicHost)
	return listenErr == nil && publicErr == nil && listenPort != "0" && listenPort == publicPort
}

func validBrowserAuthority(value string) bool {
	host, portText, err := net.SplitHostPort(value)
	if err != nil || host == "" {
		return false
	}
	port, err := strconv.Atoi(portText)
	if err != nil || port <= 0 || port > 65535 {
		return false
	}
	if net.ParseIP(host) != nil {
		return true
	}
	if len(host) > 253 || host == "localhost." {
		return false
	}
	for _, label := range strings.Split(host, ".") {
		if len(label) == 0 || len(label) > 63 || label[0] == '-' || label[len(label)-1] == '-' {
			return false
		}
		for _, r := range label {
			if !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || r == '-') {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

//go:build browser

package desktop

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"crypto/subtle"
	"encoding/hex"
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"fmt"
	"io"
	"io/fs"
	"net"
	"net/http"
	"os"

	"time"
)

const (
	browserCookieName = "platform-installer-local"
	browserIdleLimit  = 15 * time.Minute
	browserMaxRequest = 4 << 20
	browserMaxCalls   = 32
)

type browserHost struct {
	app            *App
	static         fs.FS
	operations     map[string]browserOperation
	hub            *browserEventHub
	listener       net.Listener
	server         *http.Server
	authority      string
	origin         string
	allowedHosts   map[string]struct{}
	allowedOrigins map[string]struct{}
	bootstrap      [32]byte
	session        [32]byte
	mu             sync.Mutex
	bootstrapped   bool
	leaseID        string
	lastActive     time.Time
	activeCalls    int
	exitPending    bool
	stopping       bool
	localOnly      bool
	ctx            context.Context
	cancel         context.CancelFunc
}

func newBrowserHost(app *App, static fs.FS, hub *browserEventHub) (*browserHost, error) {
	if hub == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("BROWSER_EVENT_CHANNEL_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	host := &browserHost{app: app, static: static, operations: browserOperations(), hub: hub, lastActive: time.Now()}
	if _, err := rand.Read(host.bootstrap[:]); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("BROWSER_BOOTSTRAP_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if _, err := rand.Read(host.session[:]); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("BROWSER_SESSION_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	return host, nil
}

func runBrowserHost(parent context.Context, app *App, static fs.FS, hub *browserEventHub) error {
	return runConfiguredBrowserHost(parent, app, static, hub, "127.0.0.1:0", "", true, true)
}

func runRemoteBrowserHost(parent context.Context, app *App, static fs.FS, hub *browserEventHub, listenAddress, expectedHost string) error {
	if listenAddress == "" || expectedHost == "" {
		return errors.New("BROWSER_LISTENER_CONFIGURATION_INVALID")
	}
	return runConfiguredBrowserHost(parent, app, static, hub, listenAddress, expectedHost, false, false)
}

func runConfiguredBrowserHost(parent context.Context, app *App, static fs.FS, hub *browserEventHub, listenAddress, expectedHost string, localOnly, launchLocalBrowser bool) error {
	host, err := newBrowserHost(app, static, hub)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	host.listener, err = net.Listen("tcp", listenAddress)
	if err != nil {
		return errors.New("BROWSER_LISTENER_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	host.localOnly = localOnly
	if localOnly {
		host.authority = host.listener.Addr().String()
		host.setAuthorities(host.authority, false)
	} else {
		host.authority = expectedHost
		host.setAuthorities(expectedHost, true)
	}
	host.server = &http.Server{Handler: host, ReadHeaderTimeout: 5 * time.Second, IdleTimeout: 90 * time.Second}
	host.ctx, host.cancel = context.WithCancel(parent)
	app.startup(host.ctx)
	serveResult := make(chan error, 1)
	go func() { serveResult <- host.server.Serve(host.listener) }()
	go host.monitor()
	if launchLocalBrowser {
		launchURL := host.origin + "/?mode=browser#bootstrap=" + hex.EncodeToString(host.bootstrap[:])
		if err := openBrowser(launchURL); err != nil {
			host.cancel()
			_ = host.server.Close()
			app.shutdown(context.Background())
			return err
		}
	} else {
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(os.Stdout, "Browser UI: %s\n", host.origin)
	}
	select {
	case <-host.ctx.Done():
	case err := <-serveResult:
		if !errors.Is(err, http.ErrServerClosed) {
			host.cancel()
			app.shutdown(context.Background())
			return errors.New("BROWSER_SERVER_FAILED")
		}
	}
	shutdownCtx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 5*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	_ = host.server.Shutdown(shutdownCtx)
	app.shutdown(context.Background())
	return nil
}

func (h *browserHost) setAuthorities(primary string, includeLocalhost bool) {
	h.origin = "http://" + primary
	h.allowedHosts = map[string]struct{}{primary: {}}
	h.allowedOrigins = map[string]struct{}{h.origin: {}}
	if !includeLocalhost {
		return
	}
	_, port, err := net.SplitHostPort(primary)
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	for _, host := range []string{"localhost", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]"} {
		authority := net.JoinHostPort(strings.Trim(host, "[]"), port)
		h.allowedHosts[authority] = struct{}{}
		h.allowedOrigins["http://"+authority] = struct{}{}
	}
}

func (h *browserHost) monitor() {
	ticker := time.NewTicker(15 * time.Second)
	defer ticker.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-h.ctx.Done():
			return
		case now := <-ticker.C:
			h.mu.Lock()
			shouldExit := (h.exitPending || now.Sub(h.lastActive) >= browserIdleLimit) && h.activeCalls == 0 && !h.stopping
			h.mu.Unlock()
			if !shouldExit || h.hasActiveRun() {
				continue
			}
			h.mu.Lock()
			shouldStop := !h.stopping && h.activeCalls == 0 && (h.exitPending || now.Sub(h.lastActive) >= browserIdleLimit)
			if shouldStop {
				h.stopping = true
			}
			h.mu.Unlock()
			if !shouldStop {
				continue
			}
			if h.hasActiveRun() {
				h.mu.Lock()
				h.stopping = false
				if !h.exitPending {
					h.lastActive = time.Now()
				}
				h.mu.Unlock()
				continue
			}
			h.mu.Lock()
			shouldCancel := h.stopping && h.activeCalls == 0
			if !shouldCancel {
				h.stopping = false
			}
			h.mu.Unlock()
			if !shouldCancel {
				continue
			}
			h.cancel()
			return
		}
	}
}

func (h *browserHost) hasActiveRun() bool {
	h.app.editMu.Lock()
	defer h.app.editMu.Unlock()
	if h.app.startInFlight || h.app.startOutcomeUnknown {
		return true
	}
	if h.app.current.Status != "OPEN" || h.app.current.Project == nil {
		return len(h.app.installationRuns.runIDs()) > 0
	}
	return !h.app.knownRunsTerminalLocked()
}

func (h *browserHost) ServeHTTP(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	w.Header().Set("X-Content-Type-Options", "nosniff")
	w.Header().Set("Referrer-Policy", "no-referrer")
	w.Header().Set("X-Frame-Options", "DENY")
	w.Header().Set("Content-Security-Policy", "default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data:; connect-src 'self'; object-src 'none'; base-uri 'self'; frame-ancestors 'none'")
	if !h.requestAllowed(r) {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/") {
		h.serveAPI(w, r)
		return
	}
	h.serveStatic(w, r)
}

func (h *browserHost) requestAllowed(r *http.Request) bool {
	if _, ok := h.allowedHosts[r.Host]; !ok {
		return false
	}
	if !h.localOnly {
		return true
	}
	host, _, err := net.SplitHostPort(r.RemoteAddr)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	ip := net.ParseIP(host)
	return ip != nil && ip.IsLoopback()
}

func (h *browserHost) serveAPI(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	origin := r.Header.Get("Origin")
	_, originAllowed := h.allowedOrigins[origin]
	if !originAllowed && !(origin == "" && r.Method == http.MethodGet && r.URL.Path == "/api/events" && r.Header.Get("Sec-Fetch-Site") == "same-origin") {
		http.Error(w, "origin rejected", http.StatusForbidden)
		return
	}
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	switch r.URL.Path {
	case "/api/bootstrap":
		if !h.localOnly {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		h.handleBootstrap(w, r)
	case "/api/lease/acquire":
		h.handleLease(w, r)
	case "/api/events":
		h.handleEvents(w, r)
	case "/api/heartbeat":
		h.handleHeartbeat(w, r)
	case "/api/exit":
		h.handleExit(w, r)
	default:
		if strings.HasPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/call/") {
			h.handleCall(w, r)
			return
		}
		http.NotFound(w, r)
	}
}

func (h *browserHost) handleBootstrap(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		Token string `json:"token"`
	}
	if err := decodeBrowserJSON(w, r, &request, 2048); err != nil {
		writeBrowserError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}
	supplied, err := hex.DecodeString(request.Token)
	if err != nil || len(supplied) != len(h.bootstrap) {
		http.Error(w, "bootstrap rejected", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.bootstrapped || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(supplied, h.bootstrap[:]) != 1 {
		http.Error(w, "bootstrap rejected", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	h.bootstrapped = true
	h.lastActive = time.Now()
	http.SetCookie(w, &http.Cookie{Name: browserCookieName, Value: hex.EncodeToString(h.session[:]), Path: "/", HttpOnly: true, SameSite: http.SameSiteStrictMode})
	writeBrowserJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "READY"})
}

func (h *browserHost) handleLease(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.validSession(r) {
		http.Error(w, "session rejected", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return
	}
	var request struct {
		LeaseID string `json:"leaseId"`
	}
	if err := decodeBrowserJSON(w, r, &request, 1024); err != nil || !validBrowserLeaseID(request.LeaseID) {
		writeBrowserError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("BROWSER_LEASE_INVALID"))
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	if h.stopping {
		http.Error(w, "browser host is shutting down", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return
	}
	if h.leaseID != "" && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(h.leaseID), []byte(request.LeaseID)) != 1 {
		http.Error(w, "another browser tab is active", http.StatusConflict)
		return
	}
	h.leaseID = request.LeaseID
	h.lastActive = time.Now()
	writeBrowserJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]string{"status": "ACTIVE"})
}

func validBrowserLeaseID(value string) bool {
	if len(value) < 32 || len(value) > 128 {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value {
		if !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'z' || r >= 'A' && r <= 'Z' || r >= '0' && r <= '9' || r == '-' || r == '_') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (h *browserHost) validSession(r *http.Request) bool {
	if !h.localOnly {
		return true
	}
	cookie, err := r.Cookie(browserCookieName)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	supplied, err := hex.DecodeString(cookie.Value)
	return err == nil && len(supplied) == len(h.session) && subtle.ConstantTimeCompare(supplied, h.session[:]) == 1
}

func (h *browserHost) authorized(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
	return h.authorizeRequest(w, r, false)
}

func (h *browserHost) authorizeCall(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) bool {
	return h.authorizeRequest(w, r, true)
}

func (h *browserHost) authorizeRequest(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, countCall bool) bool {
	if !h.validSession(r) {
		http.Error(w, "session rejected", http.StatusUnauthorized)
		return false
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	if h.stopping {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		http.Error(w, "browser host is shutting down", http.StatusServiceUnavailable)
		return false
	}
	lease := h.leaseID
	if lease == "" || subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(lease), []byte(r.Header.Get("X-Platform-UI-Lease"))) != 1 {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		http.Error(w, "tab lease rejected", http.StatusForbidden)
		return false
	}
	if countCall && h.activeCalls >= browserMaxCalls {
		h.mu.Unlock()
		http.Error(w, "application busy", http.StatusTooManyRequests)
		return false
	}
	h.lastActive = time.Now()
	if countCall {
		h.activeCalls++
	}
	h.mu.Unlock()
	return true
}

func (h *browserHost) finishCall() {
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.activeCalls--
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

func (h *browserHost) handleCall(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.authorizeCall(w, r) {
		return
	}
	defer h.finishCall()
	if r.Header.Get("Content-Type") != "application/json" {
		http.Error(w, "content type rejected", http.StatusUnsupportedMediaType)
		return
	}
	operationName := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/api/call/")
	operation, ok := h.operations[operationName]
	if !ok || strings.Contains(operationName, "/") {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	body, err := io.ReadAll(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, browserMaxRequest))
	if err != nil {
		writeBrowserError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, errors.New("REQUEST_BODY_INVALID"))
		return
	}
	defer clear(body)
	result, err := operation(h.app, body)
	if err != nil {
		writeBrowserError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, err)
		return
	}
	writeBrowserJSON(w, http.StatusOK, map[string]any{"result": result})
}

func (h *browserHost) handleHeartbeat(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.authorized(w, r) {
		return
	}
	w.WriteHeader(http.StatusNoContent)
}

func (h *browserHost) handleExit(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.authorized(w, r) {
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.exitPending = true
	h.mu.Unlock()
	status := "EXITING"
	if h.hasActiveRun() {
		status = "EXIT_AFTER_RUN"
	}
	writeBrowserJSON(w, http.StatusAccepted, map[string]string{"status": status})
}

func (h *browserHost) serveStatic(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet && r.Method != http.MethodHead {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	path := strings.TrimPrefix(r.URL.Path, "/")
	if path == "" || path == "index.html" {
		path = "browser.html"
	}
	if path == "browser.html" {
		data, err := fs.ReadFile(h.static, path)
		if err != nil {
			http.NotFound(w, r)
			return
		}
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/html; charset=utf-8")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		if !h.localOnly {
			data = bytes.Replace(data, []byte(`<script src="/browser-bootstrap.js"></script>`), []byte(`<script src="/browser-mode.js"></script><script src="/browser-bootstrap.js"></script>`), 1)
		}
		_, _ = w.Write(data)
		return
	}
	if path == "browser-mode.js" && !h.localOnly {
		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/javascript; charset=utf-8")
		w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
		_, _ = io.WriteString(w, `window.__PI_BROWSER_REMOTE__ = true;`)
		return
	}
	if !fs.ValidPath(path) {
		http.NotFound(w, r)
		return
	}
	fileServer := http.FileServer(http.FS(h.static))
	cloned := r.Clone(r.Context())
	cloned.URL.Path = "/" + path
	fileServer.ServeHTTP(w, cloned)
}

func (h *browserHost) handleEvents(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
	if r.Method != http.MethodGet {
		http.Error(w, "method rejected", http.StatusMethodNotAllowed)
		return
	}
	if !h.authorized(w, r) {
		return
	}
	flusher, ok := w.(http.Flusher)
	if !ok {
		http.Error(w, "stream unavailable", http.StatusInternalServerError)
		return
	}
	after, _ := strconv.ParseUint(r.Header.Get("Last-Event-ID"), 10, 64)
	backlog, events, remove, gap := h.hub.subscribe(after)
	defer remove()
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "text/event-stream")
	w.Header().Set("Cache-Control", "no-store")
	w.Header().Set("Connection", "keep-alive")
	w.Header().Set("X-Accel-Buffering", "no")
	if gap {
		frame, _ := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"name": installationEventName, "payload": InstallationSubscriptionEvent{ErrorCode: "OBSERVER_HISTORY_GAP"}})
		_, _ = fmt.Fprintf(w, "data: %s\n\n", frame)
	}
	for _, item := range backlog {
		if !writeBrowserSSE(w, item) {
			return
		}
	}
	flusher.Flush()
	heartbeat := time.NewTicker(20 * time.Second)
	defer heartbeat.Stop()
	for {
		select {
		case <-r.Context().Done():
			return
		case item, open := <-events:
			if !open {
				return
			}
			if !writeBrowserSSE(w, item) {
				return
			}
			flusher.Flush()
		case <-heartbeat.C:
			if _, err := io.WriteString(w, ": ping\n\n"); err != nil {
				return
			}
			flusher.Flush()
		}
	}
}

func writeBrowserSSE(w io.Writer, event browserEvent) bool {
	_, err := fmt.Fprintf(w, "id: %d\ndata: %s\n\n", event.ID, event.Data)
	return err == nil
}

func decodeBrowserJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request, target any, limit int64) error {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, limit))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return errors.New("REQUEST_BODY_INVALID")
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF {
		return errors.New("REQUEST_BODY_INVALID")
	}
	return nil
}

func writeBrowserJSON(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, payload any) {
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json; charset=utf-8")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(payload)
}

type browserEvent struct {
	ID   uint64
	Data []byte
}

type browserEventHub struct {
	mu          sync.Mutex
	nextID      uint64
	history     []browserEvent
	subscribers map[uint64]chan browserEvent
	nextSubID   uint64
}

func newBrowserEventHub() *browserEventHub {
	return &browserEventHub{subscribers: map[uint64]chan browserEvent{}}
}

func (h *browserEventHub) Publish(ctx context.Context, name string, payload any) {
	if ctx != nil && ctx.Err() != nil {
		return
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"name": name, "payload": payload})
	if err != nil {
		return
	}
	h.mu.Lock()
	h.nextID++
	event := browserEvent{ID: h.nextID, Data: data}
	h.history = append(h.history, event)
	if len(h.history) > 4096 {
		h.history = append([]browserEvent(nil), h.history[len(h.history)-4096:]...)
	}
	for id, channel := range h.subscribers {
		select {
		case channel <- event:
		default:
			delete(h.subscribers, id)
			close(channel)
		}
	}
	h.mu.Unlock()
}

func (h *browserEventHub) subscribe(after uint64) ([]browserEvent, <-chan browserEvent, func(), bool) {
	h.mu.Lock()
	defer h.mu.Unlock()
	gap := len(h.history) > 0 && after+1 < h.history[0].ID
	backlog := make([]browserEvent, 0, len(h.history))
	for _, event := range h.history {
		if event.ID > after {
			backlog = append(backlog, event)
		}
	}
	h.nextSubID++
	id := h.nextSubID
	channel := make(chan browserEvent, 256)
	h.subscribers[id] = channel
	remove := func() {
		h.mu.Lock()
		if current, ok := h.subscribers[id]; ok {
			delete(h.subscribers, id)
			close(current)
		}
		h.mu.Unlock()
	}
	return backlog, channel, remove, gap
}

package desktop

import (
	"errors"
	"os/exec"
	"syscall"
)

func openBrowser(address string) error {
	command := exec.Command("rundll32.exe", "url.dll,FileProtocolHandler", address)
	command.SysProcAttr = &syscall.SysProcAttr{HideWindow: true}
	if err := command.Start(); err != nil {
		return errors.New("BROWSER_LAUNCH_FAILED")
	}
	_ = command.Process.Release()
	return nil
}

package desktop

import (

type browserOperation func(*App, []byte) (any, error)

func noBrowserArgs[R any](fn func(*App) R) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app), nil
	}
}

func noBrowserArgsError[R any](fn func(*App) (R, error)) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app)
	}
}

func oneBrowserArg[A, R any](fn func(*App, A) R) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var arg A
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &arg); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app, arg), nil
	}
}

func oneBrowserArgError[A, R any](fn func(*App, A) (R, error)) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var arg A
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &arg); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app, arg)
	}
}

func twoBrowserArgs[A, B, R any](fn func(*App, A, B) R) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var first A
		var second B
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &first, &second); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app, first, second), nil
	}
}

func twoBrowserArgsError[A, B, R any](fn func(*App, A, B) (R, error)) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var first A
		var second B
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &first, &second); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return fn(app, first, second)
	}
}

func oneBrowserError[A any](fn func(*App, A) error) browserOperation {
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var arg A
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &arg); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		return struct{}{}, fn(app, arg)
	}
}

func decodeBrowserArgs(body []byte, outputs ...any) error {
	var args []json.RawMessage
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(body))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(&args); err != nil {
		return errors.New("REQUEST_ARGUMENTS_INVALID")
	}
	var trailing any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&trailing); err != io.EOF || len(args) != len(outputs) {
		return errors.New("REQUEST_ARGUMENTS_INVALID")
	}
	for i, raw := range args {
		argDecoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(raw))
		argDecoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
		if err := argDecoder.Decode(outputs[i]); err != nil {
			return errors.New("REQUEST_ARGUMENTS_INVALID")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func browserAmendConfiguration(application bool) browserOperation {
	type args struct {
		SessionID   string
		Index       int
		Expected    installer.EditCommand
		Replacement *installer.EditCommand `json:"replacement"`
	}
	return func(app *App, body []byte) (any, error) {
		var input args
		if err := decodeBrowserArgs(body, &input.SessionID, &input.Index, &input.Expected, &input.Replacement); err != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("REQUEST_ARGUMENTS_INVALID")
		}
		if application {
			return app.AmendApplicationLibraryDraft(input.SessionID, input.Index, input.Expected, input.Replacement), nil
		}
		return app.AmendServiceConfigurationDraft(input.SessionID, input.Index, input.Expected, input.Replacement), nil
	}
}

type browserAPIError struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Message string `json:"message"`
}

func writeBrowserError(w http.ResponseWriter, status int, err error) {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	if code == "" {
		code = "BROWSER_API_REQUEST_FAILED"
	}
	message := projectErrorMessage(code)
	w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
	w.WriteHeader(status)
	_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]browserAPIError{"error": {Code: code, Message: message}})
}

func projectFindingMessageRU(code, message string) string {
	for _, r := range strings.TrimSpace(message) {
		if unicode.IsLetter(r) {
			if unicode.In(r, unicode.Cyrillic) {
				return message // Preserve bounded Russian stage/cause diagnostics.
			}
			break
		}
	}
	if translated, ok := projectFindingMessagesRU[code]; ok {
		if code == "HAPROXY_BACKEND_TLS_IDENTITY_UNRESOLVED" && message == "Backend TLS identity is unavailable" {
			return "Не удалось определить DNS-имя конечной точки целевого сервиса для проверки TLS. Проверьте привязку группы конечных точек."
		}
		return translated
	}
	return "Проверка проекта обнаружила замечание для указанной настройки. Подробное описание этого кода отсутствует в текущей версии Installer."
}

func servicePreviewFailureFinding(err error) executionnode.Finding {
	reasons := map[string]string{
		"SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE":      "Сохранённый проект и готовая привязка узла недоступны для запроса Core.",
		"SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_UNSUPPORTED":      "Runtime не подтвердил поддерживаемую версию capabilities и операцию BuildServiceConfigurationPreview.",
		"SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_INPUT_INVALID":    "Запрос Core-проекции содержит некорректные входные данные.",
		"SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID": "Ответ Core-проекции не соответствует контракту.",
		"SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_STALE":            "Проект, runtime или привязка узла изменились во время получения Core-проекции.",
		"PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_INPUT_INVALID":                 "Core не смог построить снимок входных данных проекта.",
		"PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_FAILED":                        "Core завершил построение снимка проекта с ошибкой.",
		"CORE_OPERATION_FAILED":                          "Операция Core завершилась ошибкой до публикации результата.",
		"PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED":                       "Сохранённая ревизия проекта изменилась.",
		"EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED":         "Ответ Core не содержит подтверждённую идентичность текущего runtime.",
		"EXECUTION_NODE_UNAVAILABLE":                     "Не выполнен SSH-запрос к Execution Node.",
		"BINDING_REQUIRED":                               "Отсутствует действующая привязка Execution Node к текущему сеансу.",
		"SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT":          "Истёк тайм-аут получения Core-проекции.",
	}
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	var executionError *executionnode.ExecutionError
	if errors.As(err, &executionError) {
		code = executionError.Code
	}
	if errors.Is(err, context.DeadlineExceeded) {
		code = "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_TIMEOUT"
	}
	message, known := reasons[code]
	if !known {
		code, message = "SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE", "Не удалось получить Core-проекцию; безопасный код причины не предоставлен."
	}
	if known && executionError != nil {
		for _, finding := range executionError.Findings {
			if finding.Code == code {
				if safe := boundedFindingString(finding.SafeMessage, 512); safe != "" {
					message = safe
					break
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return executionnode.Finding{Code: code, SafeMessage: message}
}

	maxEndpointPreviewEndpoints        = 64
	maxEndpointPreviewProviders        = 64

	maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength = 128
	maxEndpointPreviewFQDNLength       = 253
	maxEndpointPreviewInterfaceLength  = 128

var (
	endpointPreviewIdentifier = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
	endpointPreviewInterface  = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_.:-]+$`)
)

// EndpointPreview is a bounded, presentation-only view of accepted Core
// evidence. It is not desired state and cannot be supplied to Save.
type EndpointPreview struct {
	Status            string                    `json:"status"`
	Endpoints         []EndpointPreviewEndpoint `json:"endpoints,omitempty"`
	Providers         []EndpointPreviewProvider `json:"providers,omitempty"`
	Findings          []VerificationFinding     `json:"findings,omitempty"`
	FindingsTruncated bool                      `json:"findingsTruncated,omitempty"`
	Truncated         bool                      `json:"truncated,omitempty"`
	Error             *ProjectOpenError         `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type EndpointPreviewEndpoint struct {
	DeploymentID string `json:"deploymentId"`
	FQDN         string `json:"fqdn"`
}

type EndpointPreviewProvider struct {
	EndpointGroupID      string                          `json:"endpointGroupId"`
	ProviderDeploymentID string                          `json:"providerDeploymentId"`
	EndpointGroupRef     string                          `json:"endpointGroupRef"`
	VirtualRouterID      int                             `json:"virtualRouterId"`
	VirtualAddresses     []EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress `json:"virtualAddresses"`
}

type EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress struct {
	Address   string `json:"address"`
	Interface string `json:"interface"`
}

// GetEndpointPreview exposes only the small safe endpoint/provider projection
// required by UI-01F5. Core snapshot maps never cross this Wails boundary.
func (a *App) GetEndpointPreview() EndpointPreview {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	return a.endpointPreviewLocked()
}

func (a *App) endpointPreviewLocked() EndpointPreview {
	verification := a.current.Verification
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return endpointPreviewUnavailable("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")
	}
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if verification.Status == "INVALID" {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "INVALID", Findings: append([]VerificationFinding(nil), verification.Findings...), FindingsTruncated: verification.FindingsTruncated}
	}
	if verification.Status == "STALE" {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if verification.Status != "VERIFIED" {
		if verification.Status == "UNVERIFIED" || verification.Status == "" {
			return EndpointPreview{Status: "NOT_VERIFIED"}
		}
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: verification.Error}
	}
	if a.current.Managed == nil || a.current.Snapshot == nil ||
		verification.ProjectIdentity != a.current.Project.ID ||
		verification.ProjectRevision == "" ||
		verification.ProjectRevision != a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision ||
		verification.ProjectRevision != a.current.Snapshot.ProjectRevision ||
		verification.ExecutionNodeID == "" || verification.Runtime == nil {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if a.binding == nil || a.binding.node.ID == "" ||
		a.execution.context.SelectionKind != "EXPLICIT_EXTERNAL" ||
		a.execution.external == nil || a.execution.external.hostID != a.binding.node.ID ||
		verification.ExecutionNodeID != a.binding.node.ID {
		return EndpointPreview{Status: "STALE"}
	}
	if a.current.Snapshot.Status != "PASS" || a.current.Snapshot.Partial {
		return endpointPreviewUnavailable("ENDPOINT_PREVIEW_SNAPSHOT_INVALID")
	}
	preview, err := buildEndpointPreview(a.current.Snapshot)
	if err != nil {
		return endpointPreviewUnavailable("ENDPOINT_PREVIEW_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	return preview
}

func endpointPreviewUnavailable(code string) EndpointPreview {
	return EndpointPreview{Status: "UNAVAILABLE", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: "Не удалось безопасно подготовить read-only представление точек входа."}}
}

func buildEndpointPreview(snapshot *coreadapter.Snapshot) (EndpointPreview, error) {
	if snapshot == nil {
		return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
	}
	endpointRoot, ok := object(snapshot.Endpoints["deployments"])
	if !ok || len(endpointRoot) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems || len(snapshot.ServiceDeployments) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems {
		return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
	}
	integrationRoot, ok := object(snapshot.Integrations["addressProvidersByEndpointGroup"])
	if !ok || len(integrationRoot) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems {
		return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
	}
	preview := EndpointPreview{Status: "CURRENT"}
	endpointIDs := sortedKeys(endpointRoot)
	if len(endpointIDs) > maxEndpointPreviewEndpoints {
		preview.Truncated = true
		endpointIDs = endpointIDs[:maxEndpointPreviewEndpoints]
	}
	for _, deploymentID := range endpointIDs {
		if !validPreviewIdentifier(deploymentID) {
			return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
		}
		record, ok := object(endpointRoot[deploymentID])
		fqdn, valid := requiredString(record, "fqdn", maxEndpointPreviewFQDNLength)
		if !ok || !valid || !validPreviewFQDN(fqdn) {
			return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
		}
		preview.Endpoints = append(preview.Endpoints, EndpointPreviewEndpoint{DeploymentID: deploymentID, FQDN: fqdn})
	}
	for _, groupID := range sortedKeys(integrationRoot) {
		if !validPreviewIdentifier(groupID) {
			return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
		}
		items, ok := array(integrationRoot[groupID])
		if !ok || len(items) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems {
			return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			provider, ok := object(item)
			deploymentID, valid := requiredString(provider, "deploymentId", maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength)
			if !ok || !valid || !validPreviewIdentifier(deploymentID) {
				return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
			}
			deployment, present := snapshot.ServiceDeployments[deploymentID]
			endpointGroupRef, valid := requiredString(deployment, "endpointGroupRef", maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength)
			virtualRouterID, validRouter := previewRouterID(deployment["virtualRouterId"])
			addresses, validAddresses := previewAddresses(provider["virtualAddresses"])
			deploymentAddresses, deploymentAddressesValid := previewAddresses(deployment["virtualAddresses"])
			if !present || !valid || !validPreviewIdentifier(endpointGroupRef) || endpointGroupRef != groupID || !validRouter || !validAddresses || !deploymentAddressesValid || !sameAddresses(addresses, deploymentAddresses) {
				return EndpointPreview{}, errEndpointPreview
			}
			if len(preview.Providers) >= maxEndpointPreviewProviders {
				preview.Truncated = true
				continue
			}
			if len(addresses) > maxEndpointPreviewAddresses {
				preview.Truncated = true
				addresses = addresses[:maxEndpointPreviewAddresses]
			}
			preview.Providers = append(preview.Providers, EndpointPreviewProvider{EndpointGroupID: groupID, ProviderDeploymentID: deploymentID, EndpointGroupRef: endpointGroupRef, VirtualRouterID: virtualRouterID, VirtualAddresses: addresses})
		}
	}
	sort.Slice(preview.Providers, func(i, j int) bool {
		if preview.Providers[i].EndpointGroupID == preview.Providers[j].EndpointGroupID {
			return preview.Providers[i].ProviderDeploymentID < preview.Providers[j].ProviderDeploymentID
		}
		return preview.Providers[i].EndpointGroupID < preview.Providers[j].EndpointGroupID
	})
	return preview, nil
}

var errEndpointPreview = &endpointPreviewError{}

type endpointPreviewError struct{}

func (*endpointPreviewError) Error() string { return "endpoint preview invalid" }

func object(value any) (map[string]any, bool) {
	result, ok := value.(map[string]any)
	return result, ok
}
func array(value any) ([]any, bool) { result, ok := value.([]any); return result, ok }
func sortedKeys(values map[string]any) []string {
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for key := range values {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	return keys
}
func requiredString(values map[string]any, key string, limit int) (string, bool) {
	value, ok := values[key].(string)
	return value, ok && value != "" && len(value) <= limit
}
func validPreviewIdentifier(value string) bool {
	return len(value) <= maxEndpointPreviewIdentifierLength && endpointPreviewIdentifier.MatchString(value)
}
func validPreviewFQDN(value string) bool {
	return len(value) <= maxEndpointPreviewFQDNLength && strings.Contains(value, ".") && !strings.HasPrefix(value, ".") && !strings.HasSuffix(value, ".")
}
func previewRouterID(value any) (int, bool) {
	switch item := value.(type) {
	case float64:
		if item == float64(int(item)) && item >= 1 && item <= 255 {
			return int(item), true
		}
	case int:
		if item >= 1 && item <= 255 {
			return item, true
		}
	case int64:
		if item >= 1 && item <= 255 {
			return int(item), true
		}
	}
	return 0, false
}
func previewAddresses(value any) ([]EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress, bool) {
	items, ok := array(value)
	if !ok || len(items) > maxEndpointPreviewSourceItems {
		return nil, false
	}
	result := make([]EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress, 0, len(items))
	for _, item := range items {
		object, ok := object(item)
		address, addressOK := requiredString(object, "address", 45)
		iface, interfaceOK := requiredString(object, "interface", maxEndpointPreviewInterfaceLength)
		ip := net.ParseIP(address)
		if !ok || !addressOK || !interfaceOK || ip == nil || ip.To4() == nil || !endpointPreviewInterface.MatchString(iface) {
			return nil, false
		}
		result = append(result, EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress{Address: address, Interface: iface})
	}
	return result, true
}
func sameAddresses(left, right []EndpointPreviewVirtualAddress) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left {
		if left[index] != right[index] {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

package desktop

import (
	"crypto/sha256"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"strings"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"

	"golang.org/x/sys/windows"
)

var bindingConvertSD = syscall.NewLazyDLL("advapi32.dll").NewProc("ConvertStringSecurityDescriptorToSecurityDescriptorW")
var bindingSetFileSecurity = syscall.NewLazyDLL("advapi32.dll").NewProc("SetFileSecurityW")

const bindingProtectedDACL = 0x80000004

func hardenBindingPath(file *os.File) error {
	token, err := syscall.OpenCurrentProcessToken()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer token.Close()
	user, err := token.GetTokenUser()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sid, err := user.User.Sid.String()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	sddl, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString("D:P(A;;FA;;;" + sid + ")(A;;FA;;;SY)(A;;FA;;;BA)")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var descriptor uintptr
	var size uint32
	result, _, callErr := bindingConvertSD.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(sddl)), 1, uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&descriptor)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(&size)))
	if result == 0 || descriptor == 0 {
		return callErr
	}
	defer syscall.LocalFree(syscall.Handle(descriptor))
	path, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(file.Name())
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, callErr = bindingSetFileSecurity.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(path)), bindingProtectedDACL, descriptor)
	if result == 0 {
		return callErr
	}
	opened, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	linked, err := os.Lstat(file.Name())
	if err != nil || !os.SameFile(opened, linked) || linked.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	return nil
}

// holdVerifiedBindingFile locks every pathname component against rename and
// the exact opened file against write/delete for the lifetime of ssh/scp.
// This narrow guard is only for the V02 Windows UI transport.
func holdVerifiedBindingFile(path string, identity os.FileInfo, digest [sha256.Size]byte, maxBytes int64) (func(), error) {
	if !filepath.IsAbs(path) || identity == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	clean := filepath.Clean(path)
	volume := filepath.VolumeName(clean)
	if volume == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	current := volume + string(filepath.Separator)
	relative := strings.TrimPrefix(clean, current)
	if relative == clean || relative == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	var held []*os.File
	closeHeld := func() {
		for i := len(held) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
			_ = held[i].Close()
		}
	}
	parts := strings.Split(relative, string(filepath.Separator))
	for i := 0; i < len(parts); i++ {
		if i != 0 {
			current = filepath.Join(current, parts[i-1])
		}
		directory, err := openBindingComponent(current, true)
		if err != nil {
			closeHeld()
			return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
		}
		held = append(held, directory)
	}
	file, err := openBindingComponent(clean, false)
	if err != nil {
		closeHeld()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	held = append(held, file)
	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || !os.SameFile(info, identity) || info.Size() < 1 || info.Size() > maxBytes {
		closeHeld()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	bytes, err := io.ReadAll(io.LimitReader(file, maxBytes+1))
	if err != nil || int64(len(bytes)) != info.Size() || sha256.Sum256(bytes) != digest {
		closeHeld()
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	return closeHeld, nil
}

func openBindingComponent(path string, directory bool) (*os.File, error) {
	pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	access := uint32(windows.GENERIC_READ)
	flags := uint32(windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT)
	share := uint32(windows.FILE_SHARE_READ)
	if directory {
		access = windows.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES
		flags |= windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS
		share |= windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE
	}
	handle, err := windows.CreateFile(pointer, access, share, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, flags, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	var info windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(handle, &info) != nil || info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 || (info.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_DIRECTORY != 0) != directory {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_INVALID")
	}
	return os.NewFile(uintptr(handle), "binding-component"), nil
}

// Delete by the opened object, never by a pathname observed earlier. If a
// lease or an unrelated process still holds either object, retain it safely.
func removeSessionKnownHosts(filePath string, fileInfo os.FileInfo, directory string, directoryInfo os.FileInfo) {
	if fileInfo == nil || directoryInfo == nil || filepath.Dir(filePath) != directory {
		return
	}
	if !markBindingObjectDeleted(filePath, fileInfo, false) {
		return
	}
	_ = markBindingObjectDeleted(directory, directoryInfo, true)
}

func removeSessionDirectory(path string, info os.FileInfo) {
	if info != nil {
		_ = markBindingObjectDeleted(path, info, true)
	}
}

func markBindingObjectDeleted(path string, original os.FileInfo, directory bool) bool {
	pointer, err := windows.UTF16PtrFromString(path)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	flags := uint32(windows.FILE_FLAG_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT)
	if directory {
		flags |= windows.FILE_FLAG_BACKUP_SEMANTICS
	}
	handle, err := windows.CreateFile(pointer, windows.DELETE|windows.FILE_READ_ATTRIBUTES, windows.FILE_SHARE_READ|windows.FILE_SHARE_WRITE|windows.FILE_SHARE_DELETE, nil, windows.OPEN_EXISTING, flags, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(handle), "session-host-key-cleanup")
	if file == nil {
		_ = windows.CloseHandle(handle)
		return false
	}
	defer file.Close()
	info, err := file.Stat()
	if err != nil || !os.SameFile(info, original) || info.IsDir() != directory {
		return false
	}
	var attributes windows.ByHandleFileInformation
	if windows.GetFileInformationByHandle(handle, &attributes) != nil || attributes.FileAttributes&windows.FILE_ATTRIBUTE_REPARSE_POINT != 0 {
		return false
	}
	deleteFlag := []byte{1}
	return windows.SetFileInformationByHandle(handle, windows.FileDispositionInfo, &deleteFlag[0], uint32(len(deleteFlag))) == nil
}

package desktop

import (
	"errors"

const (
	executionNodeNotConfigured = "NOT_CONFIGURED"
	executionNodeNotPrepared   = "NOT_PREPARED"

var errExecutionNodeSelectionInvalid = errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_SELECTION_INVALID")

// probeLocalExecutionNodeCandidate is intentionally fail-closed. Platform
// Installer currently ships no local Execution Node adapter, therefore no
// Linux host is offered merely because it looks compatible. When such an
// adapter is implemented, this fixed seam is the only place that may turn the
// bounded local OS/architecture observations into a selectable candidate.
func probeLocalExecutionNodeCandidate() *executionNodeCandidate {
	if runtime.GOOS != "linux" || runtime.GOARCH != "amd64" {
		return nil
	}
	content, err := os.ReadFile("/etc/os-release")
	if err != nil || !supportedLocalExecutionNodeOS(string(content)) {
		return nil
	}
	// No supported local adapter is implemented in this release.
	return nil
}

func supportedLocalExecutionNodeOS(content string) bool {
	for _, line := range strings.Split(content, "\n") {
		if strings.HasPrefix(line, "ID=") && strings.Trim(strings.TrimPrefix(line, "ID="), "\"") == "redos" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// ExecutionNodeContext is safe, application-only selection state. It is never
// a portable-project field and deliberately cannot represent READY.
type ExecutionNodeContext struct {
	Status          string `json:"status"`
	SelectionKind   string `json:"selectionKind"`
	SelectionSource string `json:"selectionSource"`
	SelectedHostID  string `json:"selectedHostId,omitempty"`
	RuntimeDigest   string `json:"runtimeDigest,omitempty"`
	SafeLabel       string `json:"safeLabel,omitempty"`
	Locked          bool   `json:"locked"`
}

type executionNodeCandidate struct {
	hostID string
	label  string
}

type executionNodeContextStore struct {
	root, projectID string
	external        *executionNodeCandidate
	local           *executionNodeCandidate
	candidates      map[string]executionNodeCandidate
	context         ExecutionNodeContext
}

func newExecutionNodeContextStore(external, local *executionNodeCandidate) *executionNodeContextStore {
	return &executionNodeContextStore{external: external, local: local, candidates: map[string]executionNodeCandidate{}, context: emptyExecutionNodeContext()}
}

func emptyExecutionNodeContext() ExecutionNodeContext {
	return ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotConfigured, SelectionKind: "NONE", SelectionSource: "NONE"}
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) bind(root, projectID string, hosts map[string]map[string]any) {
	s.root, s.projectID = root, projectID
	s.replaceSnapshotHosts(hosts)
	s.context = emptyExecutionNodeContext()
	s.selectInitial()
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) clear() {
	s.root, s.projectID = "", ""
	s.candidates = map[string]executionNodeCandidate{}
	s.context = emptyExecutionNodeContext()
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) setStatus(status string) {
	if status == "" || s.context.SelectionKind == "NONE" {
		return
	}
	s.context.Status = status
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) replaceSnapshotHosts(hosts map[string]map[string]any) {
	s.candidates = map[string]executionNodeCandidate{}
	for hostID, host := range hosts {
		if candidate, ok := candidateFromHost(hostID, host); ok {
			s.candidates[hostID] = candidate
		}
	}
}

func candidateFromHost(hostID string, host map[string]any) (executionNodeCandidate, bool) {
	address, _ := host["ansibleHost"].(string)
	if hostID == "" || address == "" {
		return executionNodeCandidate{}, false
	}
	return executionNodeCandidate{hostID: hostID, label: hostID + " · " + address}, true
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) applyCommand(commandHostID, operation, address string) {
	if s.root == "" || commandHostID == "" {
		return
	}
	switch operation {
	case "CreateServer":
		if address != "" {
			s.candidates[commandHostID] = executionNodeCandidate{hostID: commandHostID, label: commandHostID + " · " + address}
			if !s.context.Locked && s.context.Status == executionNodeNotConfigured {
				s.selectInitial()
			}
		}
	case "UpdateServer":
		if candidate, ok := s.candidates[commandHostID]; ok && address != "" {
			candidate.label = commandHostID + " · " + address
			s.candidates[commandHostID] = candidate
			if s.context.SelectionKind == "PROJECT_SERVER" && s.context.SelectedHostID == commandHostID {
				s.context.SafeLabel = candidate.label
			}
		}
	case "DeleteServer":
		delete(s.candidates, commandHostID)
		if s.context.SelectionKind == "PROJECT_SERVER" && s.context.SelectedHostID == commandHostID {
			s.context = emptyExecutionNodeContext()
		}
	}
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) discardDraft(hosts map[string]map[string]any) {
	selected := s.context
	s.replaceSnapshotHosts(hosts)
	if selected.SelectionKind == "PROJECT_SERVER" {
		if candidate, ok := s.candidates[selected.SelectedHostID]; ok {
			s.context.SafeLabel = candidate.label
			return
		}
		s.context = emptyExecutionNodeContext()
	}
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) selectInitial() {
	if s.external != nil {
		s.context = ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotPrepared, SelectionKind: "EXPLICIT_EXTERNAL", SelectionSource: "EXPLICIT", SafeLabel: s.external.label, Locked: true}
		return
	}
	if s.local != nil {
		s.context = ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotPrepared, SelectionKind: "LOCAL_LINUX", SelectionSource: "AUTO_LOCAL_LINUX", SafeLabel: s.local.label, Locked: true}
		return
	}
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(s.candidates))
	for hostID := range s.candidates {
		ids = append(ids, hostID)
	}
	if len(ids) == 0 {
		return
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)
	candidate := s.candidates[ids[0]]
	s.context = ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotPrepared, SelectionKind: "PROJECT_SERVER", SelectionSource: "AUTO_FIRST_ELIGIBLE", SelectedHostID: candidate.hostID, SafeLabel: candidate.label, Locked: true}
}

func (s *executionNodeContextStore) selectProjectServer(hostID string) error {
	candidate, ok := s.candidates[hostID]
	if !ok {
		return errExecutionNodeSelectionInvalid
	}
	s.context = ExecutionNodeContext{Status: executionNodeNotPrepared, SelectionKind: "PROJECT_SERVER", SelectionSource: "EXPLICIT", SelectedHostID: candidate.hostID, SafeLabel: candidate.label, Locked: true}
	return nil
}

// application keeps its trusted binding private; Wails receives only the safe
// result types below.

	InspectExecutionNode(context.Context, executionnode.Node) (executionnode.Inspection, error)
	PlanExecutionNodePreparation(context.Context, executionnode.Node, string) (executionnode.Plan, error)

type executionNodeBinding struct {

	dynamic              bool

}

// ExecutionNodeReadiness contains no connection, host-key, credential, or

type ExecutionNodeReadiness struct {

// ExecutionNodePreparation is a bounded, in-memory confirmation request. Its
// plan is owned and verified by executionnode.Service; the UI may return only
// PlanID to confirm it.
type ExecutionNodePreparation struct {
	Status       string                     `json:"status"`
	PlanID       string                     `json:"planId,omitempty"`
	ExpiresAt    string                     `json:"expiresAt,omitempty"`
	Steps        []ExecutionNodeSafeStep    `json:"steps,omitempty"`
	Findings     []ExecutionNodeSafeFinding `json:"findings,omitempty"`
	Error        *ProjectOpenError          `json:"error,omitempty"`
	Verification *ProjectVerification       `json:"verification,omitempty"`
}

type ExecutionNodeSafeFinding struct {
	Code        string `json:"code"`
	SafeMessage string `json:"safeMessage"`
}

type ExecutionNodeSafeStep struct {
	ID      string `json:"id"`
	Action  string `json:"action"`
	Mutates bool   `json:"mutates"`
}

func safeNodeFindings(findings []executionnode.Finding) []ExecutionNodeSafeFinding {
	const maxFindings = 64
	if len(findings) > maxFindings {
		findings = findings[:maxFindings]
	}
	result := make([]ExecutionNodeSafeFinding, 0, len(findings))
	for _, finding := range findings {
		if finding.Code == "EXECUTION_NODE_ELEVATION_REQUIRED" {
			finding.SafeMessage = "Подключение по SSH выполнено, но права sudo не подтверждены. На странице «Серверы» включите «Требуется пароль sudo», введите пароль и сохраните данные в сеансе. Затем повторите проверку сервера."
		}
		if finding.Code == "" || finding.SafeMessage == "" || len(finding.Code) > 128 || len(finding.SafeMessage) > 512 {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, ExecutionNodeSafeFinding{Code: finding.Code, SafeMessage: finding.SafeMessage})
	}
	return result
}

func safeNodeSteps(steps []executionnode.Step) []ExecutionNodeSafeStep {
	const maxSteps = 16
	if len(steps) > maxSteps {
		steps = steps[:maxSteps]
	}
	result := make([]ExecutionNodeSafeStep, 0, len(steps))
	for _, step := range steps {
		if step.ID == "" || step.Action == "" || len(step.ID) > 128 || len(step.Action) > 128 {
			continue
		}
		result = append(result, ExecutionNodeSafeStep{ID: step.ID, Action: step.Action, Mutates: step.Mutates})
	}
	return result
}

type verificationContinuation struct {
	root, projectID, revision, bindingID, planID, planDigest string
	expiresAt                                                time.Time
}

func (a *App) resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked(scope ...sshpassword.Scope) (*executionNodeBinding, error) {
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked(scope...)
	return a.validateSelectedExecutionBundleLocked(binding, err)
}

func (a *App) validateSelectedExecutionBundleLocked(binding *executionNodeBinding, err error) (*executionNodeBinding, error) {
	if err != nil || binding == nil || binding.bundleRoot == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	if binding.dynamic {
		verified, err := a.verifySelectedBundleLocked()
		if err != nil || verified.Digest != binding.reader.runtimeRelease["bundleDigest"] {
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
	}
	return binding, nil
}

// Prepare's service checks component bytes when it consumes them. Confirm the
// connection and locked manifest here without rereading the payload each time
// the same binding is checked inside the operation.
func (a *App) resolvePreparingExecutionNodeBindingLocked() (*executionNodeBinding, error) {
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || binding == nil {
		return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	if _, ok := binding.service.(*executionnode.Service); !binding.dynamic || !ok {
		return a.validateSelectedExecutionBundleLocked(binding, nil)
	}
	if a.current.Project == nil || binding.bundleRoot == "" || binding.bundleRoot != a.availableBundleRoot {
		return a.validateSelectedExecutionBundleLocked(binding, nil)
	}
	locked := a.current.Project.Source
	if locked.BundleDigest != binding.reader.runtimeRelease["bundleDigest"] || !executionbundle.DeclaresManifestIdentity(binding.bundleRoot, locked.BundleDigest, locked.CatalogDigest) {
		return a.validateSelectedExecutionBundleLocked(binding, nil)
	}
	return binding, nil
}

// Trusted connection is transport authority only. It can inspect a node or
// resolve an already-known run, but cannot authorize Core/plan/Start without
// resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked's runtime release check.
func (a *App) resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked(scope ...sshpassword.Scope) (*executionNodeBinding, error) {
	// Editing blocks operations, but is not evidence that SSH trust or runtime
	// preparation has been lost.
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	return a.resolveSavedExecutionConnectionLocked(scope...)
}

// For local presentation and publication of an already requested saved Core
// preview only. All credential, endpoint and host-key checks remain mandatory.
func (a *App) resolveSavedExecutionConnectionLocked(scope ...sshpassword.Scope) (*executionNodeBinding, error) {
	if a.binding == nil || a.binding.service == nil || a.binding.reader.transport == nil || a.binding.node.ID == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	if a.binding.dynamic {
		id, address, port, err := a.savedExecutionServerLocked()
		if err != nil || id != a.binding.node.ID || address != a.binding.node.Address || port != a.binding.node.Port {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		credentialBinding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
		if err != nil {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		identity, err := a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentity(credentialBinding)
		if len(scope) == 1 {
			identity, err = a.secrets.CurrentExecutionIdentityForOperation(credentialBinding, scope[0].PlanID, scope[0].RunID)
		}
		if err != nil || identity.Generation != a.binding.credentialGeneration || identity.Username != a.binding.node.User {
			if !a.secrets.HasRunExecutionIdentityHold(credentialBinding) {
				a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			}
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		if a.binding.hostKeyPin == nil {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		if a.binding.commandGuard == nil {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		var release func()
		var guardErr error
		if transport, ok := a.binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.OpenSSHTransport); ok && transport.ContextCommandGuard != nil && len(scope) == 1 {
			release, guardErr = transport.ContextCommandGuard(sshpassword.WithScope(context.Background(), scope[0]))
		} else {
			release, guardErr = a.binding.commandGuard()
		}
		if guardErr != nil {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
			return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		release()
		return a.binding, nil
	}
	if a.execution.context.SelectionKind != "EXPLICIT_EXTERNAL" || a.execution.external == nil || a.execution.external.hostID != a.binding.node.ID {
		return nil, errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	return a.binding, nil
}

// A long remote call may outlive its session credential. Never publish its
// result unless the same private binding is still current after the call.
func (a *App) revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding *executionNodeBinding) error {
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	if !binding.dynamic {
		return nil
	}
	current, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || current != binding {
		credentialBinding, credentialErr := a.credentialBindingLocked()
		if a.binding != binding || credentialErr != nil || !a.secrets.HasRunExecutionIdentityHold(credentialBinding) {
			a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
		}
		return errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	return nil
}

func (a *App) revalidateSavedPreviewBindingLocked(binding *executionNodeBinding) error {
	current, err := a.resolveSavedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	current, err = a.validateSelectedExecutionBundleLocked(current, err)
	if err != nil || current != binding {
		return errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	return nil
}

func (a *App) revalidateTrustedConnectionLocked(binding *executionNodeBinding) error {
	if !binding.dynamic {
		return nil
	}
	current, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || current != binding {
		return errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	return nil
}

func readinessFromInspection(binding *executionNodeBinding, label string, inspection executionnode.Inspection) ExecutionNodeReadiness {
	status := string(inspection.State)
	findings := append([]executionnode.Finding(nil), inspection.Findings...)
	if inspection.State == executionnode.Ready {
		expectedDigest, _ := binding.reader.runtimeRelease["bundleDigest"].(string)
		if expectedDigest != "" && inspection.Runtime.BundleDigest != expectedDigest {
			status = string(executionnode.UpdateRequired)
			findings = append(findings, executionnode.Finding{
				Code:        "EXECUTION_NODE_RUNTIME_BUNDLE_MISMATCH",
				SafeMessage: "Активный runtime bundle на узле не совпадает с проверенным bundle проекта; требуется обновление узла.",
			})
		}
	}
	return ExecutionNodeReadiness{Status: status, NodeID: binding.node.ID, SafeLabel: label, CheckedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), Findings: safeNodeFindings(findings)}
}

func (a *App) readinessFailureLocked(err error) ExecutionNodeReadiness {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	return ExecutionNodeReadiness{Status: code, CheckedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

func (a *App) CheckExecutionNode() ExecutionNodeReadiness {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return a.readinessFailureLocked(errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN"))
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return a.readinessFailureLocked(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(90 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	inspection, err := binding.service.InspectExecutionNode(ctx, binding.node)
	if err != nil {
		// A failed operation is not a replacement of SSH identity or trust.
		a.execution.setStatus(string(executionnode.Unreachable))
		return a.readinessFailureLocked(err)
	}
	if err := a.revalidateTrustedConnectionLocked(binding); err != nil {
		return a.readinessFailureLocked(err)
	}
	readiness := readinessFromInspection(binding, a.execution.context.SafeLabel, inspection)
	a.execution.setStatus(readiness.Status)
	return readiness
}

func (a *App) PlanExecutionNodePreparation() ExecutionNodePreparation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Root == "" {
		return preparationFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN"))
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(2 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	plan, err := binding.service.PlanExecutionNodePreparation(ctx, binding.node, binding.bundleRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	if err := a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding); err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	a.execution.setStatus(string(plan.State))
	if plan.State == executionnode.Incompatible || plan.State == executionnode.Broken || plan.State == executionnode.Unreachable || plan.ID == "" || plan.Digest == "" {
		a.continuation = nil
		return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: string(plan.State), Steps: safeNodeSteps(plan.Steps), Findings: safeNodeFindings(plan.Findings)}
	}
	a.continuation = &verificationContinuation{root: a.current.Root, projectID: a.current.Project.ID, revision: revision, bindingID: binding.node.ID, planID: plan.ID, planDigest: plan.Digest, expiresAt: plan.ExpiresAt}
	return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: "CONFIRMATION_REQUIRED", PlanID: plan.ID, ExpiresAt: plan.ExpiresAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), Steps: safeNodeSteps(plan.Steps)}
}

func preparationFailure(err error) ExecutionNodePreparation {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	message := projectErrorMessage(code)
	var diagnostic *executionnode.RuntimePreparationError
	if errors.As(err, &diagnostic) {
		message = diagnostic.Phase + ": " + diagnostic.Finding.SafeMessage + " Код: " + diagnostic.Finding.Code + "."
	}
	return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: message}}
}

// PrepareExecutionNode continues only the exact preparation plan generated for
// the current saved revision and trusted binding. After a successful Prepare it
// performs a fresh inspection and then Verify; no pre-Prepare runtime evidence
// is retained as final verification proof.
func (a *App) PrepareExecutionNode(planID string) ExecutionNodePreparation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	continuation := a.continuation
	a.continuation = nil
	if continuation == nil || continuation.planDigest == "" || planID == "" || planID != continuation.planID || !time.Now().Before(continuation.expiresAt) {
		return preparationFailure(errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_PLAN_INVALID"))
	}
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Root != continuation.root || a.current.Project.ID != continuation.projectID {
		return preparationFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED"))
	}
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil || revision != continuation.revision {
		if err == nil {
			err = errors.New("PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED")
		}
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	binding, err := a.resolvePreparingExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || binding.node.ID != continuation.bindingID {
		if err == nil {
			err = errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	// Bundle transfer and extraction can exceed five minutes for offline images.
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(20 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	result, err := binding.service.Prepare(ctx, binding.node, binding.bundleRoot, continuation.planID)
	if err != nil {
		a.execution.setStatus(executionNodeNotPrepared)
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	if current, err := a.resolvePreparingExecutionNodeBindingLocked(); err != nil || current != binding {
		return preparationFailure(errors.New("BINDING_REQUIRED"))
	}
	a.execution.setStatus(string(result.State))
	if result.State != executionnode.Ready {
		return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: string(result.State), Findings: safeNodeFindings(result.Findings)}
	}
	if result.Activated {
		verification := a.verifyProjectWithBindingLocked(binding, continuation.revision, false)
		return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: "PREPARED", Verification: &verification}
	}
	inspection, err := binding.service.InspectExecutionNode(ctx, binding.node)
	if err != nil {
		a.execution.setStatus(string(executionnode.Unreachable))
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	if err := a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding); err != nil {
		return preparationFailure(err)
	}
	a.execution.setStatus(string(inspection.State))
	if inspection.State != executionnode.Ready {
		return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: string(inspection.State), Findings: safeNodeFindings(inspection.Findings)}
	}
	verification := a.verifyProjectWithBindingLocked(binding, continuation.revision, false)
	return ExecutionNodePreparation{Status: "PREPARED", Verification: &verification}
}
