const maxInstallationPlanFindings = 64

// InstallationPlanOperation is the only UI-02B mutation response. Its plan is
// a bounded projection of a Core-owned PlanRecord, never a portable project
// document or a Start authorization. A run may retain it as display evidence.
type InstallationPlanOperation struct {
	Status string                `json:"status"`
	Plan   *InstallationPlanView `json:"plan,omitempty"`
	Error  *ProjectOpenError     `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

type InstallationPlanRequest struct {
	SkipServiceDeployments   []string                    `json:"skipServiceDeployments"`
	SkipApplicationLibraries []string                    `json:"skipApplicationLibraries"`
	SkipInfrastructureVerify bool                        `json:"skipInfrastructureVerify"`
	ExecutionMode            executionnode.ExecutionMode `json:"executionMode"`
	DeploymentOrder          []string                    `json:"deploymentOrder"`
	ApplicationLibraryOrder  []string                    `json:"applicationLibraryOrder"`
	ApplicationVaultSources  map[string]string           `json:"applicationVaultSources"`
}

type InstallationPlanView struct {
	SkipServiceDeployments                []string                                  `json:"skipServiceDeployments"`
	SkipApplicationLibraries              []string                                  `json:"skipApplicationLibraries"`
	SkipInfrastructureVerify              bool                                      `json:"skipInfrastructureVerify"`
	ExecutionMode                         executionnode.ExecutionMode               `json:"executionMode"`
	InfrastructureVerification            *executionnode.InfrastructureVerification `json:"infrastructureVerification,omitempty"`
	InfrastructureObservedAt              string                                    `json:"infrastructureObservedAt,omitempty"`
	InfrastructureCacheWarning            bool                                      `json:"infrastructureCacheWarning,omitempty"`
	ID                                    string                                    `json:"id"`
	Status                                string                                    `json:"status"`
	ProjectRevision                       string                                    `json:"projectRevision"`
	PlanFingerprint                       string                                    `json:"planFingerprint"`
	ExecutionNodeID                       string                                    `json:"executionNodeId"`
	Runtime                               InstallationRuntimeBinding                `json:"runtime"`
	ExpiresAt                             string                                    `json:"expiresAt"`
	Approved                              bool                                      `json:"approved"`
	Acknowledgements                      []InstallationAcknowledgement             `json:"acknowledgements"`
	Phases                                []InstallationPlanPhase                   `json:"phases"`
	Findings                              []InstallationPlanFinding                 `json:"findings,omitempty"`
	PKIStorePasswordRequired              bool                                      `json:"pkiStorePasswordRequired"`
	SecretOutputEncryptionRequired        bool                                      `json:"secretOutputEncryptionRequired"`
	SecretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresent bool                                      `json:"secretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresent"`
}

type InstallationRuntimeBinding struct {
	BundleDigest  string `json:"bundleDigest"`
	CoreVersion   string `json:"coreVersion"`
	CatalogDigest string `json:"catalogDigest"`
	Protocol      string `json:"protocol"`
}

type InstallationAcknowledgement struct {
	Code    string `json:"code"`
	Summary string `json:"summary"`
}

type InstallationPlanPhase struct {
	ID      string                   `json:"id"`
	Order   int                      `json:"order"`
	Actions []InstallationPlanAction `json:"actions"`
}

type InstallationPlanAction struct {
	ID                string                                 `json:"id"`
	Type              string                                 `json:"type"`
	ServiceDeployment string                                 `json:"serviceDeployment,omitempty"`
	Targets           []string                               `json:"targets"`
	DependsOn         []string                               `json:"dependsOn"`
	Mutating          bool                                   `json:"mutating"`
	Reboot            string                                 `json:"reboot"`
	Summary           string                                 `json:"summary"`
	ProgressSteps     []executionnode.DeploymentProgressStep `json:"progressSteps,omitempty"`
}

type InstallationPlanFinding struct {
	Code        string `json:"code"`
	SafeMessage string `json:"safeMessage"`
}

func (a *App) CreateInstallationPlan(deploymentOrder []string) InstallationPlanOperation {
	return a.createInstallationPlan(InstallationPlanRequest{DeploymentOrder: deploymentOrder})
}

func (a *App) CreateInstallationPlanForMode(request InstallationPlanRequest) InstallationPlanOperation {
	if request.ExecutionMode != executionnode.FullProject && request.ExecutionMode != executionnode.ApplicationLibrariesOnly && request.ExecutionMode != executionnode.InfrastructureVerifyOnly {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_INPUT_INVALID"))
	}
	return a.createInstallationPlan(request)
}

func (a *App) createInstallationPlan(request InstallationPlanRequest) InstallationPlanOperation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root == "" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Project.ID == "" {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN"))
	}
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_CHANGES_UNSAVED"))
	}
	if a.execution.context.Status != "READY" {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED"))
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || binding.plans == nil {
		if err == nil {
			err = errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED")
		}
		return installationPlanFailure(err)
	}
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_REVISION_UNAVAILABLE"))
	}
	// Offline image preparation and target-free Core planning can each take
	// several minutes when a bundle carries large application images.
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(10 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	ctx = executionnode.WithImagePreparationCredentials(ctx, a.imagePreparationCredentialsLocked)
	ctx = executionnode.WithServiceSelection(executionnode.WithApplicationLibrarySelection(ctx, request.SkipApplicationLibraries), request.SkipServiceDeployments)
	var record executionnode.PlanRecord
	if request.ExecutionMode == "" {
		record, err = binding.plans.CreatePlanWithOrder(ctx, binding.node, a.current.Root, binding.reader.runtimeRelease, request.DeploymentOrder)
	} else if request.ApplicationLibraryOrder != nil {
		record, err = binding.plans.CreatePlanForModeWithLibraryOrder(ctx, binding.node, a.current.Root, binding.reader.runtimeRelease, request.DeploymentOrder, request.ApplicationLibraryOrder, request.ExecutionMode, request.ApplicationVaultSources, request.SkipInfrastructureVerify)
	} else {
		record, err = binding.plans.CreatePlanForMode(ctx, binding.node, a.current.Root, binding.reader.runtimeRelease, request.DeploymentOrder, request.ExecutionMode, request.ApplicationVaultSources, request.SkipInfrastructureVerify)
	}
	if err != nil {
		// A rejected plan (for example, a missing registry password) is not
		// evidence that the trusted Execution Node or session inputs changed.
		// Recheck the existing identity/trust guards instead of revoking them
		// for every planning failure and erasing unrelated pending secrets.
		if bindingErr := a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding); bindingErr != nil {
			return installationPlanFailure(bindingErr)
		}
		return installationPlanFailure(err)
	}
	if err := a.revalidateBindingBeforePublicationLocked(binding); err != nil {
		return installationPlanFailure(err)
	}
	if !installationPlanMatches(record, a.current.Project.ID, revision, binding) {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED"))
	}
	a.installationPlanID = record.ID
	view, err := installationPlanView(record, binding)
	if err != nil {
		a.installationPlanID = ""
		return installationPlanFailure(err)
	}
	if record.Plan.InfrastructureVerification != nil {
		observedAt := record.CreatedAt.UTC()
		view.InfrastructureObservedAt = observedAt.Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
		view.InfrastructureCacheWarning = cacheInfrastructurePlan(a.infrastructureVerificationRoot, a.current.Root, binding.node, record.Plan, observedAt) != nil
	}
	view.SecretOutputEncryptionRequired = a.secretOutputEncryptionRequiredLocked()
	view.SecretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresent = a.secretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresentLocked()
	return InstallationPlanOperation{Status: installationPlanStateFor(record), Plan: &view}
}

func (a *App) GetInstallationPlan(planID string) InstallationPlanOperation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	return a.getInstallationPlanLocked(planID)
}

func (a *App) ApproveInstallationPlan(planID string, acknowledgements []string) InstallationPlanOperation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if planID == "" || planID != a.installationPlanID {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("INSTALLATION_PLAN_NOT_FOUND"))
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || binding.plans == nil {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED"))
	}
	record, err := binding.plans.GetPlan(planID)
	if err != nil {
		a.installationPlanID = ""
		return installationPlanFailure(err)
	}
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root == "" || a.current.Project == nil {
		a.installationPlanID = ""
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("PLAN_STALE"))
	}
	revision, revisionErr := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if revisionErr != nil || !installationPlanMatches(record, a.current.Project.ID, revision, binding) {
		a.installationPlanID = ""
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("PLAN_STALE"))
	}
	view, viewErr := installationPlanView(record, binding)
	if viewErr != nil {
		return installationPlanFailure(viewErr)
	}
	view.SecretOutputEncryptionRequired = a.secretOutputEncryptionRequiredLocked()
	view.SecretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresent = a.secretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresentLocked()
	approvalFailure := func(err *ProjectOpenError) InstallationPlanOperation {
		return InstallationPlanOperation{Status: installationPlanStateFor(record), Plan: &view, Error: err}
	}
	if record.Plan.Status == "EXECUTABLE" {
		// Reuse confirmed pins locally; probing SSH remains an explicit server action.
		if _, err := a.approvedTargetKeysForPlanLocked(record.Plan); err != nil {
			code := projectErrorCode(err)
			return approvalFailure(&ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)})
		}
	}
	if a.secretOutputEncryptionRequiredLocked() {
		credentialBinding, bindingErr := a.credentialBindingLocked()
		if bindingErr != nil || !a.secrets.HasOutputEncryptionPassword(credentialBinding) {
			code := "SECRET_OUTPUT_ENCRYPTION_PASSWORD_REQUIRED"
			return approvalFailure(&ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)})
		}
	}
	missing, secretErr := a.missingInstallationSecretsLocked(record.Plan, false)
	if secretErr != nil {
		return approvalFailure(secretErr)
	}
	if len(missing) > 0 {
		return approvalFailure(missingInstallationSecretsError(missing))
	}
	if err := binding.plans.ApprovePlan(planID, append([]string(nil), acknowledgements...)); err != nil {
		code := projectErrorCode(err)
		return approvalFailure(&ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)})
	}
	// editMu still protects this operation's checked project/runtime binding.
	// Return the checked view rather than reading every package asset again.
	record.Approved = true
	view.Approved = true
	return InstallationPlanOperation{Status: installationPlanStateFor(record), Plan: &view}
}

// missingInstallationSecretsLocked uses only the current Core plan and the
// Core-attested descriptor set. Values remain private inside the broker.
func (a *App) missingInstallationSecretsLocked(plan executionnode.DeploymentPlan, attest bool) ([]string, *ProjectOpenError) {
	passwords, requirementErr := installationPlanRuntimeSecretRequirements(plan)
	if requirementErr != nil {
		return nil, requirementErr
	}
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		code := projectErrorCode(err)
		return nil, &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}
	}
	missing := a.secrets.MissingRequiredSecrets(binding, passwords, executionnodePlanRequiresPKIStorePassword(plan), !attest)
	if len(passwords) > 0 && (attest || len(missing) > 0) {
		currentDescriptors := a.runtimeSecretEvidenceDescriptorsLocked(plan.ProjectRevision)
		// Missing opaque references may still have deployment-bound pending
		// values. Let the existing Core descriptor path attest and bind them
		// before reporting absence, even when descriptors were cached earlier.
		if currentDescriptors == nil || len(missing) > 0 {
			descriptors := a.getRuntimeSecretDescriptorsLocked(false)
			if descriptors.Status != "READY" {
				return nil, runtimeSecretDescriptorOperationError(descriptors.Error)
			}
			currentDescriptors = a.runtimeSecretEvidenceDescriptorsLocked(plan.ProjectRevision)
		}
		known := map[string]bool{}
		for _, descriptor := range currentDescriptors {
			known[descriptor.RequirementRef+"\x00"+descriptor.Purpose] = true
		}
		for _, requirement := range plan.RequiredCredentials {
			if executionnode.RuntimeSecretValuePurpose(requirement.Purpose) && !known[requirement.RequirementRef+"\x00"+requirement.Purpose] {
				code := "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_STALE"
				return nil, &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}
			}
		}
	}
	missing = a.secrets.MissingRequiredSecrets(binding, passwords, executionnodePlanRequiresPKIStorePassword(plan), !attest)
	labels := map[string]string{"pki-store-password": "Сертификаты: пароль PKCS#12"}
	for _, descriptor := range a.runtimeSecretEvidenceDescriptorsLocked(plan.ProjectRevision) {
		label := descriptor.DisplayLabel
		if descriptor.ServiceDeployment != "" {
			label = descriptor.ServiceDeployment + ": " + label
		}
		labels[descriptor.RequirementRef] = label
	}
	for i, reference := range missing {
		if label := labels[reference]; label != "" {
			missing[i] = label
		}
	}
	return missing, nil
}

func (a *App) runtimeSecretEvidenceDescriptorsLocked(revision string) []RuntimeSecretDescriptorView {
	if a.runtimeSecretEvidence == nil || a.runtimeSecretEvidence.projectRevision != revision || a.current.Project == nil || a.runtimeSecretEvidence.projectID != a.current.Project.ID || a.binding == nil || a.runtimeSecretEvidence.nodeID != a.binding.node.ID || !runtimeEvidenceMatchesExpected(a.runtimeSecretEvidence.runtime, a.binding.reader.runtimeRelease) {
		return nil
	}
	result := append([]RuntimeSecretDescriptorView(nil), a.runtimeSecretEvidence.descriptors...)
	for _, item := range a.runtimeSecretEvidence.applicationInputs {
		result = append(result, RuntimeSecretDescriptorView{RequirementRef: item.RequirementRef, Purpose: item.Purpose, DisplayLabel: item.DisplayLabel, Hosts: append([]string(nil), item.Hosts...)})
	}
	return result
}

func missingInstallationSecretsError(missing []string) *ProjectOpenError {
	return &ProjectOpenError{Code: "INSTALLATION_SECRETS_MISSING", Message: "Задайте обязательные секреты перед одобрением и запуском плана: " + strings.Join(missing, "; ") + "."}
}

func (a *App) getInstallationPlanLocked(planID string) InstallationPlanOperation {
	if planID == "" || planID != a.installationPlanID {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("INSTALLATION_PLAN_NOT_FOUND"))
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || binding.plans == nil {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED"))
	}
	record, err := binding.plans.GetPlan(planID)
	if err != nil {
		a.installationPlanID = ""
		return installationPlanFailure(err)
	}
	if record.Consumed {
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("PLAN_STALE"))
	}
	revision, revisionErr := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if revisionErr != nil || !installationPlanMatches(record, a.current.Project.ID, revision, binding) {
		a.installationPlanID = ""
		return installationPlanFailure(errors.New("PLAN_STALE"))
	}
	view, err := installationPlanView(record, binding)
	if err != nil {
		return installationPlanFailure(err)
	}
	view.SecretOutputEncryptionRequired = a.secretOutputEncryptionRequiredLocked()
	view.SecretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresent = a.secretOutputEncryptionPasswordPresentLocked()
	return InstallationPlanOperation{Status: installationPlanStateFor(record), Plan: &view}
}

func installationPlanMatches(record executionnode.PlanRecord, projectID, revision string, binding *executionNodeBinding) bool {
	if record.ID == "" || record.ID != record.Plan.ID || record.Plan.ProjectRevision != revision || !sameRuntimeRelease(record.Plan.RuntimeRelease, binding.reader.runtimeRelease) {
		return false
	}
	return record.Plan.Status == "BLOCKED" || record.Plan.ProjectIdentity == projectID
}

func sameRuntimeRelease(left, right map[string]any) bool {
	if len(left) != len(right) {
		return false
	}
	for key, value := range left {
		if right[key] != value {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func installationPlanView(record executionnode.PlanRecord, binding *executionNodeBinding) (InstallationPlanView, error) {
	runtime, ok := installationRuntimeBinding(record.Plan.RuntimeRelease)
	if !ok || record.ID == "" || record.Plan.PlanFingerprint == "" || record.Plan.ProjectRevision == "" {
		return InstallationPlanView{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	mode := record.Plan.ExecutionMode
	if mode == "" {
		mode = executionnode.FullProject
	}
	view := InstallationPlanView{SkipServiceDeployments: append([]string{}, record.Plan.SkipServiceDeployments...), SkipApplicationLibraries: append([]string{}, record.Plan.SkipApplicationLibraries...), SkipInfrastructureVerify: record.Plan.SkipInfrastructureVerify, ExecutionMode: mode, InfrastructureVerification: record.Plan.InfrastructureVerification, ID: record.ID, Status: record.Plan.Status, ProjectRevision: record.Plan.ProjectRevision,
		PlanFingerprint: record.Plan.PlanFingerprint, ExecutionNodeID: binding.node.ID, Runtime: runtime,
		ExpiresAt: record.ExpiresAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339), Approved: record.Approved,
		Acknowledgements: make([]InstallationAcknowledgement, 0, len(record.Plan.AcknowledgementDetails)),
		Phases:           make([]InstallationPlanPhase, 0, len(record.Plan.Phases)), Findings: safeInstallationPlanFindings(record.Plan.Findings),
		PKIStorePasswordRequired: executionnodePlanRequiresPKIStorePassword(record.Plan)}
	if record.Plan.InfrastructureVerification != nil {
		view.InfrastructureObservedAt = record.CreatedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano)
	}
	for _, acknowledgement := range record.Plan.AcknowledgementDetails {
		view.Acknowledgements = append(view.Acknowledgements, InstallationAcknowledgement{Code: acknowledgement.Code, Summary: acknowledgement.Summary})
	}
	for _, phase := range record.Plan.Phases {
		projected := InstallationPlanPhase{ID: phase.ID, Order: phase.Order, Actions: make([]InstallationPlanAction, 0, len(phase.Actions))}
		for _, action := range phase.Actions {
			projected.Actions = append(projected.Actions, InstallationPlanAction{ID: action.ID, Type: action.Type, ServiceDeployment: action.ServiceDeployment,
				Targets: append([]string{}, action.Targets...), DependsOn: append([]string{}, action.DependsOn...), Mutating: action.Mutating, Reboot: action.Reboot, Summary: action.Summary,
				ProgressSteps: append([]executionnode.DeploymentProgressStep(nil), action.ProgressSteps...)})
		}
		view.Phases = append(view.Phases, projected)
	}
	return view, nil
}

func executionnodePlanRequiresPKIStorePassword(plan executionnode.DeploymentPlan) bool {
	for _, requirement := range plan.RequiredCredentials {
		if requirement.RequirementRef == "pki-store-password" && requirement.Purpose == "PKI_STORE_PASSWORD" {
			return true
		}
	}
	return false
}

// installationPlanRuntimeSecretRequirements is intentionally derived from the
// fresh Core plan rather than the UI catalog. It is used only to bind already
// pending runtime-only values at approval and the pre-target Start gate.
func installationPlanRuntimeSecretRequirements(plan executionnode.DeploymentPlan) ([]string, *ProjectOpenError) {
	result := make([]string, 0)
	seen := map[string]struct{}{}
	for _, requirement := range plan.RequiredCredentials {
		if !executionnode.RuntimeSecretValuePurpose(requirement.Purpose) {
			continue
		}
		if !runtimeSecretDescriptorRequirement.MatchString(requirement.RequirementRef) {
			return nil, runtimeSecretDescriptorFailure("PLAN_SECRET_REQUIREMENT_REF_INVALID")
		}
		if _, duplicate := seen[requirement.RequirementRef]; duplicate {
			return nil, runtimeSecretDescriptorFailure("PLAN_SECRET_REQUIREMENT_REF_DUPLICATE")
		}
		seen[requirement.RequirementRef] = struct{}{}
		result = append(result, requirement.RequirementRef)
	}
	sort.Strings(result)
	return result, nil
}

func runtimeSecretDescriptorFailure(diagnosticCode string) *ProjectOpenError {
	code := "RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNAVAILABLE"
	return &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code), DiagnosticCodes: []string{diagnosticCode}}
}

func runtimeSecretDescriptorOperationError(err *ProjectOpenError) *ProjectOpenError {
	if err == nil || err.Code == "" {
		return runtimeSecretDescriptorFailure("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTOR_RESULT_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	return &ProjectOpenError{Code: err.Code, Message: projectErrorMessage(err.Code), DiagnosticCodes: err.DiagnosticCodes}
}

func installationRuntimeBinding(release map[string]any) (InstallationRuntimeBinding, bool) {
	bundleDigest, bundleOK := release["bundleDigest"].(string)
	coreVersion, coreOK := release["coreVersion"].(string)
	catalogDigest, catalogOK := release["catalogDigest"].(string)
	protocol, protocolOK := release["planningProtocol"].(string)
	if !bundleOK || !coreOK || !catalogOK || !protocolOK || !validPlanDigest(bundleDigest) || !validPlanDigest(catalogDigest) || len(coreVersion) == 0 || len(coreVersion) > 128 || len(protocol) == 0 || len(protocol) > 128 {
		return InstallationRuntimeBinding{}, false
	}
	return InstallationRuntimeBinding{BundleDigest: bundleDigest, CoreVersion: coreVersion, CatalogDigest: catalogDigest, Protocol: protocol}, true
}

func validPlanDigest(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != len("sha256:")+64 || len(value) < 8 || value[:7] != "sha256:" {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range value[7:] {
		if (character < '0' || character > '9') && (character < 'a' || character > 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func safeInstallationPlanFindings(findings []executionnode.Finding) []InstallationPlanFinding {
	if len(findings) > maxInstallationPlanFindings {
		findings = findings[:maxInstallationPlanFindings]
	}
	result := make([]InstallationPlanFinding, 0, len(findings))
	for _, finding := range findings {
		if finding.Code == "" || len(finding.Code) > 128 || finding.SafeMessage == "" || len(finding.SafeMessage) > 512 {
			continue
		}
		message := finding.SafeMessage
		if strings.HasPrefix(finding.Code, "ARTIFACT_") {
			message = projectFindingMessageRU(finding.Code, message)
		}
		if strings.HasPrefix(finding.Code, "ARTIFACT_SOURCE_") &&
			safePlanArtifactDetail(finding.ServiceDeployment) && safePlanArtifactDetail(finding.ArtifactName) &&
			(finding.ArtifactVersion == "" || safePlanArtifactDetail(finding.ArtifactVersion)) {
			version := finding.ArtifactVersion
			if version == "" {
				version = "не указана"
			}
			message = fmt.Sprintf("%s Сервис «%s», артефакт «%s», версия «%s».", message, finding.ServiceDeployment, finding.ArtifactName, version)
		}
		result = append(result, InstallationPlanFinding{Code: finding.Code, SafeMessage: message})
	}
	return result
}

func safePlanArtifactDetail(value string) bool {
	return value != "" && len(value) <= 128 && strings.IndexFunc(value, unicode.IsControl) < 0
}

func installationPlanStateFor(record executionnode.PlanRecord) string {
	if record.Plan.Status == "BLOCKED" {
		return "PLAN_BLOCKED"
	}
	if record.Approved {
		return "PLAN_APPROVED"
	}
	return "PLAN_REVIEW"
}

func installationPlanFailure(err error) InstallationPlanOperation {
	code := projectErrorCode(err)
	message := projectErrorMessage(code)
	var executionError *executionnode.ExecutionError
	if errors.As(err, &executionError) {
		for _, finding := range executionError.Findings {
			if finding.Code == code && (strings.HasPrefix(code, "APPLICATION_IMAGE_") || strings.HasPrefix(code, "APPLICATION_ARTIFACT_")) {
				if safe := boundedFindingString(finding.SafeMessage, 2048); safe != "" && !strings.ContainsAny(safe, "\x00\r\n\x1b") {
					message = safe
					break
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return InstallationPlanOperation{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: message, DiagnosticCodes: runtimeSecretDescriptorDiagnosticCodes(err)}}
}

package desktop

import "platform-installer/internal/installer"

const (
	installationStatePrerequisitesRequired = "PREREQUISITES_REQUIRED"
	installationStateReadyToPlan           = "READY_TO_PLAN"
	installationPlanNotCreated             = "NOT_CREATED"
)

// InstallationState is the closed, read-only Wails projection for UI-02A.
// It intentionally contains no plan actions, runtime paths, transport details,
// Core output, or credentials. Future UI-02 slices may add bounded plan/run
// summaries without changing the desired project.
type InstallationState struct {
	APIVersion    string                     `json:"apiVersion"`
	Kind          string                     `json:"kind"`
	Status        string                     `json:"status"`
	Project       *InstallationProjectState  `json:"project,omitempty"`
	ExecutionNode InstallationNodeState      `json:"executionNode"`
	Plan          InstallationPlanState      `json:"plan"`
	Prerequisites []InstallationPrerequisite `json:"prerequisites,omitempty"`
}

type InstallationProjectState struct {
	ID                 string `json:"id"`
	Revision           string `json:"revision"`
	VerificationStatus string `json:"verificationStatus"`
	HasUnsavedChanges  bool   `json:"hasUnsavedChanges"`
}

type InstallationNodeState struct {
	Status    string `json:"status"`
	SafeLabel string `json:"safeLabel,omitempty"`
}

type InstallationPlanState struct {
	Status string `json:"status"`
	PlanID string `json:"planId,omitempty"`
}

type InstallationPrerequisite struct {
	Code        string `json:"code"`
	Destination string `json:"destination"`
	SafeMessage string `json:"safeMessage"`
}

// GetInstallationState performs only a bounded local read of the canonical
// revision. It never calls Core, an Execution Node, or a target host.
func (a *App) GetInstallationState() InstallationState {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.reconcileEditSessionLocked()

	state := InstallationState{
		APIVersion:    "platform.installer/installation-state/v1alpha1",
		Kind:          "InstallationState",
		Status:        installationStatePrerequisitesRequired,
		ExecutionNode: installationNodeState(a.execution.context),
		Plan:          InstallationPlanState{Status: installationPlanNotCreated},
	}
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root == "" || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Project.ID == "" {
		return state.withPrerequisite("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN", "project", "Open or create a project before installation.")
	}

	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil {
		return state.withPrerequisite("PROJECT_REVISION_UNAVAILABLE", "project", "The saved project revision cannot be read safely.")
	}
	state.Project = &InstallationProjectState{
		ID:                 a.current.Project.ID,
		Revision:           revision,
		VerificationStatus: installationVerificationStatus(a.current.Verification.Status),
		HasUnsavedChanges:  a.activeSession != "",
	}
	if a.activeSession != "" {
		if a.installationPlanID != "" {
			state.Plan.Status = "PLAN_STALE_OR_EXPIRED"
		}
		return state.withPrerequisite("PROJECT_CHANGES_UNSAVED", "project", "Save or discard the current changes before creating an installation plan.")
	}
	state.Plan = a.installationPlanStateLocked()
	if a.execution.context.Status != "READY" {
		return state.withPrerequisite("EXECUTION_NODE_READY_REQUIRED", "servers", "A READY Execution Node is required before creating an installation plan.")
	}
	if _, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked(); err != nil {
		return state.withPrerequisite("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED", "servers", "The selected Execution Node has no trusted runtime binding.")
	}
	if state.Plan.Status != installationPlanNotCreated && state.Plan.Status != "PLAN_STALE_OR_EXPIRED" {
		state.Status = state.Plan.Status
		return state
	}
	state.Status = installationStateReadyToPlan
	return state
}

func (a *App) installationPlanStateLocked() InstallationPlanState {
	if a.installationPlanID == "" {
		return InstallationPlanState{Status: installationPlanNotCreated}
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked()
	if err != nil || binding.plans == nil {
		a.installationPlanID = ""
		return InstallationPlanState{Status: "PLAN_STALE_OR_EXPIRED"}
	}
	record, err := binding.plans.GetPlan(a.installationPlanID)
	if err != nil {
		a.installationPlanID = ""
		return InstallationPlanState{Status: "PLAN_STALE_OR_EXPIRED"}
	}
	status := "PLAN_REVIEW"
	if record.Consumed {
		return InstallationPlanState{Status: "PLAN_STALE_OR_EXPIRED"}
	}
	if record.Plan.Status == "BLOCKED" {
		status = "PLAN_BLOCKED"
	} else if record.Approved {
		status = "PLAN_APPROVED"
	}
	return InstallationPlanState{Status: status, PlanID: record.ID}
}

func installationNodeState(context ExecutionNodeContext) InstallationNodeState {
	return InstallationNodeState{Status: context.Status, SafeLabel: context.SafeLabel}
}

func installationVerificationStatus(status string) string {
	switch status {
	case "VERIFIED", "INVALID", "VERIFYING", "STALE", "UNAVAILABLE", "UNVERIFIED":
		return status
	default:
		return "UNVERIFIED"
	}
}

func (state InstallationState) withPrerequisite(code, destination, message string) InstallationState {
	state.Prerequisites = []InstallationPrerequisite{{Code: code, Destination: destination, SafeMessage: message}}
	return state
}

// Separate from last-run: a library run must not erase the prior observation.
// No caller may use this record as execution authorization.
type localInfrastructureVerification struct {
	Version              int                                      `json:"version"`
	ProjectRoot          string                                   `json:"projectRoot"`
	ProjectID            string                                   `json:"projectId"`
	ExecutionNodeBinding string                                   `json:"executionNodeBinding"`
	RuntimeBundleDigest  string                                   `json:"runtimeBundleDigest"`
	ObservedAt           string                                   `json:"observedAt"`
	Verification         executionnode.InfrastructureVerification `json:"verification"`
}

const maxInfrastructureRecordBytes = 128 * 1024

// Cached observations always have UNKNOWN current availability. A fresh Core
// plan is returned separately by the adapter and is the only admission input.
type InfrastructureVerificationView struct {
	Availability string                                    `json:"availability"`
	ObservedAt   string                                    `json:"observedAt,omitempty"`
	Previous     *executionnode.InfrastructureVerification `json:"previous,omitempty"`
}

func infrastructureNodeBinding(node executionnode.Node) string {
	// Account changes cannot change infrastructure state. Host identity can.
	data, _ := json.Marshal([]any{node.ID, node.Address, node.Port, node.HostKey.Fingerprint})
	hash := sha256.Sum256(data)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])
}

func cachedInfrastructureVerification(store, root, projectID string, node executionnode.Node, bundle string) InfrastructureVerificationView {
	view := InfrastructureVerificationView{Availability: "UNKNOWN"}
	r, err := readLocalInfrastructureVerification(store, root, projectID, infrastructureNodeBinding(node), bundle)
	if err == nil && r != nil {
		view.ObservedAt, view.Previous = r.ObservedAt, &r.Verification
	}
	return view
}

func cacheInfrastructurePlan(store, root string, node executionnode.Node, plan executionnode.DeploymentPlan, observedAt time.Time) error {
	canonical, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(root)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	bundle, ok := plan.RuntimeRelease["bundleDigest"].(string)
	if !ok || plan.InfrastructureVerification == nil {
		return errors.New("INFRASTRUCTURE_CACHE_INVALID")
	}
	return writeLocalInfrastructureVerification(store, localInfrastructureVerification{Version: 1, ProjectRoot: canonical, ProjectID: plan.ProjectIdentity, ExecutionNodeBinding: infrastructureNodeBinding(node), RuntimeBundleDigest: bundle, ObservedAt: observedAt.UTC().Format(time.RFC3339Nano), Verification: *plan.InfrastructureVerification})
}

func defaultInfrastructureVerificationRoot() string {
	base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
	if err != nil || base == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return filepath.Join(base, "platform-installer", "infrastructure-verification")
}

func (r localInfrastructureVerification) valid() bool {
	if !strings.HasPrefix(r.RuntimeBundleDigest, "sha256:") || strings.ToLower(r.RuntimeBundleDigest) != r.RuntimeBundleDigest {
		return false
	}
	if _, err := hex.DecodeString(strings.TrimPrefix(r.RuntimeBundleDigest, "sha256:")); err != nil {
		return false
	}
	root, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(r.ProjectRoot)
	if err != nil || root != r.ProjectRoot || r.Version != 1 || r.ProjectID == "" || len(r.ProjectID) > 128 || r.ExecutionNodeBinding == "" || len(r.ExecutionNodeBinding) > 256 || len(r.RuntimeBundleDigest) != 71 || !r.Verification.Validate() {
		return false
	}
	_, err = time.Parse(time.RFC3339, r.ObservedAt)
	return err == nil
}

func writeLocalInfrastructureVerification(store string, record localInfrastructureVerification) error {
	invalid := errors.New("INFRASTRUCTURE_CACHE_INVALID")
	if !record.valid() {
		return invalid
	}
	path, err := localRunRecordPath(store, record.ProjectRoot, record.ProjectID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(record)
	if err != nil || len(data) > maxInfrastructureRecordBytes {
		return invalid
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(store, 0o700); err != nil {
		return errors.New("INFRASTRUCTURE_CACHE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if err := safeLocalRunRecordRoot(store); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil && !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return invalid
	} else if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return invalid
	}
	return writeLocalOperationalRecord(store, path, data)
}

// A missing/corrupt record yields no observation. Availability is UNKNOWN even
// when the prior observation was PASS; refresh requires a new authoritative Build.
func readLocalInfrastructureVerification(store, projectRoot, projectID, nodeBinding, bundleDigest string) (*localInfrastructureVerification, error) {
	invalid := errors.New("INFRASTRUCTURE_CACHE_INVALID")
	path, err := localRunRecordPath(store, projectRoot, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := safeLocalRunRecordRoot(store); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() < 2 || info.Size() > maxInfrastructureRecordBytes {
		return nil, invalid
	}
	data, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || len(data) > maxInfrastructureRecordBytes {
		return nil, invalid
	}
	d := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	d.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var r localInfrastructureVerification
	root, rootErr := canonicalRunProjectRoot(projectRoot)
	if d.Decode(&r) != nil || d.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF || !r.valid() || rootErr != nil || r.ProjectRoot != root || r.ProjectID != projectID || r.ExecutionNodeBinding != nodeBinding || r.RuntimeBundleDigest != bundleDigest {
		return nil, invalid
	}
	return &r, nil
}

// An offline/reopened observation stays UNKNOWN until a fresh Core Build.
func (a *App) GetInfrastructureVerification() InfrastructureVerificationView {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.binding == nil {
		return InfrastructureVerificationView{Availability: "UNKNOWN"}
	}
	bundle, _ := a.binding.reader.runtimeRelease["bundleDigest"].(string)
	return cachedInfrastructureVerification(a.infrastructureVerificationRoot, a.current.Root, a.current.Project.ID, a.binding.node, bundle)
}

import (

const localRunRecordVersion = 1
const maxLocalRunRecordBytes = 1 << 20

// This is operational start evidence, never desired project state. The
// initial PENDING record is durable before a remote Start can be sent.
type localRunRecord struct {
	Version            int    `json:"version"`
	ProjectRoot        string `json:"projectRoot"`
	ProjectID          string `json:"projectId"`
	ProjectRevision    string `json:"projectRevision"`
	PlanID             string `json:"planId"`
	NodeID             string `json:"nodeId"`
	NodeAddress        string `json:"nodeAddress"`
	NodePort           uint16 `json:"nodePort"`
	NodeUser           string `json:"nodeUser"`
	HostKeyFingerprint string `json:"hostKeyFingerprint"`
	State              string `json:"state"` // PENDING, RUNNING, TERMINAL
	RunID              string `json:"runId,omitempty"`
	TerminalState      string `json:"terminalState,omitempty"`
	// Display evidence only; never used to approve, rebuild or start a plan.
	Plan *InstallationPlanView `json:"plan,omitempty"`
}

func defaultLocalRunRecordRoot() string {
	base, err := os.UserConfigDir()
	if err != nil || base == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return filepath.Join(base, "platform-installer", "run-records")
}

func canonicalRunProjectRoot(root string) (string, error) {
	if root == "" {
		return "", errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(root)
	if err != nil {
		return "", errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	absolute = filepath.Clean(absolute)
	if runtime.GOOS == "windows" {
		absolute = strings.ToLower(absolute)
	}
	return absolute, nil
}

func localRunRecordPath(storeRoot, projectRoot, projectID string) (string, error) {
	if storeRoot == "" || projectID == "" {
		return "", errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	canonical, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	hash := sha256.Sum256([]byte(canonical + "\x00" + projectID))
	return filepath.Join(storeRoot, hex.EncodeToString(hash[:])+".json"), nil
}

func validLocalRunID(id string) bool {
	if len(id) <= len("installer-") || len(id) > 128 || !strings.HasPrefix(id, "installer-") {
		return false
	}
	for _, ch := range id[len("installer-"):] {
		if ch < '0' || ch > '9' && (ch < 'a' || ch > 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validLocalRunRecord(record localRunRecord) bool {
	if record.Plan != nil && (record.Plan.ID != record.PlanID || record.Plan.ProjectRevision != record.ProjectRevision || record.Plan.ExecutionNodeID != record.NodeID) {
		return false
	}
	if record.Version != localRunRecordVersion || record.ProjectRoot == "" || record.ProjectID == "" || record.ProjectRevision == "" || record.PlanID == "" || record.NodeID == "" || record.NodeAddress == "" || record.NodePort == 0 || record.NodeUser == "" || !strings.HasPrefix(record.HostKeyFingerprint, "SHA256:") {
		return false
	}
	switch record.State {
	case "PENDING":
		return record.RunID == "" && record.TerminalState == ""
	case "RUNNING":
		return validLocalRunID(record.RunID) && record.TerminalState == ""
	case "TERMINAL":
		return validLocalRunID(record.RunID) && rebindTerminalRun(record.TerminalState)
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func readLocalRunRecord(storeRoot, projectRoot, projectID string) (*localRunRecord, error) {
	path, err := localRunRecordPath(storeRoot, projectRoot, projectID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := safeLocalRunRecordRoot(storeRoot); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil, nil
	}
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() || info.Size() < 2 || info.Size() > maxLocalRunRecordBytes {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil || len(content) > maxLocalRunRecordBytes {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(content))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	var record localRunRecord
	if err := decoder.Decode(&record); err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	canonical, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil || !validLocalRunRecord(record) || record.ProjectRoot != canonical || record.ProjectID != projectID {
		return nil, errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	return &record, nil
}

func writeLocalRunRecord(storeRoot string, record localRunRecord) error {
	if !validLocalRunRecord(record) {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	canonical, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(record.ProjectRoot)
	if err != nil || canonical != record.ProjectRoot {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	path, err := localRunRecordPath(storeRoot, record.ProjectRoot, record.ProjectID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := os.MkdirAll(storeRoot, 0o700); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: %w", err)
	}
	if err := safeLocalRunRecordRoot(storeRoot); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if info, err := os.Lstat(path); err == nil && !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	} else if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(record)
	if err != nil || len(data) > maxLocalRunRecordBytes {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	return writeLocalOperationalRecord(storeRoot, path, data)
}

// Shared atomic publication for bounded operational records. Callers validate
// their closed record and derive the path using localRunRecordPath.
func writeLocalOperationalRecord(storeRoot, path string, data []byte) error {
	temp, err := os.CreateTemp(storeRoot, ".run-record-")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer os.Remove(temp.Name())
	if err := temp.Chmod(0o600); err != nil {
		temp.Close()
		return err
	}
	if _, err := temp.Write(data); err != nil {
		temp.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := temp.Sync(); err != nil {
		temp.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := temp.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := replaceLocalRunRecord(temp.Name(), path); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return syncLocalRunRecordDir(storeRoot)
}

// restoreLocalRunRecordAfterUnsentStart rolls back only the exact PENDING
// reservation written for a Start request that the trusted lifecycle layer
// proves was never dispatched. A prior terminal record is restored verbatim.
func restoreLocalRunRecordAfterUnsentStart(storeRoot string, pending localRunRecord, previous *localRunRecord) error {
	if pending.State != "PENDING" || pending.RunID != "" || !validLocalRunRecord(pending) {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	current, err := readLocalRunRecord(storeRoot, pending.ProjectRoot, pending.ProjectID)
	currentJSON, currentErr := json.Marshal(current)
	pendingJSON, pendingErr := json.Marshal(pending)
	if err != nil || current == nil || currentErr != nil || pendingErr != nil || !bytes.Equal(currentJSON, pendingJSON) {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_CHANGED")
	}
	if previous != nil {
		return writeLocalRunRecord(storeRoot, *previous)
	}
	path, err := localRunRecordPath(storeRoot, pending.ProjectRoot, pending.ProjectID)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := safeLocalRunRecordRoot(storeRoot); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	info, err := os.Lstat(path)
	if err != nil || !info.Mode().IsRegular() {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	if err := os.Remove(path); err != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE: %w", err)
	}
	return syncLocalRunRecordDir(storeRoot)
}

func safeLocalRunRecordRoot(root string) error {
	info, err := os.Lstat(root)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {
		return nil
	}
	if err != nil || !info.IsDir() || info.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return errors.New("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	return nil
}

package desktop

import (
	"os"
	"syscall"
	"unsafe"
)

var localRunMoveFileEx = syscall.NewLazyDLL("kernel32.dll").NewProc("MoveFileExW")

func replaceLocalRunRecord(source, destination string) error {
	from, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(source)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	to, err := syscall.UTF16PtrFromString(destination)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	result, _, callErr := localRunMoveFileEx.Call(uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(from)), uintptr(unsafe.Pointer(to)), 0x1|0x8)
	if result == 0 {
		if callErr != nil && callErr != syscall.Errno(0) {
			return callErr
		}
		return os.ErrInvalid
	}
	return nil
}

package desktop

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"platform-installer/internal/executionnode"
	"platform-installer/internal/sshpassword"

type orphanRunRecovery struct {
	id          string
	projectRoot string
	projectID   string
	runID       string
	expires     time.Time
}

type OrphanRunRecoveryResult struct {
	Status          string            `json:"status"`
	RecoveryID      string            `json:"recoveryId,omitempty"`
	RunID           string            `json:"runId,omitempty"`
	RunState        string            `json:"runState,omitempty"`
	ProjectRevision string            `json:"projectRevision,omitempty"`
	Error           *ProjectOpenError `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func orphanRecoveryError(code string) OrphanRunRecoveryResult {
	return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

// InspectOrphanRun discovers only the locally recorded prior run on its original
// trusted node. The short-lived candidate permits explicit attach or cancellation.
func (a *App) InspectOrphanRun() OrphanRunRecoveryResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.orphanRecovery = nil
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil || a.startInFlight || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight {
		return orphanRecoveryError("PROJECT_NOT_OPEN")
	}
	record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, a.current.Root, a.current.Project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return orphanRecoveryError("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_INVALID")
	}
	if record == nil || record.State == "TERMINAL" {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "NONE"}
	}
	if record.State != "RUNNING" || record.RunID == "" {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNKNOWN"}
	}
	if a.installationRuns.knowsRun(record.RunID) {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "CURRENT", RunID: record.RunID, ProjectRevision: record.ProjectRevision}
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNAVAILABLE"}
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.ExecutionClient)
	if !ok {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNAVAILABLE"}
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(30 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	run, err := client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNAVAILABLE"}
	}
	if rebindTerminalRun(run.State) && !a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		record.State, record.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
		if err := writeLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, *record); err != nil {
			return orphanRecoveryError("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "RESOLVED", RunID: record.RunID, RunState: run.State}
	}
	if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) && !a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "UNAVAILABLE"}
	}
	var nonce [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(nonce[:]); err != nil {
		return orphanRecoveryError("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	id := hex.EncodeToString(nonce[:])
	a.orphanRecovery = &orphanRunRecovery{id: id, projectRoot: a.current.Root, projectID: record.ProjectID, runID: record.RunID, expires: time.Now().Add(2 * time.Minute)}
	result := OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "FOUND", RecoveryID: id, RunID: record.RunID, RunState: run.State, ProjectRevision: record.ProjectRevision}
	if a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		result.Error = &ProjectOpenError{Code: "ORPHAN_RUN_CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED", Message: "Остановка не подтверждена. Подключитесь и повторите отмену."}
	}
	return result
}

// AttachOrphanRun restores the existing execution session without a new Start.
func (a *App) AttachOrphanRun(recoveryID string) InstallationRunOperation {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	p := a.orphanRecovery
	a.orphanRecovery = nil
	fail := func(code string) InstallationRunOperation {
		return InstallationRunOperation{Status: "BLOCKED", Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
	}
	if p == nil || recoveryID == "" || recoveryID != p.id || !time.Now().Before(p.expires) || a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root != p.projectRoot || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Project.ID != p.projectID || a.startInFlight || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_RECOVERY_STALE")
	}
	record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, p.projectRoot, p.projectID)
	if err != nil || record == nil || record.State != "RUNNING" || record.RunID != p.runID {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_RECOVERY_STALE")
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.ExecutionClient)
	if !ok {
		return fail("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(30 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	run, err := client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || run.RunID != record.RunID || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID || a.revalidateTrustedConnectionLocked(binding) != nil {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) && !rebindTerminalRun(run.State) {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_STATE_UNKNOWN")
	}
	if binding.plans == nil {
		return fail("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	reconnected, _, err := binding.plans.Reconnect(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || reconnected.RunID != record.RunID || reconnected.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID || a.revalidateTrustedConnectionLocked(binding) != nil {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	run = reconnected
	if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) && !rebindTerminalRun(run.State) {
		return fail("ORPHAN_RUN_STATE_UNKNOWN")
	}
	a.pauseRecoveredObservationLocked()
	a.recoveredRun = record
	a.installationRuns.rememberRun(run.RunID)
	if rebindTerminalRun(run.State) && !a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(run.RunID) {
		record.State, record.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
		if err := writeLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, *record); err != nil {
			return fail("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
		}
		a.installationRuns.finishMonitor(run.RunID, &run)
	} else {
		captured := installationStartContext{generation: a.installationGeneration, root: a.current.Root, projectID: record.ProjectID, revision: record.ProjectRevision, planID: record.PlanID, nodeID: record.NodeID}
		monitorCtx, started := a.installationRuns.startMonitor(run.RunID)
		if !started {
			return fail("INSTALLATION_OPERATION_IN_PROGRESS")
		}
		go a.monitorInstallationRun(monitorCtx, binding, captured, run.RunID)
	}
	return a.observedInstallationRunLocked(run)
}

func (a *App) recoveredRunActiveLocked() bool {
	return a.recoveredRun != nil && a.recoveredRun.State == "RUNNING"
}

func (a *App) recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(runID string) bool {
	return a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed && a.recoveredRun != nil && a.recoveredRun.RunID == runID
}

func (a *App) canRenewRecoveredConnectionLocked() bool {
	return a.recoveredRunActiveLocked() && !a.startInFlight && !a.secrets.HasAnyRunExecutionIdentityHold()
}

// Credential renewal stops old local observers, never the remote controller.
func (a *App) pauseRecoveredObservationLocked() {
	if a.recoveredRun != nil {
		a.installationRuns.clear()
	}
}

func (a *App) resolveInstallationObservationLocked(runID string) (*executionNodeBinding, error) {
	if a.recoveredRun == nil || a.recoveredRun.RunID != runID {
		return a.resolveSelectedExecutionNodeBindingLocked(sshpassword.Scope{RunID: runID})
	}
	record := a.recoveredRun
	root, err := canonicalRunProjectRoot(a.current.Root)
	if err != nil || a.current.Project == nil || root != record.ProjectRoot || a.current.Project.ID != record.ProjectID {
		return nil, errors.New("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked(sshpassword.Scope{RunID: runID})
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return nil, errors.New("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	return binding, nil
}

func (a *App) observedInstallationRunLocked(run executionnode.ExecutionRun) InstallationRunOperation {
	result := InstallationRunOperation{Status: "READY", Run: ptrInstallationRun(installationRunView(run)), Result: installationResultView(run)}
	// A React reload loses view state while the same Go session still owns
	// the run. Return its saved display plan without creating or approving one.
	if a.current.Status == "OPEN" && a.current.Project != nil && run.ProjectIdentity == a.current.Project.ID {
		if record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, a.current.Root, a.current.Project.ID); err == nil && record != nil && record.RunID == run.RunID {
			result.Plan = record.Plan
			result.ProjectRevision = record.ProjectRevision
		}
	}
	if a.recoveredRun != nil && a.recoveredRun.RunID == run.RunID {
		result.Reconnected = true
		result.CancelUnconfirmed = a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed
		result.ProjectRevision = a.recoveredRun.ProjectRevision
		result.Plan = a.recoveredRun.Plan
		if a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed {
			result.Result = nil
		}
		if rebindTerminalRun(run.State) && !a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed {
			a.recoveredRun.State, a.recoveredRun.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
		}
	}
	return result
}

func orphanRunCancellable(state string) bool {
	switch state {
	case "STARTING", "RUNNING", "CANCELLING":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// CancelOrphanRun only uses the run ID kept by Go in the one-use preview. It
// never deletes remote run files and never unlocks on timeout or unknown state.
func (a *App) CancelOrphanRun(recoveryID string) OrphanRunRecoveryResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	p := a.orphanRecovery
	a.orphanRecovery = nil
	if p == nil || recoveryID == "" || recoveryID != p.id || time.Now().After(p.expires) || a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root != p.projectRoot || a.current.Project == nil || a.current.Project.ID != p.projectID || a.startInFlight || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight || a.installationRuns.knowsRun(p.runID) {
		return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_RECOVERY_STALE")
	}
	record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, p.projectRoot, p.projectID)
	if err != nil || record == nil || record.State != "RUNNING" || record.RunID != p.runID {
		return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_RECOVERY_STALE")
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return orphanRecoveryError("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.ExecutionClient)
	if !ok {
		return orphanRecoveryError("EXECUTION_NODE_BINDING_REQUIRED")
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(90 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	run, err := client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID {
		return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
	}
	if !rebindTerminalRun(run.State) || a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) {
			return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_STATE_UNKNOWN")
		}
		if _, err := client.CancelExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID); err != nil {
			return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_CANCEL_UNCONFIRMED")
		}
		for {
			run, err = client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
			if err != nil || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID {
				return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_IDENTITY_UNVERIFIED")
			}
			if rebindTerminalRun(run.State) {
				break
			}
			if !orphanRunCancellable(run.State) {
				return orphanRecoveryError("ORPHAN_RUN_STATE_UNKNOWN")
			}
			select {
			case <-ctx.Done():
				return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "CANCELLING", RunID: record.RunID}
			case <-time.After(time.Second):
			}
		}
	}
	record.State, record.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
	if err := writeLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, *record); err != nil {
		return orphanRecoveryError("LOCAL_RUN_RECORD_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if a.recoveredStopUnconfirmedLocked(record.RunID) {
		a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed = false
		a.recoveredRun.State, a.recoveredRun.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
	}
	return OrphanRunRecoveryResult{Status: "RESOLVED", RunID: record.RunID, RunState: run.State}
}

package desktop

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"platform-installer/internal/executionbundle"
	"platform-installer/internal/executionnode"
	"platform-installer/internal/installer"
	"platform-installer/internal/projectlifecycle"
)

// The source path and project root are private to Go. React receives only an
// opaque, short-lived confirmation token and integrity-checked metadata.
type runtimeBundlePreview struct {
	id, source, projectRoot, revision                string
	oldArtifact, oldCatalog, newArtifact, newCatalog string
	expires                                          time.Time
}

type RuntimeBundleUpdateResult struct {
	Status                string            `json:"status"`
	PreviewID             string            `json:"previewId,omitempty"`
	CurrentArtifactDigest string            `json:"currentArtifactDigest,omitempty"`
	CurrentCatalogDigest  string            `json:"currentCatalogDigest,omitempty"`
	NewArtifactDigest     string            `json:"newArtifactDigest,omitempty"`
	NewCatalogDigest      string            `json:"newCatalogDigest,omitempty"`
	BundleVersion         string            `json:"bundleVersion,omitempty"`
	CoreVersion           string            `json:"coreVersion,omitempty"`
	ProjectRevision       string            `json:"projectRevision,omitempty"`
	Error                 *ProjectOpenError `json:"error,omitempty"`
}

func bundleUpdateError(status, code string) RuntimeBundleUpdateResult {
	return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: status, Error: &ProjectOpenError{Code: code, Message: projectErrorMessage(code)}}
}

func (a *App) ChooseRuntimeBundleUpdate() RuntimeBundleUpdateResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	a.bundlePreview = nil
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Classification != projectlifecycle.ClassificationManaged || a.current.Project == nil || a.bundleCacheRoot == "" || a.activeSession != "" || a.startInFlight || a.startOutcomeUnknown || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	if !a.knownRunsTerminalLocked() {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	root := a.current.Root
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil || a.current.Managed == nil || revision != a.current.Managed.ProjectRevision {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	old, err := installer.ReadRuntimeLockSet(root)
	if err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	source := filepath.Join(root, "bundle")
	sourceInfo, err := os.Lstat(source)
	if os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: "NOT_FOUND"}
	} else if err != nil || !sourceInfo.IsDir() || sourceInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_INVALID")
	}
	verified, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(source)
	if err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_INVALID")
	}
	if verified.Digest == old.ArtifactDigest {
		return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: "UNCHANGED", CurrentArtifactDigest: old.ArtifactDigest, CurrentCatalogDigest: old.CatalogDigest}
	}
	var token [16]byte
	if _, err := rand.Read(token[:]); err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_UPDATE_UNAVAILABLE")
	}
	id := hex.EncodeToString(token[:])
	a.bundlePreview = &runtimeBundlePreview{id: id, source: verified.Root, projectRoot: root, revision: revision, oldArtifact: old.ArtifactDigest, oldCatalog: old.CatalogDigest, newArtifact: verified.Digest, newCatalog: verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest, expires: time.Now().Add(10 * time.Minute)}
	return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: "PREVIEW", PreviewID: id, CurrentArtifactDigest: old.ArtifactDigest, CurrentCatalogDigest: old.CatalogDigest, NewArtifactDigest: verified.Digest, NewCatalogDigest: verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest, BundleVersion: verified.Manifest.BundleVersion, CoreVersion: verified.Manifest.CoreVersion, ProjectRevision: revision}
}

func (a *App) ConfirmRuntimeBundleUpdate(previewID string) RuntimeBundleUpdateResult {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	p := a.bundlePreview
	a.bundlePreview = nil // one use, including a failed attempt
	if p == nil || previewID == "" || previewID != p.id || time.Now().After(p.expires) || a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Root != p.projectRoot || a.activeSession != "" || a.startInFlight || a.startOutcomeUnknown || a.runtimeUpdateInFlight || a.bundleCacheRoot == "" {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_PREVIEW_STALE")
	}
	if !a.knownRunsTerminalLocked() {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "INSTALLATION_RUN_ACTIVE")
	}
	revision, err := installer.ProjectRevision(p.projectRoot)
	if err != nil || revision != p.revision {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	current, err := installer.ReadRuntimeLockSet(p.projectRoot)
	if err != nil || current.ArtifactDigest != p.oldArtifact || current.CatalogDigest != p.oldCatalog {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	sourceInfo, err := os.Lstat(p.source)
	if err != nil || !sourceInfo.IsDir() || sourceInfo.Mode()&os.ModeSymlink != 0 {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_CHANGED")
	}
	verified, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(p.source)
	if err != nil || verified.Digest != p.newArtifact || verified.Manifest.CatalogDigest != p.newCatalog {
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_CHANGED")
	}
	a.runtimeUpdateInFlight = true
	defer func() { a.runtimeUpdateInFlight = false }()
	publish := a.bundlePublisher
	if publish == nil {
		publish = (executionbundle.Cache{Root: a.bundleCacheRoot}).Publish
	}
	published, publishErr := publish(verified.Root)
	if publishErr != nil {
		// Publish may have renamed a different valid source and pruned the
		// previous cache root before returning an error. Never retain a root
		// that no longer verifies, regardless of the digest now in the cache.
		if a.availableBundleRoot == "" {
			a.switchPublishedBundleLocked("")
		} else if _, err := executionbundle.ValidateRoot(a.availableBundleRoot); err != nil {
			a.switchPublishedBundleLocked("")
		}
		return bundleUpdateError("BLOCKED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_PUBLICATION_FAILED")
	}
	// The source can change during copy. Only the exact previewed, verified
	// bytes authorize the project CAS, even if another valid bundle got copied.
	a.switchPublishedBundleLocked(published.Root)
	if published.Digest != p.newArtifact || published.Manifest.CatalogDigest != p.newCatalog {
		return bundleUpdateError("PUBLISHED_NOT_BOUND", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_CHANGED")
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(2 * time.Minute)
	defer cancel()
	_, err = installer.NewBackend(nil).UpdateRuntimeLockSet(ctx, installer.RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest{ProjectRoot: p.projectRoot, ExpectedProjectRevision: p.revision, ExpectedOldArtifactDigest: p.oldArtifact, ExpectedOldCatalogDigest: p.oldCatalog, NewDigest: p.newArtifact, NewBundleRoot: published.Root})
	if err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("PUBLISHED_NOT_BOUND", projectErrorCode(err))
	}
	// Never label an uncertain post-commit refresh as rollback. The on-disk
	// locks are authoritative and OpenProject can safely be retried.
	opened, err := a.lifecycle.OpenProject(ctx, p.projectRoot)
	if err != nil || opened.Project == nil || opened.Catalog == nil || opened.Catalog.Status != "READY" || opened.Project.Source.BundleDigest != p.newArtifact || opened.Project.Source.CatalogDigest != p.newCatalog {
		return bundleUpdateError("BOUND_REFRESH_REQUIRED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_REOPEN_FAILED")
	}
	managed, err := installer.ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog(p.projectRoot, opened.Catalog)
	if err != nil {
		return bundleUpdateError("BOUND_REFRESH_REQUIRED", "RUNTIME_BUNDLE_REOPEN_FAILED")
	}
	a.secrets.Clear()
	a.current = ProjectOpenResult{Status: "OPEN", Root: opened.Root, Classification: opened.Classification, Project: opened.Project, Catalog: opened.Catalog, Managed: managed, Verification: notVerified(), Counts: opened.Counts, Diagnostics: a.managedServerTypeDiagnostics(managed)}
	a.bindExecutionLocked(opened.Root, opened.Project, managedSnapshotHosts(managed))
	return RuntimeBundleUpdateResult{Status: "UPDATED", NewArtifactDigest: p.newArtifact, NewCatalogDigest: p.newCatalog, ProjectRevision: managed.ProjectRevision}
}

func (a *App) switchPublishedBundleLocked(root string) {
	a.invalidateDynamicBindingLocked()
	a.binding = nil // explicit startup release also names the previous bundle
	a.reader = unavailableProjectReader{}
	a.availableBundleRoot = root
	if root == "" {
		a.lifecycle = projectlifecycle.NewService(nil)
	} else {
		a.lifecycle = projectlifecycle.NewService(map[string]string{projectlifecycle.DefaultCompatibilitySourceID: root})
	}
	a.current.Catalog = nil
	a.current.Managed = nil
	a.current.Snapshot = nil
	a.execution.setStatus(executionNodeNotPrepared)
	a.continuation = nil
	a.installationPlanID = ""
	a.installationGeneration++
	a.clearInstallationRunsLocked()
	a.current.Verification = notVerified()
	a.clearRuntimeSecretDescriptorEvidenceLocked()
}

func (a *App) knownRunsTerminalLocked() bool {
	if a.installationRuns.hasActiveRun() {
		return false
	}
	if a.recoveredCancelUnconfirmed && a.recoveredRun != nil {
		return false
	}
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || a.current.Project == nil {
		return false
	}
	record, err := readLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, a.current.Root, a.current.Project.ID)
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	if record == nil {
		return len(a.installationRuns.runIDs()) == 0
	}
	if record.State == "TERMINAL" {
		return true
	}
	if record.State != "RUNNING" || record.RunID == "" {
		return false
	}
	binding, err := a.resolveTrustedExecutionConnectionLocked()
	if err != nil || !sameLocalRunNode(*record, binding.node) {
		return false
	}
	client, ok := binding.reader.transport.(executionnode.ExecutionClient)
	if !ok {
		return false
	}
	ctx, cancel := a.operationContext(30 * time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	run, err := client.GetExecution(ctx, binding.node, record.RunID)
	if err != nil || run.RunID != record.RunID || run.ProjectIdentity != record.ProjectID || !rebindTerminalRun(run.State) {
		return false
	}
	record.State, record.TerminalState = "TERMINAL", run.State
	if writeLocalRunRecord(a.localRunRecordRoot, *record) != nil {
		return false
	}
	a.installationRuns.finishMonitor(record.RunID, &run)
	return true
}

func sameLocalRunNode(record localRunRecord, node executionnode.Node) bool {
	return record.NodeID == node.ID && record.NodeAddress == node.Address && record.NodePort == node.Port && record.NodeUser == node.User && record.HostKeyFingerprint == node.HostKey.Fingerprint
}

func rebindTerminalRun(state string) bool {
	switch state {
	case "SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED", "INTERRUPTED", "CORRUPT_ORPHANED":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

type RuntimeSecretStatuses struct {
	ProjectRevision string                     `json:"projectRevision,omitempty"`
	Services        map[string]bool            `json:"services,omitempty"`
	Applications    map[string]map[string]bool `json:"applications,omitempty"`
}

// GetRuntimeSecretStatuses projects the same session presence as the editors.
// Only scopes with at least one session input appear in the result. The
// projection uses the loaded saved view and does not reread project files.
func (a *App) GetRuntimeSecretStatuses(section string) RuntimeSecretStatuses {
	a.editMu.Lock()
	defer a.editMu.Unlock()
	managed := a.current.Managed
	if a.current.Status != "OPEN" || managed == nil {
		return RuntimeSecretStatuses{}
	}
	binding, err := a.credentialBindingLocked()
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeSecretStatuses{}
	}
	result := RuntimeSecretStatuses{ProjectRevision: managed.ProjectRevision}
	switch section {
	case "services":
		result.Services = make(map[string]bool)
		for deployment := range managed.Deployments {
			descriptors, err := a.pendingRuntimeSecretDescriptorsLocked(deployment)
			if err == nil && len(descriptors) > 0 {
				result.Services[deployment] = a.serviceSecretsPresent(binding, descriptors)
			}
		}
	case "applications":
		result.Applications = make(map[string]map[string]bool)
		for library, definition := range managed.ApplicationLibraries {
			slots := []string{""} // Library-level provided connection credentials.
			for slot := range secretObject(definition["applications"]) {
				slots = append(slots, slot)
			}
			for _, slot := range slots {
				items, err := a.savedApplicationSecretsLocked(PendingApplicationSecretContext{
					ApplicationLibrary: library, ApplicationSlot: slot,
				})
				if err != nil || len(items) == 0 {
					continue
				}
				keys := make([]string, 0, len(items))
				for _, item := range items {
					keys = append(keys, item.key)
				}
				presence := a.secrets.PendingApplicationSecretPresence(binding, keys)
				installed := true
				for _, key := range keys {
					installed = installed && presence[key]
				}
				if result.Applications[library] == nil {
					result.Applications[library] = make(map[string]bool)
				}
				result.Applications[library][slot] = installed
			}
		}
	}
	return result
}

package desktop

import (
	"context"

	"os"

// Only replaces the OS picker result. The bound import method and all its
// descriptor, file-handle, decryption, session and post-read guards still run.
func configureQASecretFileSelection(app *App) error {
	encoded := os.Getenv("PLATFORM_QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTIONS")
	if encoded == "" {
		return nil
	}
	if len(encoded) > 16*4096 || !utf8.ValidString(encoded) {
		return errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_INVALID")
	}
	var paths []string
	if json.Unmarshal([]byte(encoded), &paths) != nil || len(paths) == 0 || len(paths) > 16 {
		return errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_INVALID")
	}
	for _, path := range paths {
		if !utf8.ValidString(path) || len(path) == 0 || len(path) > 4096 || !filepath.IsAbs(path) {
			return errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_INVALID")
		}
		for _, char := range path {
			if char == 0 || char < 32 {
				return errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_INVALID")
			}
		}
	}
	var mu sync.Mutex
	app.chooseSecretFile = func(ctx context.Context, _ DialogOptions) (string, error) {
		mu.Lock()
		defer mu.Unlock()
		if ctx.Err() != nil {
			return "", ctx.Err()
		}
		if len(paths) == 0 {
			return "", errors.New("QA_SECRET_FILE_SELECTION_EXHAUSTED")
		}
		path := paths[0]
		paths[0] = ""
		paths = paths[1:]
		return path, nil
	}
	return nil
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/desktop/secret_output_delivery.go","mode":420,"size":11533,"sha256":"0d8c1c0403ab71d122cb5378df44d94b49a327b82327e595bcb157ce1bf6368d","index":0,"count":1,"newline":"lf","encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":11533}
package desktop

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"time"

	"platform-installer/internal/executionnode"
