const (
	ObserverIntegrityFailure = "EXECUTION_OBSERVER_INTEGRITY_FAILURE"
	ObserverTransportFailure = "EXECUTION_OBSERVER_TRANSPORT_FAILURE"
	ObserverMirrorFailure    = "EXECUTION_OBSERVER_MIRROR_FAILURE"
	ObserverSubscriberSlow   = "EXECUTION_OBSERVER_SUBSCRIBER_OVERFLOW"
	ObserverHistoryTruncated = "EXECUTION_OBSERVER_HISTORY_TRUNCATED"
	ObserverCapacityExceeded = "EXECUTION_OBSERVER_CAPACITY_EXCEEDED"

	maxObservedRuns             = 32
	maxSubscribersPerRun        = 16
	maxAggregateSubscriberSlots = 16 * 1024
	maxSubscriberBufferSlots    = 4096
)

type ObserverError struct{ Code string }

func (e *ObserverError) Error() string { return e.Code }

type ObserverSubscription struct {
	NodeID       string
	RunID        string
	MirrorPath   string
	Events       <-chan ExecutionEvent
	Errors       <-chan error
	events       chan ExecutionEvent
	errors       chan error
	done         chan struct{}
	closeRequest sync.Once
	finishOnce   sync.Once
	remove       func()
	checkpoint   int
}

func (s *ObserverSubscription) Close() {
	if s != nil {
		s.closeRequest.Do(s.remove)
	}
}

func (s *ObserverSubscription) finish(err error) {
	s.finishOnce.Do(func() {
		if err != nil {
			for {
				select {
				case s.errors <- err:
					goto delivered
				default:
				}
				select {
				case <-s.errors:
				default:
					goto delivered
				}
			}
		}
	delivered:
		close(s.events)
		close(s.errors)
		close(s.done)
	})
}

type observedRun struct {
	stateMu          sync.Mutex
	key              observerRunKey
	node             Node
	runID            string
	ctx              context.Context
	cancel           context.CancelFunc
	mirror           *EventMirror
	last             int
	seen             map[int][]byte
	subs             map[uint64]*ObserverSubscription
	nextSub          uint64
	mirrorErr        error
	mirrorCheckpoint int
	mirrorVerified   bool
	earliestSequence int
	historyTruncated bool
}

type RunObserver struct {
	client       ExecutionClient
	runtimeRoot  string
	pollInterval time.Duration
	minBackoff   time.Duration
	maxBackoff   time.Duration
	mu           sync.Mutex
	runs         map[observerRunKey]*observedRun
}

type observerRunKey struct {
	nodeID        string
	address       string
	user          string
	port          uint16
	credentialRef string
	runID         string
}

func NewRunObserver(client ExecutionClient, runtimeRoot string) (*RunObserver, error) {
	if client == nil || runtimeRoot == "" {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(runtimeRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	return &RunObserver{client: client, runtimeRoot: absolute, pollInterval: 500 * time.Millisecond, minBackoff: 250 * time.Millisecond, maxBackoff: 5 * time.Second, runs: map[observerRunKey]*observedRun{}}, nil
}

func (o *RunObserver) Observe(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string) (*ObserverSubscription, error) {
	return o.SubscribeAfter(ctx, node, runID, 0, 256)
}

func (o *RunObserver) Subscribe(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string, capacity int) (*ObserverSubscription, error) {
	return o.SubscribeAfter(ctx, node, runID, 0, capacity)
}

func (o *RunObserver) SubscribeAfter(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string, after, capacity int) (*ObserverSubscription, error) {
	if ctx == nil || !validRuntimeToken(runID) || after < 0 || capacity < 1 || capacity > maxSubscriberBufferSlots {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	key := observerKey(node, runID)
	o.mu.Lock()
	current := o.runs[key]
	startPoller := false
	if current == nil {
		if len(o.runs) >= maxObservedRuns {
			o.mu.Unlock()
			return nil, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverCapacityExceeded}
		}
		mirror, mirrorErr := OpenEventMirror(o.runtimeRoot, runID, nodeMirrorFingerprint(node))
		runContext, cancel := context.WithCancel(context.Background())
		current = &observedRun{key: key, node: node, runID: runID, ctx: runContext, cancel: cancel, mirror: mirror, seen: map[int][]byte{}, subs: map[uint64]*ObserverSubscription{}, mirrorErr: mirrorErr, mirrorVerified: true}
		if mirror != nil {
			current.last = mirror.LastSequence()
			current.seen = mirror.knownEvents()
			current.mirrorCheckpoint = current.last
			current.mirrorVerified = current.last == 0
		}
		o.runs[key] = current
		startPoller = true
	}
	if len(current.subs) >= maxSubscribersPerRun {
		o.mu.Unlock()
		return nil, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverCapacityExceeded}
	}
	current.stateMu.Lock()
	replayCount := 0
	for sequence := range current.seen {
		if sequence > after {
			replayCount++
		}
	}
	requestedSlots := replayCount + capacity
	if requestedSlots > maxObservedExecutionEvents+maxSubscriberBufferSlots {
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		o.mu.Unlock()
		if startPoller {
			o.finish(current, nil)
		}
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_REPLAY_LIMIT")
	}
	if o.aggregateSubscriberSlotsLocked()+requestedSlots > maxAggregateSubscriberSlots {
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		o.mu.Unlock()
		if startPoller {
			o.finish(current, nil)
		}
		return nil, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverCapacityExceeded}
	}
	events := make(chan ExecutionEvent, replayCount+capacity)
	errorsChannel := make(chan error, 4)
	mirrorPath := ""
	if current.mirrorErr == nil {
		mirrorPath, _ = EventMirrorPath(o.runtimeRoot, runID)
	}
	sub := &ObserverSubscription{NodeID: node.ID, RunID: runID, MirrorPath: mirrorPath, Events: events, Errors: errorsChannel, events: events, errors: errorsChannel, done: make(chan struct{}), checkpoint: after}
	id := current.nextSub
	current.nextSub++
	sub.remove = func() { o.removeSubscriber(key, current, id, sub) }
	if current.mirrorErr != nil {
		sub.errors <- &ObserverError{Code: ObserverMirrorFailure}
	}
	if current.historyTruncated && after < current.earliestSequence-1 {
		sub.errors <- &ObserverError{Code: ObserverHistoryTruncated}
	}
	if current.mirrorVerified {
		for _, sequence := range orderedSequences(current.seen, after, current.last) {
			encoded, ok := current.seen[sequence]
			if !ok {
				continue
			}
			var event ExecutionEvent
			if decodeCanonicalEvent(encoded, &event) {
				sub.events <- event
				sub.checkpoint = sequence
			}
		}
	}
	current.stateMu.Unlock()
	current.subs[id] = sub
	o.mu.Unlock()
	if startPoller {
		go o.poll(current)
	}
	go func() {
		select {
		case <-ctx.Done():
			sub.Close()
		case <-sub.done:
		}
	}()
	return sub, nil
}

func (o *RunObserver) aggregateSubscriberSlotsLocked() int {
	total := 0
	for _, current := range o.runs {
		for _, sub := range current.subs {
			total += cap(sub.events)
		}
	}
	return total
}

func nodeMirrorFingerprint(node Node) string {
	value := strings.Join([]string{node.ID, node.Address, node.User, strconv.Itoa(int(node.Port)), node.HostKey.Fingerprint}, "\x00")
	digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(value))
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
}

func (o *RunObserver) Replay(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string, after int) ([]ExecutionEvent, error) {
	if ctx == nil || !validRuntimeToken(runID) || after < 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_OBSERVER_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	result := []ExecutionEvent{}
	last := after
	seen := map[int][]byte{}
	historyTruncated := false
	for {
		page, err := o.client.GetEvents(ctx, node, runID, last, ExecutionEventPageLimit)
		if err != nil {
			if errors.Is(err, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid) || errors.Is(err, errExecutionEventResponseInvalid) {
				return nil, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
			}
			return nil, err
		}
		accepted, next, err := validateObserverPage(page, runID, last, seen)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		result = append(result, accepted...)
		historyTruncated = historyTruncated || page.HistoryTruncated
		last = next
		if !page.HasMore {
			if historyTruncated {
				return result, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverHistoryTruncated}
			}
			return result, nil
		}
	}
}

func (o *RunObserver) Stop(node Node, runID string) {
	key := observerKey(node, runID)
	o.mu.Lock()
	if current := o.runs[key]; current != nil {
		current.cancel()
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
}

func (o *RunObserver) removeSubscriber(key observerRunKey, current *observedRun, id uint64, sub *ObserverSubscription) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	if o.runs[key] == current {
		delete(current.subs, id)
		if len(current.subs) == 0 {
			current.cancel()
		}
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
	sub.finish(nil)
}

func (o *RunObserver) poll(current *observedRun) {
	backoff := o.minBackoff
	for {
		current.stateMu.Lock()
		after := current.last
		if !current.mirrorVerified && current.mirrorCheckpoint > 0 {
			after = current.mirrorCheckpoint - 1
		}
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		page, err := o.client.GetEvents(current.ctx, current.node, current.runID, after, ExecutionEventPageLimit)
		if err != nil {
			if current.ctx.Err() != nil {
				o.finish(current, nil)
				return
			}
			if errors.Is(err, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid) || errors.Is(err, errExecutionEventResponseInvalid) {
				o.finish(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure})
				return
			}
			o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverTransportFailure})
			if !waitObserver(current.ctx, backoff) {
				o.finish(current, nil)
				return
			}
			backoff *= 2
			if backoff > o.maxBackoff {
				backoff = o.maxBackoff
			}
			continue
		}
		backoff = o.minBackoff
		current.stateMu.Lock()
		accepted, next, validationErr := validateObserverPage(page, current.runID, current.last, current.seen)
		if page.HistoryTruncated {
			current.historyTruncated = true
			current.earliestSequence = page.EarliestSequence
		}
		mirrorMismatch := false
		verifiedMirror := false
		if !current.mirrorVerified && current.mirrorCheckpoint > 0 {
			checkpoint := current.mirrorCheckpoint
			remoteCheckpointMatches := len(page.Events) > 0 && page.Events[0].Sequence == checkpoint
			if remoteCheckpointMatches {
				encoded, encodeErr := canonicalEvent(page.Events[0])
				remoteCheckpointMatches = encodeErr == nil && bytes.Equal(current.seen[checkpoint], encoded)
			}
			if validationErr != nil || !remoteCheckpointMatches {
				mirrorMismatch = true
			} else {
				current.mirrorVerified = true
				verifiedMirror = true
			}
		}
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		if mirrorMismatch {
			o.resetUnverifiedMirror(current)
			continue
		}
		if verifiedMirror {
			o.publishMirroredHistory(current, current.mirrorCheckpoint)
		}
		if validationErr != nil {
			o.finish(current, validationErr)
			return
		}
		if page.HistoryTruncated {
			o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverHistoryTruncated})
		}
		for _, event := range accepted {
			if current.mirror != nil {
				if _, mirrorErr := current.mirror.Append(event); mirrorErr != nil {
					_ = current.mirror.Close()
					current.mirror = nil
					current.stateMu.Lock()
					current.mirrorErr = mirrorErr
					current.stateMu.Unlock()
					o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverMirrorFailure})
				}
			}
			current.stateMu.Lock()
			current.last = event.Sequence
			encoded, _ := canonicalEvent(event)
			current.seen[event.Sequence] = encoded
			current.stateMu.Unlock()
			o.publish(current, event)
		}
		current.stateMu.Lock()
		current.last = next
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		if page.HasMore {
			continue
		}
		run, runErr := o.client.GetExecution(current.ctx, current.node, current.runID)
		if runErr != nil {
			o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverTransportFailure})
			if !waitObserver(current.ctx, backoff) {
				o.finish(current, nil)
				return
			}
			backoff *= 2
			if backoff > o.maxBackoff {
				backoff = o.maxBackoff
			}
			continue
		}
		backoff = o.minBackoff
		current.stateMu.Lock()
		last := current.last
		current.stateMu.Unlock()
		if run.RunID != "" && run.RunID != current.runID || run.Sequence < last {
			o.finish(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure})
			return
		}
		if terminalExecutionState(run.State) {
			if run.Sequence > last {
				continue
			}
			o.finish(current, nil)
			return
		}
		if !waitObserver(current.ctx, o.pollInterval) {
			o.finish(current, nil)
			return
		}
	}
}

func validateObserverPage(page ExecutionEventPage, runID string, last int, seen map[int][]byte) ([]ExecutionEvent, int, error) {
	accepted := make([]ExecutionEvent, 0, len(page.Events))
	next := last
	if page.HistoryTruncated {
		if page.EarliestSequence <= last+1 {
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		next = page.EarliestSequence - 1
	}
	for _, event := range page.Events {
		if validateExecutionEvent(event, runID) != nil {
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		encoded, _ := canonicalEvent(event)
		if event.Sequence <= next {
			if prior, ok := seen[event.Sequence]; ok && bytes.Equal(prior, encoded) {
				continue
			}
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		if event.Sequence != next+1 {
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		if len(seen) >= maxObservedExecutionEvents {
			return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
		}
		accepted = append(accepted, event)
		seen[event.Sequence] = encoded
		next = event.Sequence
	}
	if page.NextSequence != next || page.HasMore && len(page.Events) == 0 {
		return nil, last, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverIntegrityFailure}
	}
	return accepted, next, nil
}

func (o *RunObserver) publish(current *observedRun, event ExecutionEvent) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	overflow := []*ObserverSubscription{}
	if o.runs[current.key] == current {
		for id, sub := range current.subs {
			if event.Sequence <= sub.checkpoint {
				continue
			}
			select {
			case sub.events <- event:
				sub.checkpoint = event.Sequence
			default:
				delete(current.subs, id)
				overflow = append(overflow, sub)
			}
		}
		if len(current.subs) == 0 {
			current.cancel()
		}
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
	for _, sub := range overflow {
		sub.finish(&ObserverError{Code: ObserverSubscriberSlow})
	}
}

func (o *RunObserver) publishMirroredHistory(current *observedRun, through int) {
	current.stateMu.Lock()
	history := make(map[int][]byte, len(current.seen))
	for sequence, encoded := range current.seen {
		if sequence <= through {
			history[sequence] = append([]byte(nil), encoded...)
		}
	}
	current.stateMu.Unlock()
	for _, sequence := range orderedSequences(history, 0, through) {
		encoded, ok := history[sequence]
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		var event ExecutionEvent
		if decodeCanonicalEvent(encoded, &event) {
			o.publish(current, event)
		}
	}
}

func orderedSequences(events map[int][]byte, after, through int) []int {
	result := make([]int, 0, len(events))
	for sequence := range events {
		if sequence > after && sequence <= through {
			result = append(result, sequence)
		}
	}
	sort.Ints(result)
	return result
}

func (o *RunObserver) resetUnverifiedMirror(current *observedRun) {
	current.stateMu.Lock()
	if current.mirror != nil {
		if err := current.mirror.Reset(); err != nil {
			_ = current.mirror.Close()
			current.mirror = nil
		}
	}
	current.last = 0
	current.seen = map[int][]byte{}
	current.mirrorCheckpoint = 0
	current.mirrorVerified = true
	current.earliestSequence = 0
	current.historyTruncated = false
	current.stateMu.Unlock()
	o.notify(current, &ObserverError{Code: ObserverMirrorFailure})
}

func decodeCanonicalEvent(encoded []byte, event *ExecutionEvent) bool {
	return json.Unmarshal(encoded, event) == nil
}

func (o *RunObserver) notify(current *observedRun, err error) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	if o.runs[current.key] == current {
		for _, sub := range current.subs {
			select {
			case sub.errors <- err:
			default:
			}
		}
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
}

func (o *RunObserver) finish(current *observedRun, err error) {
	o.mu.Lock()
	if o.runs[current.key] == current {
		delete(o.runs, current.key)
	}
	subs := make([]*ObserverSubscription, 0, len(current.subs))
	for id, sub := range current.subs {
		delete(current.subs, id)
		subs = append(subs, sub)
	}
	o.mu.Unlock()
	current.cancel()
	if current.mirror != nil {
		_ = current.mirror.Close()
	}
	for _, sub := range subs {
		sub.finish(err)
	}
}

func observerKey(node Node, runID string) observerRunKey {
	return observerRunKey{nodeID: node.ID, address: node.Address, user: node.User, port: node.Port, credentialRef: node.CredentialRef, runID: runID}
}

func terminalExecutionState(state string) bool {
	switch state {
	case "SUCCEEDED", "FAILED", "CANCELLED", "INTERRUPTED", "CORRUPT_ORPHANED":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

func waitObserver(ctx context.Context, duration time.Duration) bool {
	timer := time.NewTimer(duration)
	defer timer.Stop()
	select {
	case <-ctx.Done():
		return false
	case <-timer.C:
		return true
	}
}

//go:embed runtime_unpack.py
var runtimeUnpack string

func runtimeBootstrapMode(bundle executionbundle.Verified) string {
	for _, component := range bundle.Manifest.Components {
		if component.Path == runtimeBootstrapComponent {
			// Only skip the known script's INSTALLED branch. Other versions
			// may perform required work even with these packages installed.
			if component.SHA256 == installedOnlyBootstrapDigest {
				return "2"
			}
			return "1"
		}
	}
	return "0"
}

func shellLiteral(value string) string { return "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(value, "'", "'\"'\"'") + "'" }

// Bootstrap has no activation side effects. With installed prerequisites the
// activation phase verifies bytes as it writes a private root-owned candidate.
func runtimePreparationScripts(bundle executionbundle.Verified) (string, string) {
	var checks strings.Builder
	fmt.Fprintf(&checks, "[ \"$actual_files\" = %d ]\n", len(bundle.Manifest.Components)+1)
	fmt.Fprintf(&checks, "printf '%%s  %%s\\n' %s manifest.yaml | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null\n", shellLiteral(strings.TrimPrefix(bundle.Digest, "sha256:")))
	for _, component := range bundle.Manifest.Components {
		file := shellLiteral(component.Path)
		fmt.Fprintf(&checks, "[ -f %s ] && [ ! -L %s ] && [ \"$(stat -c %%u -- %s)\" = 0 ]\n", file, file, file)
		fmt.Fprintf(&checks, "[ \"$(wc -c < %s)\" = %d ]\nprintf '%%s  %%s\\n' %s %s | sha256sum -c - >/dev/null\n", file, component.Size, shellLiteral(strings.TrimPrefix(component.SHA256, "sha256:")), file)
	}
	common := strings.Replace(runtimePreparationCommon, "__COMPONENT_CHECKS__", checks.String(), 1)
	manifestSize := int64(-1)
	if info, err := os.Stat(filepath.Join(bundle.Root, "manifest.yaml")); err == nil {
		manifestSize = info.Size()
	}
	files := append([]executionbundle.Component{{Path: "manifest.yaml", SHA256: bundle.Digest, Size: manifestSize}}, bundle.Manifest.Components...)
	// Component contains only strings and integers, which JSON always encodes.
	expected, _ := json.Marshal(files)
	activation := strings.Replace(runtimeActivationPhase, "__VERIFIED_UNPACK__",
		"python3 -I - \"$stage\" \"$candidate\" <<'PLATFORM_BUNDLE_UNPACK'\n"+
			"verified_manifest = '"+base64.StdEncoding.EncodeToString(expected)+"'\n"+runtimeUnpack+"\nPLATFORM_BUNDLE_UNPACK", 1)
	return common + runtimeBootstrapPhase, common + runtimeInstalledProbe + activation
}

// plumbing only: it stores no plan, owns no session and cannot carry a remote

func (t OpenSSHTransport) StageRuntimeProjection(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID, projectIdentity, planFingerprint, requirementsFingerprint string, projections map[string]map[string]artifactsource.Result, pkiSecretFiles map[string]string) error {
	if !validRuntimeToken(runID) || projectIdentity == "" || planFingerprint == "" || requirementsFingerprint == "" || !validRemoteSecretFiles(pkiSecretFiles) {
		return errors.New("RUNTIME_PROJECTION_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	payload := map[string]any{
		"apiVersion":                                   "platform.installer/runtime-projection/v1alpha1",
		"platform_execution_run_id":                    runID,
		"platform_execution_project_identity":          projectIdentity,
		"platform_execution_plan_fingerprint":          planFingerprint,
		"platform_execution_requirements_fingerprint":  requirementsFingerprint,
		"platform_project_id":                          projectIdentity,
		"platform_service_catalog_path":                "/var/lib/platform-installer/runtime/current/catalog/service-catalog.yml",
		"platform_resolved_artifact_sources_by_target": projections,
		"platform_resolved_artifact_sources":           "{{ platform_resolved_artifact_sources_by_target[inventory_hostname] | default({}) }}",
		"platform_pki_secret_files":                    pkiSecretFiles,
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(payload)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	local, err := os.CreateTemp("", "platform-runtime-projection-*.json")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	localPath := local.Name()
	defer os.Remove(localPath)
	if _, err := local.Write(data); err != nil {
		_ = local.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := local.Close(); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	identity, err := t.Identity.IdentityFile(node.CredentialRef)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	remote := "/var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-projection/" + runID + ".json"
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote}, []byte("set -eu\ncase \"$1\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-projection/installer-*.json) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nmkdir -p -- /var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-projection\nrm -f -- \"$1\"\n")); err != nil {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: ExecutionNodeUnavailable}
	}
	args := append(t.scpBase(node, identity), "-O", "--", localPath, t.destination(node, remote))
	if _, err := t.run(ctx, "scp", args, nil); err != nil {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: ExecutionNodeUnavailable}
	}
	script := "set -eu\nremote=$1\nrun=$2\ncase \"$remote:$run\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-projection/installer-*.json:installer-*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nsudo -n install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/$run\nsudo -n install -m 0600 \"$remote\" /var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/$run/runtime-projection.json\nrm -f -- \"$remote\"\n"
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote, runID}, []byte(script)); err != nil {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: ExecutionNodeUnavailable}
	}
	return nil
}

func validRemoteSecretFiles(values map[string]string) bool {
	for reference, secretPath := range values {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(reference, "runtime:") || len(reference) == len("runtime:") || !strings.HasPrefix(secretPath, "/") || path.Clean(secretPath) != secretPath || strings.ContainsAny(reference+secretPath, "\r\n\x00") {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validRuntimeToken(value string) bool {
	const prefix = "installer-"
	if len(value) <= len(prefix) || len(value) > 128 || !strings.HasPrefix(value, prefix) {
		return false
	}
	for _, r := range value[len(prefix):] {
		// Legacy workstation-created IDs are decimal, while v1alpha2 Start
		// returns the Execution Node's lowercase hexadecimal identifier.
		if !(r >= '0' && r <= '9') && !(r >= 'a' && r <= 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

var candidateOwnedPathPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^(ansible\.cfg|inventory/hosts\.yml|inventory/group_vars/all/platform-installer\.yml|inventory/host_vars/[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}/platform-installer\.yml)$`)
var candidateIdentityPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,127}$`)
var previewSettingIDPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)

func validLowerHex(value string, size int) bool {
	if len(value) != size {
		return false
	}
	for _, item := range value {
		if (item < '0' || item > '9') && (item < 'a' || item > 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func validSHA256(value string) bool {
	return strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") && validLowerHex(strings.TrimPrefix(value, "sha256:"), 64)
}

const ExecutionEventPageLimit = 256

// Match the bounded Execution Node journal. The remote lifecycle reserves its
// final 256 slots for critical events, but permits up to 32768 total records.
const maxObservedExecutionEvents = 32768

const maxDecodedExecutionEventBytes = 64 * 1024
const maxExecutionProtocolResponseBytes = 16 * 1024 * 1024
const maxExecutionEventPageResponseBytes = 2 * 1024 * 1024
const maxProjectSnapshotResponseBytes = coreadapter.MaxSnapshotResponseBytes
const maxExecutionReleaseProbeBytes = 4 * 1024
const maxExecutionStateProbeBytes = 64 * 1024

var executionEventTypes = map[string]bool{"RUN_STARTED": true, "PHASE_STARTED": true, "ACTION_STARTED": true, "TASK_STARTED": true, "TASK_COMPLETED": true, "ACTION_COMPLETED": true, "PHASE_COMPLETED": true, "RUN_COMPLETED": true, "DIAGNOSTIC": true}
var executionEventStatuses = map[string]bool{"PENDING": true, "RUNNING": true, "SUCCESS": true, "CHANGED": true, "SKIPPED": true, "FAILED": true, "CANCELLED": true, "INTERRUPTED": true}

var errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid = errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENTS_RESPONSE_INVALID")
var errExecutionEventResponseInvalid = errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_RESPONSE_INVALID")

func (t OpenSSHTransport) BuildDeploymentPlan(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any, deploymentOrder []string) (DeploymentPlan, error) {
	if projectRoot == "" || len(runtimeRelease) == 0 || deploymentOrder == nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	capabilities, err := t.imagePlanningCapabilities(ctx, node, "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1")
	if err == nil && imagePlanCapabilitySupported(capabilities) {
		return t.buildDeploymentPlanRequest(ctx, node, projectRoot, map[string]any{"apiVersion": imagePlanRequestVersion, "runtimeRelease": runtimeRelease, "deploymentOrder": deploymentOrder,
			"executionMode": string(FullProject), "applicationVaultSources": map[string]string{}, "skipInfrastructureVerify": false}, capabilities)
	}
	if err != nil || !orderedDeploymentPlanRequestSupported(capabilities) {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_ORDER_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	return t.buildDeploymentPlanRequest(ctx, node, projectRoot, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha2", "runtimeRelease": runtimeRelease, "deploymentOrder": deploymentOrder}, capabilities)
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) buildDeploymentPlanRequest(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, request, capability map[string]any) (DeploymentPlan, error) {
	runID, err := newRunID()
	if err != nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, err
	}
	if err := t.stagePlanProject(ctx, node, projectRoot, runID, "plan"); err != nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, err
	}
	request["operation"], request["runId"], request["project"] = "BuildDeploymentPlan", runID, "/var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/"+runID+"/project"
	if request["apiVersion"] == availabilityPlanRequestVersion || request["apiVersion"] == imagePlanRequestVersion || (request["apiVersion"] == selectionPlanRequestVersion || request["apiVersion"] == serviceSelectionRequestVersion) {
		feature, _ := capability["applicationImagePlanning"].(map[string]any)
		canonicalPlanContext := request["apiVersion"] == availabilityPlanRequestVersion && feature["protocol"] == "RegistryAvailabilityPlanning/v1alpha2"
		if err := t.prepareApplicationImages(ctx, node, request, canonicalPlanContext); err != nil {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, err
		}
	}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, request)
	if err != nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, err
	}
	value, ok := response["deploymentPlan"].(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	if (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12") != (request["apiVersion"] == availabilityPlanRequestVersion) ||
		request["apiVersion"] == availabilityPlanRequestVersion && value["imageResolution"] != "AT_EXECUTION" {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	postInstallSupported := false
	if value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha9" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha10" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha11" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12")) {
		var probeErr error
		// Reuse this operation's negotiation only for the exact requested
		// immutable runtime. Older responses without identity retain the probe.
		if !planCapabilityMatchesRuntime(capability, request["runtimeRelease"]) {
			capability, probeErr = t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": request["apiVersion"], "operation": "GetCapabilities"})
		}
		postInstallSupported = probeErr == nil && postInstallCapabilitySupported(capability)
		if (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha10" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha11" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12")) && !applicationProgressCapabilitySupported(capability) {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		if !postInstallSupported {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("APPLICATION_POST_INSTALL_RUNTIME_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
	}
	if request["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha4" && (value["apiVersion"] != "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha5" || value["executionMode"] != request["executionMode"]) {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	if request["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha5" && (value["apiVersion"] != "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha6" || value["skipInfrastructureVerify"] != request["skipInfrastructureVerify"] || value["executionMode"] != request["executionMode"]) {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	if request["apiVersion"] == imagePlanRequestVersion && ((value["apiVersion"] != "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha7" && !((value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha9" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha10" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha11" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12"))) && postInstallSupported)) || value["skipInfrastructureVerify"] != request["skipInfrastructureVerify"] || value["executionMode"] != request["executionMode"]) {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	plan, err := decodeDeploymentPlan(value)
	if err != nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, err
	}
	if request["apiVersion"] == availabilityPlanRequestVersion {
		libraries, _ := request["skipApplicationLibraries"].([]string)
		services, _ := request["skipServiceDeployments"].([]string)
		if value["executionMode"] != request["executionMode"] || value["skipInfrastructureVerify"] != request["skipInfrastructureVerify"] || !sameLibrarySelection(libraries, plan.SkipApplicationLibraries) || !sameLibrarySelection(services, plan.SkipServiceDeployments) {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
	}
	if request["apiVersion"] == selectionPlanRequestVersion || request["apiVersion"] == serviceSelectionRequestVersion {
		requested, _ := request["skipApplicationLibraries"].([]string)
		requested = slices.Clone(requested)
		slices.Sort(requested)
		if (value["apiVersion"] != "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha8" && !((value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha9" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha10" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha11" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12"))) && postInstallSupported)) || value["executionMode"] != request["executionMode"] || value["skipInfrastructureVerify"] != request["skipInfrastructureVerify"] || !slices.Equal(requested, plan.SkipApplicationLibraries) {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
	}
	if request["apiVersion"] == serviceSelectionRequestVersion {
		requested, _ := request["skipServiceDeployments"].([]string)
		if value["apiVersion"] != "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha11" || !sameLibrarySelection(requested, plan.SkipServiceDeployments) {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
	}
	if err := bindExecutionManifest(&plan, response, runID); err != nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, err
	}
	return plan, nil
}

func planCapabilityMatchesRuntime(capability map[string]any, expected any) bool {
	release, ok := expected.(map[string]any)
	runtime, runtimeOK := capability["runtime"].(map[string]any)
	digest, _ := runtime["bundleDigest"].(string)
	core, _ := capability["coreVersion"].(string)
	catalog, _ := capability["catalogDigest"].(string)
	return ok && runtimeOK && validSHA256(digest) && core != "" && validSHA256(catalog) &&
		digest == release["bundleDigest"] &&
		core == release["coreVersion"] && catalog == release["catalogDigest"]
}

func orderedDeploymentPlanRequestSupported(response map[string]any) bool {
	if response["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha8" {
		return b0PlanCapabilitySupported(response) && contains(response["deploymentPlanRequestVersions"], "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha2")
	}
	if response["apiVersion"] != "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha6" || response["kind"] != "ExecutionCapabilities" {
		return false
	}
	allowed := []string{"apiVersion", "kind", "bootstrapProtocol", "coreVersion", "catalogDigest", "schemaDigest", "runtime", "supportedOperations", "executionStart", "targetCredentialLease", "runtimeSecretDescriptors", "serviceConfigurationPreview", "deploymentPlanRequestVersions", "projectSnapshotRequestVersions"}
	return closedKeys(response, allowed...) && contains(response["supportedOperations"], "BuildDeploymentPlan") && exactArrayOfStrings(response["deploymentPlanRequestVersions"], "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha2")
}

// A blocked plan has no execution manifest by design: it cannot enter Start.
// Only an executable plan is bound to a staged manifest and may be approved.
func bindExecutionManifest(plan *DeploymentPlan, response map[string]any, stagingID string) error {
	if plan == nil || plan.Status == "BLOCKED" {
		return nil
	}
	manifestDigest, ok := response["executionManifestDigest"].(string)
	if !ok || !validSHA256(manifestDigest) {
		return errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	plan.stagingID = stagingID
	plan.executionManifestDigest = manifestDigest
	return nil
}

// BuildProjectSnapshot is a read-only, controller-only Core query. Its project
// staging is owned by this one request and the Execution Node removes it after
// replying; it never creates an execution manifest or lifecycle run.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) BuildProjectSnapshot(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error) {
	result, err := t.BuildProjectVerificationSnapshot(ctx, node, projectRoot, runtimeRelease)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return result.Snapshot, nil
}

// ServiceConfigurationPreview is a bounded, target-free presentation result.
// It is never Project Verify evidence or execution authorization.
type ServiceConfigurationPreview struct {
	APIVersion      string                               `json:"apiVersion"`
	Kind            string                               `json:"kind"`
	ProjectRevision string                               `json:"projectRevision"`
	Services        map[string]ServiceConfigurationScope `json:"services"`
	// Populated only from attested runtime evidence after decoding the closed
	// Core response; this is Wails presentation metadata, not a Core field.
	RuntimeDigest string          `json:"runtimeDigest,omitempty"`
	Runtime       RuntimeEvidence `json:"-"`
	// Wails/browser-only safe failure metadata; not accepted from Core JSON.
	Diagnostic *Finding `json:"diagnostic,omitempty"`
}

type ServiceConfigurationScope struct {
	Configuration map[string]ServiceConfigurationValue            `json:"configuration"`
	Members       map[string]map[string]ServiceConfigurationValue `json:"members"`
}

type ServiceConfigurationValue struct {
	State  string `json:"state"`
	Source string `json:"source"`
	Value  any    `json:"value,omitempty"`
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) BuildServiceConfigurationPreview(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any) (ServiceConfigurationPreview, error) {
	if projectRoot == "" || len(runtimeRelease) == 0 {
		return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	capabilities, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "GetCapabilities"})
	if err != nil {
		return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, err
	}
	if !serviceConfigurationPreviewSupported(capabilities) {
		return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	runID, err := newRunID()
	if err != nil {
		return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, err
	}
	fullRevision, projectedRevision, err := t.stageServicePreviewProject(ctx, node, projectRoot, runID)
	if err != nil {
		return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, err
	}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "BuildServiceConfigurationPreview", "runId": runID, "runtimeRelease": runtimeRelease})
	if err != nil {
		return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, err
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(response["serviceConfigurationPreview"])
	if err != nil || len(data) > 1024*1024 {
		return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	var result ServiceConfigurationPreview
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(strings.NewReader(string(data)))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if decoder.Decode(&result) != nil || decoder.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF || result.RuntimeDigest != "" || result.Diagnostic != nil || result.APIVersion != "platform.installer/service-configuration-preview/v1alpha1" || result.Kind != "ServiceConfigurationPreview" || !validSHA256(result.ProjectRevision) || result.Services == nil || len(result.Services) > 512 {
		return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	for deploymentID, service := range result.Services {
		if len(deploymentID) > 128 || !runtimeSecretDeploymentPattern.MatchString(deploymentID) || service.Configuration == nil || service.Members == nil || len(service.Configuration) > 256 || len(service.Members) > 512 || !validPreviewValues(service.Configuration) {
			return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		for memberID, values := range service.Members {
			if len(memberID) > 128 || !runtimeSecretDeploymentPattern.MatchString(memberID) || values == nil || len(values) > 256 || !validPreviewValues(values) {
				return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_RESPONSE_INVALID")
			}
		}
	}
	runtime, ok := decodeRuntimeEvidence(response["runtimeEvidence"])
	if !ok || runtime.BundleDigest != runtimeRelease["bundleDigest"] {
		return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED")
	}
	if projectedRevision != "" {
		if result.ProjectRevision != projectedRevision {
			return ServiceConfigurationPreview{}, errors.New("SERVICE_CONFIGURATION_PREVIEW_STALE")
		}
		result.ProjectRevision = fullRevision
	}
	result.Runtime = runtime
	result.RuntimeDigest = runtime.BundleDigest
	return result, nil
}

func validPreviewValues(values map[string]ServiceConfigurationValue) bool {
	for settingID, item := range values {
		if !previewSettingIDPattern.MatchString(settingID) {
			return false
		}
		switch item.State {
		case "RESOLVED", "DEFERRED", "UNRESOLVED", "CYCLIC":
		default:
			return false
		}
		switch item.Source {
		case "ROLE_DEFAULT", "DEPLOYMENT_OVERRIDE", "MEMBER_OVERRIDE", "STATIC_REFERENCE", "RUNTIME_DEFERRED":
		default:
			return false
		}
		if item.Value != nil {
			if item.State != "RESOLVED" {
				return false
			}
			switch value := item.Value.(type) {
			case string:
				if len(value) > 4096 || !utf8.ValidString(value) {
					return false
				}
			case float64:
				if math.IsNaN(value) || math.IsInf(value, 0) {
					return false
				}
			case bool:
			default:
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

// BuildProjectVerificationSnapshot is additive to the UI-01B snapshot query:
// it returns the same read-only Core snapshot plus identity attested by the
// active immutable runtime that executed it.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) BuildProjectVerificationSnapshot(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any) (ProjectVerificationSnapshot, error) {
	if projectRoot == "" || len(runtimeRelease) == 0 {
		return ProjectVerificationSnapshot{}, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	runID, err := newRunID()
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectVerificationSnapshot{}, err
	}
	if err := t.stagePlanProject(ctx, node, projectRoot, runID, "snapshot"); err != nil {
		return ProjectVerificationSnapshot{}, err
	}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{
		"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1",
		"operation":  "BuildProjectSnapshot", "runId": runID,
		"runtimeRelease": runtimeRelease,
	})
	if err != nil {
		return ProjectVerificationSnapshot{}, err
	}
	value, ok := response["projectSnapshot"]
	if !ok {
		return ProjectVerificationSnapshot{}, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil || len(data) > maxProjectSnapshotResponseBytes {
		return ProjectVerificationSnapshot{}, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	snapshot, err := coreadapter.DecodeSnapshot(data)
	if err != nil || snapshot.ProjectRevision == "" {
		return ProjectVerificationSnapshot{}, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	runtime, ok := decodeRuntimeEvidence(response["runtimeEvidence"])
	if !ok {
		return ProjectVerificationSnapshot{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED")
	}
	return ProjectVerificationSnapshot{Snapshot: snapshot, Runtime: runtime}, nil
}

func decodeRuntimeEvidence(raw any) (RuntimeEvidence, bool) {
	value, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
	if !ok || len(value) != 4 {
		return RuntimeEvidence{}, false
	}
	evidence := RuntimeEvidence{}
	var fields = []struct {
		key    string
		target *string
	}{
		{"bundleDigest", &evidence.BundleDigest}, {"coreVersion", &evidence.CoreVersion},
		{"catalogDigest", &evidence.CatalogDigest}, {"protocol", &evidence.Protocol},
	}
	for _, field := range fields {
		value, ok := value[field.key].(string)
		if !ok || value == "" || len(value) > 256 {
			return RuntimeEvidence{}, false
		}
		*field.target = value
	}
	if !validSHA256(evidence.BundleDigest) || !validSHA256(evidence.CatalogDigest) {
		return RuntimeEvidence{}, false
	}
	return evidence, true
}

// BuildCandidateProjectSnapshot proves a complete transient candidate through
// a separately negotiated fixed request. Older read-only snapshot runtimes are
// never treated as candidate-capable.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) BuildCandidateProjectSnapshot(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any, request CandidateProjectSnapshotRequest) (*coreadapter.Snapshot, error) {
	if request.RequestID == "" {
		value := make([]byte, 16)
		if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		request.RequestID = hex.EncodeToString(value)
	}
	ownedSeen := make(map[string]bool)
	ownedValid := len(request.InstallerOwnedLogicalPaths) <= 1026
	for _, logical := range request.InstallerOwnedLogicalPaths {
		if !candidateOwnedPathPattern.MatchString(logical) || ownedSeen[logical] {
			ownedValid = false
		}
		ownedSeen[logical] = true
	}
	if projectRoot == "" || len(runtimeRelease) == 0 || !validLowerHex(request.RequestID, 32) || !candidateIdentityPattern.MatchString(request.ProjectIdentity) || !validSHA256(request.CandidateProjectRevision) || !validSHA256(request.ArtifactLockDigest) || !validSHA256(request.CatalogLockDigest) || !ownedValid {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	capabilities, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "GetCapabilities"})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if !candidateSnapshotCapabilitySupported(capabilities) {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_CANDIDATE_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	runID, err := newRunID()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	archiveDigest, err := t.stageCandidateProject(ctx, node, projectRoot, runID, request.RequestID)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer t.cleanupSnapshotStaging(node, runID, request.RequestID, archiveDigest)
	payload := map[string]any{
		"apiVersion": "platform.installer/project-snapshot-request/v1alpha1", "kind": "BuildProjectSnapshotRequest",
		"requestId": request.RequestID, "projectIdentity": request.ProjectIdentity,
		"candidateProjectRevision": request.CandidateProjectRevision, "projectArchiveDigest": archiveDigest,
		"artifactLockDigest": request.ArtifactLockDigest, "catalogLockDigest": request.CatalogLockDigest,
		"installerOwnedLogicalPaths": request.InstallerOwnedLogicalPaths,
		"projectContract":            "v2alpha1", "snapshotContract": "v1alpha1", "editContract": "v1alpha2",
	}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "BuildProjectSnapshot", "runId": runID, "runtimeRelease": runtimeRelease, "snapshotRequest": payload})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	value, ok := response["projectSnapshot"]
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil || len(data) > maxProjectSnapshotResponseBytes {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	snapshot, err := coreadapter.DecodeSnapshot(data)
	if err != nil || snapshot.ProjectRevision != request.CandidateProjectRevision {
		return nil, errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	return snapshot, nil
}

// BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors stages a verified candidate archive through
// the existing request-owned path, then asks only Core for safe prompts.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot string, runtimeRelease map[string]any, request RuntimeSecretDescriptorRequest) (RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult, error) {
	if projectRoot == "" || len(runtimeRelease) == 0 || !validLowerHex(request.RequestID, 32) || !candidateIdentityPattern.MatchString(request.ProjectIdentity) || !validSHA256(request.ProjectRevision) || !validSHA256(request.ArtifactLockDigest) || !validSHA256(request.CatalogLockDigest) {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	capability, err := t.CredentialStartCapability(ctx, node)
	if err != nil || (capability.APIVersion != "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha4" && capability.APIVersion != "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha5" && capability.APIVersion != "platform.installer/execution-capabilities/v1alpha6") || !capability.TypedRuntimeInputs || !capability.supportsPayloadVersion(credentialPayloadVersionV4) {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_UNSUPPORTED")
	}
	runID, err := newRunID()
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, err
	}
	archiveDigest, err := t.stageCandidateProject(ctx, node, projectRoot, runID, request.RequestID)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, err
	}
	defer t.cleanupSnapshotStaging(node, runID, request.RequestID, archiveDigest)
	payload := map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/project-snapshot-request/v1alpha1", "kind": "BuildProjectSnapshotRequest", "requestId": request.RequestID, "projectIdentity": request.ProjectIdentity, "candidateProjectRevision": request.ProjectRevision, "projectArchiveDigest": archiveDigest, "artifactLockDigest": request.ArtifactLockDigest, "catalogLockDigest": request.CatalogLockDigest, "installerOwnedLogicalPaths": []string{}, "projectContract": "v2alpha1", "snapshotContract": "v1alpha1", "editContract": "v1alpha2"}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors", "descriptorResponse": "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors/v1alpha5", "runId": runID, "runtimeRelease": runtimeRelease, "snapshotRequest": payload})
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, err
	}
	value, ok := response["runtimeSecretDescriptors"].(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	responseLimit := 64 * 1024
	if version := value["apiVersion"]; version == "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors/v1alpha3" || version == "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors/v1alpha4" || version == "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors/v1alpha5" {
		responseLimit = 256 * 1024
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(value)
	if err != nil || len(data) > responseLimit {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	var result RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult
	if err := json.Unmarshal(data, &result); err != nil || result.ProjectIdentity != request.ProjectIdentity || result.ProjectRevision != request.ProjectRevision || !validSHA256(result.DescriptorSetFingerprint) {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	if result.APIVersion == "BuildRuntimeSecretDescriptors/v1alpha5" && (result.EditorLocations == nil || len(result.EditorLocations) > 1024) {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_SECRET_DESCRIPTORS_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	result.Runtime, ok = decodeRuntimeEvidence(response["runtimeEvidence"])
	if !ok {
		return RuntimeSecretDescriptorResult{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_IDENTITY_UNCONFIRMED")
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) CheckCandidateProjectSnapshotCapability(ctx context.Context, node Node, expectedRuntime map[string]any) error {
	expectedDigest, _ := expectedRuntime["bundleDigest"].(string)
	if !validSHA256(expectedDigest) {
		return errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	active, err := t.sshBounded(ctx, node, "sudo", []string{"-n", "cat", "/var/lib/platform-installer/runtime/state/active"}, nil, maxExecutionStateProbeBytes)
	if err != nil {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: ExecutionNodeUnavailable}
	}
	if parseFacts(string(active))["BUNDLE_DIGEST"] != expectedDigest {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_RUNTIME_RELEASE_CHANGED")
	}
	capabilities, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "GetCapabilities"})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if candidateSnapshotCapabilitySupported(capabilities) {
		return nil
	}
	return errors.New("PROJECT_SNAPSHOT_CANDIDATE_UNSUPPORTED")
}

func candidateSnapshotCapabilitySupported(capabilities map[string]any) bool {
	contains := func(value any, expected string) bool {
		items, ok := value.([]any)
		if !ok {
			return false
		}
		for _, item := range items {
			if item == expected {
				return true
			}
		}
		return false
	}
	return contains(capabilities["supportedOperations"], "BuildProjectSnapshot") &&
		contains(capabilities["projectSnapshotRequestVersions"], "platform.installer/project-snapshot-request/v1alpha1")
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) cleanupSnapshotStaging(node Node, runID, requestID, archiveDigest string) {
	if !validRuntimeToken(runID) || !validLowerHex(requestID, 32) || !validSHA256(archiveDigest) {
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.Background(), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	script := "set -eu\ncase \"$1:$2:$3\" in installer-*:[0-9a-f][0-9a-f]*:sha256:*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nruntime=$(sudo -n readlink -f /var/lib/platform-installer/runtime/current)\ncase \"$runtime\" in /var/lib/platform-installer/runtime/releases/*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nsudo -n env PYTHONPATH=\"$runtime/ansible-core/tools\" python3 \"$runtime/ansible-core/tools/execution_protocol.py\" --runtime-release \"$runtime\" --controller \"$runtime/ansible-core/tools/execution_controller.py\" --cleanup-snapshot-run-id \"$1\" --cleanup-request-id \"$2\" --cleanup-archive-digest \"$3\" >/dev/null\ntemporary=/var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-plan/$1\ncase \"$temporary\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-plan/installer-*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nrm -rf -- \"$temporary\"\n"
	_, _ = t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", runID, requestID, archiveDigest}, []byte(script))
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) cleanupSnapshotUpload(parent context.Context, node Node, runID, purpose, remote string) {
	if remote == "" || remote != projectUploadPath(runID, purpose) {
		return
	}
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(context.WithoutCancel(parent), 30*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	script := "set -eu\ntemporary=$1\nrm -rf -- \"$temporary\"\n"
	_, _ = t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote}, []byte(script))
}

func projectUploadPath(runID, purpose string) string {
	if !validRuntimeToken(runID) {
		return ""
	}
	switch purpose {
	case "candidate":
		return "/var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-plan/" + runID
	case "plan", "snapshot":
		return "/var/tmp/platform-installer-project-" + runID
	default:
		return ""
	}
}

const privateProjectStageScript = `set -eu
case "$1" in /var/tmp/platform-installer-project-installer-*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac
[ -d /var/tmp ] && [ ! -L /var/tmp ] || exit 64
[ "$(stat -c %u /var/tmp)" = 0 ] && [ "$(stat -c %a /var/tmp)" = 1777 ] || exit 64
umask 077
mkdir -- "$1"
`

func (t OpenSSHTransport) stagePlanProject(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot, runID, purpose string) error {
	return t.stageProjectWithIdentity(ctx, node, projectRoot, runID, purpose, projectTransferIdentity)
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) stageProjectWithIdentity(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot, runID, purpose string, transferIdentity func(string) (string, string, error)) error {
	slot, expected, err := transferIdentity(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	hit, err := t.projectArchiveCache(ctx, node, slot, expected, "lookup", runID, purpose, "")
	if err != nil {
		return &ExecutionError{Code: "PROJECT_TRANSFER_FAILED"}
	}
	if hit {
		return nil
	}
	archive, err := createProjectArchive(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	defer os.Remove(archive)
	_, err = t.stageProjectArchive(ctx, node, archive, runID, purpose, "", slot, expected)
	return err
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) stageCandidateProject(ctx context.Context, node Node, projectRoot, runID, requestID string) (string, error) {
	archive, err := createCandidateProjectArchive(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	defer os.Remove(archive)
	return t.stageProjectArchive(ctx, node, archive, runID, "candidate", requestID)
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) stageProjectArchive(ctx context.Context, node Node, archive, runID, purpose, requestID string, cacheIdentity ...string) (string, error) {
	archiveFile, err := os.Open(archive)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	digest := sha256.New()
	_, copyErr := io.Copy(digest, archiveFile)
	closeErr := archiveFile.Close()
	if copyErr != nil {
		return "", copyErr
	}
	if closeErr != nil {
		return "", closeErr
	}
	archiveDigest := "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(digest.Sum(nil))
	if len(cacheIdentity) != 0 && (len(cacheIdentity) != 2 || cacheIdentity[1] != archiveDigest) {
		return "", errors.New("PROJECT_REVISION_CHANGED")
	}
	identity, err := t.identityFile(node.CredentialRef)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	remote := projectUploadPath(runID, purpose)
	if remote == "" {
		return "", &ExecutionError{Code: "PROJECT_TRANSFER_FAILED"}
	}
	claim := privateProjectStageScript
	if purpose == "candidate" {
		claim = "set -eu\ncase \"$1\" in /var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-plan/installer-*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\n[ -d /var/tmp ] && [ ! -L /var/tmp ] || exit 64\n[ \"$(stat -c %u /var/tmp)\" = 0 ] && [ \"$(stat -c %a /var/tmp)\" = 1777 ] || exit 64\nbase=/var/tmp/platform-installer\nparent=$base/execution-plan\n[ -d \"$base\" ] && [ ! -L \"$base\" ] || exit 64\n[ \"$(stat -c %u \"$base\")\" = 0 ] && [ \"$(stat -c %a \"$base\")\" = 711 ] || exit 64\n[ -d \"$parent\" ] && [ ! -L \"$parent\" ] || exit 64\n[ \"$(stat -c %u \"$parent\")\" = \"$(id -u)\" ] && [ \"$(stat -c %a \"$parent\")\" = 700 ] || exit 64\numask 077\nmkdir -- \"$1\"\n"
	}
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote}, []byte(claim)); err != nil {
		return "", &ExecutionError{Code: "PROJECT_TRANSFER_FAILED"}
	}
	owned := true
	defer func() {
		if owned {
			t.cleanupSnapshotUpload(ctx, node, runID, purpose, remote)
		}
	}()
	args := append(t.scpBase(node, identity), "-O", "--", archive, t.destination(node, remote+"/project.tar"))
	if _, err := t.run(ctx, "scp", args, nil); err != nil {
		return "", &ExecutionError{Code: "PROJECT_TRANSFER_FAILED"}
	}
	if len(cacheIdentity) == 2 {
		if _, err := t.projectArchiveCache(ctx, node, cacheIdentity[0], archiveDigest, "publish", runID, purpose, remote+"/project.tar"); err != nil {
			return "", &ExecutionError{Code: "PROJECT_TRANSFER_FAILED"}
		}
	}
	script := "set -eu\nrun=$1; archive=$2; run_id=$3; expected=$4; purpose=$5; request_id=${6-}\ncase \"$purpose:$run\" in candidate:/var/tmp/platform-installer/execution-plan/installer-*|plan:/var/tmp/platform-installer-project-installer-*|snapshot:/var/tmp/platform-installer-project-installer-*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\ncase \"$archive\" in \"$run/project.tar\") ;; *) exit 64;; esac\ncase \"$purpose\" in plan|snapshot|candidate) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\nactual=sha256:$(sha256sum \"$archive\" | awk '{print $1}')\n[ \"$actual\" = \"$expected\" ]\nif [ \"$purpose\" = candidate ]; then\n  runtime=$(sudo -n readlink -f /var/lib/platform-installer/runtime/current)\n  case \"$runtime\" in /var/lib/platform-installer/runtime/releases/*) ;; *) exit 64;; esac\n  sudo -n env PYTHONPATH=\"$runtime/ansible-core/tools\" python3 \"$runtime/ansible-core/tools/execution_protocol.py\" --runtime-release \"$runtime\" --controller \"$runtime/ansible-core/tools/execution_controller.py\" --stage-candidate-archive \"$archive\" --stage-run-id \"$run_id\" --stage-request-id \"$request_id\" --expected-archive-digest \"$expected\" >/dev/null\nelse\n  sudo -n install -d -m 0700 /var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/$run_id/project\n  sudo -n sh -c 'umask 077; printf \"%s\\n\" \"$1\" > \"$2\"' -- \"$actual\" /var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/$run_id/project-archive.digest\n  sudo -n tar -xf \"$archive\" -C /var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/$run_id/project\n  if [ \"$purpose\" = snapshot ]; then\n    sudo -n sh -c 'umask 077; printf \"{\\\"kind\\\":\\\"readonly\\\",\\\"runId\\\":\\\"%s\\\"}\\n\" \"$1\" > \"$2\"' -- \"$run_id\" /var/lib/platform-installer/execution/runs/$run_id/.snapshot-owner.json\n  fi\nfi\nsudo -n rm -f -- \"$archive\"\nrm -rf -- \"$run\"\n"
	if _, err := t.ssh(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s", "--", remote, remote + "/project.tar", runID, archiveDigest, purpose, requestID}, []byte(script)); err != nil {
		return "", &ExecutionError{Code: "PROJECT_TRANSFER_FAILED"}
	}
	owned = false
	return archiveDigest, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) StartExecution(ctx context.Context, node Node, request ExecutionStartRequest) (ExecutionRun, error) {
	if request.RunID == "" || request.ProjectIdentity == "" || request.PlanFingerprint == "" || len(request.RuntimeRelease) == 0 {
		return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_START_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "StartExecution", "runId": request.RunID, "projectIdentity": request.ProjectIdentity, "planFingerprint": request.PlanFingerprint, "runtimeRelease": request.RuntimeRelease})
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionRun{}, err
	}
	run, err := decodeRun(response)
	if err == nil {
		run.RunID = request.RunID
		run.ProjectIdentity = request.ProjectIdentity
	}
	return run, err
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) GetExecution(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string) (ExecutionRun, error) {
	ctx = sshpassword.WithScope(ctx, sshpassword.Scope{RunID: runID})
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "GetExecution", "runId": runID})
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionRun{}, err
	}
	run, err := decodeRun(response)
	if err == nil {
		run.RunID = runID
	}
	return run, err
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) GetEvents(ctx context.Context, node Node, runID string, afterSequence, limit int) (ExecutionEventPage, error) {
	ctx = sshpassword.WithScope(ctx, sshpassword.Scope{RunID: runID})
	if afterSequence < 0 || limit < 1 || limit > 512 {
		return ExecutionEventPage{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENTS_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocol(ctx, node, map[string]any{"apiVersion": "platform.installer/execution-runtime/v1alpha1", "operation": "GetEvents", "runId": runID, "afterSequence": afterSequence, "limit": limit})
	if err != nil {
		return ExecutionEventPage{}, err
	}
	return decodeEventPage(response, runID, afterSequence, limit)
}

	if err != nil {
