func decodeRun(response map[string]any) (ExecutionRun, error) {
	value, ok := response["run"].(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_RUN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	run := ExecutionRun{}
	if v, ok := value["runId"].(string); ok {
		run.RunID = v
	}
	if v, ok := value["projectIdentity"].(string); ok {
		run.ProjectIdentity = v
	}
	if metadata, ok := response["metadata"].(map[string]any); ok {
		if v, ok := metadata["projectIdentity"].(string); ok {
			run.ProjectIdentity = v
		}
		if run.RunID == "" {
			if v, ok := metadata["runId"].(string); ok {
				run.RunID = v
			}
		}
	}
	if v, ok := value["state"].(string); ok {
		run.State = v
	}
	if v, ok := value["sequence"].(float64); ok {
		run.Sequence = int(v)
	}
	if run.State == "" {
		return ExecutionRun{}, errors.New("EXECUTION_RUN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	return run, nil
}
func decodeEventPage(response map[string]any, runID string, afterSequence, limit int) (ExecutionEventPage, error) {
	values, ok := response["events"].([]any)
	if !ok || len(values) > 2048 {
		return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid
	}
	result := make([]ExecutionEvent, 0, len(values))
	earliestRaw, earliestExists := response["earliestSequence"]
	truncatedRaw, truncatedExists := response["historyTruncated"]
	earliest, earliestOK := earliestRaw.(float64)
	truncated, truncatedOK := truncatedRaw.(bool)
	if earliestExists != truncatedExists || earliestExists && (!earliestOK || !truncatedOK || earliest < 0 || earliest != float64(int(earliest))) {
		return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid
	}
	earliestPresent := earliestExists
	truncatedPresent := truncatedExists
	expectedSequence := afterSequence + 1
	if truncatedPresent && truncated {
		if earliest <= float64(expectedSequence) {
			return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid
		}
		expectedSequence = int(earliest)
	}
	for _, raw := range values {
		value, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventResponseInvalid
		}
		for _, key := range []string{"planFingerprint", "phaseId", "actionId", "host", "serviceDeployment"} {
			if rawValue, present := value[key]; present {
				text, valid := rawValue.(string)
				if !valid || text == "" {
					return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventResponseInvalid
				}
			}
		}
		if rawError, present := value["error"].(map[string]any); present {
			if rawDiagnostic, exists := rawError["diagnosticRef"]; exists {
				text, valid := rawDiagnostic.(string)
				if !valid || text == "" {
					return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventResponseInvalid
				}
			}
		}
		encoded, err := json.Marshal(value)
		if err != nil || len(encoded) > maxDecodedExecutionEventBytes {
			return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventResponseInvalid
		}
		event := ExecutionEvent{}
		if err := json.Unmarshal(encoded, &event); err != nil || validateExecutionEvent(event, runID) != nil || event.Sequence != expectedSequence {
			return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventResponseInvalid
		}
		result = append(result, event)
		expectedSequence++
	}
	page := ExecutionEventPage{Events: result, NextSequence: afterSequence}
	if earliestPresent {
		page.EarliestSequence = int(earliest)
		page.HistoryTruncated = truncated
	}
	nextRaw, hasNext := response["nextSequence"]
	moreRaw, hasHasMore := response["hasMore"]
	if !hasNext && !hasHasMore {
		if len(result) > 0 {
			page.NextSequence = result[len(result)-1].Sequence
		}
		return page, nil
	}
	next, nextOK := nextRaw.(float64)
	more, moreOK := moreRaw.(bool)
	if !nextOK || next < 0 || next != float64(int(next)) || !moreOK || len(result) > limit {
		return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid
	}
	page.NextSequence, page.HasMore = int(next), more
	if len(result) > 0 && page.NextSequence != result[len(result)-1].Sequence {
		return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid
	}
	if len(result) == 0 && (page.NextSequence != afterSequence || page.HasMore) {
		return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid
	}
	if page.HistoryTruncated && len(result) == 0 {
		return ExecutionEventPage{}, errExecutionEventsResponseInvalid
	}
	return page, nil
}

func validateExecutionEvent(event ExecutionEvent, runID string) error {
	if event.APIVersion != "platform.installer/event/v1alpha1" || event.Kind != "ExecutionEvent" || event.RunID != runID || event.Sequence < 1 || !executionEventTypes[event.EventType] || !executionEventStatuses[event.Status] || event.SafeMessage == "" || !event.Redaction.Applied {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, event.Timestamp); err != nil {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	if event.PlanFingerprint != "" && !validSHA256Fingerprint(event.PlanFingerprint) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	for _, value := range []string{event.SafeMessage, event.AnsibleOutput, event.PhaseID, event.ActionID, event.Host, event.ServiceDeployment} {
		if len(value) > 8192 || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\x00\r\n\x1b") {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
		}
	}
	if event.ElapsedMillis != nil && *event.ElapsedMillis < 0 {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	if event.Task != nil && (len(event.Task.UUID) > 128 || len(event.Task.Role) > 256 || len(event.Task.Name) > 512 || strings.ContainsAny(event.Task.UUID+event.Task.Role+event.Task.Name, "\x00\r\n\x1b")) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	if (event.EventType == "TASK_STARTED" || event.EventType == "TASK_COMPLETED") && (event.Task == nil || event.Task.UUID == "") {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	if event.Error != nil && (!validEventCode(event.Error.Code) || event.Error.Summary == "" || len(event.Error.Summary) > 2048 || len(event.Error.DiagnosticRef) > 2048 || strings.ContainsAny(event.Error.Summary+event.Error.DiagnosticRef, "\x00\r\n\x1b")) {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	if len(event.Redaction.Fields) > 64 {
		return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
	}
	seenRedactions := map[string]bool{}
	for _, field := range event.Redaction.Fields {
		if field == "" || len(field) > 256 || strings.ContainsAny(field, "\x00\r\n\x1b") || seenRedactions[field] {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
		}
		seenRedactions[field] = true
		if field == "task.name" && event.Task != nil && event.Task.Name != "" {
			return errors.New("EXECUTION_EVENT_INVALID")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validSHA256Fingerprint(value string) bool {
	if len(value) != len("sha256:")+64 || !strings.HasPrefix(value, "sha256:") {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range value[len("sha256:"):] {
		if (character < '0' || character > '9') && (character < 'a' || character > 'f') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validEventCode(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || len(value) > 128 || value[0] < 'A' || value[0] > 'Z' {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range value[1:] {
		if character != '_' && (character < 'A' || character > 'Z') && (character < '0' || character > '9') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}
func decodeDeploymentPlan(value map[string]any) (DeploymentPlan, error) {
	plan := DeploymentPlan{}
	if value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha11" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12" && value["serviceExecutionScope"] != nil {
		values, ok := value["skipServiceDeployments"].([]any)
		if !ok || len(values) > 256 {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		seen := map[string]bool{}
		for _, raw := range values {
			id, ok := raw.(string)
			if !ok || seen[id] || !runtimeSecretDeploymentPattern.MatchString(id) {
				return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
			}
			seen[id] = true
			plan.SkipServiceDeployments = append(plan.SkipServiceDeployments, id)
		}
	}
	if value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha8" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha9" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha10" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha11" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12"))) {
		values, ok := value["skipApplicationLibraries"].([]any)
		if !ok {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		for _, raw := range values {
			id, ok := raw.(string)
			if !ok {
				return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
			}
			plan.SkipApplicationLibraries = append(plan.SkipApplicationLibraries, id)
		}
	}
	if value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha7" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha8" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha9" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha10" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha11" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12")))) {
		skip, ok := value["skipInfrastructureVerify"].(bool)
		if !ok || skip && value["executionMode"] != string(ApplicationLibrariesOnly) {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		plan.SkipInfrastructureVerify = skip
	}
	if value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha6" {
		if value["skipInfrastructureVerify"] != true || value["executionMode"] != string(ApplicationLibrariesOnly) {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		plan.SkipInfrastructureVerify = true
	}
	if value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha5" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha6" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha7" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha8" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha9" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha10" || (value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha11" || value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12")))) {
		mode, ok := value["executionMode"].(string)
		plan.ExecutionMode = ExecutionMode(mode)
		if !ok || !plan.ExecutionMode.valid() {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		var err error
		plan.InfrastructureVerification, err = decodeInfrastructureVerification(value["infrastructureVerification"])
		if err != nil {
			return DeploymentPlan{}, err
		}
	}
	if v, ok := value["id"].(string); ok {
		plan.ID = v
	}
	if v, ok := value["status"].(string); ok {
		plan.Status = v
	}
	if v, ok := value["projectIdentity"].(string); ok {
		plan.ProjectIdentity = v
	}
	if v, ok := value["projectRevision"].(string); ok {
		plan.ProjectRevision = v
	}
	if f, ok := value["fingerprints"].(map[string]any); ok {
		if v, ok := f["plan"].(string); ok {
			plan.PlanFingerprint = v
		}
	}
	acknowledgements, err := decodePlanAcknowledgements(value["acknowledgements"])
	if err != nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, err
	}
	plan.AcknowledgementDetails = acknowledgements
	for _, acknowledgement := range acknowledgements {
		plan.Acknowledgements = append(plan.Acknowledgements, acknowledgement.Code)
	}
	phases, err := decodeDeploymentPlanPhases(value["phases"])
	if err != nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, err
	}
	plan.Phases = phases
	plan.Findings = decodeFindings(value["findings"])
	if requirements, ok := value["artifactRequirements"].([]any); ok {
		for _, raw := range requirements {
			item, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
			if !ok {
				return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
			}
			if item["artifactType"] == "container-image" {
				image, err := decodeApplicationImage(item, value["apiVersion"] == "platform.installer/plan/v1alpha12")
				if err != nil {
					return DeploymentPlan{}, err
				}
				plan.ApplicationImages = append(plan.ApplicationImages, image)
				continue
			}
			requirement := artifactsource.Requirement{}
			if v, ok := item["requirementId"].(string); ok {
				requirement.ID = v
			}
			if v, ok := item["name"].(string); ok {
				requirement.Name = v
			}
			if v, ok := item["version"].(string); ok {
				requirement.Version = v
			}
			if v, ok := item["os"].(string); ok {
				requirement.OS = v
			}
			if v, ok := item["architecture"].(string); ok {
				requirement.Architecture = v
			}
			if requirement.ID == "" || requirement.Name == "" || requirement.OS == "" || requirement.Architecture == "" {
				return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_REQUIREMENT_INVALID")
			}
			plan.ArtifactRequirements = append(plan.ArtifactRequirements, requirement)
			id, _ := item["id"].(string)
			deployment, _ := item["serviceDeployment"].(string)
			if id != "" && deployment != "" {
				for index := range plan.Findings {
					finding := &plan.Findings[index]
					if finding.field == "artifactRequirements."+id {
						finding.ServiceDeployment = deployment
						finding.ArtifactName = requirement.Name
						finding.ArtifactVersion = requirement.Version
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	credentials, err := decodeRequiredCredentials(value["requiredCredentials"])
	if err != nil {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, err
	}
	plan.RequiredCredentials = credentials
	if r, ok := value["runtimeRelease"].(map[string]any); ok {
		plan.RuntimeRelease = r
	}
	if plan.ID == "" || plan.ProjectRevision == "" || plan.PlanFingerprint == "" || len(plan.RuntimeRelease) == 0 || (plan.Status != "EXECUTABLE" && plan.Status != "BLOCKED") || (plan.Status == "EXECUTABLE" && plan.ProjectIdentity == "") {
		return DeploymentPlan{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	return plan, nil
}

func decodeRequiredCredentials(raw any) ([]RequiredCredential, error) {
	values, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	result := make([]RequiredCredential, 0, len(values))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, rawValue := range values {
		value, ok := rawValue.(map[string]any)
		if !ok || !closedKeys(value, "requirementRef", "purpose", "hosts") {
			return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		ref, refOK := value["requirementRef"].(string)
		purpose, purposeOK := value["purpose"].(string)
		hostValues, hostsOK := value["hosts"].([]any)
		if !refOK || !purposeOK || !hostsOK || ref == "" || len(ref) > 128 || purpose == "" || len(purpose) > 128 || seen[ref] || len(hostValues) > maxDeploymentPlanTargets {
			return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		credential := RequiredCredential{RequirementRef: ref, Purpose: purpose, Hosts: make([]string, 0, len(hostValues))}
		prior := ""
		for _, rawHost := range hostValues {
			host, ok := rawHost.(string)
			if !ok || !candidateIdentityPattern.MatchString(host) || host <= prior {
				return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
			}
			credential.Hosts = append(credential.Hosts, host)
			prior = host
		}
		seen[ref] = true
		result = append(result, credential)
	}
	return result, nil
}

const (
	maxDeploymentPlanPhases           = 32
	maxDeploymentPlanActions          = 512
	maxDeploymentPlanTargets          = 256
	maxDeploymentPlanDependencies     = 256
	maxDeploymentPlanAcknowledgements = 64
	maxDeploymentPlanText             = 512
)

func decodePlanAcknowledgements(raw any) ([]PlanAcknowledgement, error) {
	values, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok || len(values) > maxDeploymentPlanAcknowledgements {
		return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	result := make([]PlanAcknowledgement, 0, len(values))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, rawValue := range values {
		value, ok := rawValue.(map[string]any)
		if !ok || len(value) != 2 {
			return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		code, codeOK := value["code"].(string)
		summary, summaryOK := value["summary"].(string)
		if !codeOK || !summaryOK || !validEventCode(code) || len(summary) == 0 || len(summary) > maxDeploymentPlanText || seen[code] {
			return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		seen[code] = true
		result = append(result, PlanAcknowledgement{Code: code, Summary: summary})
	}
	return result, nil
}

func decodeDeploymentPlanPhases(raw any) ([]DeploymentPlanPhase, error) {
	values, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok || len(values) > maxDeploymentPlanPhases {
		return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	result := make([]DeploymentPlanPhase, 0, len(values))
	seenPhases, seenActions := map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}
	actionCount := 0
	for index, rawValue := range values {
		value, ok := rawValue.(map[string]any)
		if !ok || len(value) != 3 {
			return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		id, idOK := value["id"].(string)
		order, orderOK := exactNonNegativeInteger(value["order"])
		rawActions, actionsOK := value["actions"].([]any)
		if !idOK || !orderOK || order != index || len(id) == 0 || len(id) > maxDeploymentPlanText || seenPhases[id] {
			return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		if !actionsOK || actionCount+len(rawActions) > maxDeploymentPlanActions {
			return nil, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		seenPhases[id] = true
		phase := DeploymentPlanPhase{ID: id, Order: order, Actions: make([]DeploymentPlanAction, 0, len(rawActions))}
		for _, rawAction := range rawActions {
			action, err := decodeDeploymentPlanAction(rawAction, seenActions)
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			phase.Actions = append(phase.Actions, action)
			actionCount++
		}
		result = append(result, phase)
	}
	return result, nil
}

func decodeDeploymentPlanAction(raw any, seen map[string]bool) (DeploymentPlanAction, error) {
	value, ok := raw.(map[string]any)
	if !ok {
		return DeploymentPlanAction{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	keys := []string{"id", "type", "targets", "dependsOn", "mutating", "reboot", "summary"}
	if _, present := value["serviceDeployment"]; present {
		keys = append(keys, "serviceDeployment")
	}
	if _, present := value["progressSteps"]; present {
		keys = append(keys, "progressSteps")
	}
	if !closedKeys(value, keys...) {
		return DeploymentPlanAction{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	action := DeploymentPlanAction{}
	var idOK, typeOK, summaryOK, mutatingOK bool
	action.ID, idOK = value["id"].(string)
	action.Type, typeOK = value["type"].(string)
	action.Summary, summaryOK = value["summary"].(string)
	action.Mutating, mutatingOK = value["mutating"].(bool)
	if deployment, present := value["serviceDeployment"]; present {
		var deploymentOK bool
		action.ServiceDeployment, deploymentOK = deployment.(string)
		if !deploymentOK || action.ServiceDeployment == "" || len(action.ServiceDeployment) > maxDeploymentPlanText {
			return DeploymentPlanAction{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
	}
	if reboot, ok := value["reboot"].(string); ok && (reboot == "NONE" || reboot == "RECOMMENDED" || reboot == "REQUIRED") {
		action.Reboot = reboot
	} else {
		return DeploymentPlanAction{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	targets, targetOK := decodePlanStringList(value["targets"], maxDeploymentPlanTargets)
	dependsOn, dependsOK := decodePlanStringList(value["dependsOn"], maxDeploymentPlanDependencies)
	if !idOK || !typeOK || !summaryOK || !mutatingOK || !validEventCode(action.Type) || len(action.ID) == 0 || len(action.ID) > maxDeploymentPlanText || len(action.Summary) == 0 || len(action.Summary) > maxDeploymentPlanText || !targetOK || !dependsOK || seen[action.ID] {
		return DeploymentPlanAction{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	seen[action.ID] = true
	action.Targets, action.DependsOn = targets, dependsOn
	if rawSteps, present := value["progressSteps"]; present {
		steps, ok := rawSteps.([]any)
		if !ok || len(steps) == 0 || len(steps) > 257 || action.ID != "applications:apply" || action.Type != "APPLICATION_LIBRARIES_APPLY" {
			return DeploymentPlanAction{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
		}
		for _, rawStep := range steps {
			step, ok := rawStep.(map[string]any)
			if !ok || !closedKeys(step, "id", "summary") {
				return DeploymentPlanAction{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
			}
			id, idOK := step["id"].(string)
			summary, summaryOK := step["summary"].(string)
			if !idOK || !summaryOK || id == "" || len(id) > maxDeploymentPlanText || summary == "" || len(summary) > maxDeploymentPlanText || seen[id] {
				return DeploymentPlanAction{}, errors.New("DEPLOYMENT_PLAN_RESPONSE_INVALID")
			}
			seen[id] = true
			action.ProgressSteps = append(action.ProgressSteps, DeploymentProgressStep{ID: id, Summary: summary})
		}
	}
	return action, nil
}

func decodePlanStringList(raw any, limit int) ([]string, bool) {
	values, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok || len(values) > limit {
		return nil, false
	}
	result := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, rawValue := range values {
		value, ok := rawValue.(string)
		if !ok || value == "" || len(value) > maxDeploymentPlanText || seen[value] {
			return nil, false
		}
		seen[value] = true
		result = append(result, value)
	}
	return result, true
}

func exactNonNegativeInteger(raw any) (int, bool) {
	value, ok := raw.(float64)
	if !ok || value < 0 || value != float64(int(value)) || int(value) < 0 {
		return 0, false
	}
	return int(value), true
}

func decodeFindings(raw any) []Finding {
	values, ok := raw.([]any)
	if !ok {
		return nil
	}
	result := make([]Finding, 0, len(values))
	for _, rawFinding := range values {
		value, ok := rawFinding.(map[string]any)
		if !ok {
			continue
		}
		code, codeOK := value["code"].(string)
		message, messageOK := value["safeMessage"].(string)
		if codeOK && messageOK && code != "" && message != "" {
			field, _ := value["field"].(string)
			if len(field) > 512 {
				field = ""
			}
			result = append(result, Finding{Code: code, SafeMessage: message, field: field})
		}
	}
	return result
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) runtimeProtocol(ctx context.Context, node Node, request map[string]any) (map[string]any, error) {
	return t.runtimeProtocolWithPrivateFlag(ctx, node, request, "")
}

// StageTargetHostTrust is private execution input, not a public Start wire
// field or portable project mutation. The node verifies the Core-resolved
// endpoints and binds the resulting file to the exact staged manifest.
func (t OpenSSHTransport) StageTargetHostTrust(ctx context.Context, node Node, plan DeploymentPlan, approvals []TargetHostKeyApproval) error {
	if plan.stagingID == "" || !validSHA256(plan.executionManifestDigest) || len(approvals) == 0 || len(approvals) > 256 {
		return errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_INVALID")
	}
	response, err := t.runtimeProtocolWithPrivateFlag(ctx, node, map[string]any{
		"stagingId": plan.stagingID, "projectIdentity": plan.ProjectIdentity,
		"projectRevision": plan.ProjectRevision, "planFingerprint": plan.PlanFingerprint,
		"runtimeRelease": plan.RuntimeRelease, "manifestDigest": plan.executionManifestDigest,
		"approvals": approvals,
	}, "--stage-target-host-trust")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if response["status"] != "STAGED" {
		return errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_INVALID")
	}
	return nil
}

// Fixed node-side launcher: resolve/validate the active immutable runtime and
// exec the protocol in the same SSH process. Request bytes stay on private stdin.
const runtimeProtocolLauncher = `import os, sys
try:
    root = "/var/lib/platform-installer/runtime"
    release = os.path.realpath(root + "/current")
    if len(release.encode()) > 4096 or not release.startswith(root + "/releases/") or any(c in release for c in " \t\r\n"):
        sys.exit(70)
    with open(root + "/state/active", "rb") as stream:
        active = stream.read(65537)
    if len(active) > 65536:
        sys.exit(70)
    facts = dict(line.split("=", 1) for line in active.decode().split("\n") if "=" in line)
    digest = facts.get("BUNDLE_DIGEST", "")
    if not digest.startswith("sha256:") or len(digest) != 71:
        sys.exit(70)
    tools = release + "/ansible-core/tools"
    os.environ["PYTHONPATH"] = tools
    os.execv(sys.executable, [sys.executable, tools + "/execution_protocol.py", "--runtime-release", release, "--bundle-digest", digest, "--controller", tools + "/execution_controller.py"] + sys.argv[1:])
except (OSError, UnicodeError):
    sys.exit(70)
`

func (t OpenSSHTransport) runtimeProtocolWithPrivateFlag(ctx context.Context, node Node, request map[string]any, flag string) (map[string]any, error) {
	payload, err := json.Marshal(request)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	args := []string{"-n", "python3", "-c", "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(runtimeProtocolLauncher, "'", "'\\''") + "'"}
	if flag != "" {
		if flag != "--stage-target-host-trust" || len(payload) > 65536 {
			return nil, errors.New("TARGET_HOST_TRUST_INVALID")
		}
		args = append(args, flag)
	}
	responseLimit := maxExecutionProtocolResponseBytes
	if request["operation"] == "GetEvents" {
		responseLimit = maxExecutionEventPageResponseBytes
	} else if request["operation"] == "BuildProjectSnapshot" {
		responseLimit = maxProjectSnapshotResponseBytes
	}
	output, err := t.sshBounded(ctx, node, "sudo", args, payload, responseLimit)
	var response map[string]any
	decodeErr := errors.New("EXECUTION_PROTOCOL_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	if len(output) <= maxExecutionProtocolResponseBytes {
		decodeErr = json.Unmarshal(output, &response)
	}
	if decodeErr != nil {
		if err != nil {
			return nil, &ExecutionError{Code: ExecutionNodeUnavailable}
		}
		return nil, errors.New("EXECUTION_PROTOCOL_RESPONSE_INVALID")
	}
	if code, ok := response["error"].(string); ok && code != "" {
		var findings []Finding
		if diagnostic, ok := response["diagnostic"].(map[string]any); ok {
			findings = decodeFindings(diagnostic["findings"])
		}
		return response, &ExecutionError{Code: code, Findings: findings}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, &ExecutionError{Code: ExecutionNodeUnavailable}
	}
	return response, nil
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/executionnode/runtime_unpack.py","mode":420,"size":3452,"sha256":"6fa5b23f600ab40d40b9b8a1a3704fcd8a92243f2e0c313eb673a475ab78db8a","index":0,"count":1,"newline":"lf","encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":3452}
# Sent by the Installer over authenticated SSH, before using any bundle code.
import base64
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import stat
import sys
import tarfile


class BoundedHeader(tarfile.TarInfo):
    # Reject oversized extended headers before tarfile allocates their payload.
    def _extension(self, archive, parse):
        depth = getattr(archive, "bundle_header_depth", 0)
        if not 0 < self.size <= 65536 or depth >= 4:
            raise ValueError("oversized or nested bundle header")
        archive.bundle_header_depth = depth + 1
        try:
            return parse(archive)
        finally:
            archive.bundle_header_depth = depth

    def _proc_pax(self, archive):
        return self._extension(archive, super()._proc_pax)

    def _proc_gnulong(self, archive):
        return self._extension(archive, super()._proc_gnulong)

    def _reject_sparse(self, *args):
        raise ValueError("sparse bundle member")

    _proc_sparse = _reject_sparse
    _proc_gnusparse_00 = _reject_sparse
    _proc_gnusparse_01 = _reject_sparse
    _proc_gnusparse_10 = _reject_sparse


def verified_unpack(stage, candidate, entries):
    expected = {}
    for entry in entries:
        name = entry["path"]
        if name in expected or any(part in ("", ".", "..") for part in name.split("/")):
            raise ValueError("invalid expected path")
        expected[name] = (entry["size"], entry["sha256"])

    directory = os.open(stage, os.O_RDONLY | os.O_DIRECTORY | os.O_NOFOLLOW)
    try:
        descriptor = os.open("bundle.tar", os.O_RDONLY | os.O_NOFOLLOW | os.O_NONBLOCK, dir_fd=directory)
        with os.fdopen(descriptor, "rb") as source:
            info = os.fstat(source.fileno())
            if not stat.S_ISREG(info.st_mode) or info.st_nlink != 1 or info.st_uid != os.fstat(directory).st_uid:
                raise ValueError("unsafe archive")
            with tarfile.open(fileobj=source, mode="r|", tarinfo=BoundedHeader, bufsize=1024 * 1024) as archive:
                for member in archive:
                    size, digest = expected.pop(member.name)
                    if member.type not in (tarfile.REGTYPE, tarfile.AREGTYPE) or member.sparse is not None or member.size != size:
                        raise ValueError("unexpected member type or size")
                    target = candidate / member.name
                    target.parent.mkdir(mode=0o750, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
                    checksum = hashlib.sha256()
                    with archive.extractfile(member) as data, target.open("xb") as output:
                        while block := data.read(1024 * 1024):
                            checksum.update(block)
                            output.write(block)
                    if "sha256:" + checksum.hexdigest() != digest:
                        raise ValueError("component checksum mismatch")
            if expected:
                raise ValueError("bundle components missing")
            for directory_name in ("runtime/packages", "runtime/python"):
                (candidate / directory_name).mkdir(mode=0o750, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    finally:
        os.close(directory)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    os.umask(0o027)
    try:
        verified_unpack(sys.argv[1], Path(sys.argv[2]), json.loads(base64.b64decode(verified_manifest)))
    except (OSError, EOFError, ValueError, KeyError, tarfile.TarError):
        sys.exit(78)

package executionnode

import (

const secretOutputProtocol = "SecretOutputDelivery/v1alpha1"

const (
	maxSecretOutputRequestBytes  = 8 * 1024
	maxSecretOutputResponseBytes = 64 * 1024
	maxSecretOutputStderrBytes   = 4 * 1024
)

var errSecretOutputProtocol = errors.New("SECRET_OUTPUT_PROTOCOL_UNAVAILABLE")
var ErrSecretOutputRecoveryRequired = errors.New("OUTPUT_RECOVERY_REQUIRED")
var secretOutputOpaqueID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9a-f]{32}$`)
var secretOutputDeploymentID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
var secretOutputSourceRunID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]{0,127}$`)

type SecretOutputPackage struct {
	Protocol      string   `json:"protocol"`
	PackageID     string   `json:"packageId"`
	ProjectID     string   `json:"projectId"`
	DeploymentID  string   `json:"deploymentId"`
	SourceRunID   string   `json:"sourceRunId"`
	RuntimeDigest string   `json:"runtimeDigest"`
	Generation    int      `json:"generation"`
	State         string   `json:"state"`
	Entries       []string `json:"entries"`

type SecretOutputCapabilities struct {
	Protocol        string   `json:"protocol"`
	Operation       string   `json:"operation"`
	MaxPayloadBytes int      `json:"maxPayloadBytes"`
	Operations      []string `json:"operations"`

type SecretOutputList struct {
	Protocol   string                `json:"protocol"`
	Operation  string                `json:"operation"`
	ProjectID  string                `json:"projectId"`

type SecretOutputAck struct {
	Protocol   string `json:"protocol"`
	Operation  string `json:"operation"`
	ProjectID  string `json:"projectId"`
	PackageID  string `json:"packageId"`
	Generation int    `json:"generation"`
	ReceiptID  string `json:"receiptId"`
	State      string `json:"state"`
}

// SecretOutputRequest is a closed-operation transport input. It accepts only
// the protocol's fixed request fields; no remote path or command is exposed.
type SecretOutputRequest struct {
	Operation         string
	ProjectID         string
	Limit             int
	Cursor            *string
	PackageID         string
	Generation        int
	ReceiptID         string
	CiphertextDigests map[string]string
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) GetSecretOutputCapabilities(ctx context.Context, node Node, expectedRuntimeDigest, projectID string) (SecretOutputCapabilities, error) {
	request := SecretOutputRequest{Operation: "GetCapabilities", ProjectID: projectID}
	data, err := t.callSecretOutputProtocol(ctx, node, expectedRuntimeDigest, request, false)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputCapabilities{}, err
	}
	var result SecretOutputCapabilities
	if err := decodeClosedJSON(data, &result); err != nil || result.Protocol != secretOutputProtocol || result.Operation != request.Operation || result.MaxPayloadBytes != maxSecretOutputResponseBytes || len(result.Operations) != 3 || result.Operations[0] != "ListPending" || result.Operations[1] != "Fetch" || result.Operations[2] != "Acknowledge" {
		return SecretOutputCapabilities{}, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) ListPendingSecretOutputs(ctx context.Context, node Node, expectedRuntimeDigest, projectID string, limit int, cursor *string) (SecretOutputList, error) {
	request := SecretOutputRequest{Operation: "ListPending", ProjectID: projectID, Limit: limit, Cursor: cursor}
	data, err := t.callSecretOutputProtocol(ctx, node, expectedRuntimeDigest, request, false)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputList{}, err
	}
	var result SecretOutputList
	if err := decodeClosedJSON(data, &result); err != nil || result.Protocol != secretOutputProtocol || result.Operation != request.Operation || result.ProjectID != projectID || result.Packages == nil || len(result.Packages) > limit {
		return SecretOutputList{}, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	if result.NextCursor != nil && !secretOutputOpaqueID.MatchString(*result.NextCursor) {
		return SecretOutputList{}, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(result.Packages))
	for _, item := range result.Packages {
		if item.Protocol != secretOutputProtocol || !secretOutputOpaqueID.MatchString(item.PackageID) || seen[item.PackageID] || item.ProjectID != projectID || !secretOutputDeploymentID.MatchString(item.DeploymentID) || len(item.DeploymentID) > 128 || !secretOutputSourceRunID.MatchString(item.SourceRunID) || !validSHA256(item.RuntimeDigest) || item.Generation < 1 || item.Generation > 2147483647 || (item.State != "READY" && item.State != "ACKED_CLEANUP_PENDING") || len(item.Entries) != 2 || item.Entries[0] != "admin-token" || item.Entries[1] != "unseal-shares" {
			return SecretOutputList{}, errSecretOutputProtocol
		}
		seen[item.PackageID] = true
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) FetchSecretOutput(ctx context.Context, node Node, expectedRuntimeDigest, projectID, packageID string, generation int) ([]byte, error) {
	if !secretOutputOpaqueID.MatchString(packageID) || generation < 1 {
		return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	return t.callSecretOutputProtocol(ctx, node, expectedRuntimeDigest, SecretOutputRequest{Operation: "Fetch", ProjectID: projectID, PackageID: packageID, Generation: generation}, true)
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) AcknowledgeSecretOutput(ctx context.Context, node Node, expectedRuntimeDigest string, request SecretOutputRequest) (SecretOutputAck, error) {
	if request.Operation != "Acknowledge" || !secretOutputOpaqueID.MatchString(request.PackageID) || !secretOutputOpaqueID.MatchString(request.ReceiptID) || request.Generation < 1 || len(request.CiphertextDigests) != 2 || !validSHA256(request.CiphertextDigests["admin-token"]) || !validSHA256(request.CiphertextDigests["unseal-shares"]) {
		return SecretOutputAck{}, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	data, err := t.callSecretOutputProtocol(ctx, node, expectedRuntimeDigest, request, false)
	if err != nil {
		return SecretOutputAck{}, err
	}
	var result SecretOutputAck
	if err := decodeClosedJSON(data, &result); err != nil || result.Protocol != secretOutputProtocol || result.Operation != "Acknowledge" || result.ProjectID != request.ProjectID || result.PackageID != request.PackageID || result.Generation != request.Generation || result.ReceiptID != request.ReceiptID || (result.State != "DELIVERED" && result.State != "ACKED_CLEANUP_PENDING") {
		return SecretOutputAck{}, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	return result, nil
}

func (t OpenSSHTransport) callSecretOutputProtocol(ctx context.Context, node Node, expectedRuntimeDigest string, request SecretOutputRequest, binaryResponse bool) ([]byte, error) {
	if !validSHA256(expectedRuntimeDigest) || !candidateIdentityPattern.MatchString(request.ProjectID) {
		return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	body := map[string]any{"protocol": secretOutputProtocol, "operation": request.Operation, "projectId": request.ProjectID}
	switch request.Operation {
	case "GetCapabilities":
	case "ListPending":
		if request.Limit < 1 || request.Limit > 32 {
			return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
		}
		body["limit"] = request.Limit
		if request.Cursor != nil {
			if !secretOutputOpaqueID.MatchString(*request.Cursor) {
				return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
			}
			body["cursor"] = *request.Cursor
		}
	case "Fetch":
		if !secretOutputOpaqueID.MatchString(request.PackageID) || request.Generation < 1 {
			return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
		}
		body["packageId"], body["expectedGeneration"] = request.PackageID, request.Generation
	case "Acknowledge":
		if !secretOutputOpaqueID.MatchString(request.PackageID) || !secretOutputOpaqueID.MatchString(request.ReceiptID) || request.Generation < 1 || len(request.CiphertextDigests) != 2 || !validSHA256(request.CiphertextDigests["admin-token"]) || !validSHA256(request.CiphertextDigests["unseal-shares"]) {
			return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
		}
		body["packageId"], body["expectedGeneration"] = request.PackageID, request.Generation
		body["receiptId"], body["ciphertextDigests"] = request.ReceiptID, request.CiphertextDigests
	default:
		return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	input, err := json.Marshal(body)
	if err != nil || len(input) > maxSecretOutputRequestBytes {
		return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	root := "/var/lib/platform-installer/runtime"
	releaseOutput, err := t.sshBounded(ctx, node, "sudo", []string{"-n", "readlink", "-f", root + "/current"}, nil, maxExecutionReleaseProbeBytes)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	release := strings.TrimSpace(string(releaseOutput))
	if !strings.HasPrefix(release, root+"/releases/") || strings.ContainsAny(release, " \t\r\n") {
		return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	active, err := t.sshBounded(ctx, node, "sudo", []string{"-n", "cat", root + "/state/active"}, nil, maxExecutionStateProbeBytes)
	if err != nil || parseFacts(string(active))["BUNDLE_DIGEST"] != expectedRuntimeDigest {
		return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	limit := maxSecretOutputResponseBytes
	if binaryResponse {
		limit = maxSecretOutputResponseBytes
	}
	args := []string{"-n", "env", "PYTHONPATH=" + release + "/ansible-core/tools", "python3", release + "/ansible-core/tools/execution_secret_output_protocol.py"}
	output, err := t.sshSeparatedBounded(ctx, node, "sudo", args, input, limit, maxSecretOutputStderrBytes)
	var failure struct {
		Protocol  string `json:"protocol"`
		Operation string `json:"operation"`
		ErrorCode string `json:"errorCode"`
	}
	if decodeClosedJSON(output, &failure) == nil && failure.Protocol == secretOutputProtocol && failure.Operation == request.Operation && failure.ErrorCode == "OUTPUT_RECOVERY_REQUIRED" {
		return nil, ErrSecretOutputRecoveryRequired
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	return output, nil
}

func decodeClosedJSON(data []byte, target any) error {
	if len(data) == 0 || !uniqueJSONKeys(data) {
		return errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	decoder.DisallowUnknownFields()
	if err := decoder.Decode(target); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	var extra any
	if err := decoder.Decode(&extra); !errors.Is(err, io.EOF) {
		return errSecretOutputProtocol
	}
	return nil
}

func uniqueJSONKeys(data []byte) bool {
	decoder := json.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(data))
	if !scanUniqueJSONValue(decoder) {
		return false
	}
	var extra any
	return errors.Is(decoder.Decode(&extra), io.EOF)
}

func scanUniqueJSONValue(decoder *json.Decoder) bool {
	token, err := decoder.Token()
	if err != nil {
		return false
	}
	delim, ok := token.(json.Delim)
	if !ok {
		return true
	}
	switch delim {
	case '{':
		seen := map[string]struct{}{}
		for decoder.More() {
			keyToken, err := decoder.Token()
			if err != nil {
				return false
			}
			key, ok := keyToken.(string)
			if !ok {
				return false
			}
			if _, exists := seen[key]; exists {
				return false
			}
			seen[key] = struct{}{}
			if !scanUniqueJSONValue(decoder) {
				return false
			}
		}
		end, err := decoder.Token()
		return err == nil && end == json.Delim('}')
	case '[':
		for decoder.More() {
			if !scanUniqueJSONValue(decoder) {
				return false
			}
		}
		end, err := decoder.Token()
		return err == nil && end == json.Delim(']')
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// ServerInformation is an observation, never installation readiness or inventory.
type ServerInformation struct {
	Hostname     string `json:"hostname"`
	OS           string `json:"os"`
	OSVersion    string `json:"osVersion"`
	Architecture string `json:"architecture"`
	CPUCount     int    `json:"cpuCount"`
	MemoryBytes  int64  `json:"memoryBytes"`
	ServerTime   string `json:"serverTime"`
	CheckedAt    string `json:"checkedAt"`
}

const serverInformationScript = `set -eu
export LC_ALL=C
printf 'HOSTNAME=%s\n' "$(hostname)"
awk -F= '$1 == "NAME" {print "OS=" substr($0,6)} $1 == "VERSION_ID" {print "VERSION=" substr($0,12)}' /etc/os-release
printf 'ARCH=%s\nCPU=%s\n' "$(uname -m)" "$(getconf _NPROCESSORS_ONLN)"
awk '$1 == "MemTotal:" {print "MEMORY_KIB=" $2}' /proc/meminfo
printf 'TIME=%s\n' "$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)"
`

func (t OpenSSHTransport) ReadServerInformation(ctx context.Context, node Node) (ServerInformation, error) {
	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, 20*time.Second)
	defer cancel()
	output, err := t.sshSeparatedBounded(ctx, node, "sh", []string{"-s"}, []byte(serverInformationScript), 16384, 1024)
	if err != nil {
		return ServerInformation{}, errors.New("SERVER_INFORMATION_CONNECTION_FAILED")
	}
	return parseServerInformation(output)
}

func parseServerInformation(output []byte) (ServerInformation, error) {
	invalid := errors.New("SERVER_INFORMATION_INVALID")
	if len(output) == 0 || len(output) > 16384 {
		return ServerInformation{}, invalid
	}
	values := map[string]string{}
	for _, line := range strings.Split(strings.TrimSpace(string(output)), "\n") {
		key, value, ok := strings.Cut(line, "=")
		if !ok || len(value) > 256 || strings.ContainsAny(value, "\x00\r\t") {
			return ServerInformation{}, invalid
		}
		switch key {
		case "HOSTNAME", "OS", "VERSION", "ARCH", "CPU", "MEMORY_KIB", "TIME":
		default:
			return ServerInformation{}, invalid
		}
		if _, exists := values[key]; exists {
			return ServerInformation{}, invalid
		}
		values[key] = strings.Trim(value, "\"")
	}
	if len(values) != 7 {
		return ServerInformation{}, invalid
	}
	for _, value := range values {
		if value == "" {
			return ServerInformation{}, invalid
		}
	}
	cpu, err := strconv.Atoi(values["CPU"])
	if err != nil || cpu < 1 || cpu > 1048576 {
		return ServerInformation{}, invalid
	}
	memory, err := strconv.ParseInt(values["MEMORY_KIB"], 10, 64)
	if err != nil || memory < 1 || memory > 1<<50 {
		return ServerInformation{}, invalid
	}
	if _, err := time.Parse(time.RFC3339, values["TIME"]); err != nil {
		return ServerInformation{}, invalid
	}
	return ServerInformation{Hostname: values["HOSTNAME"], OS: values["OS"], OSVersion: values["VERSION"], Architecture: values["ARCH"], CPUCount: cpu, MemoryBytes: memory * 1024, ServerTime: values["TIME"], CheckedAt: time.Now().UTC().Format(time.RFC3339)}, nil
}

// PreparationStepError exposes only the failed preparation boundary to the UI.

// ServiceExecutionRequest is the production boundary for one service run.
// Requirements and bundle candidates are package metadata. The request does
// not contain a selected source; source selection remains in artifactsource.
type ServiceExecutionRequest struct {
	Service          string
	Operation        string
	ProjectRoot      string
	Target           Node
	ArtifactTargets  []Node
	Requirements     []artifactsource.Requirement
	BundleCandidates []artifactsource.Candidate
	PKISecretFiles   map[string]string
}

type ServiceExecutionResult struct {
	Projection        map[string]artifactsource.Result
	TargetProjections map[string]map[string]artifactsource.Result
	Probes            []artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult
	Applied           bool
}

// ServiceRuntimeExecutor is implemented by the execution-node transport. It
// receives derived runtime variables only after the shared Go-side gate.
type ServiceRuntimeExecutor interface {
	ExecuteService(context.Context, ServiceExecutionRequest, map[string]map[string]artifactsource.Result) (bool, error)
}

type TargetRepositoryProbe interface {
	ProbeRepository(context.Context, Node, artifactsource.Requirement) (artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult, error)
}

type requestRepositoryProbe struct {
	target Node
	probe  TargetRepositoryProbe
}

func (p requestRepositoryProbe) ProbeRepository(ctx context.Context, requirement artifactsource.Requirement) (artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult, error) {
	return p.probe.ProbeRepository(ctx, p.target, requirement)
}

// ServiceExecutionService wires the existing probe, resolver and projection
// to the existing Ansible service entrypoint. It deliberately has no Ansible
// or service policy of its own.
type ServiceExecutionService struct {
	probe   TargetRepositoryProbe
	runtime ServiceRuntimeExecutor
}

func NewServiceExecutionService(probe TargetRepositoryProbe, runtime ServiceRuntimeExecutor) *ServiceExecutionService {
	return &ServiceExecutionService{probe: probe, runtime: runtime}
}

func (s *ServiceExecutionService) Execute(ctx context.Context, request ServiceExecutionRequest) (ServiceExecutionResult, error) {
	if s == nil || s.probe == nil || s.runtime == nil || request.Service == "" || request.ProjectRoot == "" || len(request.Requirements) == 0 {
		return ServiceExecutionResult{}, errors.New("SERVICE_EXECUTION_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	projections, probes, err := s.Resolve(ctx, request)
	if err != nil {
		return ServiceExecutionResult{Projection: projections[request.Target.ID], TargetProjections: projections, Probes: probes}, err
	}
	for _, projection := range projections {
		for _, result := range projection {
			if result.Source == artifactsource.Blocked {
				return ServiceExecutionResult{Projection: projections[request.Target.ID], TargetProjections: projections, Probes: probes}, errors.New("SERVICE_EXECUTION_BLOCKED")
			}
		}
	}
	applied, err := s.runtime.ExecuteService(ctx, request, projections)
	return ServiceExecutionResult{Projection: projections[request.Target.ID], TargetProjections: projections, Probes: probes, Applied: applied}, err
}

// Resolve performs only the existing read-only probe/resolver/projection
// phase. It never calls a service runtime or mutates a target.
func (s *ServiceExecutionService) Resolve(ctx context.Context, request ServiceExecutionRequest) (map[string]map[string]artifactsource.Result, []artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult, error) {
	if s == nil || s.probe == nil || request.ProjectRoot == "" || len(request.Requirements) == 0 {
		return nil, nil, errors.New("SERVICE_EXECUTION_INPUT_INVALID")
	}
	targets := request.ArtifactTargets
	if len(targets) == 0 {
		targets = []Node{request.Target}
	}
	projections := make(map[string]map[string]artifactsource.Result, len(targets))
	var probes []artifactsource.RepositoryProbeResult
	for _, target := range targets {
		projection, targetProbes, err := ResolveRequirementsWithTargetProbe(ctx, target, request.Requirements, requestRepositoryProbe{target: target, probe: s.probe}, artifactsource.CandidatesProvider(request.BundleCandidates))
		projections[target.ID] = projection
		probes = append(probes, targetProbes...)
		if err != nil {
			return projections, probes, err
		}
	}
	return projections, probes, nil
}

// Transport is internal and semantic: it does not expose arbitrary remote
// command execution to the application or a future UI.
type Transport interface {
	InspectExecutionNode(context.Context, Node) (Inspection, error)
	ReconcileWorkspaceOwnership(context.Context, Node) (bool, error)
	StageVerifiedBundle(context.Context, Node, executionbundle.Verified) (string, error)
	ActivateStagedRuntime(context.Context, Node, string, executionbundle.Verified) (Runtime, error)
	DiscardStagedRuntime(context.Context, Node, string) error
}

type Service struct {
	transport Transport
	cache     executionbundle.Cache
	now       func() time.Time
	ttl       time.Duration
	mu        sync.Mutex
	plans     map[string]Plan
}

type Option func(*Service)

func WithBundleCache(cache executionbundle.Cache) Option {
	return func(service *Service) { service.cache = cache }
}

func NewService(transport Transport, options ...Option) *Service {
	service := &Service{transport: transport, now: time.Now, ttl: time.Hour, plans: map[string]Plan{}}
	for _, option := range options {
		option(service)
	}
	return service
}

func (s *Service) InspectExecutionNode(ctx context.Context, node Node) (Inspection, error) {
	if err := validNode(node); err != nil {
		return Inspection{State: Incompatible, Findings: []Finding{{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_INPUT_INVALID", SafeMessage: "Execution Node connection details are invalid"}}}, nil
	}
	if node.HostKey.State != "TRUSTED" {
		return Inspection{State: Broken, Findings: []Finding{{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_HOST_KEY_UNTRUSTED", SafeMessage: "Execution Node host key must be explicitly trusted"}}}, nil
	}
	inspection, err := s.transport.InspectExecutionNode(ctx, node)
	if err == nil && inspection.OS != "" && !inspection.Elevation && inspection.State != Unreachable {
		inspection.State = Broken
		inspection.Findings = append(inspection.Findings, Finding{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_ELEVATION_REQUIRED", SafeMessage: "Execution Node preparation requires non-interactive sudo access"})
	}
	return inspection, err
}

func (s *Service) PlanExecutionNodePreparation(ctx context.Context, node Node, bundleRoot string) (Plan, error) {
	inspection, err := s.InspectExecutionNode(ctx, node)
	if err != nil {
		return Plan{}, err
	}
	bundle, err := s.resolveBundle(bundleRoot, inspection)
	if err != nil {
		findings := append([]Finding(nil), inspection.Findings...)
		findings = append(findings, Finding{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_BUNDLE_UNAVAILABLE", SafeMessage: "Проверенный набор установки недоступен для планирования."})
		return Plan{APIVersion: APIVersion, Kind: "ExecutionNodePreparationPlan", NodeID: node.ID, State: inspection.State, Steps: []Step{{"bundle-invalid", "BLOCKED", false}}, Findings: findings}, nil
	}
	state := requiredState(inspection, bundle)
	findings := append([]Finding(nil), inspection.Findings...)
	if state == Incompatible && inspection.State != Incompatible {
		findings = append(findings, platformMismatchFinding(inspection, bundle.Manifest.Platforms))
	}
	plan := Plan{APIVersion: APIVersion, Kind: "ExecutionNodePreparationPlan", NodeID: node.ID, State: state, BundleDigest: bundle.Digest, Steps: preparationSteps(state), Findings: findings, ExpiresAt: s.now().UTC().Add(s.ttl)}
	if bundleRoot != "" && (state == PreparationRequired || state == UpdateRequired || state == Unprepared) {
		plan.bundle = bundle
	}
	plan.Digest, plan.ID = planDigest(plan), planDigest(plan)
	s.mu.Lock()
	for id, previous := range s.plans {
		if !s.now().Before(previous.ExpiresAt) {
			delete(s.plans, id)
		}
	}
	s.plans[plan.ID] = plan
	s.mu.Unlock()
	return plan, nil
}

func platformMismatchFinding(inspection Inspection, platforms []executionbundle.Platform) Finding {
	const code = "EXECUTION_NODE_PLATFORM_INCOMPATIBLE"
	actual := []string{inspection.OS, inspection.OSVersion, inspection.Architecture}
	for _, value := range actual {
		if !safePlatformToken(value) {
			return Finding{Code: code, SafeMessage: "Платформа узла содержит недопустимое или слишком длинное значение OS, VERSION_ID либо ARCH."}
		}
	}
	supported := make([]string, 0, 4)
	for _, platform := range platforms {
		if len(supported) == 4 {
			break
		}
		if safePlatformToken(platform.OS) && safePlatformToken(platform.Version) && safePlatformToken(platform.Architecture) {
			supported = append(supported, platform.OS+"/"+platform.Version+"/"+platform.Architecture)
		}
	}
	message := fmt.Sprintf("Платформа узла %s не указана в наборе установки; поддерживаются: %s.", strings.Join(actual, "/"), strings.Join(supported, ", "))
	if len(platforms) > len(supported) {
		message += " Список сокращён."
	}
	if len(message) > 512 {
		message = "Платформа узла не указана в наборе установки; значения OS, VERSION_ID и ARCH слишком длинные для отображения."
	}
	return Finding{Code: code, SafeMessage: message}
}

func safePlatformToken(value string) bool {
	if value == "" || len(value) > 64 {
		return false
	}
	for _, character := range value {
		if !(character >= 'a' && character <= 'z' || character >= 'A' && character <= 'Z' || character >= '0' && character <= '9' || character == '.' || character == '_' || character == '-') {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func (s *Service) Prepare(ctx context.Context, node Node, bundleRoot, planID string) (Result, error) {
	result := Result{APIVersion: APIVersion, Kind: "ExecutionNodePreparationResult", PlanID: planID}
	s.mu.Lock()
	plan, exists := s.plans[planID]
	s.mu.Unlock()
	if !exists || plan.ID != planID || plan.Digest != planDigest(plan) || !s.now().Before(plan.ExpiresAt) {
		result.State = Broken
		result.Findings = []Finding{{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_PLAN_INVALID", SafeMessage: "Preparation plan is missing, changed or expired"}}
		return result, nil
	}
	if plan.NodeID != node.ID {
		result.State = Broken
		result.Findings = []Finding{{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_PLAN_NODE_MISMATCH", SafeMessage: "Preparation plan belongs to another Execution Node"}}
		return result, nil
	}
	inspection, err := s.InspectExecutionNode(ctx, node)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, &PreparationStepError{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_PREPARE_INSPECT_FAILED", cause: err}
	}
	bundle := plan.bundle
	plannedTransport, planned := s.transport.(interface {
		stagePlannedBundle(context.Context, Node, executionbundle.Verified, string) (string, bool, error)
		activateRuntime(context.Context, Node, string, executionbundle.Verified, bool) (Runtime, error)
	})
	planned = planned && inspection.archiveStaging && bundle.Root != "" && bundleRoot != "" && requiredState(inspection, bundle) != Ready
	if planned && bundle.RecheckManifest(bundleRoot) != nil {
		planned = false
	}
	if !planned {
		bundle, err = s.resolveBundle(bundleRoot, inspection)
	}
	if err != nil || bundle.Digest != plan.BundleDigest {
		result.State = Broken
		result.Findings = []Finding{{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_BUNDLE_CHANGED", SafeMessage: "Offline runtime bundle changed after planning"}}
		return result, nil
	}
	state := requiredState(inspection, bundle)
	if state == Incompatible || state == Broken || state == Unreachable {
		result.State, result.Findings = state, inspection.Findings
		return result, nil
	}
	var archive string
	if planned {
		// Establish a proof of the bytes before any privileged workspace change.
		// The closed archive created here is the exact input to SCP below.
		archive, err = createBundleArchive(bundle, true)
		if err != nil {
			return Result{}, &PreparationStepError{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_PREPARE_STAGE_FAILED", cause: err}
		}
		defer os.Remove(archive)
	}
	workspaceChanged, err := s.transport.ReconcileWorkspaceOwnership(ctx, node)
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, &PreparationStepError{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_PREPARE_WORKSPACE_FAILED", cause: err}
	}
	if state == Ready {
		result.State, result.Runtime, result.Changed = Ready, inspection.Runtime, workspaceChanged
		return result, nil
	}
	var stage string
	var fast bool
	if planned {
		stage, fast, err = plannedTransport.stagePlannedBundle(ctx, node, bundle, archive)
	} else {
		stage, err = s.transport.StageVerifiedBundle(ctx, node, bundle)
	}
	if err != nil {
		return Result{}, &PreparationStepError{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_PREPARE_STAGE_FAILED", cause: err}
	}
	var runtime Runtime
	if fast {
		runtime, err = plannedTransport.activateRuntime(ctx, node, stage, bundle, true)
	} else {
		runtime, err = s.transport.ActivateStagedRuntime(ctx, node, stage, bundle)
	}
	if err != nil {
		_ = s.transport.DiscardStagedRuntime(context.Background(), node, stage)
		return Result{}, &PreparationStepError{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_PREPARE_ACTIVATE_FAILED", cause: err}
	}
	_ = s.transport.DiscardStagedRuntime(context.Background(), node, stage)
	result.Changed, result.Runtime = true, runtime
	if runtime.BundleDigest != bundle.Digest || runtime.Protocol != executionbundle.ProtocolVersion || !runtime.Ansible || !runtime.Capabilities {
		result.State = Broken
		result.Findings = []Finding{{Code: "EXECUTION_NODE_RUNTIME_VERIFY_FAILED", SafeMessage: "Prepared runtime did not pass the capability handshake"}}
		return result, nil
	}
	result.State = Ready
	result.Activated = fast
	return result, nil
}

func (s *Service) resolveBundle(override string, inspection Inspection) (executionbundle.Verified, error) {
	if s.cache.Root == "" {
		return executionbundle.ValidateRoot(override)
	}
	return s.cache.Resolve(override, executionbundle.Platform{
		OS: inspection.OS, Version: inspection.OSVersion, Architecture: inspection.Architecture,
	})
}

func requiredState(i Inspection, bundle executionbundle.Verified) State {
	if i.State == Unreachable || i.State == Incompatible || i.State == Broken {
		return i.State
	}
	if !i.Elevation {
		return Broken
	}
	if i.OS == "" || i.OSVersion == "" || i.Architecture == "" || i.FreeBytes <= 0 {
		return PreparationRequired
	}
	compatible := false
	for _, platform := range bundle.Manifest.Platforms {
		if platform.OS == i.OS && platform.Version == i.OSVersion && platform.Architecture == i.Architecture {
			compatible = true
			break
		}
	}
	if !compatible {
		return Incompatible
	}
	if i.Runtime.BundleDigest == "" {
		return Unprepared
	}
	if i.Runtime.BundleDigest != bundle.Digest || i.Runtime.Protocol != executionbundle.ProtocolVersion {
		return UpdateRequired
	}
	if !i.Runtime.Ansible || !i.Runtime.Capabilities {
		return Broken
	}
	return Ready
}
func preparationSteps(state State) []Step {
	if state == Ready {
		return []Step{{"reconcile-workspace", "RECONCILE", true}, {"verify-ready", "VERIFY", false}}
	}
	if state == Incompatible || state == Broken || state == Unreachable {
		return []Step{{"blocked", "BLOCKED", false}}
	}
	return []Step{{"verify-bundle", "VERIFY", false}, {"reconcile-workspace", "RECONCILE", true}, {"stage-runtime", "TRANSFER", true}, {"ensure-runtime-packages", "BOOTSTRAP", true}, {"activate-runtime", "ACTIVATE", true}, {"capability-handshake", "VERIFY", false}}
}
func planDigest(plan Plan) string {
	plan.ID, plan.Digest, plan.ExpiresAt = "", "", time.Time{}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(plan)
	sum := sha256.Sum256(data)
	return "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
}
func validNode(node Node) error {
	if node.ID == "" || node.Address == "" || node.User == "" || node.Port == 0 || node.CredentialRef == "" || node.HostKey.KnownHosts == "" || node.HostKey.Fingerprint == "" {
		return errors.New("invalid node")
	}
	return nil
}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/executionnode/sudo_password.go","mode":420,"size":2032,"sha256":"5133c7452b3e336684fb47094c2696634ba25d398650a231d948967ca72b31d7","index":0,"count":1,"newline":"lf","encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":2032}
package executionnode

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"errors"
	"strings"
)

// Authentication and the command run under the same shell parent for each
// invocation, including command substitutions and pipelines. Unsupported sudo
// timestamp policy fails closed at the subsequent noninteractive command.
const executionSudoFunction = `sudo() {
 [ "$1" = -n ] || return 64
 shift
 printf '%s\n' "$_platform_sudo_password" | command sudo -S -p '' -v || return
 command sudo -n "$@"
 _platform_sudo_status=$?
 return "$_platform_sudo_status"
}
`

func (t OpenSSHTransport) withSudoInput(ctx context.Context, program string, args []string, input []byte, run func(string, []string, []byte) ([]byte, error)) ([]byte, error) {
	script := program == "sh" && len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "-s" && bytes.Contains(input, []byte("sudo -n"))
	direct := program == "sudo" && len(args) > 0 && args[0] == "-n"
	if t.SudoPassword == nil || (!script && !direct) {
		return run(program, args, input)
	}
	var output []byte
	err := t.SudoPassword(ctx, func(password []byte) error {
		if len(password) == 0 || len(password) > 32768 || bytes.ContainsAny(password, "\r\n\x00") {
			return errors.New("SESSION_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD_FORMAT_UNSUPPORTED")
		}
		var framed []byte
		if script {
			framed = append(framed, []byte("set +ax\nunset _platform_sudo_password\nIFS= read -r _platform_sudo_password || exit 64\n")...)
		}
		framed = append(framed, password...)
		framed = append(framed, '\n')
		if script {
			framed = append(framed, executionSudoFunction...)
		}
		framed = append(framed, input...)
		defer func() {
			for i := range framed {
				framed[i] = 0
			}
		}()
		if direct {
			wrapper := "set +ax\nunset _platform_sudo_password\nIFS= read -r _platform_sudo_password || exit 64\n" + executionSudoFunction + "sudo \"$@\""
			args = append([]string{"-c", "'" + strings.ReplaceAll(wrapper, "'", "'\\''") + "'", "--"}, args...)
			program = "sh"
		}
		var err error
		output, err = run(program, args, framed)
		return err
	})
	return output, err
}

func Read(file *os.File) (Stamp, bool) {

		Modified: basic.LastWriteTime,
		Size:     int64(uint64(identity.FileSizeHigh)<<32 | uint64(identity.FileSizeLow))}, true

var libraryInputID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
var exactLibraryRef = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9-]*@[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$`)
var registryAuthority = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9.-]*(?::[0-9]+)?$`)

func applicationEditOperation(op string) bool {
	if op == "DeleteApplicationLibraryWithPlacements" {
		return true
	}
	if libraryEndpointOperation(op) {
		return true
	}
	switch op {
	case "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment", "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment", "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment", "SetApplicationLibrarySlot", "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot", "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement", "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement", "SetApplicationLibraryOverride", "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride":
		return true
	}
	return false
