const libraryEndpointGroupsKey = "x-applicationLibraryEndpointGroups"

func libraryEndpointOperation(op string) bool {
	return op == "SetApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup" || op == "ClearApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup"
}

func applicationCommandVersion(op string) string {
	if libraryEndpointOperation(op) || op == "DeleteApplicationLibraryWithPlacements" {
		return EditCommandAPIVersionV12
	}
	return EditCommandAPIVersionV11
}

func validLibraryInputID(s string) bool { return len(s) <= 128 && libraryInputID.MatchString(s) }

func validateApplicationEdit(c EditCommand) error {
	invalid := blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "Application library edit is invalid", "command")
	if c.APIVersion != applicationCommandVersion(c.Operation) || c.Kind != "EditCommand" || !validSHA256(c.BaseProjectRevision) || !validLibraryInputID(c.DeploymentID) {
		return invalid
	}
	fields := []string{"deploymentId"}
	switch c.Operation {
	case "DeleteApplicationLibraryWithPlacements":
	case "SetApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup", "ClearApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup":
		if c.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup" {
			fields = append(fields, "value")
			ref, ok := c.Value.(string)
			if !ok || !validLibraryInputID(ref) {
				return invalid
			}
		}
	case "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment", "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		fields = append(fields, "entity")
		if c.Entity == nil || !applicationKeys(c.Entity, "libraryRef", "runtimeRef", "runtime_directory", "bindings", "resources", "shared_secrets", "vaultRef", "vault_ref", "applications", "overrides", "registry_credentials", "provided_connections") {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Operation == "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment" {
			if _, ok := c.Entity["libraryRef"]; !ok {
				return invalid
			}
			if _, ok := c.Entity["runtimeRef"]; !ok {
				return invalid
			}
		}
		for key, value := range c.Entity {
			if key == "overrides" && !applicationKeys(asMap(value), "environment", "parameters") {
				return invalid
			}
			if key == "libraryRef" {
				s, ok := value.(string)
				if !ok || !exactLibraryRef.MatchString(s) || len(s) > 160 {
					return invalid
				}
			} else if key == "runtime_directory" {
				s, ok := value.(string)
				if !ok || len(s) > 4096 {
					return invalid
				}
			} else if key == "runtimeRef" {
				s, ok := value.(string)
				if !ok || !validLibraryInputID(s) {
					return invalid
				}
			} else if asMap(value) == nil {
				return invalid
			}
			if key == "provided_connections" {
				if asMap(value) == nil {
					return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Provided connection overrides must be a map", "command")
				}
				for name, raw := range asMap(value) {
					entry := asMap(raw)
					if !validLibraryInputID(name) || entry == nil || !applicationKeys(entry, "parameters", "credentials") {
						return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Only parameters and credential sources can be overridden", "command")
					}
					for _, property := range []string{"parameters", "credentials"} {
						if value, exists := entry[property]; exists && asMap(value) == nil {
							return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Provided parameters and credentials must be maps", "command")
						}
					}
					for field, credential := range asMap(entry["credentials"]) {
						if !validLibraryInputID(field) || !validApplicationCredential(credential, true) {
							return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Provided credential source is invalid", "command")
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if key == "applications" {
				for _, slot := range asMap(value) {
					if !validLibrarySlot(asMap(slot)) {
						return invalid
					}
				}
			}
		}
	case "SetApplicationLibrarySlot", "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot":
		fields = append(fields, "entityId")
		if !validLibraryInputID(c.EntityID) {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Operation == "SetApplicationLibrarySlot" {
			fields = append(fields, "entity")
			if !validLibrarySlot(c.Entity) {
				return invalid
			}
		}
	case "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement", "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement":
		fields = append(fields, "hostId")
		if !identifierPattern.MatchString(c.HostID) {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement" {
			fields = append(fields, "placement")
			if c.Placement == nil || !applicationKeys(c.Placement, "overrides") {
				return invalid
			}
		}
	case "SetApplicationLibraryOverride", "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride":
		fields = append(fields, "entityId", "hostId", "property", "setting")
		if c.EntityID != "" && !validLibraryInputID(c.EntityID) || c.HostID != "" && !identifierPattern.MatchString(c.HostID) || c.EntityID != "" && c.HostID != "" {
			return invalid
		}
		// Empty slot/host addresses the common library environment/parameters only.
		if c.EntityID == "" && c.HostID == "" && c.Property != "parameters" &&
			(c.Property != "" || c.Setting != "environment" && c.Setting != "parameters") {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.HostID != "" && c.Property != "parameters" && c.Property != "ports" {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Property != "" && c.Property != "parameters" && c.Property != "environment" && c.Property != "ports" && c.Property != "endpoint" && c.Property != "endpoints" && c.Property != "connections" {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Property == "endpoints" && c.Setting != "https" && c.Setting != "tcp" {
			return invalid
		}
		if !configurationSettingPattern.MatchString(c.Setting) {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Property == "" && !applicationKeys(map[string]any{c.Setting: nil}, applicationSettingKeys...) {
			return invalid
		}
		if c.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryOverride" {
			fields = append(fields, "value")
			if c.Value == nil {
				return invalid
			}
		}
	case "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment":
	default:
		return invalid
	}
	if err := validateCommandFields(c, fields...); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for _, value := range []any{c.Entity, c.Placement} {
		if err := safeApplicationInput(value, 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if err := boundedApplicationInput(c.Value, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if c.Property == "" && (c.Setting == "accounts" || c.Setting == "connections") && c.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryOverride" {
		if err := safeApplicationInput(map[string]any{c.Setting: c.Value}, 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if c.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryOverride" {
		if (c.Property == "connections" && !validApplicationConnectionSettings(map[string]any{c.Setting: c.Value})) ||
			(c.Property == "" && c.Setting == "connections" && !validApplicationConnectionSettings(c.Value)) {
			return invalid
		}
	}
	data, err := json.Marshal(c)
	if err != nil || len(data) > 64*1024 {
		return invalid
	}
	return nil
}

func applicationKeys(m map[string]any, keys ...string) bool {
	for k := range m {
		found := false
		for _, allowed := range keys {
			if k == allowed {
				found = true
				break
			}
		}
		if !found {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func validLibrarySlot(m map[string]any) bool {
	if m == nil || !applicationKeys(m, "overrides", "accounts", "credentials") {
		return false
	}
	for key, value := range m {
		obj := asMap(value)
		if obj == nil {
			return false
		}
		if key == "overrides" && (!applicationKeys(obj, applicationSettingKeys...) || !validApplicationConnectionSettings(obj["connections"])) {
			return false
		}
		if key == "credentials" {
			if !applicationKeys(obj, "vault_binding") {
				return false
			}
			if raw, exists := obj["vault_binding"]; exists {
				binding, ok := raw.(string)
				if !ok || !validLibraryInputID(binding) {
					return false
				}
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

// Bound authored input without classifying arbitrary parameter names as secrets.
// Declared credential descriptors retain their separate runtime reference rules.
func safeApplicationInput(v any, depth int) error {
	if depth > 16 {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application input nesting exceeds its limit", "command")
	}
	switch value := v.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		if len(value) > 128 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application input exceeds its limit", "command")
		}
		for key, item := range value {
			if key == "registry_credentials" {
				if asMap(item) == nil {
					return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Registry credentials must contain runtime references", "command")
				}
				for registry, entry := range asMap(item) {
					if !registryAuthority.MatchString(registry) {
						return blocked("REGISTRY_AUTHORITY_INVALID", "Registry must be a host or host:port without scheme, path or credentials", "command")
					}
					pair := asMap(entry)
					if len(pair) != 2 || !applicationKeys(pair, "username", "password") {
						return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Registry credentials require username and password references", "command")
					}
					for _, name := range []string{"username", "password"} {
						if !validApplicationCredential(pair[name], false) || asMap(asMap(pair[name])["source"])["kind"] != "runtime_secret_ref" {
							return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Registry credentials accept runtime references only", "command")
						}
					}
				}
			}
			if key == "shared_secrets" {
				if asMap(item) == nil {
					return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Shared secret descriptors must be a map", "command")
				}
				for _, raw := range asMap(item) {
					if !validApplicationCredential(raw, false) {
						return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Shared secret source is invalid", "command")
					}
				}
			}
			if key == "accounts" {
				for _, account := range asMap(item) {
					fields := asMap(account)
					if fields == nil {
						return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Account descriptor must be a map", "command")
					}
					if raw, exists := fields["credentials"]; exists && (asMap(raw) == nil || !applicationKeys(asMap(raw), "username", "password")) {
						return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Account credentials are invalid", "command")
					}
					for name, raw := range asMap(fields["credentials"]) {
						if !validApplicationCredential(raw, name == "username") {
							return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Credential source is invalid", "command")
						}
					}
				}
			}
			next := safeApplicationInput
			if key == "environment" || key == "parameters" || key == "grants" || key == "endpoint" || key == "endpoints" || key == "config_files" || key == "config_directories" || key == "config_archives" {
				next = boundedApplicationInput
			}
			if err := next(item, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case []any:
		if len(value) > 256 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application list exceeds its limit", "command")
		}
		for _, item := range value {
			if err := safeApplicationInput(item, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case string:
		if strings.Contains(value, "PRIVATE KEY-----") {
			return blocked("SECRET_VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED", "Secret material is not accepted", "command")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Match the closed source shapes in settings.schema.json, only at declared
// credential locations. Core still owns semantic resolution of these references.
func validApplicationCredential(raw any, allowLiteral bool) bool {
	descriptor := asMap(raw)
	if len(descriptor) != 1 || !applicationKeys(descriptor, "source") {
		return false
	}
	source := asMap(descriptor["source"])
	required := []string{"kind"}
	switch source["kind"] {
	case "generated":
		if profile, present := source["profile"]; present {
			if profile != "password" && profile != "client_secret" {
				return false
			}
			required = append(required, "profile")
		}
	case "runtime_secret_ref":
		required = append(required, "ref")
	case "vault_ref":
		required = append(required, "binding", "mount", "document", "field")
	case "pki_credential":
		required = append(required, "binding", "credential")
	case "literal":
		if !allowLiteral {
			return false
		}
		required = append(required, "value")
	default:
		return false
	}
	if len(source) != len(required) || !applicationKeys(source, required...) {
		return false
	}
	for _, key := range required {
		value, ok := source[key].(string)
		if !ok || value == "" {
			return false
		}
		if key == "ref" {
			if len(value) > 128 || !(validLibraryInputID(value) || applicationTemplateRef.MatchString(value)) {
				return false
			}
		} else if key == "binding" || key == "mount" || key == "field" || key == "credential" {
			if !validLibraryInputID(value) {
				return false
			}
		}
	}
	return true
}

var applicationTemplateRef = regexp.MustCompile(`.*\{\{.+\}\}.*`)

func boundedApplicationInput(v any, depth int) error {
	if depth > 16 {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application input nesting exceeds its limit", "command")
	}
	switch x := v.(type) {
	case map[string]any:
		if len(x) > 128 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application input exceeds its limit", "command")
		}
		for _, item := range x {
			if err := boundedApplicationInput(item, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case []any:
		if len(x) > 256 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Application list exceeds its limit", "command")
		}
		for _, item := range x {
			if err := boundedApplicationInput(item, depth+1); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
	case string:
		if strings.Contains(x, "PRIVATE KEY-----") {
			return blocked("SECRET_VALUE_NOT_ALLOWED", "Private key material is not accepted", "command")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func applicationMap(parent map[string]any, key string) (map[string]any, error) {
	if value, exists := parent[key]; exists {
		if m := asMap(value); m != nil {
			return m, nil
		}
		return nil, managedReadError("Application input root is malformed", key)
	}
	m := map[string]any{}
	parent[key] = m
	return m, nil
}

// Explicit package import enrolls matching authored slots; no Ansible values
// are resolved and existing instance settings are never replaced.
func (c *structuralCandidate) includeImportedApplicationSlots(packages map[string]ManagedApplicationPackage, imported map[string]bool) ([]SemanticChange, error) {
	state, _, _, err := c.desired()
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	libraries := asMap(state["applicationLibraryDeployments"])
	changes := []SemanticChange{}
	ids := make([]string, 0, len(libraries))
	for id := range libraries {
		ids = append(ids, id)
	}
	sort.Strings(ids)
	for _, id := range ids {
		library := asMap(libraries[id])
		ref, _ := library["libraryRef"].(string)
		slots := asMap(packages["library:"+ref].Definition["slots"])
		names := make([]string, 0, len(slots))
		for name := range slots {
			names = append(names, name)
		}
		sort.Strings(names)
		for _, name := range names {
			appRef, _ := asMap(slots[name])["applicationRef"].(string)
			if !validLibraryInputID(name) || !imported[appRef] {
				continue
			}
			apps, err := applicationMap(library, "applications")
			if err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
			if _, exists := apps[name]; exists {
				continue
			}
			apps[name] = map[string]any{}
			c.dirty[desiredDocument] = true
			changes = append(changes, SemanticChange{Operation: "SetApplicationLibrarySlot", EntityID: id + "/" + name, SafeSummary: "Добавить приложение «" + name + "» в библиотеку «" + id + "»"})
		}
	}
	return changes, nil
}

func libraryPackageManifestForTransition(root, ref string) (applicationPackageManifest, error) {
	if !exactLibraryRef.MatchString(ref) {
		return applicationPackageManifest{}, referenceNotFound("libraryRef")
	}
	name, version, _ := strings.Cut(ref, "@")
	parts := []string{"library-packages", name, version, "library.yml"}
	logical := strings.Join(parts, "/")
	content, err := readF1OwnedFile(root, parts, maxManagedDocumentBytes)
	if errors.Is(err, fs.ErrNotExist) {
		return applicationPackageManifest{}, nil
	}
	if err != nil {
		return applicationPackageManifest{}, packageImportError(logical, "Не удалось безопасно прочитать описание библиотеки.")
	}
	return decodeApplicationPackageManifest(content, logical)
}

func checkLibraryScenarioTransition(id string, library map[string]any, previous, next applicationPackageManifest) error {
	parameters := asMap(asMap(library["overrides"])["parameters"])
	retained := make(map[string]bool, len(next.UserScenarios))
	for _, scenario := range next.UserScenarios {
		retained[scenario.Setting] = true
	}
	var removed []string
	for _, scenario := range previous.UserScenarios {
		if _, authored := parameters[scenario.Setting]; authored && !retained[scenario.Setting] {
			removed = append(removed, scenario.Setting)
		}
	}
	if len(removed) == 0 {
		return nil
	}
	sort.Strings(removed)
	return blocked("APPLICATION_SCENARIO_RESET_REQUIRED",
		"Новый пакет не объявляет настройку сценария «"+removed[0]+"» библиотеки «"+id+"». Сбросьте настройку в общих параметрах и повторите изменение.",
		"applicationLibraryDeployments."+id+".overrides.parameters."+removed[0])
}

func (c *structuralCandidate) reduceApplicationEdit(cmd EditCommand) error {
	state, _, _, err := c.desired()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	libraries, err := applicationMap(state, "applicationLibraryDeployments")
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	// Move the former root extension only during an explicit application Save.
	// A binding already authored inside the library is authoritative.
	if raw, exists := state[libraryEndpointGroupsKey]; exists {
		groups := asMap(raw)
		if groups == nil {
			return managedReadError("Library endpoint selections are malformed", libraryEndpointGroupsKey)
		}
		for id, rawRef := range groups {
			ref, ok := rawRef.(string)
			library := asMap(libraries[id])
			if !ok || !validLibraryInputID(ref) || library == nil {
				return referenceNotFound("bindings.endpoint")
			}
			bindings, e := applicationMap(library, "bindings")
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if _, exists := bindings["endpoint"]; !exists {
				bindings["endpoint"] = map[string]any{"endpointGroupRef": ref}
			}
		}
		delete(state, libraryEndpointGroupsKey)
	}
	for _, raw := range libraries {
		normalizeLibraryVaultBinding(asMap(raw))
	}
	owner := asMap(libraries[cmd.DeploymentID])
	switch cmd.Operation {
	case "SetApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup", "ClearApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup":
		if owner == nil {
			return referenceNotFound("deploymentId")
		}
		bindings, e := applicationMap(owner, "bindings")
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if cmd.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup" {
			bindings["endpoint"] = map[string]any{"endpointGroupRef": cmd.Value}
		} else {
			delete(bindings, "endpoint")
		}
		if len(bindings) == 0 {
			delete(owner, "bindings")
		}
	case "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		if owner != nil {
			return blocked("EDIT_COMMAND_CONFLICT", "Library deployment already exists", "command.deploymentId")
		}
		libraries[cmd.DeploymentID] = deepCopy(cmd.Entity)
	case "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		if owner == nil {
			return referenceNotFound("deploymentId")
		}
		previousRef, _ := owner["libraryRef"].(string)
		nextRef, _ := cmd.Entity["libraryRef"].(string)
		if nextRef != "" && previousRef != nextRef && len(asMap(asMap(owner["overrides"])["parameters"])) > 0 {
			previous, err := libraryPackageManifestForTransition(c.root, previousRef)
			if err != nil {
				return err
			}
			if len(previous.UserScenarios) > 0 {
				next, err := libraryPackageManifestForTransition(c.root, nextRef)
				if err != nil {
					return err
				}
				if err := checkLibraryScenarioTransition(cmd.DeploymentID, owner, previous, next); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		}
		for key, value := range cmd.Entity {
			owner[key] = deepCopy(value)
		}
	case "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment", "DeleteApplicationLibraryWithPlacements":
		if owner == nil {
			return referenceNotFound("deploymentId")
		}
		if cmd.Operation == "DeleteApplicationLibraryWithPlacements" {
			for id, rawLibrary := range libraries {
				if id == cmd.DeploymentID {
					continue
				}
				for _, rawBinding := range asMap(asMap(rawLibrary)["bindings"]) {
					if asMap(asMap(rawBinding)["providedConnectionRef"])["libraryId"] == cmd.DeploymentID {
						return referenceInUse("providedConnectionRef")
					}
				}
			}
			for logical, document := range c.documents {
				if strings.HasPrefix(logical, "inventory/host_vars/") {
					members := asMap(document["platform_application_libraries"])
					if _, exists := members[cmd.DeploymentID]; exists {
						delete(members, cmd.DeploymentID)
						c.dirty[logical] = true
					}
				}
			}
		}
		delete(libraries, cmd.DeploymentID)
		delete(asMap(state[libraryEndpointGroupsKey]), cmd.DeploymentID)
		if len(asMap(state[libraryEndpointGroupsKey])) == 0 {
			delete(state, libraryEndpointGroupsKey)
		}
	default:
		if owner == nil {
			return referenceNotFound("deploymentId")
		}
		logical := desiredDocument
		if cmd.HostID != "" {
			inventory, e := c.inventory()
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if inventory.targets[cmd.HostID] == nil {
				return referenceNotFound("hostId")
			}
			if _, e := c.hostDocument(cmd.HostID, true); e != nil {
				return e
			}
			logical = managedHostDocument(cmd.HostID)
			members, e := applicationMap(c.documents[logical], "platform_application_libraries")
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if cmd.Operation == "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement" {
				members[cmd.DeploymentID] = deepCopy(cmd.Placement)
				c.dirty[logical] = true
				return nil
			}
			if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement" {
				delete(members, cmd.DeploymentID)
				c.dirty[logical] = true
				return nil
			}
			owner = asMap(members[cmd.DeploymentID])
			if owner == nil {
				return referenceNotFound("placement")
			}
		} else if cmd.EntityID != "" {
			if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" && asMap(owner["applications"]) == nil {
				return nil
			}
			slots, e := applicationMap(owner, "applications")
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
			if cmd.Operation == "SetApplicationLibrarySlot" {
				current := asMap(slots[cmd.EntityID])
				if current == nil {
					current = map[string]any{}
					slots[cmd.EntityID] = current
				}
				for key, v := range cmd.Entity {
					current[key] = deepCopy(v)
				}
				c.dirty[logical] = true
				return nil
			}
			if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot" {
				delete(slots, cmd.EntityID)
				c.dirty[logical] = true
				return nil
			}
			owner = asMap(slots[cmd.EntityID])
			if owner == nil {
				if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" {
					return nil
				}
				owner = map[string]any{}
				slots[cmd.EntityID] = owner
			}
		}
		if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" && asMap(owner["overrides"]) == nil {
			return nil
		}
		overrides, e := applicationMap(owner, "overrides")
		if e != nil {
			return e
		}
		if cmd.Property != "" {
			if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" && asMap(overrides[cmd.Property]) == nil {
				return nil
			}
			overrides, e = applicationMap(overrides, cmd.Property)
			if e != nil {
				return e
			}
		}
		if cmd.Operation == "RemoveApplicationLibraryOverride" {
			delete(overrides, cmd.Setting)
		} else {
			overrides[cmd.Setting] = deepCopy(cmd.Value)
		}
		c.dirty[logical] = true
		return nil
	}
	for _, raw := range libraries {
		normalizeLibraryVaultBinding(asMap(raw))
	}
	c.documents[desiredDocument]["platform_desired_state_contract"] = "platform.installer/project-desired-state/v3alpha1"
	c.dirty[desiredDocument] = true
	return nil
}

func normalizeLibraryVaultBinding(library map[string]any) {
	legacy := asMap(library["vault_ref"])
	if legacy == nil {
		legacy = asMap(library["vaultRef"])
	}
	bindings := asMap(library["bindings"])
	if bindings["secrets"] == nil {
		if name, ok := legacy["binding"].(string); ok && bindings[name] != nil {
			bindings["secrets"] = deepCopy(bindings[name])
		}
	}
	delete(library, "vault_ref")
	delete(library, "vaultRef")
}

func (c *structuralCandidate) validateApplicationReferences() error {
	state, deployments, _, err := c.desired()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	libraries := asMap(state["applicationLibraryDeployments"])
	endpointGroups := asMap(state["endpointGroups"])
	if raw, exists := state[libraryEndpointGroupsKey]; exists {
		selected := asMap(raw)
		if selected == nil || len(selected) > 128 {
			return managedReadError("Library endpoint selection is malformed", libraryEndpointGroupsKey)
		}
		for id, rawRef := range selected {
			ref, ok := rawRef.(string)
			if !validLibraryInputID(id) || !ok || !validLibraryInputID(ref) {
				return managedReadError("Library endpoint reference is malformed", libraryEndpointGroupsKey)
			}
			if libraries[id] == nil {
				return referenceNotFound("libraryEndpointGroups.libraryId")
			}
			if endpointGroups[ref] == nil {
				return referenceNotFound("libraryEndpointGroups.endpointGroup")
			}
		}
	}
	if len(libraries) > 128 {
		return managedReadError("Too many library deployments", desiredDocument)
	}
	var packages map[string]ManagedApplicationPackage
	for _, raw := range libraries {
		library := asMap(raw)
		ref, _ := library["runtimeRef"].(string)
		if library == nil || deployments[ref] == nil {
			return referenceNotFound("runtimeRef")
		}
		for name, rawExport := range asMap(library["provided_connections"]) {
			for field, rawCredential := range asMap(asMap(rawExport)["credentials"]) {
				if asMap(asMap(rawCredential)["source"])["kind"] != "literal" {
					continue
				}
				if packages == nil {
					packages, err = readManagedApplicationPackages(c.root)
					if err != nil {
						return err
					}
				}
				packageRef, _ := library["libraryRef"].(string)
				declaration := asMap(asMap(packages["library:"+packageRef].Definition["provided_connections"])[name])
				credential := asMap(asMap(declaration["credentials"])[field])
				if sensitive, declared := credential["sensitive"].(bool); !declared || sensitive {
					return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "Literal credential requires an explicitly non-sensitive package declaration", "provided_connections")
				}
			}
		}
		for name, rawBinding := range asMap(library["bindings"]) {
			if name == "endpoint" {
				binding := asMap(rawBinding)
				ref, ok := binding["endpointGroupRef"].(string)
				if len(binding) != 1 || !ok || !validLibraryInputID(ref) || endpointGroups[ref] == nil {
					return referenceNotFound("bindings.endpoint.endpointGroupRef")
				}
			}
			ref, _ := asMap(rawBinding)["deploymentRef"].(string)
			if ref != "" && deployments[ref] == nil {
				return referenceNotFound("bindings")
			}
		}
	}
	inventory, err := c.inventory()
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	for logical, doc := range c.documents {
		if !strings.HasPrefix(logical, "inventory/host_vars/") {
			continue
		}
		for id := range asMap(doc["platform_application_libraries"]) {
			if libraries[id] == nil || inventory.targets[hostIDFromManagedDocument(logical)] == nil {
				return referenceInUse("applicationLibraryPlacement")
			}
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Paths describe authored writes, not resolved application settings.
func applicationWritePaths(c EditCommand) []string {
	root := "library/" + c.DeploymentID
	if c.HostID != "" {
		root = "host/" + c.HostID + "/library/" + c.DeploymentID
	}
	switch c.Operation {
	case "SetApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup", "ClearApplicationLibraryEndpointGroup":
		return []string{root + "/endpoint-group"}
	case "CreateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		// Creation may be followed by slot and placement edits in the same session.
		paths := []string{root + "/@create"}
		for key := range c.Entity {
			paths = append(paths, root+"/"+key)
		}
		return paths
	case "UpdateApplicationLibraryDeployment":
		var paths []string
		for key := range c.Entity {
			paths = append(paths, root+"/"+key)
		}
		return paths
	case "DeleteApplicationLibraryDeployment", "DeleteApplicationLibraryWithPlacements", "RemoveApplicationLibraryPlacement":
		return []string{root}
	case "SetApplicationLibraryPlacement":
		var paths []string
		for key := range c.Placement {
			paths = append(paths, root+"/"+key)
		}
		return paths
	case "RemoveApplicationLibrarySlot":
		return []string{root + "/applications/" + c.EntityID}
	case "SetApplicationLibrarySlot":
		var paths []string
		for key := range c.Entity {
			paths = append(paths, root+"/applications/"+c.EntityID+"/"+key)
		}
		return paths
	default:
		if c.EntityID != "" {
			root += "/applications/" + c.EntityID
		}
		root += "/overrides"
		if c.Property != "" {
			root += "/" + c.Property
		}
		return []string{root + "/" + c.Setting}
	}
}

// Validate the authored settings surface, not package connection declarations or arbitrary parameters.
func validApplicationConnectionSettings(v any) bool {
	if v == nil {
		return true
	}
	entries := asMap(v)
	if entries == nil {
		return false
	}
	for name, raw := range entries {
		entry := asMap(raw)
		if !validLibraryInputID(name) || entry == nil || !applicationKeys(entry, "enabled") {
			return false
		}
		if _, ok := entry["enabled"].(bool); !ok {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

const maxApplicationPackageFiles = 512

var packageVersion = regexp.MustCompile(`^[0-9]+\.[0-9]+\.[0-9]+$`)
var packageComponent = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z0-9_.-]+$`)
var packageEnvName = regexp.MustCompile(`^[A-Za-z_][A-Za-z0-9_]*$`)
var packageScenarioID = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)
var packageYAMLLine = regexp.MustCompile(`^line ([0-9]+): (.*)$`)
var packageYAMLDuplicateKey = regexp.MustCompile(`^mapping key .* already defined at line ([0-9]+)$`)

// Fixed data-only destinations. Neither the caller nor a manifest can add
// tasks, plugins, hooks or roles from another package. JARs are application
// inputs; they are never executed on the controller.
func safeApplicationPackagePath(logical string) bool {
	if !safeExportLogicalPath(logical) {
		return false
	}
	p := strings.Split(logical, "/")
	if len(p) < 4 || (p[0] != "application-packages" && p[0] != "library-packages") || !validLibraryInputID(p[1]) || !packageVersion.MatchString(p[2]) {
		return false
	}
	for _, s := range p {
		if !packageComponent.MatchString(s) || s == "." || s == ".." || strings.HasSuffix(s, ".") || reservedExportDirectoryName(s) {
			return false
		}
	}
	kind := strings.TrimSuffix(p[0], "-packages")
	short := strings.Join(p[3:], "/")
	if short == kind+".yml" {
		return true
	}
	if kind == "library" && short == "files/.env" {
		return true
	}
	role := "roles/" + kind + "_" + p[1] + "/"
	if short == role+"defaults/main.yml" {
		return true
	}
	if !strings.HasPrefix(short, role+"templates/") && !strings.HasPrefix(short, "configuration/") && !strings.HasPrefix(short, "assets/") {
		return false
	}
	return true
}

// ApplicationPackagePathAllowed exposes the existing data-only package path
// contract to the guarded project transport; it does not authorize execution.
func ApplicationPackagePathAllowed(logical string) bool {
	return safeApplicationPackagePath(logical)
}

func applicationPackageDocuments(root string) ([]exportRecord, error) {
	return observeApplicationPackageDocuments(root, false)
}
func observeApplicationPackageDocuments(root string, digestOnly bool, reusePreviewAssets ...bool) ([]exportRecord, error) {
	directory, err := openExportSourceDirectory(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	defer directory.close()
	result := exportObservation{digestOnly: digestOnly,
		reusePreviewAssets: len(reusePreviewAssets) == 1 && reusePreviewAssets[0]}
	seen, folded := map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}
	for _, name := range []string{"application-packages", "library-packages"} {
		child, err := directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
		if isExportNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		err = collectExportDirectory(child, name, &result, seen, folded)
		child.close()
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	if len(result.documents) > maxApplicationPackageFiles {
		return nil, errors.New("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_LIMIT")
	}
	return result.documents, nil
}

type applicationPackageManifest struct {
	APIVersion    string                                `yaml:"apiVersion"`
	Kind          string                                `yaml:"kind"`
	Name          string                                `yaml:"name"`
	Version       string                                `yaml:"version"`
	Files         []string                              `yaml:"files"`
	Render        map[string]string                     `yaml:"render,omitempty"`
	Scripts       []map[string]any                      `yaml:"scripts,omitempty"`
	UserScenarios map[string]applicationPackageScenario `yaml:"user_scenarios,omitempty"`
}

type applicationPackageScenario struct {
	Title       string         `yaml:"title"`
	Description string         `yaml:"description"`
	Setting     string         `yaml:"setting"`
	Action      map[string]any `yaml:"action"`
}

func packageImportError(path, reason string) *writerError {
	return blocked("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_INVALID", "Пакет «"+path+"»: "+reason, path)
}

func packageDefaultsYAMLError(err error) string {
	const summary = "Некорректный YAML defaults."
	const typeErrorPrefix = "yaml: unmarshal errors:\n"
	detail := err.Error()
	if list, ok := strings.CutPrefix(detail, typeErrorPrefix); ok {
		first, _, _ := strings.Cut(list, "\n")
		detail = strings.TrimSpace(first)
	} else {
		detail = strings.TrimPrefix(detail, "yaml: ")
	}
	location := ""
	if match := packageYAMLLine.FindStringSubmatch(detail); match != nil {
		location = " Строка " + match[1] + "."
		detail = match[2]
	}
	// Decoder messages may quote YAML keys and scalar values. Report only
	// recognized reasons and line numbers, never the raw diagnostic.
	if match := packageYAMLDuplicateKey.FindStringSubmatch(detail); match != nil {
		return summary + location + " Повторяющийся ключ. Первое объявление на строке " + match[1] + "."
	}
	switch {
	case detail == "cannot unmarshal !!seq into map[string]interface {}":
		return summary + location + " В корне файла ожидается словарь, получен список."
	case strings.HasPrefix(detail, "cannot unmarshal "):
		return summary + location + " Недопустимый тип данных."
	case strings.HasPrefix(detail, "invalid map key:"):
		return summary + location + " В качестве ключа словаря указан список или другой словарь."
	case strings.HasPrefix(detail, "unknown anchor ") && strings.HasSuffix(detail, " referenced"):
		return summary + location + " Ссылка * указывает на необъявленный якорь &. Проверьте имя якоря и порядок объявления."
	case strings.HasPrefix(detail, "anchor ") && strings.HasSuffix(detail, " value contains itself"):
		return summary + location + " Якорь YAML ссылается сам на себя."
	case detail == "document contains excessive aliasing":
		return summary + location + " Слишком много вложенных ссылок на якоря YAML."
	case detail == "map merge requires map or sequence of maps as the value":
		return summary + location + " После ключа объединения << ожидается словарь или список словарей."
	case detail == "!!binary value contains invalid base64 data":
		return summary + location + " Значение с тегом !!binary не удалось прочитать как Base64."
	case detail == "control characters are not allowed":
		return summary + location + " В файле есть недопустимые управляющие символы."
	case strings.Contains(detail, "UTF-8") || strings.Contains(detail, "UTF-16") ||
		detail == "unexpected low surrogate area" || detail == "expected low surrogate area":
		return summary + location + " Повреждена кодировка текста. Проверьте исходную кодировку файла и пересохраните его в UTF-8."
	case detail == "did not find expected key" || detail == "mapping values are not allowed in this context":
		return summary + location + " Проверьте отступы и двоеточия рядом с этой строкой."
	case detail == "did not find expected '-' indicator":
		return summary + location + " Проверьте отступы и дефисы элементов списка."
	case detail == "found character that cannot start any token":
		return summary + location + " Недопустимый символ. Проверьте, нет ли табуляции в отступах."
	case detail == "found unknown escape character" || detail == "found unexpected end of stream" ||
		detail == "did not find expected ',' or ']'" || detail == "did not find expected ',' or '}'":
		return summary + location + " Проверьте кавычки, экранирование и закрывающие скобки."
	default:
		if location == "" {
			return summary + " Декодер не указал строку. Причину не удалось распознать."
		}
		return summary + location + " Декодер не смог разобрать YAML рядом с указанной строкой."
	}
}

func checkPackageManifest(records []exportRecord, kind, name, version string) (string, error) {
	return readPackageManifest(records, kind, name, version, nil)
}

func decodeApplicationPackageManifest(content []byte, path string) (applicationPackageManifest, error) {
	var m applicationPackageManifest
	d := yaml.NewDecoder(bytes.NewReader(content))
	d.KnownFields(true)
	if d.Decode(&m) != nil {
		return m, packageImportError(path, "Описание пакета не соответствует формату манифеста.")
	}
	if d.Decode(new(any)) != io.EOF {
		return m, packageImportError(path, "Ожидается один YAML-документ описания пакета.")
	}
	return m, nil
}

func readPackageManifest(records []exportRecord, kind, name, version string, view *[]ManagedApplicationScenario) (string, error) {
	prefix := kind + "-packages/" + name + "/" + version + "/"
	byPath := map[string][]byte{}
	for _, r := range records {
		byPath[strings.TrimPrefix(r.LogicalPath, prefix)] = r.content
	}
	content, ok := byPath[kind+".yml"]
	if !ok {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+kind+".yml", "Не найден файл описания пакета.")
	}
	m, err := decodeApplicationPackageManifest(content, prefix+kind+".yml")
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	const scenarioVersion = "platform.installer/application-package/v1alpha5"
	if m.APIVersion != "platform.installer/application-package/v1alpha1" && m.APIVersion != "platform.installer/application-package/v1alpha2" && m.APIVersion != "platform.installer/application-package/v1alpha3" && m.APIVersion != "platform.installer/application-package/v1alpha4" && m.APIVersion != scenarioVersion {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+kind+".yml", "Неподдерживаемая apiVersion описания пакета.")
	}
	if (m.APIVersion == scenarioVersion && (kind != "library" || len(m.UserScenarios) == 0 || len(m.UserScenarios) > 16)) ||
		(m.APIVersion != scenarioVersion && m.UserScenarios != nil) {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+kind+".yml", "Недопустимый раздел user_scenarios для этой версии пакета.")
	}
	scenarios := make([]ManagedApplicationScenario, 0, len(m.UserScenarios))
	settings := map[string]bool{}
	for id, scenario := range m.UserScenarios {
		if !packageScenarioID.MatchString(id) || !packageScenarioID.MatchString(scenario.Setting) ||
			len(id) > 128 || len(scenario.Setting) > 128 || settings[scenario.Setting] ||
			scenario.Title == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(scenario.Title) > 128 ||
			scenario.Description == "" || utf8.RuneCountInString(scenario.Description) > 512 ||
			len(scenario.Action) == 0 || safeApplicationInput(scenario.Action, 0) != nil {
			return "", packageImportError(prefix+kind+".yml", "Некорректное описание пользовательского сценария.")
		}
		settings[scenario.Setting] = true
		scenarios = append(scenarios, ManagedApplicationScenario{ID: id, Title: scenario.Title, Description: scenario.Description, Setting: scenario.Setting})
	}
	if m.Kind != strings.ToUpper(kind[:1])+kind[1:]+"Package" {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+kind+".yml", "Поле kind не соответствует выбранному типу пакета.")
	}
	if m.Name != name {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+kind+".yml", "Поле name не соответствует имени папки «"+name+"».")
	}
	if m.Version != version {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+kind+".yml", "Поле version не соответствует папке версии «"+version+"».")
	}
	if len(m.Files) < 1 || len(m.Files) > maxApplicationPackageFiles-1 {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+kind+".yml", "Список files должен содержать от 1 до 511 записей.")
	}
	listed := map[string]bool{kind + ".yml": true}
	declared := map[string]bool{}
	for _, file := range m.Files {
		folded := strings.ToLower(file)
		if declared[folded] {
			return "", packageImportError(prefix+file, "Повторная запись в списке files.")
		}
		declared[folded] = true
		if strings.HasSuffix(file, "/") {
			// A trailing slash is one allowlist entry for all files below it.
			// Validate the directory as a package data path; records remain files.
			if !safeApplicationPackagePath(prefix + file + "member") {
				return "", packageImportError(prefix+file, "Каталог из files не разрешён для импорта.")
			}
			for member := range byPath {
				if strings.HasPrefix(member, file) {
					listed[strings.ToLower(member)] = true
				}
			}
			continue
		}
		if !safeApplicationPackagePath(prefix + file) {
			return "", packageImportError(prefix+file, "Путь из files не разрешён для импорта.")
		}
		listed[folded] = true
		if _, ok := byPath[file]; !ok {
			return "", packageImportError(prefix+file, "Файл указан в files, но отсутствует в выбранной папке.")
		}
	}
	paths := make([]string, 0, len(byPath))
	for path := range byPath {
		paths = append(paths, path)
	}
	sort.Strings(paths)
	for _, path := range paths {
		if !listed[strings.ToLower(path)] {
			return "", packageImportError(prefix+path, "Файл не объявлен в списке files описания пакета.")
		}
	}
	defaultsPath := "roles/" + kind + "_" + name + "/defaults/main.yml"
	if !listed[defaultsPath] {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+defaultsPath, "Файл defaults не объявлен в списке files.")
	}
	for key, value := range m.Render {
		if key != "compose_template" && key != "agent_template" && key != "base_compose_template" && key != "base_compose_filename" && key != "base_service" {
			return "", packageImportError(prefix+kind+".yml", "Неподдерживаемый параметр раздела render.")
		}
		if strings.HasSuffix(key, "template") {
			if !listed[strings.ToLower(value)] {
				return "", packageImportError(prefix+value, "Шаблон из render не объявлен в files.")
			}
			if !strings.HasSuffix(value, ".j2") && !(key == "agent_template" && strings.HasSuffix(value, ".hcl")) {
				return "", packageImportError(prefix+value, "Недопустимое расширение шаблона в render.")
			}
		}
	}
	// Identity/default namespace is checked locally; resolution and semantic
	// schema validation remain optional target-free Core Project Verify.
	var defaults map[string]any
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(byPath[defaultsPath], &defaults); err != nil {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+defaultsPath, packageDefaultsYAMLError(err))
	}
	if len(defaults) != 1 {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+defaultsPath, "В defaults ожидается единственный корневой раздел platform_"+kind+"_definition.")
	}
	definition := asMap(defaults["platform_"+kind+"_definition"])
	if definition["name"] != name {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+defaultsPath, "Имя в defaults не соответствует описанию пакета.")
	}
	if definition["version"] != version {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+defaultsPath, "Версия в defaults не соответствует описанию пакета.")
	}
	if safeApplicationInput(defaults, 0) != nil {
		return "", packageImportError(prefix+defaultsPath, "Структура defaults содержит недопустимые данные.")
	}
	rows := make([][]string, 0, len(paths))
	for _, p := range paths {
		content := byPath[p]
		if strings.Contains(string(content), "PRIVATE KEY-----") {
			return "", packageImportError(prefix+p, "Файл содержит приватный ключ; импорт запрещён.")
		}
		if p == "files/.env" {
			keys := map[string]bool{}
			for _, line := range strings.Split(string(content), "\n") {
				line = strings.TrimSpace(line)
				if line == "" || strings.HasPrefix(line, "#") {
					continue
				}
				name, _, found := strings.Cut(line, "=")
				if !found || !packageEnvName.MatchString(name) || keys[name] || name == "SERVER_ID" {
					return "", packageImportError(prefix+p, "Некорректная запись .env: требуется уникальное допустимое имя переменной; SERVER_ID задаётся автоматически.")
				}
				keys[name] = true
			}
		}
		rows = append(rows, []string{p, strings.TrimPrefix(digestBytes(content), "sha256:")})
	}
	data, _ := json.Marshal(rows)
	if view != nil {
		sort.Slice(scenarios, func(i, j int) bool { return scenarios[i].ID < scenarios[j].ID })
		*view = scenarios
	}
	return digestBytes(data), nil
}

func validateExportPackages(records []exportRecord) error {
	groups := map[string][]exportRecord{}
	for _, r := range records {
		if strings.HasPrefix(r.LogicalPath, "application-packages/") || strings.HasPrefix(r.LogicalPath, "library-packages/") {
			p := strings.Split(r.LogicalPath, "/")
			if len(p) < 4 {
				return errors.New("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_INVALID")
			}
			key := strings.Join(p[:3], "/")
			groups[key] = append(groups[key], r)
		}
	}
	keys := make([]string, 0, len(groups))
	for key := range groups {
		keys = append(keys, key)
	}
	sort.Strings(keys)
	for _, key := range keys {
		p := strings.Split(key, "/")
		if _, err := checkPackageManifest(groups[key], strings.TrimSuffix(p[0], "-packages"), p[1], p[2]); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

// Import retains the reviewed package bytes in the existing opaque plan store
// and publishes them through the same revision-guarded/recoverable transaction.
// Existing versions may be replaced through the same reviewed, guarded transaction.
func (b *Backend) PlanApplicationPackageImport(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, sourceRoot, revision, kind, name, version, _ string) (*StructuralEditPlan, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	invalid := packageImportError("package", "Некорректные параметры импорта пакета.")
	batch := kind == "application" && name == "" && version == ""
	if (kind != "application" && kind != "library") || (!batch && !validLibraryInputID(name)) || (version != "" && !packageVersion.MatchString(version)) {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, invalid), nil
	}
	root, err := cleanRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
	}
	current, err := ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil || current != revision {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Проект изменился перед проверкой импорта. Повторите проверку.", "project")), nil
	}
	candidate, err := loadStructuralCandidate(root, projectlifecycle.ClassificationManaged)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
	}
	source, err := openExportSourceDirectory(sourceRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, packageImportError("source", "Не удалось безопасно открыть выбранную папку пакета.")), nil
	}
	defer source.close()
	prefix := "application-packages"
	var manifest []byte
	if !batch {
		manifest, _, err = source.readFile([]string{kind + ".yml"}, 0)
		if err != nil {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, packageImportError(kind+".yml", "Не удалось прочитать описание пакета в выбранной папке.")), nil
		}
		var metadata applicationPackageManifest
		if yaml.Unmarshal(manifest, &metadata) != nil || !packageVersion.MatchString(metadata.Version) || (version != "" && version != metadata.Version) {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, packageImportError(kind+".yml", "Некорректная версия в описании пакета; ожидается версия выбранного приложения в формате X.Y.Z.")), nil
		}
		version = metadata.Version
		prefix = kind + "-packages/" + name + "/" + version
	}
	observation := exportObservation{}
	if err := collectExportDirectory(source, prefix, &observation, map[string]bool{}, map[string]bool{}); err != nil {
		if _, ok := err.(*writerError); ok {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
		}
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, packageImportError(prefix, "Не удалось безопасно прочитать состав пакетов.")), nil
	}
	if len(observation.documents) == 0 {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, packageImportError(prefix, "В выбранной папке не найдены файлы пакетов. Ожидается структура <имя>/<версия>/application.yml.")), nil
	}
	if len(observation.documents) > maxApplicationPackageFiles {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_LIMIT", "Превышен лимит импорта: 512 файлов пакетов.", prefix)), nil
	}
	// Validate the captured package, without requiring an operator-supplied SHA.
	// The manifest used to derive the destination must be the reviewed bytes.
	for _, record := range observation.documents {
		if !batch && record.LogicalPath == prefix+"/"+kind+".yml" && string(record.content) != string(manifest) {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, packageImportError(record.LogicalPath, "Описание пакета изменилось во время проверки. Повторите импорт.")), nil
		}
	}
	err = validateExportPackages(observation.documents)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
	}
	existing, err := applicationPackageDocuments(root)
	if err != nil {
		if _, ok := err.(*writerError); ok {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
		}
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, packageImportError("project", "Не удалось проверить файлы пакетов, уже находящихся в проекте.")), nil
	}

	// Reimport replaces exactly the reviewed versions; other packages are retained.
	versions := map[string]bool{}
	incoming := map[string]exportRecord{}
	for _, record := range observation.documents {
		versions[strings.Join(strings.Split(record.LogicalPath, "/")[:3], "/")] = true
		incoming[record.LogicalPath] = record
	}
	existingByPath := map[string]exportRecord{}
	retained := []exportRecord{}
	documents := []storedDocument{}
	for _, record := range existing {
		existingByPath[record.LogicalPath] = record
		versionPath := strings.Join(strings.Split(record.LogicalPath, "/")[:3], "/")
		if !versions[versionPath] {
			retained = append(retained, record)
		} else if _, present := incoming[record.LogicalPath]; !present {
			documents = append(documents, storedDocument{LogicalPath: record.LogicalPath, Before: record.content, Existed: true, Deleted: true})
		}
	}
	if kind == "library" {
		manifestPath := prefix + "/library.yml"
		previous, existed := existingByPath[manifestPath]
		next := incoming[manifestPath]
		if existed && !bytes.Equal(previous.content, next.content) {
			oldManifest, err := decodeApplicationPackageManifest(previous.content, manifestPath)
			if err != nil {
				return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
			}
			if len(oldManifest.UserScenarios) > 0 {
				newManifest, err := decodeApplicationPackageManifest(next.content, manifestPath)
				if err != nil {
					return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
				}
				state, _, _, err := candidate.desired()
				if err != nil {
					return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
				}
				libraries := asMap(state["applicationLibraryDeployments"])
				ids := make([]string, 0, len(libraries))
				for id := range libraries {
					ids = append(ids, id)
				}
				sort.Strings(ids)
				for _, id := range ids {
					library := asMap(libraries[id])
					if library["libraryRef"] == name+"@"+version {
						if err := checkLibraryScenarioTransition(id, library, oldManifest, newManifest); err != nil {
							return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
						}
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
	if len(retained)+len(observation.documents) > maxApplicationPackageFiles {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("APPLICATION_PACKAGE_LIMIT", "После импорта будет превышен лимит 512 файлов пакетов в проекте.", "package")), nil
	}
	for _, record := range observation.documents {
		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		if _, err := safeProjectPath(root, record.LogicalPath, true); err != nil {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
		}
		previous, existed := existingByPath[record.LogicalPath]
		if existed && bytes.Equal(previous.content, record.content) {
			continue
		}
		documents = append(documents, storedDocument{LogicalPath: record.LogicalPath, Before: previous.content, After: record.content, Existed: existed})
	}
	changes := []SemanticChange{}
	if kind == "application" {
		packages, err := managedApplicationPackages(append(retained, observation.documents...))
		if err != nil {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
		}
		imported := map[string]bool{}
		for path := range versions {
			parts := strings.Split(path, "/")
			imported[parts[1]+"@"+parts[2]] = true
		}
		changes, err = candidate.includeImportedApplicationSlots(packages, imported)
		if err != nil {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
		}
		managedDocuments, err := candidate.storedDocuments()
		if err != nil {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
		}
		documents = append(documents, managedDocuments...)
	}
	if latest, err := ProjectRevision(root); err != nil || latest != revision {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Проект изменился во время проверки импорта. Повторите проверку.", "project")), nil
	}
	entityID := name + "@" + version
	if batch {
		entityID = "application-packages"
	}
	changes = append([]SemanticChange{{Operation: "ImportApplicationPackage", EntityID: entityID, SafeSummary: "Импорт / замена пакетов приложений или библиотеки"}}, changes...)
	return b.storeStructuralPlan(root, revision, changes, documents)
}

package installer

import (
	"gopkg.in/yaml.v3"
	"strings"

// Reuse the handle-bound package reader and validator. Only package definition
// data is exposed: templates and arbitrary file contents never enter UI models.
func readManagedApplicationPackages(root string) (map[string]ManagedApplicationPackage, error) {
	records, err := applicationPackageDocuments(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return managedApplicationPackages(records)
}

func managedApplicationPackages(records []exportRecord) (map[string]ManagedApplicationPackage, error) {
	groups := map[string][]exportRecord{}
	for _, record := range records {
		parts := strings.Split(record.LogicalPath, "/")
		if len(parts) < 4 {
			return nil, managedReadError("Некорректная структура пути пакета приложения.", record.LogicalPath)
		}
		key := strings.Join(parts[:3], "/")
		groups[key] = append(groups[key], record)
	}
	result := map[string]ManagedApplicationPackage{}
	for key, group := range groups {
		parts := strings.Split(key, "/")
		kind := strings.TrimSuffix(parts[0], "-packages")
		var scenarios []ManagedApplicationScenario
		digest, err := readPackageManifest(group, kind, parts[1], parts[2], &scenarios)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, managedReadError("Содержимое пакета не соответствует его описанию или требованиям к структуре пакета.", key)
		}
		for _, r := range group {
			if r.LogicalPath != key+"/roles/"+kind+"_"+parts[1]+"/defaults/main.yml" {
				continue
			}
			var doc map[string]any
			if yaml.Unmarshal(r.content, &doc) != nil {
				return nil, managedReadError("Некорректный YAML определения пакета.", r.LogicalPath)
			}
			ref := parts[1] + "@" + parts[2]
			result[kind+":"+ref] = ManagedApplicationPackage{Kind: kind, Ref: ref, Digest: digest, Definition: asMap(doc["platform_"+kind+"_definition"]), UserScenarios: scenarios}
		}
	}
	return result, nil
}

package installer

import (
	"bytes"
	"context"
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"

	"strings"

// ArtifactLockUpdateRequest is the intentionally narrow, explicit authority
// for rebinding a managed project to an already verified immutable bundle.
// It is not an EditCommand and is never used by the ordinary ProjectWriter.
type ArtifactLockUpdateRequest struct {
	ProjectRoot       string
	ExpectedOldDigest string
	NewDigest         string
	NewBundleRoot     string
}

type ArtifactLockUpdateResult struct {
	PreviousDigest     string
	NewDigest          string
	NewProjectRevision string
}

// RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest is the deliberately narrow, explicit authority
// for an immutable runtime release whose catalog lock also changed. Normal
// project writers never receive this authority.
type RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest struct {
	ProjectRoot               string
	ExpectedProjectRevision   string
	ExpectedOldArtifactDigest string
	ExpectedOldCatalogDigest  string
	NewDigest                 string
	NewBundleRoot             string
}

type RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult struct {
	PreviousArtifactDigest string
	PreviousCatalogDigest  string
	NewArtifactDigest      string
	NewCatalogDigest       string
	NewProjectRevision     string
}

// RuntimeLockSet is the narrow read-only view required by controlled runtime
// promotion. It exposes neither desired topology nor catalog content.
type RuntimeLockSet struct {
	ArtifactDigest string
	CatalogDigest  string
}

// ReadRuntimeLockSet reads only the two immutable compatibility locks from a
// managed project. It does not require the old runtime to remain in the local
// cache, which is essential after immutable cache publication prunes it.
func ReadRuntimeLockSet(projectRoot string) (RuntimeLockSet, error) {
	root, err := cleanRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, err
	}
	path, err := safeProjectPath(root, "project.yml", false)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, err
	}
	content, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, err
	}
	return readRuntimeLockSet(content)
}

// UpdateRuntimeLockSet atomically moves both lock fields to the complete pair
// derived from a verified immutable bundle. The expected raw project revision
// makes this a compare-and-swap for the whole canonical project, not merely a
// digest replacement.
func (b *Backend) UpdateRuntimeLockSet(ctx context.Context, request RuntimeLockSetUpdateRequest) (RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if !validDigest(request.ExpectedProjectRevision) || !validDigest(request.ExpectedOldArtifactDigest) || !validDigest(request.ExpectedOldCatalogDigest) || !validDigest(request.NewDigest) || request.NewBundleRoot == "" || request.ExpectedOldArtifactDigest == request.NewDigest {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Runtime lock-set update input is invalid", "project.yml")
	}
	root, err := cleanRoot(request.ProjectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	release, err := acquireWriterLock(ctx, root, b.lockWait)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	defer release()
	if err := recoverTransactions(root); err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	currentRevision, err := ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if currentRevision != request.ExpectedProjectRevision {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, blocked("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Project changed before runtime lock update", "project.yml")
	}
	candidate, err := projectlifecycle.ResolveRuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate(ctx, root, request.NewBundleRoot, request.NewDigest)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	path, err := safeProjectPath(root, "project.yml", false)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	after, err := replaceRuntimeLockSet(before, request.ExpectedOldArtifactDigest, request.ExpectedOldCatalogDigest, candidate)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	identifier, err := artifactLockTransactionID()
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if err := b.commitDocuments(root, identifier, []storedDocument{{LogicalPath: "project.yml", Before: before, After: after, Existed: true}}); err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	reopened, err := projectlifecycle.NewService(map[string]string{"runtime-lock-set-update": request.NewBundleRoot}).OpenProject(ctx, root)
	if err != nil || reopened.Project == nil || reopened.Project.Source.BundleDigest != candidate.ArtifactDigest || reopened.Catalog == nil || reopened.Catalog.Status != "READY" {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, errors.New("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_REOPEN_FAILED")
	}
	revision, err := ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil {
		return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	return RuntimeLockSetUpdateResult{PreviousArtifactDigest: request.ExpectedOldArtifactDigest, PreviousCatalogDigest: request.ExpectedOldCatalogDigest, NewArtifactDigest: candidate.ArtifactDigest, NewCatalogDigest: candidate.CatalogDigest, NewProjectRevision: revision}, nil
}

// UpdateArtifactLock validates a compatible immutable bundle, then changes
// only artifactLock.digest through the existing guarded writer transaction.
func (b *Backend) UpdateArtifactLock(ctx context.Context, request ArtifactLockUpdateRequest) (ArtifactLockUpdateResult, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if !validDigest(request.ExpectedOldDigest) || !validDigest(request.NewDigest) || request.ExpectedOldDigest == request.NewDigest || request.NewBundleRoot == "" {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Artifact lock update input is invalid", "artifactLock")
	}
	root, err := cleanRoot(request.ProjectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	release, err := acquireWriterLock(ctx, root, b.lockWait)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	defer release()
	if err := recoverTransactions(root); err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if err := projectlifecycle.ValidateArtifactLockCandidate(ctx, root, request.NewBundleRoot, request.NewDigest); err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	path, err := safeProjectPath(root, "project.yml", false)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	before, err := os.ReadFile(path)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	after, err := replaceArtifactLockDigest(before, request.ExpectedOldDigest, request.NewDigest)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	identifier, err := artifactLockTransactionID()
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	if err := b.commitDocuments(root, identifier, []storedDocument{{LogicalPath: "project.yml", Before: before, After: after, Existed: true}}); err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	reopened, err := projectlifecycle.NewService(map[string]string{"artifact-lock-update": request.NewBundleRoot}).OpenProject(ctx, root)
	if err != nil || reopened.Project == nil || reopened.Project.Source.BundleDigest != request.NewDigest || reopened.Catalog == nil || reopened.Catalog.Status != "READY" {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, errors.New("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_REOPEN_FAILED")
	}
	revision, err := ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil {
		return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{}, err
	}
	return ArtifactLockUpdateResult{PreviousDigest: request.ExpectedOldDigest, NewDigest: request.NewDigest, NewProjectRevision: revision}, nil
}

func artifactLockTransactionID() (string, error) {
	value := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return hex.EncodeToString(value), nil
}

// replaceArtifactLockDigest accepts only the canonical scalar form emitted for
// managed projects. It validates the YAML shape first, then replaces that one
// scalar in-place so all unrelated project.yml bytes remain untouched.
func replaceArtifactLockDigest(before []byte, expectedOldDigest, newDigest string) ([]byte, error) {
	var document yaml.Node
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(before, &document); err != nil || len(document.Content) != 1 || document.Content[0].Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project manifest cannot be safely updated", "artifactLock")
	}
	artifactLock, found, duplicate := yamlMappingValue(document.Content[0], "artifactLock")
	if !found || duplicate || artifactLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project artifact lock is invalid", "artifactLock")
	}
	digest, found, duplicate := yamlMappingValue(artifactLock, "digest")
	if !found || duplicate || digest.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || digest.Tag != "!!str" || digest.Value != expectedOldDigest {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_CHANGED", "Artifact lock changed before update", "artifactLock.digest")
	}
	start, end, ok := yamlSourceLine(before, digest.Line)
	if !ok {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project artifact lock is not in canonical form", "artifactLock.digest")
	}
	line := string(before[start:end])
	trimmed := strings.TrimSpace(strings.TrimSuffix(line, "\r"))
	if trimmed != "digest: "+expectedOldDigest || strings.Count(line, expectedOldDigest) != 1 {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project artifact lock is not in canonical form", "artifactLock.digest")
	}
	offset := bytes.Index(before[start:end], []byte(expectedOldDigest))
	if offset < 0 {
		return nil, blocked("ARTIFACT_LOCK_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project artifact lock is not in canonical form", "artifactLock.digest")
	}
	position := start + offset
	after := make([]byte, 0, len(before)-len(expectedOldDigest)+len(newDigest))
	after = append(after, before[:position]...)
	after = append(after, newDigest...)
	after = append(after, before[position+len(expectedOldDigest):]...)
	return after, nil
}

type runtimeCatalogLock struct {
	APIVersion string                                                `yaml:"apiVersion"`
	Digest     string                                                `yaml:"digest"`
	Services   map[string]projectlifecycle.RuntimeCatalogServiceLock `yaml:"services"`
}

func replaceRuntimeLockSet(before []byte, expectedArtifactDigest, expectedCatalogDigest string, candidate projectlifecycle.RuntimeLockUpgradeCandidate) ([]byte, error) {
	locks, err := readRuntimeLockSet(before)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if locks.CatalogDigest != expectedCatalogDigest || locks.ArtifactDigest != expectedArtifactDigest {
		return nil, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_CHANGED", "Runtime lock changed before update", "project.yml")
	}
	var document yaml.Node
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(before, &document); err != nil || len(document.Content) != 1 || document.Content[0].Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return nil, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project manifest cannot be safely updated", "project.yml")
	}
	mapping := document.Content[0]
	catalogKey, catalogLock, catalogFound, catalogDuplicate := yamlMappingPair(mapping, "catalogLock")
	artifactKey, artifactLock, artifactFound, artifactDuplicate := yamlMappingPair(mapping, "artifactLock")
	if !catalogFound || catalogDuplicate || !artifactFound || artifactDuplicate || catalogLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode || artifactLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode || catalogKey.Line < 1 || artifactKey.Line <= catalogKey.Line {
		return nil, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project lock layout is invalid", "project.yml")
	}
	catalogStart, _, ok := yamlSourceLine(before, catalogKey.Line)
	artifactStart, _, okArtifact := yamlSourceLine(before, artifactKey.Line)
	if !ok || !okArtifact || catalogStart >= artifactStart {
		return nil, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project lock layout is not canonical", "project.yml")
	}
	encoded, err := yaml.Marshal(runtimeCatalogLock{APIVersion: "platform.installer/catalog/v1alpha1", Digest: candidate.CatalogDigest, Services: candidate.CatalogServices})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	block := "catalogLock:\n" + indentYAML(encoded, "    ")
	withCatalog := append(append(append([]byte{}, before[:catalogStart]...), []byte(block)...), before[artifactStart:]...)
	return replaceArtifactLockDigest(withCatalog, expectedArtifactDigest, candidate.ArtifactDigest)
}

func readRuntimeLockSet(content []byte) (RuntimeLockSet, error) {
	var document yaml.Node
	if err := yaml.Unmarshal(content, &document); err != nil || len(document.Content) != 1 || document.Content[0].Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project manifest cannot be safely read", "project.yml")
	}
	mapping := document.Content[0]
	_, catalogLock, catalogFound, catalogDuplicate := yamlMappingPair(mapping, "catalogLock")
	_, artifactLock, artifactFound, artifactDuplicate := yamlMappingPair(mapping, "artifactLock")
	if !catalogFound || catalogDuplicate || !artifactFound || artifactDuplicate || catalogLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode || artifactLock.Kind != yaml.MappingNode {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project lock layout is invalid", "project.yml")
	}
	catalogDigest, catalogFound, catalogDuplicate := yamlMappingValue(catalogLock, "digest")
	artifactDigest, artifactFound, artifactDuplicate := yamlMappingValue(artifactLock, "digest")
	if !catalogFound || catalogDuplicate || catalogDigest.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || catalogDigest.Tag != "!!str" || !validDigest(catalogDigest.Value) || !artifactFound || artifactDuplicate || artifactDigest.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || artifactDigest.Tag != "!!str" || !validDigest(artifactDigest.Value) {
		return RuntimeLockSet{}, blocked("RUNTIME_LOCK_SET_UPDATE_INVALID", "Managed project lock layout is invalid", "project.yml")
	}
	return RuntimeLockSet{ArtifactDigest: artifactDigest.Value, CatalogDigest: catalogDigest.Value}, nil
}

func yamlMappingPair(mapping *yaml.Node, name string) (*yaml.Node, *yaml.Node, bool, bool) {
	var key, value *yaml.Node
	for index := 0; index+1 < len(mapping.Content); index += 2 {
		candidateKey := mapping.Content[index]
		if candidateKey.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || candidateKey.Value != name {
			continue
		}
		if value != nil {
			return nil, nil, true, true
		}
		key, value = candidateKey, mapping.Content[index+1]
	}
	return key, value, value != nil, false
}

func indentYAML(value []byte, prefix string) string {
	trimmed := strings.TrimSuffix(string(value), "\n")
	if trimmed == "" {
		return ""
	}
	return prefix + strings.ReplaceAll(trimmed, "\n", "\n"+prefix) + "\n"
}

func yamlMappingValue(mapping *yaml.Node, name string) (*yaml.Node, bool, bool) {
	var value *yaml.Node
	for index := 0; index+1 < len(mapping.Content); index += 2 {
		key := mapping.Content[index]
		if key.Kind != yaml.ScalarNode || key.Value != name {
			continue
		}
		if value != nil {
			return nil, true, true
		}
		value = mapping.Content[index+1]
	}
	return value, value != nil, false
}

func yamlSourceLine(content []byte, lineNumber int) (int, int, bool) {
	if lineNumber < 1 {
		return 0, 0, false
	}
	start := 0
	for line := 1; line < lineNumber; line++ {
		next := bytes.IndexByte(content[start:], '\n')
		if next < 0 {
			return 0, 0, false
		}
		start += next + 1
	}
	end := len(content)
	if next := bytes.IndexByte(content[start:], '\n'); next >= 0 {
		end = start + next
	}
	return start, end, true
}
