const (
	maxManagedDocumentBytes  int64 = 4 * 1024 * 1024
	maxManagedAggregateBytes int64 = 64 * 1024 * 1024
	maxManagedHostDocuments        = 4096
	maxManagedEntities             = 4096
	maxManagedPlacements           = 16384
	maxManagedRoles                = 128
)

// ReadManagedProjectView reads only directly Installer-owned canonical fields.
// It does not implement Ansible precedence, service validation or derived
// provider/VIP semantics.
func ReadManagedProjectView(projectRoot string) (*ManagedProjectView, error) {
	return ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog(projectRoot, nil)
}

// ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog joins direct owned values only with the
// exact READY catalog selected by the caller. Without it the projection keeps
// stable setting identities and presence, but never exposes raw values.
func ReadManagedProjectViewWithCatalog(projectRoot string, catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView) (*ManagedProjectView, error) {
	root, err := cleanRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	before, err := ProjectRevision(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	read := managedReadBudget{}
	document, _, err := read.ownedDocument(root, managedInventoryDocument)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	all := asMap(document["all"])
	hosts := asMap(all["hosts"])
	targets := asMap(asMap(asMap(all["children"])["platform_targets"])["hosts"])
	if all == nil || hosts == nil || targets == nil {
		return nil, blocked("MANAGED_DOCUMENT_INVALID", "Отсутствуют или некорректны all.hosts и all.children.platform_targets.hosts.", managedInventoryDocument)
	}
	view := &ManagedProjectView{Servers: make(map[string]ManagedServer), Deployments: make(map[string]ManagedDeployment), EndpointGroups: make(map[string]ManagedEndpointGroup), MemberPlacements: []ManagedMemberPlacement{}, HostPlacements: []ManagedHostPlacement{}, PKI: ManagedPKI{Authorities: map[string]map[string]any{}, Profiles: map[string]map[string]any{}, TLSProfiles: map[string]map[string]any{}, Scopes: map[string]map[string]any{}}}
	for hostID := range targets {
		if len(view.Servers) >= maxManagedEntities || !identifierPattern.MatchString(hostID) {
			return nil, managedReadError("Недопустимый ID сервера или превышен лимит серверов.", managedInventoryDocument)
		}
		host := asMap(hosts[hostID])
		if host == nil {
			return nil, blocked("MANAGED_DOCUMENT_INVALID", "Для сервера из platform_targets отсутствует запись в all.hosts.", managedInventoryDocument)
		}
		platformHost := asMap(host["platform_host"])
		server := ManagedServer{HostID: hostID}
		server.Address, _ = host["ansible_host"].(string)
		server.Type, _ = platformHost["type"].(string)
		server.DesiredHostname, _ = platformHost["desiredHostname"].(string)
		if raw, found := host["ansible_port"]; found {
			port, ok := yamlInteger(raw)
			if !ok || port < 1 || port > 65535 {
				return nil, blocked("MANAGED_DOCUMENT_INVALID", "SSH-порт сервера должен быть целым числом от 1 до 65535.", managedInventoryDocument)
			}
			server.SSHPort = &port
		}
		view.Servers[hostID] = server
	}
	if err := readManagedDesiredState(root, &read, view, catalog); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if err := readManagedHostPlacements(root, &read, view, catalog); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	sortManagedView(view)
	view.ApplicationPackages, err = readManagedApplicationPackages(root)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	view.ProjectRevision, err = ProjectRevision(root)
	if err == nil && view.ProjectRevision != before {
		return nil, blocked("PROJECT_CHANGED", "Project changed while reading its managed view", "project")
	}
	return view, err
}

type managedReadBudget struct{ total int64 }

func (budget *managedReadBudget) ownedDocument(root, logical string) (map[string]any, []byte, error) {
	content, err := readF1OwnedDocument(root, logical)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, managedDocumentReadError(err, logical)
	}
	if int64(len(content)) > maxManagedDocumentBytes || budget.total+int64(len(content)) > maxManagedAggregateBytes {
		return nil, nil, managedReadError("Превышен лимит чтения: 4 МиБ на документ или 64 МиБ суммарно.", logical)
	}
	budget.total += int64(len(content))
	document, err := parseManagedYAML(content)
	if err != nil {
		if failure := ManagedDocumentFinding(err); failure != nil {
			return nil, nil, blocked(failure.Code, failure.SafeMessage, logical)
		}
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	return document, content, nil
}

func (budget *managedReadBudget) ownedDocumentOptional(root, logical string) (map[string]any, bool, error) {
	document, _, exists, err := budget.ownedDocumentOptionalBytes(root, logical)
	return document, exists, err
}

func (budget *managedReadBudget) ownedDocumentOptionalBytes(root, logical string) (map[string]any, []byte, bool, error) {
	content, err := readF1OwnedDocument(root, logical)
	if errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) || os.IsNotExist(err) {
		return nil, nil, false, nil
	}
	// This is only an absence classification after the authoritative
	// handle-bound read failed. It never authorizes a later pathname read.
	if err != nil {
		if _, statErr := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(root, filepath.FromSlash(logical))); errors.Is(statErr, os.ErrNotExist) {
			return nil, nil, false, nil
		}
	}
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, false, managedDocumentReadError(err, logical)
	}
	if int64(len(content)) > maxManagedDocumentBytes || budget.total+int64(len(content)) > maxManagedAggregateBytes {
		return nil, nil, false, managedReadError("Превышен лимит чтения: 4 МиБ на документ или 64 МиБ суммарно.", logical)
	}
	budget.total += int64(len(content))
	document, err := parseManagedYAML(content)
	if err != nil {
		if failure := ManagedDocumentFinding(err); failure != nil {
			return nil, nil, false, blocked(failure.Code, failure.SafeMessage, logical)
		}
		return nil, nil, false, err
	}
	return document, content, true, nil
}

func managedReadError(message, field string) error {
	return blocked("MANAGED_DOCUMENT_INVALID", message, field)
}

func managedDocumentReadError(err error, logical string) error {
	message := "Ошибка безопасного чтения документа."
	switch {
	case errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist):
		message = "Обязательный документ не найден."
	case errors.Is(err, os.ErrPermission):
		message = "Отказано в доступе к документу."
	case err.Error() == "managed file is unsafe":
		message = "Путь содержит ссылку/reparse point, имеет недопустимый тип или файл превышает лимит 4 МиБ."
	case err.Error() == "managed file read failed":
		message = "Не удалось прочитать стабильную полную копию документа."
	case err.Error() == "managed file open failed":
		message = "Не удалось открыть дескриптор документа."
	default:
		// Numeric OS codes identify the failure without exposing arbitrary error text.
		var errno syscall.Errno
		if errors.As(err, &errno) {
			message += fmt.Sprintf(" Код ОС: %d.", errno)
		}
	}
	return managedReadError(message, logical)
}

func readManagedDesiredState(root string, budget *managedReadBudget, view *ManagedProjectView, catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView) error {
	document, _, err := budget.ownedDocument(root, desiredDocument)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	state := asMap(document["platform_desired_state"])
	view.ApplicationLibraries = map[string]map[string]any{}
	view.LibraryEndpointGroups = map[string]string{}
	if raw, exists := state[libraryEndpointGroupsKey]; exists {
		groups := asMap(raw)
		if groups == nil || len(groups) > 128 {
			return managedReadError("Старые привязки endpoint должны быть объектом в пределах лимита записей.", desiredDocument)
		}
		for id, rawRef := range groups {
			ref, ok := rawRef.(string)
			if !validLibraryInputID(id) || !ok || !validLibraryInputID(ref) {
				return managedReadError("Недопустимый ID библиотеки или группы endpoint.", desiredDocument)
			}
			view.LibraryEndpointGroups[id] = ref
		}
	}
	view.ApplicationPlacements = map[string]map[string]any{}
	for id, raw := range asMap(state["applicationLibraryDeployments"]) {
		value := asMap(raw)
		field := desiredDocument + ": platform_desired_state.applicationLibraryDeployments." + id
		if !validLibraryInputID(id) || value == nil {
			return managedReadError("Недопустимый ID библиотеки или настройки библиотеки не являются объектом.", field)
		}
		if err := safeApplicationInput(value, 0); err != nil {
			var failure *writerError
			if errors.As(err, &failure) {
				messages := map[string]string{
					"Application input nesting exceeds its limit":                              "Превышен лимит вложенности настроек библиотеки (16).",
					"Application input exceeds its limit":                                      "Превышен лимит полей объекта настроек библиотеки (128).",
					"Application list exceeds its limit":                                       "Превышен лимит элементов списка настроек библиотеки (256).",
					"Registry credentials must contain runtime references":                     "registry_credentials должен быть объектом ссылок на сессионные секреты.",
					"Registry must be a host or host:port without scheme, path or credentials": "Имя registry должно содержать хост и необязательный порт, без схемы, пути и учётных данных.",
					"Registry credentials require username and password references":            "Для registry необходимы ровно две ссылки: username и password.",
					"Registry credentials accept runtime references only":                      "username и password registry должны использовать source.kind: runtime_secret_ref и допустимый ref.",
					"Shared secret descriptors must be a map":                                  "shared_secrets должен быть объектом источников секретов.",
					"Shared secret source is invalid":                                          "Некорректный источник общего секрета shared_secrets.",
					"Account descriptor must be a map":                                         "Настройки учётной записи должны быть объектом.",
					"Account credentials are invalid":                                          "credentials учётной записи должен содержать только username и password.",
					"Credential source is invalid":                                             "Некорректный источник секрета учётной записи.",
					"Secret material is not accepted":                                          "В настройках библиотеки обнаружен закрытый ключ; хранение ключей в проекте запрещено.",
				}
				if message := messages[failure.message]; message != "" {
					return managedReadError(message, field)
				}
			}
			return managedReadError("Некорректная структура настроек библиотеки.", field)
		}
		view.ApplicationLibraries[id] = asMap(deepCopy(value))
		normalizeLibraryVaultBinding(view.ApplicationLibraries[id])
		if raw, exists := asMap(value["bindings"])["endpoint"]; exists {
			binding := asMap(raw)
			ref, ok := binding["endpointGroupRef"].(string)
			if !ok || len(binding) != 1 || !validLibraryInputID(ref) {
				return managedReadError("bindings.endpoint должен содержать только endpointGroupRef с допустимым ID группы.", field+".bindings.endpoint")
			}
			view.LibraryEndpointGroups[id] = ref
		}
	}
	view.DataRootDirectory = "/var/lib"
	if raw, found := document["platform_data_root_directory"]; found {
		value, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || !validProjectSetting("platform_data_root_directory", value) {
			return managedReadError("Некорректен корневой каталог данных platform_data_root_directory.", desiredDocument)
		}
		view.DataRootDirectory = value
	}
	if raw, found := document["platform_name_prefix"]; found {
		value, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || !validProjectSetting("platform_name_prefix", value) {
			return managedReadError("Некорректен префикс имён platform_name_prefix.", desiredDocument)
		}
		view.NamePrefix = value
	}
	deployments := asMap(state["serviceDeployments"])
	groups := asMap(state["endpointGroups"])
	if state == nil || deployments == nil {
		return managedReadError("Отсутствует объект platform_desired_state.serviceDeployments.", desiredDocument)
	}
	if groups == nil {
		groups = map[string]any{}
	}
	for id, raw := range deployments {
		if len(view.Deployments) >= maxManagedEntities || !identifierPattern.MatchString(id) {
			return managedReadError("Недопустимый ID развёртывания или превышен лимит развёртываний.", desiredDocument)
		}
		deployment := asMap(raw)
		serviceType, serviceOK := deployment["serviceType"].(string)
		mode, modeOK := deployment["mode"].(string)
		endpointGroup, endpointOK := optionalString(deployment, "endpointGroup")
		if deployment == nil || !serviceOK || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(serviceType) || !modeOK || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(mode) || !endpointOK || (endpointGroup != "" && !identifierPattern.MatchString(endpointGroup)) {
			return managedReadError("У развёртывания должны быть строковые serviceType и mode, а endpointGroup — допустимым ID.", desiredDocument+": platform_desired_state.serviceDeployments."+id)
		}
		provider, providerErr := managedProviderProjection(deployment)
		if providerErr != nil {
			return providerErr
		}
		configuration, configurationErr := managedConfigurationProjection(deployment, serviceType, catalog, desiredDocument+": platform_desired_state.serviceDeployments."+id)
		if configurationErr != nil {
			return configurationErr
		}
		view.Deployments[id] = ManagedDeployment{DeploymentID: id, ServiceType: serviceType, Mode: mode, EndpointGroup: endpointGroup,
			EndpointGroupRef: provider.endpointGroupRef, VirtualRouterID: provider.virtualRouterID,
			VirtualAddresses: provider.virtualAddresses, ProviderEditState: provider.editState, Configuration: configuration}
	}
	for id, raw := range groups {
		if len(view.EndpointGroups) >= maxManagedEntities || !identifierPattern.MatchString(id) {
			return managedReadError("Недопустимый ID группы endpoint или превышен лимит групп.", desiredDocument)
		}
		group := asMap(raw)
		address := asMap(group["address"])
		domain, domainOK := address["domain"].(string)
		wildcard, wildcardOK := address["wildcard"].(bool)
		if group == nil || address == nil || !domainOK || domain == "" || !wildcardOK {
			return managedReadError("Группа должна содержать address.domain (непустая строка) и address.wildcard (логическое значение).", desiredDocument+": platform_desired_state.endpointGroups."+id)
		}
		view.EndpointGroups[id] = ManagedEndpointGroup{EndpointGroupID: id, Domain: domain, Wildcard: wildcard}
	}
	for _, entry := range []struct {
		key       string
		target    map[string]map[string]any
		operation string
	}{{"certificateAuthorities", view.PKI.Authorities, "CreateCertificateAuthority"}, {"certificateProfiles", view.PKI.Profiles, "CreateCertificateProfile"}, {"tlsProfiles", view.PKI.TLSProfiles, "CreateTLSProfile"}, {"certificateScopes", view.PKI.Scopes, "CreateCertificateScope"}} {
		rawValues := state[entry.key]
		if rawValues == nil {
			continue
		}
		values := asMap(rawValues)
		if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedEntities {
			return managedReadError("Настройки PKI должны быть объектом в пределах лимита записей.", desiredDocument)
		}
		for id, raw := range values {
			entity := asMap(raw)
			if !validDesiredStateIdentifier(id) || validPKIEntity(entry.operation, entity) != nil {
				return managedReadError("Некорректный ID или структура записи PKI.", desiredDocument+": platform_desired_state."+entry.key+"."+id)
			}
			entry.target[id] = deepCopy(entity).(map[string]any)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

type managedProviderView struct {
	endpointGroupRef string
	virtualRouterID  *int
	virtualAddresses []VirtualAddress
	editState        string
}

func managedProviderProjection(deployment map[string]any) (managedProviderView, error) {
	result := managedProviderView{virtualAddresses: []VirtualAddress{}, editState: "NONE"}
	refRaw, hasRef := deployment["endpointGroupRef"]
	routerRaw, hasRouter := deployment["virtualRouterId"]
	addressesRaw, hasAddresses := deployment["virtualAddresses"]
	if !hasRef && !hasRouter && !hasAddresses {
		return result, nil
	}
	if hasRef {
		ref, ok := refRaw.(string)
		if !ok {
			return result, managedReadError("Некорректная ссылка endpointGroupRef провайдера.", desiredDocument)
		}
		result.endpointGroupRef = ref
	}
	if hasRouter {
		routerID, ok := yamlInteger(routerRaw)
		if !ok {
			return result, managedReadError("Некорректный virtualRouterId провайдера.", desiredDocument)
		}
		result.virtualRouterID = &routerID
	}
	if hasAddresses {
		values := asSlice(addressesRaw)
		if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedEntities {
			return result, managedReadError("Некорректный список виртуальных адресов провайдера или превышен лимит.", desiredDocument)
		}
		result.virtualAddresses = make([]VirtualAddress, 0, len(values))
		for _, raw := range values {
			value := asMap(raw)
			address, addressOK := value["address"].(string)
			iface, interfaceOK := value["interface"].(string)
			if value == nil || len(value) != 2 || !addressOK || !interfaceOK {
				return result, managedReadError("Некорректный виртуальный адрес провайдера.", desiredDocument)
			}
			result.virtualAddresses = append(result.virtualAddresses, VirtualAddress{Address: address, Interface: iface})
		}
	}

	unsupported := len(result.virtualAddresses) > 64
	complete := hasRef && hasRouter && hasAddresses && result.endpointGroupRef != "" && result.virtualRouterID != nil && *result.virtualRouterID >= 1 && *result.virtualRouterID <= 255 && len(result.virtualAddresses) != 0
	if result.endpointGroupRef != "" && !identifierPattern.MatchString(result.endpointGroupRef) {
		unsupported = true
	}
	for _, value := range result.virtualAddresses {
		address, addressErr := netip.ParseAddr(value.Address)
		if addressErr != nil || !address.Is4() || value.Interface == "" || !virtualAddressInterfacePattern.MatchString(value.Interface) {
			complete = false
		}
		if len(value.Interface) > 128 {
			unsupported = true
		}
	}
	if unsupported {
		result.editState = "UNSUPPORTED"
		return result, nil
	}
	if complete {
		result.editState = "EDITABLE"
		return result, nil
	}
	result.editState = "INCOMPLETE"
	return result, nil
}

func readManagedHostPlacements(root string, budget *managedReadBudget, view *ManagedProjectView, catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView) error {
	hostIDs := make([]string, 0, len(view.Servers))
	for hostID := range view.Servers {
		hostIDs = append(hostIDs, hostID)
	}
	sort.Strings(hostIDs)
	if len(hostIDs) > maxManagedHostDocuments {
		return managedReadError("Превышен лимит документов host_vars.", "inventory/host_vars")
	}
	for _, hostID := range hostIDs {
		logical := managedHostDocument(hostID)
		document, exists, documentErr := budget.ownedDocumentOptional(root, logical)
		if documentErr != nil {
			// A server without an owned host-vars document has no direct placement.
			// Do not inspect an unbound pathname merely to distinguish absence.
			return documentErr
		}
		if !exists {
			continue
		}
		if placements := asMap(document["platform_application_libraries"]); placements != nil {
			if safeApplicationInput(placements, 0) != nil {
				return managedReadError("Некорректная структура размещения библиотеки приложений.", logical)
			}
			view.ApplicationPlacements[hostID] = asMap(deepCopy(placements))
		}
		placements := asMap(document["platform_deployments"])
		if placements == nil {
			return managedReadError("Отсутствует объект platform_deployments в документе сервера.", logical)
		}
		for deploymentID, raw := range placements {
			if !identifierPattern.MatchString(deploymentID) {
				return managedReadError("Недопустимый ID развёртывания в размещении.", logical)
			}
			placement := asMap(raw)
			if placement == nil {
				return managedReadError("Размещение должно быть объектом.", logical)
			}
			members, hasMembers := placement["members"]
			_, hasRoles := placement["roles"]
			if hasMembers && hasRoles {
				return managedReadError("Размещение одновременно содержит формы экземпляра и сервера.", logical)
			}
			if hasMembers {
				memberMap := asMap(members)
				if memberMap == nil {
					return managedReadError("Некорректная структура размещения экземпляра.", logical)
				}
				for memberID, memberRaw := range memberMap {
					member := asMap(memberRaw)
					roles, rolesErr := managedRoles(member["roles"], logical)
					if rolesErr != nil || !identifierPattern.MatchString(memberID) || len(view.MemberPlacements)+len(view.HostPlacements) >= maxManagedPlacements {
						return managedReadError("Недопустимый экземпляр или превышен лимит размещений.", logical)
					}
					deployment := view.Deployments[deploymentID]
					configuration, configurationErr := managedConfigurationProjection(member, deployment.ServiceType, catalog, logical)
					if configurationErr != nil {
						return configurationErr
					}
					view.MemberPlacements = append(view.MemberPlacements, ManagedMemberPlacement{DeploymentID: deploymentID, MemberID: memberID, HostID: hostID, Roles: roles, Configuration: configuration})
				}
				continue
			}
			roles, rolesErr := managedRoles(placement["roles"], logical)
			if rolesErr != nil || len(view.MemberPlacements)+len(view.HostPlacements) >= maxManagedPlacements {
				return managedReadError("Недопустимое размещение на сервере или превышен лимит.", logical)
			}
			var priority *int
			if rawPriority, present := placement["priority"]; present {
				value, valid := yamlInteger(rawPriority)
				if !valid || value < 1 || value > 254 {
					return managedReadError("Приоритет размещения должен быть целым числом.", logical)
				}
				priority = &value
			}
			view.HostPlacements = append(view.HostPlacements, ManagedHostPlacement{DeploymentID: deploymentID, HostID: hostID, Roles: roles, Priority: priority})
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func managedConfigurationProjection(owner map[string]any, serviceType string, catalog *projectlifecycle.ProjectCatalogView, field string) ([]ManagedConfigurationOverride, error) {
	raw, present := owner["configuration"]
	if !present {
		return []ManagedConfigurationOverride{}, nil
	}
	configuration := asMap(raw)
	if configuration == nil || len(configuration) > maxManagedEntities {
		return nil, managedReadError("Конфигурация должна быть объектом в пределах лимита параметров.", field)
	}
	result := make([]ManagedConfigurationOverride, 0, len(configuration))
	for settingID, value := range configuration {
		if len(settingID) > 128 || !configurationSettingPattern.MatchString(settingID) {
			return nil, managedReadError("Недопустимый идентификатор параметра конфигурации.", field)
		}
		entry := ManagedConfigurationOverride{Setting: settingID, OverridePresent: true, State: "UNKNOWN"}
		if catalog != nil && catalog.Status == "READY" {
			descriptor, found := catalogConfigurationSetting(catalog, serviceType, settingID)
			if !found || descriptor.Kind != "MANAGED" || descriptor.EditorShape == "UNSUPPORTED" {
				entry.State = "UNSUPPORTED"
			} else {
				if err := validateConfigurationValue(descriptor, value); err != nil {
					return nil, managedReadError("Тип или структура значения параметра не соответствует каталогу сервиса.", field+".configuration."+settingID)
				}
				entry.State, entry.Value = "EDITABLE", deepCopy(value)
			}
		}
		result = append(result, entry)
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool { return result[left].Setting < result[right].Setting })
	return result, nil
}

func optionalString(value map[string]any, key string) (string, bool) {
	raw, found := value[key]
	if !found {
		return "", true
	}
	text, ok := raw.(string)
	return text, ok
}

func managedRoles(raw any, field string) ([]string, error) {
	if raw == nil {
		return []string{}, nil
	}
	values := asSlice(raw)
	if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedRoles {
		return nil, managedReadError("Роли размещения должны быть списком в пределах лимита.", field)
	}
	seen := make(map[string]bool, len(values))
	roles := make([]string, 0, len(values))
	for _, rawRole := range values {
		role, ok := rawRole.(string)
		if !ok || !identifierPattern.MatchString(role) || seen[role] {
			return nil, managedReadError("Список ролей содержит недопустимое или повторяющееся имя.", field)
		}
		seen[role] = true
		roles = append(roles, role)
	}
	sort.Strings(roles)
	return roles, nil
}

func sortManagedView(view *ManagedProjectView) {
	sort.Slice(view.MemberPlacements, func(left, right int) bool {
		leftValue, rightValue := view.MemberPlacements[left], view.MemberPlacements[right]
		return leftValue.DeploymentID+"\x00"+leftValue.MemberID+"\x00"+leftValue.HostID < rightValue.DeploymentID+"\x00"+rightValue.MemberID+"\x00"+rightValue.HostID
	})
	sort.Slice(view.HostPlacements, func(left, right int) bool {
		leftValue, rightValue := view.HostPlacements[left], view.HostPlacements[right]
		return leftValue.DeploymentID+"\x00"+leftValue.HostID < rightValue.DeploymentID+"\x00"+rightValue.HostID
	})
}

func yamlInteger(value any) (int, bool) {
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case int:
		return typed, true
	case int64:
		return int(typed), int64(int(typed)) == typed
	case uint64:
		return int(typed), uint64(int(typed)) == typed
	default:
		return 0, false
	}
}

func blockedStructuralPlan(revision string, err error) *StructuralEditPlan {
	plan := &StructuralEditPlan{APIVersion: StructuralPlanAPIVersion, Kind: "StructuralEditPlan", Status: "BLOCKED",
		BaseProjectRevision: revision, SemanticChanges: []SemanticChange{}, AffectedEntities: []string{},
		AffectedDocuments: []DocumentChange{}, SaveAllowed: false}
	if typed, ok := err.(*writerError); ok {
		finding := typed.finding()
		plan.Finding = &finding
	}
	return plan
}

// PlanStructuralSave builds a bounded local preview for server and topology intents and
// stores its candidate bytes in the existing opaque plan store.
func (b *Backend) PlanStructuralSave(ctx context.Context, projectRoot, classification, revision string, commands []EditCommand) (*StructuralEditPlan, error) {
	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	if len(commands) == 0 {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_EMPTY", "Edit session contains no commands", "session")), nil
	}
	if len(commands) > 16 {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("EDIT_SESSION_COMMANDS_UNSUPPORTED", "This edit set must be split", "session")), nil
	}
	for _, command := range commands {
		if command.Operation != "CreateServer" && command.Operation != "UpdateServer" && command.Operation != "DeleteServer" && !topologyOperation(command.Operation) {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, blocked("EDIT_OPERATION_NOT_AVAILABLE", "Edit operation is not available in this editor", "command.operation")), nil
		}
		if err := b.validateCommand(command); err != nil {
			return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
		}
	}
	root, err := cleanRoot(projectRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return blockedStructuralPlan(revision, err), nil
	}
	return b.planStructuralCandidate(ctx, root, classification, revision, commands)
}

func (b *Backend) storeStructuralPlan(root, revision string, changes []SemanticChange, documents []storedDocument) (*StructuralEditPlan, error) {
	if len(documents) == 0 {
		return &StructuralEditPlan{APIVersion: StructuralPlanAPIVersion, Kind: "StructuralEditPlan", Status: "NO_CHANGE", BaseProjectRevision: revision,
			SemanticChanges: []SemanticChange{}, AffectedEntities: []string{}, AffectedDocuments: []DocumentChange{}, SaveAllowed: false}, nil
	}
	documentChanges := make([]DocumentChange, 0, len(documents))
	diffs := make([]string, 0, len(documents))
	for _, document := range documents {
		before := &DocumentState{State: "ABSENT"}
		if document.Existed {
			before = &DocumentState{State: "PRESENT", Digest: digestBytes(document.Before)}
		}
		after := &DocumentState{State: "PRESENT", Digest: digestBytes(document.After)}
		if document.Deleted {
			after = &DocumentState{State: "ABSENT"}
		}
		documentChanges = append(documentChanges, DocumentChange{LogicalPath: document.LogicalPath, Before: before, After: after})
		diffs = append(diffs, boundedDiff(document.LogicalPath, document.Before, document.After))
	}
	plan := StructuralEditPlan{APIVersion: StructuralPlanAPIVersion, Kind: "StructuralEditPlan", Status: "READY", BaseProjectRevision: revision,
		SemanticChanges: changes, AffectedEntities: affectedEntities(changes), AffectedDocuments: documentChanges,
		ReviewDiff: strings.Join(diffs, ""), SaveAllowed: true, ExpiresAt: b.now().Add(b.planTTL)}
	internal := EditPlan{APIVersion: EditPlanAPIVersionV2, Kind: "EditPlan", Status: "READY", BaseProjectRevision: revision,
		AffectedDocuments: documentChanges, CommitAllowed: true, ApplyRequired: true}
	id, err := b.plans.Put(storedPlan{Created: b.now(), ProjectRoot: root, Public: internal, LocalOnly: true, Documents: documents})
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	plan.PlanID = id
	return &plan, nil
}

func (b *Backend) CommitStructuralSave(ctx context.Context, planID string) StructuralSaveResult {
	result := b.CommitEditPlanV2(ctx, planID)
	return StructuralSaveResult{APIVersion: StructuralResultAPIVersion, Kind: "StructuralSaveResult", Status: result.Status,
		Changed: result.Changed, Finding: result.Finding, OldProjectRevision: result.OldProjectRevision,
		NewProjectRevision: result.NewProjectRevision, AffectedDocuments: result.AffectedDocuments, Timing: result.Timing, Managed: result.Managed}
}

// A pathname check is used only to classify an already-failed handle-relative
// open as absence. It never authorizes a subsequent read from that pathname.
func managedDirectoryAbsent(root string, parts ...string) bool {
	_, err := os.Lstat(filepath.Join(append([]string{root}, parts...)...))
	return errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist)
}

package installer

// desiredStateIdentifierPattern is deliberately separate from the shorter
// Installer command ID grammar. PKI references are desired-state fields and
// must use the grammar published by project/v2alpha1.
var desiredStateIdentifierPattern = regexp.MustCompile(`^[a-z][a-z0-9]*(?:[-_.][a-z0-9]+)*$`)

func pkiOperation(operation string) bool {
	switch operation {
	case "CreateCertificateAuthority", "UpdateCertificateAuthority", "DeleteCertificateAuthority", "CreateCertificateProfile", "UpdateCertificateProfile", "DeleteCertificateProfile", "CreateTLSProfile", "UpdateTLSProfile", "DeleteTLSProfile", "CreateCertificateScope", "UpdateCertificateScope", "DeleteCertificateScope":
		return true
	}
	return false
}

func pkiMap(state map[string]any, key string) map[string]any {
	value := asMap(state[key])
	if value == nil {
		value = map[string]any{}
		state[key] = value
	}
	return value
}

func reducePKICommand(state map[string]any, command EditCommand, mutations topologyMutationSet) error {
	var values map[string]any
	var deleted map[string]bool
	switch command.Operation {
	case "CreateCertificateAuthority", "UpdateCertificateAuthority", "DeleteCertificateAuthority":
		values, deleted = pkiMap(state, "certificateAuthorities"), mutations.deletedAuthorities
	case "CreateCertificateProfile", "UpdateCertificateProfile", "DeleteCertificateProfile":
		values, deleted = pkiMap(state, "certificateProfiles"), mutations.deletedProfiles
	case "CreateTLSProfile", "UpdateTLSProfile", "DeleteTLSProfile":
		values, deleted = pkiMap(state, "tlsProfiles"), mutations.deletedTLSProfiles
	case "CreateCertificateScope", "UpdateCertificateScope", "DeleteCertificateScope":
		values = pkiMap(state, "certificateScopes")
	}
	if values == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "PKI operation is unsupported", "command.operation")
	}
	if command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV7 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV8 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV9 && command.APIVersion != EditCommandAPIVersionV10 {
		return blocked("EDIT_OPERATION_UNAVAILABLE", "PKI editing requires v1alpha7 or a compatible later contract", "command.apiVersion")
	}
	if command.Operation[:6] == "Create" {
		if values[command.EntityID] != nil {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "PKI entity already exists", "command.entityId")
		}
		if err := validPKIEntity(command.Operation, command.Entity); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		values[command.EntityID] = deepCopy(command.Entity)
		return nil
	}
	if command.Operation[:6] == "Update" {
		if values[command.EntityID] == nil {
			return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "PKI entity does not exist", "command.entityId")
		}
		if err := validPKIEntity(command.Operation, command.Entity); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		next := deepCopy(command.Entity).(map[string]any)
		for key, value := range asMap(values[command.EntityID]) {
			if _, supplied := next[key]; extensionKeyPattern.MatchString(key) && !supplied {
				next[key] = deepCopy(value)
			}
		}
		values[command.EntityID] = next
		return nil
	}
	if values[command.EntityID] == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_EDIT_COMMAND", "PKI entity does not exist", "command.entityId")
	}
	delete(values, command.EntityID)
	if deleted != nil {
		deleted[command.EntityID] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func validPKIEntity(operation string, value map[string]any) error {
	if value == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI entity is required", "command.entity")
	}
	if operation == "CreateCertificateAuthority" || operation == "UpdateCertificateAuthority" {
		if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"mode", "displayName", "commonName", "validityDays"}, "command.entity"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if value["mode"] != "MANAGED" {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Only MANAGED certificate authorities are supported", "command.entity.mode")
		}
		if name, ok := value["commonName"].(string); !ok || name == "" || len(name) > 128 {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate authority common name is invalid", "command.entity.commonName")
		}
		if err := validOptionalString(value, "displayName", 1, 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return validOptionalInteger(value, "validityDays", 1, "command.entity.validityDays")
	}
	if operation == "CreateCertificateProfile" || operation == "UpdateCertificateProfile" {
		if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"displayName", "authorityRef", "keyAlgorithm", "keySize", "validityDays", "usages", "sanPolicy", "subject"}, "command.entity"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if ref, ok := value["authorityRef"].(string); !ok || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(ref) || asMap(value["sanPolicy"]) == nil {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate profile is invalid", "command.entity")
		}
		if err := validOptionalString(value, "displayName", 1, 0); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := validOptionalInteger(value, "keySize", 2048, "command.entity.keySize"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := validOptionalInteger(value, "validityDays", 1, "command.entity.validityDays"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if algorithm, present := value["keyAlgorithm"]; present && algorithm != "RSA" && algorithm != "EC" {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate profile key algorithm is invalid", "command.entity.keyAlgorithm")
		}
		if raw, present := value["usages"]; present {
			if err := validPKIEnumList(raw, "command.entity.usages", []string{"serverAuth", "clientAuth"}, maxManagedEntities); err != nil {
				return err
			}
		}
		if err := validClosedBoolMap(asMap(value["sanPolicy"]), []string{"includeHostDns", "includeHostIp", "includeEndpointFqdns", "includeEndpointWildcard", "includeEndpointVip"}, "command.entity.sanPolicy"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if raw, present := value["subject"]; present {
			subject := asMap(raw)
			if subject == nil {
				return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate subject is invalid", "command.entity.subject")
			}
			return validSubjectDN(subject)
		}
		return nil
	}
	if operation == "CreateTLSProfile" || operation == "UpdateTLSProfile" {
		if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"certificateProfileRef", "scope", "storePasswordSecretRef"}, "command.entity"); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if ref, ok := value["certificateProfileRef"].(string); !ok || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(ref) {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "TLS profile certificate reference is invalid", "command.entity.certificateProfileRef")
		}
		if ref, ok := value["storePasswordSecretRef"].(string); !ok || !runtimeRefPattern.MatchString(ref) {
			return blocked("SECRET_REFERENCE_INVALID", "TLS profile requires an opaque runtime secret reference", "command.entity.storePasswordSecretRef")
		}
		if err := validOptionalScope(value, "scope", "command.entity.scope", true); err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	}
	if operation != "CreateCertificateScope" && operation != "UpdateCertificateScope" {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI operation is unsupported", "command.operation")
	}
	if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"displayName", "profile", "scope", "sources"}, "command.entity"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if ref, ok := value["profile"].(string); !ok || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(ref) || asMap(value["sources"]) == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate scope is invalid", "command.entity")
	}
	if err := validOptionalString(value, "displayName", 1, 0); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if err := validOptionalScope(value, "scope", "command.entity.scope", false); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	return validScopeSources(asMap(value["sources"]))
}

func validPKIObjectKeys(value map[string]any, keys []string, field string) error {
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, key := range keys {
		allowed[key] = true
	}
	for key := range value {
		if !allowed[key] && !extensionKeyPattern.MatchString(key) {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI entity contains an unknown field", field)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validOptionalString(value map[string]any, key string, min, max int) error {
	raw, present := value[key]
	if !present {
		return nil
	}
	text, ok := raw.(string)
	if !ok || (min > 0 && len(text) < min) || (max > 0 && len(text) > max) {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI string field is invalid", "command.entity."+key)
	}
	return nil
}

func validOptionalInteger(value map[string]any, key string, min int, field string) error {
	raw, present := value[key]
	if !present {
		return nil
	}
	number, ok := pkiInteger(raw)
	if !ok || number < min {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI integer field is invalid", field)
	}
	return nil
}

func pkiInteger(value any) (int, bool) {
	if number, ok := yamlInteger(value); ok {
		return number, true
	}
	var number float64
	switch typed := value.(type) {
	case float64:
		number = typed
	case json.Number:
		parsed, err := strconv.ParseFloat(string(typed), 64)
		if err != nil {
			return 0, false
		}
		number = parsed
	default:
		return 0, false
	}
	// A decoded float64 has at most 53 exact integer bits. Do not round a JSON
	// number or convert an out-of-range value to the platform int type.
	if math.IsNaN(number) || math.IsInf(number, 0) || math.Trunc(number) != number || number < float64(-maxIntValue()) || number > float64(maxIntValue()) || number > 1<<53 || number < -(1<<53) {
		return 0, false
	}
	return int(number), true
}

func maxIntValue() int {
	return int(^uint(0) >> 1)
}

func validDesiredStateIdentifier(value string) bool {
	return len(value) >= 1 && len(value) <= 128 && desiredStateIdentifierPattern.MatchString(value)
}

func validOptionalScope(value map[string]any, key, field string, allowProject bool) error {
	raw, present := value[key]
	if !present {
		return nil
	}
	if raw != "HOST" && raw != "MEMBER" && raw != "DEPLOYMENT" && !(allowProject && raw == "PROJECT") {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI scope is invalid", field)
	}
	return nil
}

func validClosedBoolMap(value map[string]any, keys []string, field string) error {
	if value == nil {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI object is invalid", field)
	}
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, key := range keys {
		allowed[key] = true
	}
	for key, raw := range value {
		if !allowed[key] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI object contains an unknown field", field)
		}
		if _, ok := raw.(bool); !ok {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI policy value is invalid", field)
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validSubjectDN(value map[string]any) error {
	if value == nil {
		return nil
	}
	limits := map[string]int{"C": 2, "ST": 128, "L": 128, "O": 128, "OU": 128}
	for key, raw := range value {
		limit, allowed := limits[key]
		text, ok := raw.(string)
		if !allowed || !ok || len(text) > limit {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Certificate subject is invalid", "command.entity.subject")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func validPKIEnumList(value any, field string, allowedValues []string, limit int) error {
	values := asSlice(value)
	if values == nil || len(values) > limit {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI list is invalid", field)
	}
	allowed := map[string]bool{}
	for _, item := range allowedValues {
		allowed[item] = true
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range values {
		item, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || !allowed[item] || seen[item] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI list item is invalid", field)
		}
		seen[item] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func validScopeSources(value map[string]any) error {
	if err := validPKIObjectKeys(value, []string{"serviceDeployments", "hosts", "members", "explicitDnsNames", "explicitIpAddresses"}, "command.entity.sources"); err != nil {
		return err
	}
	if raw, present := value["serviceDeployments"]; present {
		if err := validIdentifierList(raw, "command.entity.sources.serviceDeployments", maxManagedEntities); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if raw, present := value["hosts"]; present {
		if err := validIdentifierList(raw, "command.entity.sources.hosts", maxManagedEntities); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if raw, present := value["members"]; present {
		if err := validMemberReferenceList(raw); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if raw, present := value["explicitDnsNames"]; present {
		if err := validStringList(raw, "command.entity.sources.explicitDnsNames", false); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	if raw, present := value["explicitIpAddresses"]; present {
		return validStringList(raw, "command.entity.sources.explicitIpAddresses", true)
	}
	return nil
}

func validIdentifierList(value any, field string, limit int) error {
	values := asSlice(value)
	if values == nil || len(values) > limit {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI identifier list is invalid", field)
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range values {
		item, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(item) || seen[item] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI identifier list item is invalid", field)
		}
		seen[item] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func validMemberReferenceList(value any) error {
	values := asSlice(value)
	if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedPlacements {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI member list is invalid", "command.entity.sources.members")
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range values {
		member := asMap(raw)
		deploymentID, deploymentOK := member["deploymentId"].(string)
		memberID, memberOK := member["memberId"].(string)
		key := deploymentID + "\x00" + memberID
		if len(member) != 2 || !deploymentOK || !memberOK || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(deploymentID) || !validDesiredStateIdentifier(memberID) || seen[key] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI member reference is invalid", "command.entity.sources.members")
		}
		seen[key] = true
	}
	return nil
}

func validStringList(value any, field string, requireIP bool) error {
	values := asSlice(value)
	if values == nil || len(values) > maxManagedEntities {
		return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI string list is invalid", field)
	}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	for _, raw := range values {
		text, ok := raw.(string)
		if !ok || text == "" || seen[text] {
			return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "PKI string list item is invalid", field)
		}
		if requireIP {
			if _, err := netip.ParseAddr(text); err != nil {
				return blocked("INVALID_VALUE", "Explicit IP address is invalid", field)
			}
		}
		seen[text] = true
	}
	return nil
}

package installer

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"

)

type storedDocument struct {
	LogicalPath string
	Before      []byte
	After       []byte
	Existed     bool
	Deleted     bool
}

type storedPlan struct {
	Created     time.Time
	ProjectRoot string
	Public      EditPlan
	LocalOnly   bool
	Documents   []storedDocument
}

type PlanStore interface {
	Put(plan storedPlan) (string, error)
	Get(id string) (storedPlan, bool)
	Discard(id string) bool
}

type MemoryPlanStore struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	ttl   time.Duration
	now   func() time.Time
	plans map[string]storedPlan
}

func NewMemoryPlanStore(ttl time.Duration) *MemoryPlanStore {
	return &MemoryPlanStore{ttl: ttl, now: time.Now, plans: make(map[string]storedPlan)}
}

func cloneStoredPlan(plan storedPlan) storedPlan {
	copyPlan := plan
	copyPlan.Public.AffectedDocuments = append([]DocumentChange(nil), plan.Public.AffectedDocuments...)
	copyPlan.Public.SemanticChanges = append([]SemanticChange(nil), plan.Public.SemanticChanges...)
	copyPlan.Documents = make([]storedDocument, len(plan.Documents))
	for index, document := range plan.Documents {
		copyPlan.Documents[index] = document
		copyPlan.Documents[index].Before = append([]byte(nil), document.Before...)
		copyPlan.Documents[index].After = append([]byte(nil), document.After...)
	}
	return copyPlan
}

func (s *MemoryPlanStore) Put(plan storedPlan) (string, error) {
	identifier := make([]byte, 16)
	if _, err := rand.Read(identifier); err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	id := hex.EncodeToString(identifier)
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	s.plans[id] = cloneStoredPlan(plan)
	return id, nil
}

func (s *MemoryPlanStore) Get(id string) (storedPlan, bool) {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	plan, found := s.plans[id]
	if !found {
		return storedPlan{}, false
	}
	if s.ttl > 0 && s.now().Sub(plan.Created) > s.ttl {
		delete(s.plans, id)
		return storedPlan{}, false
	}
	return cloneStoredPlan(plan), true
}

func (s *MemoryPlanStore) Discard(id string) bool {
	s.mu.Lock()
	defer s.mu.Unlock()
	_, found := s.plans[id]
	delete(s.plans, id)
	return found
}

import (

const maxPreviewAssetDigests = 4096

var previewAssetDigests = struct {
	sync.Mutex
	values map[fileversion.Stamp]string
}{values: make(map[fileversion.Stamp]string)}

type previewAssetRead struct {
	stamp     fileversion.Stamp
	cacheable bool
	digest    string
}

func (read *previewAssetRead) lookup(file *os.File) bool {
	read.stamp, read.cacheable = fileversion.Read(file)
	if read.cacheable {
		previewAssetDigests.Lock()
		read.digest = previewAssetDigests.values[read.stamp]
		previewAssetDigests.Unlock()
	}
	return read.digest != ""
}

func (read *previewAssetRead) unchanged(file *os.File) bool {
	if !read.cacheable {
		return true
	}
	stamp, ok := fileversion.Read(file)
	return ok && stamp == read.stamp
}

func (read *previewAssetRead) remember(digest string) {
	if !read.cacheable {
		return
	}
	previewAssetDigests.Lock()
	defer previewAssetDigests.Unlock()
	if len(previewAssetDigests.values) >= maxPreviewAssetDigests {
		clear(previewAssetDigests.values)
	}
	previewAssetDigests.values[read.stamp] = digest
}

func packageAssetPath(logical string) bool {
	parts := strings.SplitN(logical, "/", 5)
	return len(parts) == 5 && (parts[0] == "application-packages" || parts[0] == "library-packages") && parts[3] == "assets"
}

func tryProcessFileLock(file *os.File) (func() error, bool, error) {
	err := unix.Flock(int(file.Fd()), unix.LOCK_EX|unix.LOCK_NB)

	if err != nil {

}

@@PORTABLE {"path":"internal/installer/project_export.go","mode":420,"size":21947,"sha256":"4fabdc579a01be244802a9aaf37b40f816b63ecc1a3f111b1dd8b6786787362a","index":0,"count":1,"newline":"lf","encoding":"utf-8","payloadBytes":21947}
package installer

import (

	"crypto/sha256"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"

	"path/filepath"

const (
	projectExportAPIVersion   = "platform.installer/project-export/v1alpha1"
	maxExportFiles            = 4096
	maxExportDirectoryEntries = maxExportFiles
	maxExportLogicalBytes     = 512
)

// ProjectExportDocument is bounded metadata for one portable desired-state
// document. Content is intentionally never returned across the App/Wails seam.
type ProjectExportDocument struct {
	LogicalPath string `json:"logicalPath"`
	Size        int64  `json:"size"`
	Digest      string `json:"digest"`
}

// ProjectExportPlan is an in-memory capability summary, not portable desired
// state and not a public/versioned project contract.
type ProjectExportPlan struct {
	APIVersion            string                  `json:"apiVersion"`
	Kind                  string                  `json:"kind"`
	SourceProjectRoot     string                  `json:"sourceProjectRoot"`
	SourceProjectRevision string                  `json:"sourceProjectRevision"`
	DestinationParent     string                  `json:"destinationParent"`
	DirectoryName         string                  `json:"directoryName"`
	DestinationRoot       string                  `json:"destinationRoot"`
	Documents             []ProjectExportDocument `json:"documents"`
	AggregateSize         int64                   `json:"aggregateSize"`
	ExcludedCategories    []string                `json:"excludedCategories"`
	PlanDigest            string                  `json:"planDigest"`
}

type ProjectExportResult struct {
	APIVersion            string `json:"apiVersion"`
	Kind                  string `json:"kind"`
	Status                string `json:"status"`
	DestinationRoot       string `json:"destinationRoot,omitempty"`
	SourceProjectRevision string `json:"sourceProjectRevision,omitempty"`
	DocumentCount         int    `json:"documentCount"`
	AggregateSize         int64  `json:"aggregateSize"`
	ErrorCode             string `json:"errorCode,omitempty"`
}

// ProjectExport retains the two opened filesystem authorities for one preview
// and exactly one commit attempt. It must be closed when the App invalidates
// the preview or shuts down.
type ProjectExport struct {
	source           *exportDirectory
	destination      *exportDirectory
	sourceIdentity   exportIdentity
	destIdentity     exportIdentity
	sourceDisplay    string
	destDisplay      string
	directoryName    string
	plan             ProjectExportPlan
	manifest         exportObservation
	writeObservation func(*exportDirectory, exportObservation) error
	closed           bool
}

func PlanProjectExport(sourceRoot, destinationParent, directoryName string) (*ProjectExport, ProjectExportPlan, error) {
	name, err := ValidateExportDirectoryName(directoryName)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, err
	}
	sourceDisplay, err := absoluteExportDisplayPath(sourceRoot)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	destDisplay, err := absoluteExportDisplayPath(destinationParent)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_INVALID")
	}
	if rootsOverlap(sourceDisplay, filepath.Join(destDisplay, name)) {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_INVALID")
	}
	source, err := openExportSourceDirectory(sourceDisplay)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	destination, err := openExportDestinationDirectory(destDisplay)
	if err != nil {
		source.close()
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE")
	}
	capability := &ProjectExport{source: source, destination: destination, sourceIdentity: source.identity(), destIdentity: destination.identity(), sourceDisplay: sourceDisplay, destDisplay: destDisplay, directoryName: name}
	observation, err := stableExportObservation(source)
	if err != nil {
		capability.Close()
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New(exportErrorCode(err, "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE"))
	}
	if exists, existErr := destination.exists(name); existErr != nil || exists {
		capability.Close()
		if existErr != nil {
			return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE")
		}
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, errors.New("EXPORT_DESTINATION_EXISTS")
	}
	output, err := namedExportObservation(observation, name)
	if err != nil {
		capability.Close()
		return nil, ProjectExportPlan{}, err
	}
	plan := projectExportPlan(sourceDisplay, destDisplay, name, capability.sourceIdentity, capability.destIdentity, output, observation.revision)
	// The capability retains only integrity metadata between preview and
	// commit. Exact bytes are re-read through the held source authority during
	// Commit, after the source has been proven unchanged.
	capability.plan, capability.manifest = plan, exportObservationMetadata(observation)
	return capability, cloneProjectExportPlan(plan), nil
}

func (export *ProjectExport) Plan() ProjectExportPlan { return cloneProjectExportPlan(export.plan) }

func (export *ProjectExport) Close() {
	if export == nil || export.closed {
		return
	}
	export.closed = true
	if export.source != nil {
		export.source.close()
	}
	if export.destination != nil {
		export.destination.close()
	}
}

func (export *ProjectExport) Commit(planDigest string) (result ProjectExportResult) {
	result = ProjectExportResult{APIVersion: projectExportAPIVersion, Kind: "ProjectExportResult", Status: "FAILED", ErrorCode: "EXPORT_PLAN_STALE"}
	if export == nil || export.closed || planDigest == "" || planDigest != export.plan.PlanDigest {
		return result
	}
	defer export.Close()
	if export.source.identity() != export.sourceIdentity || export.destination.identity() != export.destIdentity {
		result.ErrorCode = "PROJECT_CHANGED"
		return result
	}
	observation, err := stableExportObservation(export.source)
	if err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = exportErrorCode(err, "PROJECT_CHANGED")
		return result
	}
	if !sameExportObservation(observation, export.manifest) {
		result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_PLAN_STALE"
		return result
	}
	output, err := namedExportObservation(observation, export.directoryName)
	if err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = exportErrorCode(err, "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
		return result
	}
	if exists, existErr := export.destination.exists(export.directoryName); existErr != nil || exists {
		if existErr != nil {
			result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE"
		} else {
			result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_DESTINATION_EXISTS"
		}
		return result
	}
	staging, stagingName, err := export.destination.createStaging(export.directoryName)
	if err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED"
		return result
	}
	published := false
	defer func() {
		if !published {
			if cleanupErr := export.destination.removeOwnedTree(staging, stagingName); cleanupErr != nil {
				result.ErrorCode = exportErrorCode(cleanupErr, "EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED")
			}
		}
		staging.close()
	}()
	write := writeExportObservation
	if export.writeObservation != nil {
		write = export.writeObservation
	}
	if err := write(staging, output); err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = exportErrorCode(err, "EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED")
		return result
	}
	if err := verifyExportObservation(staging, output); err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED"
		return result
	}
	finalObservation, err := stableExportObservation(export.source)
	if err != nil || !sameExportObservation(finalObservation, export.manifest) || export.source.identity() != export.sourceIdentity {
		result.ErrorCode = "PROJECT_CHANGED"
		return result
	}
	if exists, existErr := export.destination.exists(export.directoryName); existErr != nil || exists {
		if existErr != nil {
			result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE"
		} else {
			result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_DESTINATION_EXISTS"
		}
		return result
	}
	if err := export.destination.publish(staging, stagingName, export.directoryName); err != nil {
		result.ErrorCode = "EXPORT_PUBLISH_FAILED"
		return result
	}
	published = true
	return ProjectExportResult{APIVersion: projectExportAPIVersion, Kind: "ProjectExportResult", Status: "EXPORTED", DestinationRoot: filepath.Join(export.destDisplay, export.directoryName), SourceProjectRevision: observation.revision, DocumentCount: len(output.documents), AggregateSize: output.total}
}

type exportRecord struct {
	ProjectExportDocument
	identity exportFileIdentity
	content  []byte
}

type exportObservation struct {
	reusePreviewAssets bool
	digestOnly         bool
	documents          []exportRecord
	revision           string
	total              int64
}

func exportObservationMetadata(observation exportObservation) exportObservation {
	metadata := exportObservation{
		documents: make([]exportRecord, len(observation.documents)),
		revision:  observation.revision,
		total:     observation.total,
	}
	for index, record := range observation.documents {
		metadata.documents[index] = exportRecord{
			ProjectExportDocument: record.ProjectExportDocument,
			identity:              record.identity,
		}
	}
	return metadata
}

func stableExportObservation(root *exportDirectory) (exportObservation, error) {
	first, err := observeExportProject(root)
	if err != nil {
		return exportObservation{}, err
	}
	second, err := observeExportProject(root)
	if err != nil {
		return exportObservation{}, err
	}
	if !sameExportObservation(first, second) {
		return exportObservation{}, errors.New("PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	return second, nil
}

func observeExportProject(root *exportDirectory) (exportObservation, error) {
	if root == nil || root.identity().empty() {
		return exportObservation{}, errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	result := exportObservation{}
	seen := map[string]bool{}
	caseFolded := map[string]bool{}
	for _, logical := range []string{"project.yml", "ansible.cfg", "inventory/hosts.yml"} {
		if err := addExportDocument(root, logical, &result, seen, caseFolded); err != nil {
			if isExportNotExist(err) {
				continue
			}
			return exportObservation{}, err
		}
	}
	for _, logical := range []string{"inventory/group_vars", "inventory/host_vars", "application-packages", "library-packages"} {
		directory, err := root.openDirectory(strings.Split(logical, "/"))
		if isExportNotExist(err) {
			continue
		}
		if err != nil {
			return exportObservation{}, errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
		}
		err = collectExportDirectory(directory, logical, &result, seen, caseFolded)
		directory.close()
		if err != nil {
			return exportObservation{}, err
		}
	}
	if err := validateExportPackages(result.documents); err != nil {
		return exportObservation{}, err
	}
	sort.Slice(result.documents, func(left, right int) bool {
		return result.documents[left].LogicalPath < result.documents[right].LogicalPath
	})
	result.revision = exportContentRevision(result.documents)
	return result, nil
}

func exportContentRevision(documents []exportRecord) string {
	var revisionInput []byte
	for _, document := range documents {
		if document.LogicalPath == generatedDocument {
			continue
		}
		revisionInput = append(revisionInput, []byte(document.LogicalPath)...)
		revisionInput = append(revisionInput, 0)
		revisionInput = append(revisionInput, []byte(document.Digest)...)
		revisionInput = append(revisionInput, 0)
	}
	return digestBytes(revisionInput)
}

func exportPackagePathError(logical, code, message string) error {
	if strings.HasPrefix(logical, "application-packages/") || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "library-packages/") {
		return blocked(code, message+" «"+logical+"».", logical)
	}
	return errors.New(code)
}

func collectExportDirectory(directory *exportDirectory, prefix string, result *exportObservation, seen, caseFolded map[string]bool) error {
	entries, err := directory.entries()
	if err != nil {
		return exportPackagePathError(prefix, "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE", "Не удалось безопасно прочитать каталог")
	}
	for _, entry := range entries {
		logical := prefix + "/" + entry.name
		if !safeExportLogicalPath(logical) {
			return exportPackagePathError(logical, "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE", "Недопустимый путь")
		}
		switch entry.kind {
		case exportEntryDirectory:
			child, openErr := directory.openDirectory([]string{entry.name})
			if openErr != nil {
				return exportPackagePathError(logical, "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE", "Не удалось безопасно открыть каталог")
			}
			recurseErr := collectExportDirectory(child, logical, result, seen, caseFolded)
			child.close()
			if recurseErr != nil {
				return recurseErr
			}
		case exportEntryRegular:
			if logical == generatedDocument {
				continue
			}
			extension := strings.ToLower(path.Ext(entry.name))
			if strings.HasPrefix(logical, "application-packages/") || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "library-packages/") || extension == ".yml" || extension == ".yaml" || extension == ".json" {
				if strings.HasPrefix(logical, "application-packages/") || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "library-packages/") {
					if !safeApplicationPackagePath(logical) {
						return exportPackagePathError(logical, "APPLICATION_PACKAGE_PATH_INVALID", "Путь не разрешён для пакета. Ожидается <имя>/<версия>/application.yml и объявленные файлы пакета:")
					}
				}
				if err := addExportDocument(directory, entry.name, result, seen, caseFolded, logical); err != nil {
					return err
				}
			}
		default:
			return exportPackagePathError(logical, "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE", "Элемент не является обычным файлом или каталогом")
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func addExportDocument(root *exportDirectory, logical string, result *exportObservation, seen, caseFolded map[string]bool, explicit ...string) error {
	parts := strings.Split(logical, "/")
	storedLogical := logical
	if len(explicit) == 1 {
		storedLogical = explicit[0]
	}
	if !safeExportLogicalPath(storedLogical) {
		return errors.New("EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE")
	}
	if seen[storedLogical] || caseFolded[strings.ToLower(storedLogical)] {
		return exportPackagePathError(storedLogical, "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE", "Повторяющийся путь с учётом регистра")
	}
	var content []byte
	var identity exportFileIdentity
	var size int64
	var digest string
	var err error
	if result.digestOnly {
		h := sha256.New()
		if result.reusePreviewAssets && packageAssetPath(storedLogical) {
			var read previewAssetRead
			size, identity, err = root.streamFile(parts, 0, h, &read)
			digest = read.digest
			if err == nil && digest == "" {
				digest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
				read.remember(digest)
			}
		} else {
			size, identity, err = root.streamFile(parts, 0, h)
			digest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(h.Sum(nil))
		}
	} else {
		content, identity, err = root.readFile(parts, 0)
		size = int64(len(content))
		digest = digestBytes(content)
	}
	if err != nil {
		if strings.HasPrefix(storedLogical, "application-packages/") || strings.HasPrefix(storedLogical, "library-packages/") {
			return exportPackagePathError(storedLogical, "APPLICATION_PACKAGE_INVALID", "Не удалось безопасно прочитать файл")
		}
		return err
	}
	if len(result.documents) >= maxExportFiles {
		return exportPackagePathError(storedLogical, "EXPORT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", "Превышен лимит количества файлов проекта")
	}
	seen[storedLogical], caseFolded[strings.ToLower(storedLogical)] = true, true
	record := exportRecord{ProjectExportDocument: ProjectExportDocument{LogicalPath: storedLogical, Size: size, Digest: digest}, identity: identity, content: content}
	result.documents = append(result.documents, record)
	result.total += size
	return nil
}

func safeExportLogicalPath(logical string) bool {
	if logical == "" || len([]byte(logical)) > maxExportLogicalBytes || strings.Contains(logical, "\\") || path.Clean(logical) != logical || strings.HasPrefix(logical, "/") {
		return false
	}
	for _, part := range strings.Split(logical, "/") {
		if part == "" || part == "." || part == ".." {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func sameExportObservation(left, right exportObservation) bool {
	if left.revision != right.revision || left.total != right.total || len(left.documents) != len(right.documents) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left.documents {
		leftDocument, rightDocument := left.documents[index], right.documents[index]
		if leftDocument.LogicalPath != rightDocument.LogicalPath || leftDocument.Size != rightDocument.Size || leftDocument.Digest != rightDocument.Digest || leftDocument.identity != rightDocument.identity {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func sameExportContentObservation(left, right exportObservation) bool {
	if left.revision != right.revision || left.total != right.total || len(left.documents) != len(right.documents) {
		return false
	}
	for index := range left.documents {
		leftDocument, rightDocument := left.documents[index], right.documents[index]
		if leftDocument.LogicalPath != rightDocument.LogicalPath || leftDocument.Size != rightDocument.Size || leftDocument.Digest != rightDocument.Digest {
			return false
		}
	}
	return true
}

func projectExportPlan(sourceRoot, destinationParent, name string, sourceIdentity, destinationIdentity exportIdentity, observation exportObservation, sourceRevision string) ProjectExportPlan {
	documents := make([]ProjectExportDocument, len(observation.documents))
	for index, document := range observation.documents {
		documents[index] = document.ProjectExportDocument
	}
	plan := ProjectExportPlan{APIVersion: projectExportAPIVersion, Kind: "ProjectExportPlan", SourceProjectRoot: sourceRoot, SourceProjectRevision: sourceRevision, DestinationParent: destinationParent, DirectoryName: name, DestinationRoot: filepath.Join(destinationParent, name), Documents: documents, AggregateSize: observation.total, ExcludedCategories: []string{"DRAFT", "RUNTIME_CREDENTIALS", "GENERATED_STATE", "RUNTIME_STATE", "PLANS", "FACTS", "LOGS", "RESULTS", "VERIFICATION_EVIDENCE"}}
	input := []byte(plan.APIVersion + "\x00" + sourceIdentity.String() + "\x00" + destinationIdentity.String() + "\x00" + plan.SourceProjectRevision + "\x00" + plan.DestinationRoot + "\x00")
	for _, document := range documents {
		input = append(input, []byte(document.LogicalPath)...)
		input = append(input, 0)
		input = append(input, []byte(document.Digest)...)
		input = append(input, 0)
		input = append(input, []byte(strconv.FormatInt(document.Size, 10))...)
		input = append(input, 0)
	}
	sum := sha256.Sum256(input)
	plan.PlanDigest = "sha256:" + hex.EncodeToString(sum[:])
	return plan
}

func cloneProjectExportPlan(plan ProjectExportPlan) ProjectExportPlan {
	plan.Documents = append([]ProjectExportDocument(nil), plan.Documents...)
	plan.ExcludedCategories = append([]string(nil), plan.ExcludedCategories...)
	return plan
}

func absoluteExportDisplayPath(value string) (string, error) {
	if value == "" {
		return "", errors.New("invalid path")
	}
	absolute, err := filepath.Abs(value)
	if err != nil {
		return "", err
	}
	return filepath.Clean(absolute), nil
}

func rootsOverlap(left, right string) bool {
	leftToRight, leftErr := filepath.Rel(left, right)
	rightToLeft, rightErr := filepath.Rel(right, left)
	leftContainsRight := leftErr == nil && (leftToRight == "." || (leftToRight != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(leftToRight, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))))
	rightContainsLeft := rightErr == nil && (rightToLeft == "." || (rightToLeft != ".." && !strings.HasPrefix(rightToLeft, ".."+string(filepath.Separator))))
	return leftContainsRight || rightContainsLeft
}

func writeExportObservation(staging *exportDirectory, observation exportObservation) error {
	created := map[string]*exportDirectory{"": staging}
	defer func() {
		for logical, directory := range created {
			if logical != "" {
				directory.close()
			}
		}
	}()
	for _, document := range observation.documents {
		parent := path.Dir(document.LogicalPath)
		directory, err := ensureExportDirectory(staging, parent, created)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		if err := directory.writeFile(path.Base(document.LogicalPath), document.content); err != nil {
			return err
		}
	}
	return nil
}

func ensureExportDirectory(root *exportDirectory, logical string, created map[string]*exportDirectory) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	if logical == "." || logical == "" {
		return root, nil
	}
	current, currentLogical := root, ""
	for _, part := range strings.Split(logical, "/") {
		if currentLogical == "" {
			currentLogical = part
		} else {
			currentLogical += "/" + part
		}
		if known, ok := created[currentLogical]; ok {
			current = known
			continue
		}
		next, err := current.createDirectory(part)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
		created[currentLogical], current = next, next
	}
	return current, nil
}

func verifyExportObservation(staging *exportDirectory, expected exportObservation) error {
	actual, err := observeExportProject(staging)
	if err != nil || !sameExportContentObservation(actual, expected) {
		return errors.New("EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED")
	}
	return nil
}

func exportErrorCode(err error, fallback string) string {
	if err == nil {
		return fallback
	}
	for _, code := range []string{"PROJECT_CHANGED", "EXPORT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED", "EXPORT_SOURCE_UNSAFE", "EXPORT_DESTINATION_UNSAFE", "EXPORT_WRITE_FAILED", "EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED"} {
		if err.Error() == code {
			return code
		}
	}
	return fallback
}

// Export/import callers still need the bytes. Revision callers use streamFile
// through the same handle-relative, no-links and before/after identity guards.
func (directory *exportDirectory) readFile(parts []string, limit int64) ([]byte, exportFileIdentity, error) {
	var content bytes.Buffer
	_, identity, err := directory.streamFile(parts, limit, &content)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, exportFileIdentity{}, err
	}
	return content.Bytes(), identity, nil
}

package installer

import (
	"crypto/rand"
	"encoding/hex"
	"errors"
	"io"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"sort"
	"strings"

	"golang.org/x/sys/unix"
)

type exportIdentity struct {
	device uint64
	inode  uint64
}

func (identity exportIdentity) empty() bool { return identity.device == 0 && identity.inode == 0 }
func (identity exportIdentity) String() string {
	return hex.EncodeToString([]byte{byte(identity.device), byte(identity.device >> 8), byte(identity.device >> 16), byte(identity.device >> 24), byte(identity.device >> 32), byte(identity.device >> 40), byte(identity.device >> 48), byte(identity.device >> 56), byte(identity.inode), byte(identity.inode >> 8), byte(identity.inode >> 16), byte(identity.inode >> 24), byte(identity.inode >> 32), byte(identity.inode >> 40), byte(identity.inode >> 48), byte(identity.inode >> 56)})
}

type exportFileIdentity struct {
	exportIdentity
	links uint64
}

type exportDirectory struct{ fd int }

type exportEntryKind uint8

const (
	exportEntryDirectory exportEntryKind = iota + 1
	exportEntryRegular
)

type exportEntry struct {
	name string
	kind exportEntryKind
}

func openExportSourceDirectory(root string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	return openExportUnixRoot(root)
}
func openExportDestinationDirectory(root string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	return openExportUnixRoot(root)
}

func openExportUnixRoot(root string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	if !filepath.IsAbs(root) {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export root")
	}
	fd, err := unix.Open("/", unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	directory := &exportDirectory{fd: fd}
	if err := directory.verify(); err != nil {
		directory.close()
		return nil, err
	}
	relative := strings.TrimPrefix(filepath.Clean(root), string(filepath.Separator))
	if relative == "" {
		directory.close()
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export root")
	}
	opened, err := directory.openDirectory(strings.Split(relative, string(filepath.Separator)))
	directory.close()
	return opened, err
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) close() {
	if directory != nil && directory.fd >= 0 {
		_ = unix.Close(directory.fd)
		directory.fd = -1
	}
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) verify() error {
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if directory == nil || directory.fd < 0 || unix.Fstat(directory.fd, &stat) != nil || stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFDIR {
		return errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	return nil
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) identity() exportIdentity {
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if directory == nil || directory.fd < 0 || unix.Fstat(directory.fd, &stat) != nil {
		return exportIdentity{}
	}
	return exportIdentity{device: uint64(stat.Dev), inode: stat.Ino}
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) openDirectory(parts []string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	if directory == nil || directory.fd < 0 {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	current, owned := directory.fd, false
	for _, part := range parts {
		next, err := unix.Openat(current, part, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_DIRECTORY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
		if err != nil {
			if owned {
				_ = unix.Close(current)
			}
			return nil, exportUnixNotExist(err)
		}
		if owned {
			_ = unix.Close(current)
		}
		current, owned = next, true
	}
	if !owned {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	child := &exportDirectory{fd: current}
	if err := child.verify(); err != nil {
		child.close()
		return nil, err
	}
	return child, nil
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) entries() ([]exportEntry, error) {
	duplicate, err := unix.Dup(directory.fd)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(duplicate), "export-directory")
	if file == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(duplicate)
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	entries, err := file.ReadDir(maxExportDirectoryEntries + 1)
	closeErr := file.Close()
	if (err != nil && !errors.Is(err, io.EOF)) || closeErr != nil || len(entries) > maxExportDirectoryEntries {
		return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
	}
	result := make([]exportEntry, 0, len(entries))
	for _, entry := range entries {
		name := entry.Name()
		if name == "" || name == "." || name == ".." {
			return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
		}
		child, directoryErr := directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
		if directoryErr == nil {
			child.close()
			result = append(result, exportEntry{name: name, kind: exportEntryDirectory})
			continue
		}
		fd, fileErr := unix.Openat(directory.fd, name, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
		if fileErr != nil {
			return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
		}
		var stat unix.Stat_t
		valid := unix.Fstat(fd, &stat) == nil && stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT == unix.S_IFREG
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		if !valid {
			return nil, errors.New("unsafe export directory")
		}
		result = append(result, exportEntry{name: name, kind: exportEntryRegular})
	}
	sort.Slice(result, func(left, right int) bool { return result[left].name < result[right].name })
	return result, nil
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) streamFile(parts []string, limit int64, output io.Writer, preview ...*previewAssetRead) (int64, exportFileIdentity, error) {
	if len(parts) == 0 {
		return 0, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	parent := directory
	var owned *exportDirectory
	if len(parts) > 1 {
		var err error
		owned, err = directory.openDirectory(parts[:len(parts)-1])
		if err != nil {
			return 0, exportFileIdentity{}, err
		}
		defer owned.close()
		parent = owned
	}
	fd, err := unix.Openat(parent.fd, parts[len(parts)-1], unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if err != nil {
		return 0, exportFileIdentity{}, exportUnixNotExist(err)
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), parts[len(parts)-1])
	if file == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return 0, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	defer file.Close()
	identity, size, err := exportUnixFileIdentity(fd)
	if err != nil || identity.links != 1 {
		return 0, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	if limit > 0 && size > limit {
		return 0, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("EXPORT_LIMIT_EXCEEDED")
	}
	if len(preview) != 0 && preview[0].lookup(file) {
		return size, identity, nil
	}
	var reader io.Reader = file
	if limit > 0 {
		reader = io.LimitReader(file, limit+1)
	}
	count, err := io.Copy(output, reader)
	if err != nil || count != size {
		return 0, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	after, afterSize, afterErr := exportUnixFileIdentity(fd)
	if afterErr != nil || after != identity || afterSize != size ||
		(len(preview) != 0 && !preview[0].unchanged(file)) {
		return 0, exportFileIdentity{}, errors.New("PROJECT_CHANGED")
	}
	return count, identity, nil
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) exists(name string) (bool, error) {
	child, directoryErr := directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
	if directoryErr == nil {
		child.close()
		return true, nil
	}
	fd, fileErr := unix.Openat(directory.fd, name, unix.O_RDONLY|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0)
	if fileErr == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return true, nil
	}
	if isExportNotExist(exportUnixNotExist(directoryErr)) && isExportNotExist(exportUnixNotExist(fileErr)) {
		return false, nil
	}
	return false, errors.New("unsafe export destination")
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) createStaging(_ string) (*exportDirectory, string, error) {
	for attempt := 0; attempt < 16; attempt++ {
		value := make([]byte, 12)
		if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
			return nil, "", err
		}
		name := ".platform-export-" + hex.EncodeToString(value)
		if err := unix.Mkdirat(directory.fd, name, 0o700); err == nil {
			staging, openErr := directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
			if openErr != nil {
				return nil, "", openErr
			}
			return staging, name, nil
		} else if !errors.Is(err, unix.EEXIST) {
			return nil, "", err
		}
	}
	return nil, "", errors.New("staging name collision")
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) createDirectory(name string) (*exportDirectory, error) {
	if err := unix.Mkdirat(directory.fd, name, 0o700); err != nil {
		return nil, err
	}
	return directory.openDirectory([]string{name})
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) writeFile(name string, content []byte) error {
	fd, err := unix.Openat(directory.fd, name, unix.O_WRONLY|unix.O_CREAT|unix.O_EXCL|unix.O_NOFOLLOW|unix.O_CLOEXEC, 0o600)
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	file := os.NewFile(uintptr(fd), name)
	if file == nil {
		_ = unix.Close(fd)
		return errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	if _, err := file.Write(content); err != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		return err
	}
	if err := file.Sync(); err != nil {
		_ = file.Close()
		return err
	}
	return file.Close()
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) publish(_ *exportDirectory, stagingName, destination string) error {
	return unix.Renameat2(directory.fd, stagingName, directory.fd, destination, unix.RENAME_NOREPLACE)
}

func (directory *exportDirectory) removeOwnedTree(staging *exportDirectory, stagingName string) error {
	linked, err := directory.openDirectory([]string{stagingName})
	if err != nil {
		return err
	}
	linkedIdentity, stagingIdentity := linked.identity(), staging.identity()
	linked.close()
	if linkedIdentity != stagingIdentity {
		return errors.New("EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED")
	}
	// Linux has no unlink-by-open-directory-handle primitive. A pathname-based
	// recursive cleanup could delete a sibling swapped in after the identity
	// check above, so fail closed and leave staging for operator cleanup.
	return errors.New("EXPORT_STAGING_RETAINED")
}

func exportUnixFileIdentity(fd int) (exportFileIdentity, int64, error) {
	var stat unix.Stat_t
	if err := unix.Fstat(fd, &stat); err != nil || stat.Mode&unix.S_IFMT != unix.S_IFREG {
		return exportFileIdentity{}, 0, errors.New("unsafe export file")
	}
	return exportFileIdentity{exportIdentity: exportIdentity{device: uint64(stat.Dev), inode: stat.Ino}, links: uint64(stat.Nlink)}, stat.Size, nil
}

func exportUnixNotExist(err error) error {
	if errors.Is(err, unix.ENOENT) || errors.Is(err, unix.ENOTDIR) {
		return os.ErrNotExist
	}
	return err
}

func isExportNotExist(err error) bool { return errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) }
